description.value: Magical darkness spreads from a point you choose within range to fill a 15-foot-radius sphere for the duration. The darkness spreads around corners. A creature with darkvision can't see through this darkness, and nonmagical light can't illuminate it. While you are within the spell's area of darkness, you can see normally as though it were not there.

If the point you choose is on an object you are holding or one that isn't being worn or carried, the darkness emanates from the object and moves with it. Completely covering the source of the darkness with an opaque object, such as a bowl or a helm, blocks the darkness.
If any of this spell's area overlaps with an area of light created by a spell of 3rd level or lower, the spell that created the light is dispelled.
**Replaces:** __Sword Burst__

You conjure a ring of blades to slash or stab at your foes. All other creatures within 5 feet of you must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take **1d6** slashing or piercing damage (your choice).
This spell's damage increases by **1d6** when you reach 5th level (**2d6**), 11th level (**3d6**), and 17th level (**4d6**).

You create a blade-shaped planar rift about 3 feet long in an unoccupied space you can see within range. The blade lasts for the duration. When you cast this spell, you can make up to two melee spell attacks with the blade, each one against a creature, loose object, or structure within 5 feet of the blade. On a hit, the target takes **8d12** force damage. This attack scores a critical hit if the number on the d20 is 18 or higher. On a critical hit, the blade deals an extra **8d12** force damage (for a total of **16d12** force damage).
As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the blade up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see and then make up to two melee spell attacks with it again.
The blade can harmlessly pass through any barrier, including a Wall of Force.

A column of disembodied gnashing teeth appears in your hand in the shape of a sword. When you cast the spell, or as an action on your turn, you can make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of you. On a hit, the target takes slashing damage equal to 2d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier and must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of you for the duration of this spell.
A creature frightened by this spell can make a Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a success, it is no longer frightened of you.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 2nd.

You empower the weapon used in the spell's casting, unleashing a flurry of blows. When you cast this spell, make a melee attack with the weapon used in the spell's casting against any number of creatures within 5 feet of you, making a separate attack roll for each creature. On a hit, a target suffers the weapon attack's normal effects plus an additional **1d8** force damage.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the bonus damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 2nd.

You touch a melee weapon, imbuing it with the power to steal the vitality from your enemies. The next time a creature successfully hits with a melee weapon attack using that weapon, it deals an additional 2d12 necrotic damage, the creature gains temporary hit points equal to the additional necrotic damage dealt and the spell ends.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the bonus damage increases by 1d12 for each slot level above 3rd.
You trace a sigil of warding into the air. Whenever you take bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage for the duration of this spell, you can reduce the damage you would take by 1d4.

A sword made entirely of elemental fire bursts into existence, orbiting around you. Whenever a hostile creature moves within 5 feet of you for the first time on a turn, one of the swords strikes at it. When a sword strikes at a creature, the target must make a Dexterity saving throw. A target takes **2d10** fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. As a bonus action on your turn, you either can create another sword or command one of your existing swords to strike at a creature within 30 feet of you. Once a sword strikes at a creature, either from your command or from a creature moving within 5 feet of you, it ceases to exist.

When this spell ends, any remaining swords you have explode outward in a burst of fire. Each creature of your choice in a 10-foot radius sphere centered on you must make a Dexterity saving throw. A target takes 1d10 fire damage for each remaining sword on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
You may have a maximum of three swords at a time.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the maximum number of swords you can have summoned at a time, as well as the number ofswords you create when you cast this spell, increases byone for each spell level above 1st.

As you finish casting this spell, you are filled with a magical finesse, as every movement you make with your weapon seems beautiful and full of flourish. On the turn you cast this spell, or as a bonus action while the spell lasts, you can empower the next melee weapon attack you make this turn. When you hit a creature with an empowered melee weapon attack, the target must succeed on an Intelligence saving throw or have disadvantage on any attack roll or ability check it makes before the end of its next turn.

You draw upon magic in its purest form, causing a wave of invisible energy to blast outward from a point you choose within range. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a Dexterity saving throw. A target takes **6d4** force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 2d4 foreach slot level above 2nd.

Your body ignites in magical flames, leaving you and your equipment unharmed but burning those that approach you. When a creature gets within 5 feet of you for the first time on a turn or starts its turn within 5 feet of you, it takes **1d8** fire damage.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st.

name: Bless
components: V, S, M (a Holy Symbol worth 5+ GP)

description.value: You bless up to three creatures within range. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target adds 1d4 to the attack roll or save. Do not add it if a positive bonus has already been applied to the roll by a spell.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.
While this spell lasts, if you fail a saving throw you may choose to succeed instead. Once you have chosen to succeed on one failed saving throw this spell ends.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level, the number of times you may choose to succeed on a failed saving throw before this spell ends increases to two. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 9th level, the number of times you may choose to succeed on a failed saving throw before this spell ends increases to three.

You expel a blast of blinding radiance. Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes **4d8** radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. In addition, a creature that fails its saving throw is blinded until the end of its next turn. If it fails this save by 5 or more, it is blinded for 1 minute instead. A creature blinded by this spell can make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect for itself on a success.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 foreach slot level above 4th.

name: Blinding Smite (Alternate)
components: V, M (a melee weapon worth at least 1 sp)

description.value: When you hit with a melee weapon attack you can cause the weapon to flare with an overwhelming blinding light. This attack deals **3d8** bonus radiant damage, and the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or become blinded until the spell ends. The target can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
If your target is a fiend or undead, or if it has the sunlight sensitivity trait, the bonus radiant damage increases by **1d8**.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd-level or higher, the radiant damage increases by **1d8** for each spell slot level above 2nd.

Make a ranged spell attack against a creature you can see in range. On a hit, the target takes **3d8** acid damage and is blinded for 1 minute. A creature blinded by this spell can use an action to clear their eyes and end the blinded condition.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 2nd.
You touch a willing creature to grant it the ability to sense its surroundings. For the duration, that creature has blindsight out to a range of 30 feet.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the blindsight granted by this spell increases by 30 feet for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Blistering Radiance
components: V, S, M (a bit of tinder and a small lens)

description.value: You hurl a ball of light towards a point you can see in range, which erupts into a brilliant sphere of scorching light. Each creature in a 50-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a Constitution saving throw or be blinded for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, a creature blinded by this spell can make a Constitution saving throw, ending the blinded condition on a success.

When a creature enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, that creature must make a Constitution saving throw. The creature takes 5d10 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
If any of this spell's area overlaps with an area of darkness created by a spell of 6th level or lower, the spell that created the darkness is dispelled

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 foreach slot level above 6th.

name: Blizzard Shape
components: V, S, M (a handful of powder)

description.value: A willing creature you touch gets surrounded by a blizzard. While surrounded, the target gains a fly speed of 60 feet, and it can hover. The target has resistance to Cold damage. When the target moves within 5 feet of another creature for the first time that turn, it will take **1d6** Cold damage.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you may target an additional creature for each slot level above 4.

You touch a willing creature, filling them with a primal fury. Until the spell ends, the target cannot cast spells or concentrate on them and has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened. Whenever the target makes a melee weapon attack or damage roll, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the attack roll or damage roll. This spell ends early if the target is knocked unconscious or if their turn ends and they haven't attacked a hostile creature since their last turn or taken damage since then.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spellslot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional.creature for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Blood Print
components: V, S, M (an ounce or more of blood)

description.value: At your touch, wet blood on a surface shifts and reforms into a pattern of crimson blotches. This blood print is unique to the particular creature to whom the blood belongs, but you can determine the creature's kind (such as Human, Gnoll, Deer, or Fire Giant) by examining the general shape. A print can be preserved by pressing a sheet of paper against it. If this spell is cast twice, it is possible to match blood samples originating from the same creature.

You cause a stifling wind to tear across the landscape, emanating from your outstretched arms in a 60 foot cone and lacerating those caught in the gale. Each creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make a Strength saving throw or take 10d6 slashing damage and be pushed 15 feet away from you. A creature pushed by this spell is knocked prone if it is Medium or smaller. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and is not pushed.
Any creature in this spell's area must spend 2 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves when moving closer to you.
This wind disperses gas or vapor, and it extinguishes candles, torches, and other flames in the area (including protected flames, such as those of lanterns).
As a bonus action on each of your turns before the spell ends, you can change the direction in which the cone emanates from you.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 foreach slot level above 6th.

A blue-tinged ball of energy hovers above your hand, slowly turning red as your foes have their blood turned into pure water. Up to five creatures you can see within range must make a Constitution saving throw when you cast this spell and at the start of each of your turns for as long as this spell lasts and the target is still within 30 feet of you when your turns starts. A target takes 12d6 necrotic damage and gain one level of exhaustion on a failed save. On a successful save they take half as much damage, gain one level of exhaustion and this spell has no further effect on them.
This spell has no effect on creatures without blood, such as Constructs, Elementals, Oozes, Plants and Undead.

You choose a willing creature you can see within range. The next melee weapon attack that creature makes on its turn can strike enemies as though their reach were 10 feet greater than normal. This range increases to 15 feet when you reach 5th level, 20 feet when you reach 11th level, and 25 feet when you reach 17th level.

name: Bloodhound
components: V, S, M (something belonging to the target)

description.value: For the duration of this spell, a creature of your choice has a +10 bonus to Wisdom (Survival) checks to track the target designated when you cast this spell.

name: Bloodstar
components: V, S, M (a ruby worth at least 30 gp)

description.value: You summon a small, intangible blood-red crystal to hover at a point of your choice within range to siphon the blood from your enemies wounds. When you cast this spell, you can designate any number of creatures you can see to be unaffected by it. The bloodstar sheds red-tinted light, providing dim light in a 30-foot radius area. Whenever an affected creature within this radius takes damage it must make a Constitution saving throw or take 4d10 necrotic damage and have its max HP reduced by the amount of necrotic damage taken. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage. A creature can only take damage from Bloodstar once per round.
As a bonus action on your turn, you may move the Bloodstar to any location within range.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 4th.

name: Bodak's Glare
components: V, S, M (a black onyx skull worth at least 500 gp)

description.value: You attempt to drain the life from nearby creatures with a baleful glare. Each creature in a 60-foot cone must make a Constitution saving throw, taking **12d10** psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the target fails its save by 5 or more it is reduced to 0 hit points unless it is immune to the frightened condition. Any creature of challenge rating 3 or less (or level 3 or less, if it doesn't have a challenge rating) that fails this save is instantly slain unless it is immune to the frightened condition.
A Humanoid that is slain by this spell rises as a bodak 24 hours later unless the target is restored to life or its body is destroyed. Your GM has the creatures' statistics.

You cause razor-sharp spikes to erupt from your body and limbs. They appear metallic but are not actually metal and do not interfere with your movement or spellcasting. You are proficient with these weapons, which count as melee martial weapons that deal 1d6 piercing or slashing damage. When you make an attack using these blades you can use your spellcasting ability modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity for the attack and damage rolls.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level, the blades you create have a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls. When you use a spell slot of 4th level, the bonus increases to +2. When you use a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the bonus increases to +3.

You choose one creature to suffer from discordant energies. Choose one ability score when you cast the spell. The target has disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws made with the chosen ability score. As a bonus action on your turn, you may choose a different ability score to affect.

You draw upon the power of the sun, causing your body to emanate fire. Until the spell ends, fire radiates from your body in all directions, creating a 5-foot aura of flame around you. When a creature enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, that creature must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes **2d6** fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. You are unaffected by the flames.
The fires emanating from your body provide bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 foreach slot level above 2nd. When you cast this spell using aspell slot of 5th level or higher, the light created by thisspell is sunlight

name: Body of War
components: V, S, M (a miniature bronze hammer)

description.value: This spell transforms you into the form of a __Warforged Titan__ (the GM has the creatures' statistics). The transformation lasts for the duration, or until you drop to 0 hit points or dies. Your game statistics, including mental ability scores, are replaced by the statistics of a Warforged Titan. You retain your alignment and personality.

You assume the hit points of your new form. When you revert to your normal form, you return to the number of hit damage doesn't reduce your normal form to 0 hit points, you aren't knocked unconscious.
You are limited in the actions you can perform by the nature of your new form, and you can't speak, cast spells, or take any other action that requires hands or speech.
Your gear melds into the new form. You can't activate, use, wield, or otherwise benefit from any of your equipment. As an action on your turn, you can choose to end this spell and transform back.

When you cast this spell, your ability to concentrate on spells you cast is enhanced. For the duration, you have advantage on Constitution saving throws you make to maintain your *Concentration* on a spell.

You fire a bolt of pure white energy toward a creature of your choice within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 6d10 + 40 radiant damage. If the creature is Undead or a Fiend, it continues to burn with radiant energy, taking an additional **4d6** radiant damage at the end of its next turn.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the initial damage increases by2d10 and the extra damage against Undead and Fiendsincreases by 1d6 for each slot level above 6th.

You fire a black bolt of energy from your finger at a creature you can see in range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 4d12 psychic damage and must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure the creature is stunned until the end of its next turn.
On each of your turns while the spell lasts, you can use your action to fire another bolt, targeting the same creature or a different one.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 5th.

name: Bombardment
components: V, S, M (a quartz crystal embedded into a rock)

description.value: You choose a point you can see in range, causing boulders to tumble into being, burying those beneath them. centered on that point must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes **8d10** bludgeoning damage and is buried under 5 feet of rubble on a failed save. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and is not buried.

A creature buried by this spell is restrained and has total cover. As an action on its turn, a buried creature can attempt to free itself with a Strength (Athletics) check with a DC equal to your spell save DC. If another creature wishes to free a buried creature, It takes one minute of digging for a single creature to dig out a buried creature.
After this spell is cast, the area is covered by 5 feet of dense rubble, which is considered difficult terrain.

name: Bonefiddle
components: V, S, M (a miniature silver fiddle)

description.value: You call up a ghostly fiddle bow in the air above the targeted creature, which immediately descends into the targets body and begins to saw back and forth against its skeleton. At the start of each of its turns, the target must succeed on a Constitution saving or take 3d6 slashing damage. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and the spell ends. So long as the spell lasts an eerily beautiful tune, audible from as far away as 300 feet, emanates from the target. Creatures have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing to locate the target and any creature with hearing that comes within 10 feet of the target can automatically pinpoint its location.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Booming Blade
components: S, M (a melee weapon worth at least 1 sp)

description.value: You brandish the weapon used in the spell's casting and make a melee attack with it against one creature within 5 feet of you. On a hit, the target suffers the weapon attack's normal effects and then becomes sheathed in booming energy until the start of your next turn. If the target willingly moves 5 feet or more before then, the target takes **1d8** thunder damage, and the spell ends.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you reach 5th level, the melee attack deals an extra **1d8** thunder damage to the target on a hit, and the damage the target takes for moving increases to **2d8**. Both damage rolls increase by 1d8 at 11th level (**2d8** and **3d8**) and again at 17th level (**3d8** and **4d8**).

name: Booming Blade (Alternate)
components: V, M (a simple or martial melee weapon)

description.value: As a bonus action, you wreathe the melee weapon used in the casting of this spell with thunderous magic. Until the start of your next turn, your attacks with that weapon deal thunder damage in place of the weapon's normal damage type.

Once per casting when you deal thunder damage with this spell, you can envelop your target in thunderous energy until the start of your next turn. If the target willingly moves 5 feet or more before then, this thunderous energy explodes and it takes **1d6** thunder damage, then the energy dissipates.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The thunder damage dealt by this spell when the creature moves at least 5 feet increases at 5th level (**1d8**), 11th level (**1d10**), and 17th level (**1d12**).

name: Brain Spider
components: V, S, M (ink made from drider venom and moltings worth at least 500 gp, which the spell consumes)

description.value: This spell allows you to listen in on the thoughts of other creatures and manipulate their actions. When you cast this spell, you can choose up to 8 creatures you can see in range. While the spell lasts, you can use an action to eavesdrop on the thoughts of all 8 targets at once, learning any of the following pieces of information as desired:

• A creature's surface thoughts.
• A piece of information that the target knows about a specific topic, thing or being.
• The thoughts and memories of one creature of the group in detail.

As an action you can attempt to implant a suggestion into the mind of any one of the eight creatures. When you do so, the target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you may mentally suggest a reasonable course of action to the target, which is pursues to the best of its ability. The target continues to pursue the course of action until it is completed, or until the target takes damage, the spell ends or you give the same target another suggestion. On a successful save, the target is unaffected by this suggestion. A creature automatically succeeds on its saving throw if it can't be charmed.
You touch a nonmagical wooden weapon. Until the spell ends, that weapon sprouts sharp thorns, causing melee weapon attack to deal **1d4** piercing damage in addition to its normal damage.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th Level or higher, the bonus increases to 2d4. When you use a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the bonus increases to 3d4.

name: Branding Smite (Alternate)
components: V, M (a melee weapon worth at least 1 sp)

description.value: When you hit with a melee weapon attack you can cause the weapon to gleam with an otherworldly astral radiance. This attack deals **2d8** bonus radiant damage, and the target sheds dim light out to a 5-foot radius until the spell ends. The target also becomes visible if it was invisible and it cannot become invisible by magical or mundane means for the duration.
If your target is a fiend or undead, or if it has the sunlight sensitivity trait, the bonus radiant damage increases by **1d8**.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd-level or higher, the radiant damage increases by **1d8** for each spell slot level above 2nd.

name: Breath of Belladonna
components: S, M (three belladonna berries, which the spell consumes)

description.value: You consume the belladonna berries used as a Material component, taking 3 Poison damage, and breathe out a poisonous cloud. Each creature in a 15-foot Cube originating from you must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes **3d10** Poison damage and has the Poisoned condition until the start of your next turn. On a success, the creature takes half as much damage only. A creature that doesn't need to breathe automatically succeeds on its saving throw.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: If you use a level 3+ spell slot to cast this spell, the damage you deal increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 2. The damage you take doesn't increase.

With a word of power and a flick of your wrist, a foulsmelling mist appears. You create a 15-foot-radius sphere of poisonous mist centered on a point you choose within range. The mist spreads around corners. It lasts for the duration or until strong wind disperses the mist, ending the spell. Its area is lightly obscured. When a creature enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, that creature must make a Constitution saving throw. The creature is poisoned on a failed save and unaffected on a successful one. Creatures are affected even if they hold their breath or don't need to breathe.
**Replaces:** __Daylight__
A 60-foot-radius sphere of light spreads out from a point you choose within range. The sphere is bright light and sheds dim light for an additional 60 feet. This light isn't sunlight.

If you target a point on an object you are holding or one that isn't being worn or carried, the light shines from the object and moves with it. Completely covering the affected object with an opaque object, such as a bowl or a helm, blocks the light.

If any of this spell's area overlaps with an area of darkness created by a spell of its own level or lower, or an equivalent magical effect, the spell or effect that created the darkness is dispelled.

With a touch, you cause the weapons carried by a willing creature to burst forth with brilliant energy, transforming them partially into light and allowing them to pass through nonliving matter as though it weren't there. Until the spell ends, any melee or ranged weapon attack made by that creature against a target wearing armor has advantage, ignores cover and deals an additional **1d8** radiant damage. Weapons under the effects of Brilliant Aura have no effect on Undead, Constructs or objects.

A weapon loses the benefits of this spell if the creature ends its turn while not carrying that weapon, or another creature attempts to use the weapon. Additionally, the creature can use a bonus action on their turn to subdue this effect on a single weapon they carry until the start of their next turn.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, you may target one additional creature when casting this spell for each slot level above 5th.

You touch a creature, causing them to sprout long, deadly-looking spikes that respond to your mental commands. The spikes are flexible enough not to impede movement. Whenever a creature within 5 feet of the target hits the target with a melee attack you may use your reaction to cause the spikes to strike at the creature, dealing **2d6** piercing damage.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2nd.

Choose one creature within range. Until this spell ends, that creature has its jump distance increased by 5 feet, and its weight is reduced to one-half of normal If the creature is underwater, it rises 30 feet towards the surface at the start of each of its turns. If the creature is unwilling, it may make a Constitution saving throw. On a success, this spell does not affect it.

name: Burning Blade
components: S, M (a Melee weapon with which you have proficiency and that is worth 1+ CP)

description.value: Engulfing the weapon used in the spell's casting in flames, you make one attack. This attack and any other attacks you make using the weapon until the start of your next turn use your spellcasting ability for the attack and damage rolls instead of using Strength or Dexterity. If such an attack deals damage, it can be Fire damage or the weapon's normal damage type (your choice).

description.name: Cantrip Upgrade
description.value: Whether you deal Fire damage or the weapon's normal damage type, attacks you make using this weapon until the start of your next turn deal extra Fire damage when you reach levels 5 (1d6), 11 (2d6), and 17 (3d6).

name: Burning Blood
components: V, S, M (a drop of blood and a pinch of saltpeter)

description.value: You corrupt a creature's blood with a hot, corrosive infusion. Choose a creature within range that you can see. When you initially cast this spell and at the start of each of your turns while the spell lasts, target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes **2d6** acid damage and **2d6** fire damage and if the creature would regain hit points, it regains only half as many hit points until the start of your next turn. On a successful save it takes half as much damage and there is no additional effect.
This spell does not affect Constructs, Elementals, Oozes, Plants, or Undead.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the acid damage or the fire damage (your choice) increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 4th.
You touch a willing creature. The target gains a burrow speed of 60 feet for the duration.

name: Burrow
components: V, S, M (a claw from a burrowing creature)

description.value: You touch a willing creature. The target gains a burrow speed of 30 feet for the duration.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.
**Replaces:** __Pyrotechnics__

You summon up a fiery explosion, creating light, heat, or smoke. You may conjure the explosion at any point within 60 feet, but it will have added effect if you conjure it atop an existing nonmagical flame (extinguishing up to a 5 foot cube of flame). Choose one of the following effects.

• **Light:** You create a shower of sparks, blinding onlookers. Each creature in a 10-foot radius must make a Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of your next turn. If you target an existing flame, the radius increases to 20 feet.
• **Heat:** You conjure a blast of intense heat. Each creature in a 10-foot radius must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes **3d6 fire** damage, or half as much on a successful save. If you target an existing flame, the damage increases to **4d6**.
• **Smoke:** You create a 15-foot radius cloud of thick, oily smoke. It spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. If you target an existing flame, the radius is 30 feet. The cloud lasts for 1 minute or until dispersed by a strong breeze.

name: Buzzing Bee
components: V, S, M (a dab of honey)

description.value: A small but extremely loud spectral bee appears, buzzing around the head of a creature you can see in range. While the spell lasts, the target has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws that they make to maintain *Concentration* on a spell.
The bee follows the target in spite of darkness, invisibility, or any other attempts at hiding or concealment.
As a bonus action on your turn, you can direct the bee to switch targets to another creature you can see within 60 feet of the current target.

You cackle wildly at one creature within range that can hear you, unleashing the power of your scorn and animosity. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take **1d8** Psychic damage and have Disadvantage on the next ability check or saving throw based on Strength or Dexterity it makes before the start of your next turn.

description.name: Cantrip Upgrade
description.value: The damage increases by 1d8 when you reach levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

You cause a burst of discordant noise to erupt at a point of your choice within range. Each creature in a 20-footradius sphere centered on that point must make a Dexterity saving throw. A target takes **8d8** thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spellslot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 foreach slot level above 5th.

You create a barrier of sonic energy in a 10-foot radius sphere around yourself. The sphere is centered on you and moves with you. Creatures near the barrier hear it as a loud but harmless buzzing, audible up to 30 feet away. Sounds do not cross the barrier and ranged weapon attacks that cross the barrier in either direction have disadvantage. A creature that attempts to cross the barrier or ends its turn in the same space as it takes 3d12 thunder damage and must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is deafened for 1 minute. A creature deafened by this effect may repeat this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a successful save. If a creature crosses the barrier as a result of your movement, they do not take damage.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spellslot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d12 foreach slot level above 4th.
**Replaces:** __Planar Ally__

You seek assistance from a mighty extraplanar being - a god, archdevil, or other legendary and powerful creature. It sends one of its loyal servants to aid you, which appears in an unoccupied space within range.

When the creature appears, it is friendly but under no obligation to help you. It speaks at least one language you speak. It typically demands payment for its aid, in a form appropriate to the creature (for example, tithes for a celestial or sacrifices for a fiend). When payment has monetary value, it usually is 50 gp per minute, 500 gp per hour, or 5,000 gp per day. It may be decreased or increased as much as 50% depending on whether the extraplanar being endorses the task, or on the danger of the task. The cost usually increases when repeatedly summoning the same extraplanar being and may be free the first time if the being favors you.

Services can be anything appropriate to the creature summoned. Creatures will rarely agree to tasks that are suicidal, impossible, abhorrent, or especially lengthy. After the creature completes the task, or you are unable to satisfy its payment, it returns to its home plane.

You can call an allied Beast to your side in times of need, drawing on your reciprocal connection to the living things around you. When you summon this ally, choose its native environment: Air, Land, or Water. The creature uses the __Allied Hunter__ stat block and has the form of an animal native to the chosen environment, which determines certain traits in its stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends.

In combat, it shares your Initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, it defends itself against hostile creatures or takes the Dodge action, using its movement to avoid danger.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: When you cast this spell using a level 3+ spell slot, use the higher level wherever the spell's level appears in the stat block.

With a throwing gesture, coppery sparks spring from your palm to land at a location you can see within range. These caltrops cover the ground in a 5-foot cube. Any creature in the caltrops' space when you cast the spell must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d4 force damage. A creature must also make this saving throw when it enters the caltrops' space for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there. Until a creature damaged by Caltrops regains at least 1 hit point, or until the spell ends, its walking speed is reduced by 10 feet. This spell ends early if you cast it again.
The spell's damage increases by 1d4 when you reach 5th level (2d4), 11th level (3d4), and 17th level (4d4)

You summon a handful of hard candy—boiled sweets, mints, jelly beans, etc.—and hurl them at a creature you can see within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes **1d8** Force damage and the candy forms a pile on the ground in its space, causing a 5-foot-square area of your choice in the target's space to become Difficult Terrain. The candy produced by this pell is edible, but has no nutritional value, and vanishes after 1 minute, ending any Difficult Terrain.

description.name: Cantrip Upgrade
description.value: The damage increases by 1d8 when you reach levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

A 5-foot radius ball of swirling wind and dust appears in a point you can see in range, pushing your foes across the battlefield. When a creature enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, that creature must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes **4d8** bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and is not knocked prone.

The zephyr disperses gas or vapor, and it extinguishes candles, torches, and similar unprotected flames in the area. It causes protected flames, such as those of lanterns, to dance wildly and has a 50 percent chance to extinguish them.
As a bonus action, you can command the zephyr to move up to 30 feet in any direction.
**Replaces:** __Enthrall__

You enact a performance laced with subtle magic, your gestures and voice causing others to focus on you to the exclusion of all else. Creatures you choose within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you. If you or your companions are fighting a creature, it has advantage on the save. While charmed by you in this way, a creature has disadvantage on initiative rolls as well as Wisdom (Perception) checks made to perceive any creature other than you until the spell ends, or until the target can no longer see or hear you.

Additionally, if a creature rolls initiative while affected by this spell, its speed is reduced by 10 feet and it can't take reactions until after its first turn ends. The spell ends if you are incapacitated or can no longer speak. A creature that fails its saving throw doesn't realize that you used magic to influence it, even if it witnessed the spell being cast.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the duration increases by 1 minute and the radius increases by 10 feet for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Card Trick
components: V, S, M (a deck of playing cards)

description.value: With a flash of your hands, you fling a playing or tarot card charged with magical energy. Choose whether you make a ranged spell attack roll or if the target makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a hit or a failed saving throw, the target takes **1d8** Force damage.

description.name: Cantrip Upgrade
description.value: The damage increases by 1d8 when you reach levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

You attempt to turn any number of creatures that you can see within range to stone. Each target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it is restrained as its flesh begins to harden. On a successful save, the creature isn't affected.

A creature restrained by this spell must make another Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If it successfully saves against this spell three times, the spell ends for that creature. If it fails its saves three times against this spell, it is turned to stone and subjected to the petrified condition. The successes and failures don't need to be consecutive; keep track of both until the target collects three of either kind.
If the creature is physically broken while petrified, it suffers from similar injuries if it reverts to its original state.

You rebuke your foes with the conviction of your sacred words. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet that can hear you must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes **5d8** force damage and is deafened for 1 minute. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and is not deafened.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 4th.

The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before this spell ends, the attack deals an extra **1d8** psychic damage and the target must make a Wisdom saving throw as crackling energy surrounds it. On a failed save, the target has disadvantage on the next attack they make before the end of your next turn.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can increase the damage by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st.

One creature that you can see within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature gains the frightened condition against you for 1 minute. The frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

name: Caustic Quarrel
components: V, S, M (a bit of fool's gold, sulfur, and water)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Melf's Acid Arrow__

You conjure an arrow of acid and send it streaking towards a target within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes **6d4** acid damage and is coated in acid. An acid-coated target can use its action to wipe the acid off. If not, then at the end of its next turn, it takes an additional **4d4** acid damage.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, both instances of damage increase by **1d4** for each slot level above 2nd.

You begin to perform a captivating song, compelling those around to join in the revelry. Each creature of your choice within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature is distracted by your performance, causing it to have disadvantage on dexterity saving throws and attack rolls until the end of your next turn. If a creature is already distracted by this spell and fails its save, it additionally gains one level of exhaustion. If a creature fails its save while it has any levels of exhaustion, it instead falls unconscious and this spell no longer affects it. A creature regains consciousness if it takes any damage or another creature uses an action to shake or slap the unconscious creature awake.
On each of your turns while the spell lasts, you can use your action to cause each creature of your choice within range to repeat this saving throw.
Once a creature has succeeded on a saving throw against this spell, they are immune to its effects for the next hour. Creatures that can't be charmed are immune to this spell.

Your mind unleashes a mental thrust of overwhelming force in a 30-foot cone. Each creature within the area of this spell must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes **5d8** magical bludgeoning damage and is pushed 20 feet directly away from you, and falls prone. On a successful save, a creature takes half damage and remains in place.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th-level or higher, the magical bludgeoning damage increases by **1d8** for each spell slot level above 3rd.

name: Ceremony
components: V, S, M (25 gp worth of powdered silver, which the spell consumes)

description.value: Choose one of the following ceremonies. Decorations for that type of ceremony worth a total of 50 gp appear in locations of your choice within 15 ft of where you began casting this spell. After 24 hours the decorations disappear. Anyone who closely inspects the decorations can see that they are fake. Once within the duration while you and your targets are in the affected area you can use your action to perform the effect for this type of ceremony (listed below).

description.name: Atonement
description.value: You touch one willing creature whose alignment has changed, and you make a DC 20 Wisdom (Insight) check. On a successful check, you restore the target to its original alignment.

description.name: Bless Water
description.value: You touch one vial of water and cause it to become holy water.

description.name: Coming of Age
description.value: You touch one humanoid who is a young adult. For the next 24 hours, they cannot be aged (magically or otherwise). A creature can benefit from this rite only once.

description.name: Dedication
description.value: You touch one humanoid who wishes to be dedicated to your diety's service. Once within the next 24 hours when you cast a spell with a range of touch the creature can use their reaction to deliver the spell with their touch instead of yours if they are within 90 ft of you. A creature can benefit from this rite only once.

description.name: Funeral Rite
description.value: You touch one corpse, and for the next 7 days, the target can't become undead by any means short of a Wish spell.

description.name: Wedding
description.value: You touch willing adult humanoids. Each target can sense what other alive adult humanoids the other targets have married previously in this way. If the targets are still willing, they are bonded in marriage.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of second level or higher, the radius of the spell increases by 15 ft and the perceived price of the decorations is tripled for every spell slot above 1st.

You fire a salvo of magic missiles at a creature you can see in range, which ricochet upon striking your target. You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart hits the same creature, then ricochets to hit a second target you can see within 120 feet of the original target. You can direct these ricochets to hit one creature or several, so long as they are within range and are not the original target. Each dart deals **1d4 + 1** force damage to its target.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spellslot of 5th level or higher, the spell creates one more dartfor each slot above 4th.

With a touch, you can use another creature's vision instead of your own. An unwilling creature may make a Wisdom saving throw. On a successful saving throw this spell fails. While *Concentrating* on this spell, you may use a bonus action on your turn to switch between seeing with your own eyes or seeing through the eyes of a creature affected by this spell.

If an affected creature makes physical contact with another creature while you are seeing through its eyes, you may extend your Chain of Eyes to include the new creature. If the new creature is unwilling, it may make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is now affected by this spell. On a successful save the creature is unaffected by this casting of chain of eyes.
This spell may affect a maximum of three creatures at a time. If you attempt to extend your chain beyond this number, the oldest affected creature in the chain is no longer affected by this spell.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the maximum number of creatures you can affect increases by one for each slot above 3rd. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you may freely switch between seeing through the eyes of a creature affected by this spell with no action required.

name: Channel Craftsman
components: V, S, M (the insignia of a dead craftsman)

description.value: Choose a tool mastery. You can use two tool masteries when you make a tool check instead of one. It can be the same mastery twice. One of the tool masteries must be one of the tool masteries you chose. Undead creatures, creatures that can see through invisibility, and instant capturing of your likeness (such as reflections) perceive a spirit guiding your hand.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell at higher levels, increase the number of masteries you choose by 1 for each additional level.

You twist your fingers and fate seems to follow suit. Until the end of your next turn, you can reroll any ability check you make to play nonmagical games of skill. Therefore, this spell could influence a game of poker, but not the result of a Deck of Many Things.

name: Cheat
components: V, S, M (a pair of loaded dice)

description.value: You attempt to manipulate fate to alter the outcome of a game of chance. When you make an ability check while *Concentrating* on this spell, you may grant yourself advantage on the roll, provided it involves a mundane game of chance. If the game of chance involves magic items or magic other than this spell, then this spell ends and nothing happens.

Channeling the chill of the grave, make a melee spell attack against a target within reach. On a hit, the target takes **1d10** Necrotic damage, and it can't regain Hit Points until the end of your next turn.

description.name: Cantrip Upgrade
description.value: The damage increases by 1d10 when you reach levels 5 (**2d10**), 11 (**3d10**), and 17 (**4d10**).

Tracing a compass rose on the ground, you name another creature that you are familiar with as you make a wide circular sweep. The direction you are pointing in when you finish casting this spell is the direction the creature is located. Additionally, you get an impression of its current physical and emotional state. If the creature is hostile towards you, it may make a Charisma saving throw. On a successful save, you still know the direction the creature is located in, but do not any further information. If the creature you name is dead or on a different plane when you cast this spell, the spell fails.

name: Circle of Protection
components: V, S, M (a mixture of salt and silver powder worth at least 100 gp, which the spell consumes)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Magic Circle__

You draw a 10-foot radius circular glyph upon the ground, which projects upward into a luminous 30-foot tall cylinder. Select one of the following creature types when you draw the glyph: aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, or undead. A challenge rating 5 or lower creature of the chosen type can't willingly move across the cylinder's boundary. When the creature attempts to make an attack, cast a spell, use teleportation or interplanar travel, or cause any other effect across the boundary, it must first succeed on a Charisma saving throw.
Whenever you start casting the spell, you can modify it so that it doesn't require *Concentration*. If you do so, the spell's casting time becomes 10 minutes for that casting.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the maximum challenge rating of affected creatures increases by 3 for each slot level above 3rd. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th or 6th level, the duration is *concentration*, up to 12 hours. When cast using a spell slot of 7th or 8th level, the duration is *concentration*, up to 24 hours. When cast using a 9th-level spell slot, the spell lasts until dispelled, and there is no challenge rating limit on affected creatures.
You touch a willing creature, ending one effect that charmed or frightened the target. For the next minute, that creature has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

You draw material from the Plane of Shadow, causing your hands and forearms to elongate and change shape into featureless claws of inky blackness. When you cast the spell, or as an action on your turn, you may make a melee spell attack against a creature within 10 feet of you. On a hit, the creature takes 2d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier cold damage and must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, that creature's speed is halved and it can't take reactions until the start of your next turn.
While *Concentrating* on this spell, you cannot cast any spells that require somatic or material components.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Cleansing Crystal
components: V, S, M (a gem worth at least 50 gp)

description.value: You imbue a crystal with magic to absorb harmful influences. For the duration of the spell, when a creature carrying the crystal would take damage as a result of a spell or magical effect in the space it occupies at the start of its turn, the crystal reduces the damage it takes by 2d6. When the creature would make a saving throw to avoid an effect based on the space it occupies at the start of its turn, it has Advantage on the saving throw.

For the spell's duration, when a creature carrying the crystal would take Necrotic, Poison, or Psychic damage, you can end the spell as a Reaction to give the creature Resistance to the triggering damage type until the end of its next turn.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: When you cast this spell using a level 4+ spell slot, creatures within 10 feet of the crystal also gain its benefits.

You cloak yourself and any number of allies within 60 feet of you in a glittering mantle of magic that bolsters their courage. Creatures of your choice within this aura have advantage on saves against being frightened.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, affected creatures cannot be frightened.

You create a dusky haze around a creature in range. This haze does not interfere with vision, but the target and anything it is wearing or carrying are protected from the sun. For the duration of the spell, the target suffers no ill effects from being in sunlight or bright light. Additionally, any items the target is carrying that would be harmed by exposure to sunlight are unaffected while this spell lasts.
With a touch you imbue a creature with a blue-green aura. While underwater, the target gains the following benefits:

• The target can breathe underwater in addition to its normal mode of respiration.
• Any creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against the target. An attacker is immune to this effect if it doesn't rely on sight, as with blindsight, or can see through illusions, as with truesight.
• The target's movement is unaffected by difficult terrain, and spells and spells and other magical effects can neither reduce the target's speed nor cause the target to be paralyzed or restrained.
When out of water, even partially, the creature gains none of these advantages. The creature can enter or leave water without ending this spell.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 5th.

name: Close Wounds
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when you see a creature within 60 feet of you take damage

description.value: A creature of your choice that you can see within range that has just taken damage from any source regains hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spellslot of 2nd level or higher, the Healing increases by 1d4 foreach slot level above 1st.

name: Cloud Jump
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when a willing creature you can see within 30ft moves

description.value: You create a cloud for the target to momentarily step on. If the target is currently jumping, they can change the direction of their jump and can move up to 5 ft in a straight line without spending movement.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell at a higher level, increase the distance they move by 5 ft for every additional level.

You create a small cloud of noxious, disorienting vapors in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range. The sphere spreads around corners and its area is heavily obscured. It lasts for the duration or until a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses it. Any creature that ends its turn in the area of this spell must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save the creature has disadvantage on ability checks as long as it remains in the cloud and for 1d4 + 1 rounds after leaving.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the radius of the cloud increases by 20 feet for each slot level above 2nd.

You touch a willing creature, causing mist to form in the shape of wings on the creature's back. If the creature has a fly speed, that speed is increased by 30 feet. If the creature cannot already fly, then this spell does nothing.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

You cause gaseous shrouds of cloudstuff to form around the feet of any number of willing creatures within range. For the duration of this spell, each of those creatures gains a flying speed of 60 feet. Additionally, targets are lightly obscured from creatures directly below them.

If a creature is flying when the effect ends, the creature descends 60 feet per round for 1 minute until it lands, which it does safely. If it can't land after 1 minute, the creature falls the remaining distance.

You cause clouds to gather above a point of your choice in range and a heavy rain begins to fall in a 100-foot radius, 300-foot cylinder focused on that point. The rain causes the area to be lightly obscured. It automatically extinguishes unprotected flames and has a 50% chance of extinguishing protected flames.
This spell does not function indoors, underground, underwater, or in desert climates. After the spell ends, the water created evaporates over the next 10 minutes.

name: Clue
components: V, S, M (a magnifying glass and pipe)

description.value: When you cast this spell, all footprints and fingerprints within a 30-foot Emanation originating from you become highlighted and glow faintly for the duration. When you cast the spell, choose any point in time up to 10 days ago. Only footprints and fingerprints left between that time and the present will be highlighted. Each creature that leaves footprints and fingerprints is assigned a unique color, but are not otherwise identified. Any creature that moves or touches objects within the Emanation will also leave colorful footprints and fingerprints, which might reveal invisible creatures in the area.

You attempt to crush the heart of a humanoid that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, a paralyzed target takes 4d8 necrotic damage and must make another Constitution saving throw. On a successful saving throw, this spell ends.

If the target dies while you are *Concentrating* on this spell, its smoking heart appears in your hand and each hostile creature within 30 feet of you that can see you must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, nothing happens. On a failed save, the creature becomes frightened of you for 1 minute. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Cocoon
components: V, S, M (a silkworm cocoon, which the spell consumes)

description.value: You touch a dead humanoid or a piece of a dead humanoid. Provided that the creature has been dead no longer than 10 days, silk threads begin to coalesce from thin air around the target until it is fully encased. For the next 10 days, this spell preserves the body and begins the slow process of rebirth.

While in the cocoon, the target is protected from decay and can't become undead. If someone casts a spell on the target that would raise it from the dead, the casting time is reduced to 1 action and the spell requires no material components. The cocoon is immune to poison and psychic damage, has an AC of 10 and 1 hp. If the cocoon is destroyed, the spell ends.
If the spell lasts the full 10 days, it forms a new adult body for the target, which then calls the soul to enter that body. If the target's soul isn't free or willing to do so, the spell fails.

The magic fashions a new body for the creature to inhabit, which likely causes the creature's race to change. The GM rolls a d100 and consults the following table to determine what form the creature takes when restored to life, or the GM chooses a form.

You are able to change the flames of a fire into cold flames. Affected flames deal cold damage rather than fire damage to creatures that come into contact with them, including fires produced by magical sources. Flames affected by Cold Fire burn blue and white for the duration of the spell.

If the fire is part of a creature (a fire elemental, for example), then that creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 3d8 cold damage and this spell ends. On a successful save, the creature is unaffected.

This spell causes a powerful cold front to form in a 1-mile-radius from the location where you cast this spell, lowering the temperature in the affected area by 5 degrees every minute until the temperature reaches -20 degrees fahrenheit (the DMG has rules for the effects of extreme cold environments).
Spells that deal cold damage in the area of this spell while it lasts deal an additional **2d4** cold damage.
**Replaces:** __Snilloc's Snowball Swarm__

With a snap of your fingers, a swirling burst of freezing wind erupts at a point you choose within range. Each creature in a 5-foot radius sphere must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes **3d8** cold damage and becomes coated in ice, reducing its speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. On a success, it takes half as much damage and is not slowed.
The ground in the area is covered with slick ice and snow, making it difficult terrain until the start of your next turn.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by **1d8** for each slot level above 2nd.

You conjure a brightly glowing comet in the air above a point on the ground within range that you can see. It immediately strikes the ground, and every creature within 10 feet of the point of impact must make a Dexterity saving throw or take **11d6** fire damage and be knocked prone. On a successful save, a creature takes half damage and is not knocked prone.The comet breaks apart on impact, creating a field of dense rubble within 10 feet of the point of impact. This rubble is difficult terrain.You must cast this spell in an area with at least 40 feet of vertical space above the point of impact, or else the spell fails.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the damage increases by 2d6 for each slot level above 6th.
**Replaces:** __Dominate Beast__

You attempt to take control of a beast you can see within range. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration. A beast of challenge rating 4 or higher automatically succeeds on this saving throw. If you or creatures that are friendly to you are fighting it, it has advantage on the saving throw.

While the beast is charmed, you can issue telepathic commands to the creature while you are conscious (no action required), which it does its best to obey. You can specify a simple and general course of action, such as "Attack that creature," "Run over there," or "Fetch that object." If the creature completes the order and doesn't receive further direction from you, it defends and preserves itself to the best of its ability.

As an action, you can take full control of the target. Until the end of your next turn, the creature takes only the actions you choose, and doesn't do anything that you don't allow it to do. During this time, any reactions the creature takes require you to use your reaction as well.
Each time the target takes damage, it makes a new Wisdom saving throw against the spell. If the saving throw succeeds, the spell ends.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell with a spell slot of 4th level or higher, there is no challenge rating limit to the target creature.
**Replaces:** __Animate Objects__

You magically animate nearby objects, bending them to your will. Choose up to six nonmagical objects within range that are not being worn or carried. All objects must be the same size, and you can animate six Tiny, four Small, three Medium, two Large, or one Huge object(s). Each object animates until spell ends or until reduced to 0 hit points; when an object drops to 0 hit points, any remaining damage carries over to its original object form.

An animated object has blindsight with a radius of 30 feet and statistics as shown in the table above. The GM might rule an object has immunities, resistances, and vulnerabilities to specific damage types based on its form. If an object is securely attached to a surface or a larger object, such as a chain bolted to a wall, its speed is 0.
In combat, an object shares your initiative count, but takes its turn immediately after yours.

As a bonus action, you can issue one command to any number of objects within the spell's range. That command can be to attack, or some other action. Otherwise, the only action an object takes on its turn is the Dodge action. An object may also be commanded to attempt an action available to all creatures, such as grapple or shove, if its form permits it to do so.

If commanded to attack, an object makes one melee attack against a target you specify within 5 feet of it. Its attack bonus is equal to your spell attack modifier. An object usually deals bludgeoning damage, but the DM might rule it deals slashing or piercing damage based on its form.
One creature that you can see within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature gains the angered condition against you for 1 minute.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell at a higher level, you can target one additional creature for each additional level.

You utter a challenge infused with divine authority, targeting one creature within range that can both hear and understand you. For the duration, it has disadvantage on attacks against targets other than you, it cannot willingly move more than 30 feet from you, and if it casts a spell that targets creatures you must be one of the targets of that spell.
At the end of each of its turns, the creature can make a Wisdom saving throw, ending this effect on a success.

The spell also ends early if you cast this spell again, if you attack or force another creature to make an ability check or a saving throw, if you are Incapacitated, or if your allies attack the target or force it to make an ability check or saving throw.

You let loose a translucent gray cone of energy drawn from the shadowy places of the world. Each creature in a 30 foot cone must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, a creature is blinded for the next minute. A creature blinded by this spell may repeat this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a successful save.
**Replaces:** __Burning Hands__
Flames shoot forth from your fingertips. Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes **3d6** fire damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success.
The flames ignite any flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by **1d6** and the range of the cone increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 1st.

name: Confinement
components: V, S, M (ruby dust worth 1,500 gp)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Forcecage__

An immobile, invisible, cube-shaped prison composed of magical force springs into existence around an area you choose within range. The prison can be a cage or a solid box as you choose. The prison has an AC of 17 and 140 hit points.
A prison in the shape of a cage can be up to 20 feet on a side, is made from 1/2-inch diameter bars spaced a 1/2-inch apart, and provides half cover to creatures inside.
A prison in the shape of a box can be up to 10 feet on a side, creating a solid barrier that prevents any matter from passing through it and blocking any spells cast into or out from the area.

When you cast the spell, any creature that is completely inside the cage's area is trapped. Creatures only partially within the area, or those too large to fit inside the area, are pushed away from the center of the area until they are completely outside the area.

A creature inside the cage can't leave it by nonmagical means. If the creature tries to use teleportation or interplanar travel to leave the cage, it must first make a Charisma saving throw. On a success, the creature can use that magic to exit the cage. On a failure, the magic fails and has no effect. The cage also extends into the Ethereal Plane, blocking ethereal travel.
This spell can't be dispelled by __dispel magic__.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th level or higher, the cage's AC increases by 1 and its hit points increase by 20 for each slot level above 7th.

name: Conjure Aberration
components: V, S, M (a prism worth at least 50 gold, bathed in the aberrant energies of the Far Realm)

description.value: You grasp the material component of this spell, tearing a rift in reality, causing an Aberration to appear in range. For the duration, the Aberration uses the rules below:

description.name: Statistics
description.value: When you cast the spell, roll a d4 and consult the table below. The Aberration corresponding to your result appears, using its stat block. Alternately, you can choose any result lower than yours to appear in its place.

description.name: Combat
description.value: The Aberration shares your initiative and acts on your turn. You can give it verbal orders (no action required). If the Aberration does not receive any orders, or its orders are completed, it moves and defends itself with prejudice.

description.name: Spellcasting
description.value: If it can cast spells, you can command it to do so, but it uses your spell slots to fuel its spellcasting, even if it would normally be able to cast without spell slots.

description.name: Control
description.value: If the spell ends because your concentration was broken, the Aberration remains, but is no longer under your control. For the duration of the spell, or until it is reduced to 0 hit points, the Aberration acts according to its alignment.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th-level or higher, you gain a +1 bonus to your roll to determine the Aberration conjured for each slot above 4th.

name: Conjure Beast (Alternate)
components: V, S, M (a silver bone, feather, scale, or hair worth at least 1 gold, willingly gifted to you by a Fey spirit)

description.value: You grasp the material component of this spell and call its Fey spirit to your aid. It is Friendly to you and your allies, and it follows your commands to the best of its abilities. For the duration, the spirit uses the following rules:

• **Statistics**: The spirit appears in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see in range. The Fey spirit takes on the statistics and appearance of one Beast of CR 1 or lower, choosing from among the Beasts you have seen before.
• **Combat**: In combat, the Beast shares your initiative and it acts during your turn. You can issue it verbal commands (no action required). If the Beast has not received a command, it will move and defend itself to the best of its abilities. When the Beast is reduced to 0 hit points, the spirit disappears.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the CR of the 1 this spirit can take on increases by 1 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Conjure Beast Pack
components: V, S, M (a handful of grain or corn)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Conjure Animals__

You pull together wisps of magical energy and sculpt them into beasts. Choose a Small or Tiny beast of challenge rating 1/4 or lower, and eight creatures of that type appear immediately in unoccupied spaces around you. If you choose a beast with a flying speed, you summon six creatures instead. Each beast is considered fey and disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends.

The summoned beasts are friendly to you and your companions. In combat, the beasts share your initiative count, but take their turns immediately after yours. The beasts obey any verbal commands that you issue to them (no action required by you). If you don't issue any commands to them, they move as a group and take the Dodge action.

If you command the beasts to attack, choose a target for each beast to attack within its reach, making a single melee spell attack for each target. On a hit, the target takes **1d4** bludgeoning or piercing damage (your choice), plus **1d4** extra damage for each additional beast attacking it. You have advantage on the attack roll if three or more beasts attack the same target, and you add your spellcasting ability modifier to the damage dealt if six or more beasts attack the same target.

*Note that a conjured beast pack does not use the normal attack within its stat block, and so does not apply any additional effects. Below are all the eligible beasts in the SRD 5.1.*
*Frog, Sea Horse, Baboon, Badger, Bat, Cat, Crab, Eagle, Giant Fire Beetle, Hawk, Jackal, Lizard, Octopus, Owl, Quipper, Rat, Raven, Scorpion, Spider, Weasel, Blood Hawk, Flying Snake, Giant Rat, Poisonous Snake, Stirge, Badger, Giant Centipede.*

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you summon two additional beasts per level above 3rd.

name: Conjure Celestial (Alternate)
components: V, S, M (a Celestial's true name)

description.value: Speaking its true name, you conjure a Celestial of CR 5 or lower to aid you. This Celestial is Friendly to you and your allies, obeys your commands, and uses the rules below:
