• **Statistics**: The Celestial appears in an unoccupied space of your choice you can see in range. When it appears, you can cause it to take on the appearance and statistics of a different Celestial of your choice equal to its CR, or lower.
• **Combat**: This Celestial shares your initiative and it acts during your turn. You can give it verbal commands (no action required). If the Celestial does not receive a command, or its commands are completed, it will move and defend itself.
• **Spellcasting**: If it can cast spells, you can command it to do so, but it uses your spell slots to fuel its spellcasting, even if it would normally be able to cast without spell slots.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the CR of the Celestials that you can conjure increases by 1 for each slot level above 5th.

name: Conjure Dragon (Alternate)
components: V, S, M (the scale of an Ancient Dragon, inlaid with gems worth at last 500 gold, willingly gifted to you)

description.value: Grasping the material component of this spell, you conjure a portion of that Ancient Dragon's essence to your aid. While your concentration lasts, it is Friendly to you and your allies and obeys your commands. For the duration, this draconic essence uses the rules below:

• **Statistics**: The draconic essence manifests in the form of a Dragon of CR 5 or lower, which must match the color of the scale used as the material component for the spell. It appears in an unoccupied space of your choice within range.
• **Combat**: In combat, this Dragon shares your initiative and acts on your turn. You can give it verbal commands (no action required). If the Dragon does not receive any commands, or if its commands are completed, it defend itself with prejudice.
• **Spellcasting**: If it can cast spells, you can command it to do so, but it uses your spell slots to fuel its spellcasting, even if it would normally be able to cast without spell slots.
• **Control**: If your concentration ends, the Dragon instantly disappears, the essence returning to the Ancient Dragon.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the CR of Dragon this essence can manifest increases by 1 for each slot level above 5th.

name: Conjure Elemental (Alternate)
components: V, S, M (a gemstone containing a mote of pure elemental air, earth, fire, or water, worth at least 50 gold)

description.value: Grasping the material component of the spell, you conjure an Elemental whose makeup matches the material component. While your concentration lasts, the Elemental is Friendly to you and your allies and obeys all of your commands. For the duration, the Elemental uses the rules below:

• **Statistics**: The Elemental appears in an unoccupied space of your choice you can see in range. It takes on the statistics and appearance of an Elemental of CR 3 or lower, so long as its makeup matches that of the material component.
• **Combat**: The Elemental shares your initiative and it acts during your turn. You can give it verbal commands (no action required). If the Elemental does not receive a command, or its commands are completed, it will only defend itself.
• **Spellcasting**: If it can cast spells, you can command it to do so, but it uses your spell slots to fuel its spellcasting, even if it would normally be able to cast without spell slots.
• **Control**: If your concentration on this spell is broken, the Elemental remains, but is no longer under your control. For the duration of the spell, or until it is reduced to 0 hit points, the Elemental will act according to its alignment, spreading chaos and destruction wherever it can.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the CR of Elemental that you can conjure increases by 1 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Conjure Familiar
components: V, S, M (a drop of the spellcaster's blood, consumed by the casting of this spell)

description.value: Offering a drop of blood, reduce your maximum hit points by 1 to conjure a Familiar. It is Friendly to you and it obeys your commands. Your Familair uses the following rules:

• **Statistics**: Your Familiar manifests as a CR 0 Beast of your choice, but its creature type is Celestial, Fey, or Fiend. Familiars often reflect the true nature of the caster's soul in appearance and alignment. You can only have one Familiar, but you can perform the ritual again to change its form.
• **Control**: In combat, the Familiar shares your initiative and acts during your turn. It cannot attack, but can otherwise act normally. If it drops to 0 hit points your Familiar is destroyed. If it is destroyed, you regain the maximum hit points spent in its creation at the end of your next long rest.
• **Dismissal**: As an action, you can shunt your Familiar to a unique pocket dimension, or dismiss it forever. As an aciton, you can recall your Familiar from its pocket dimension, and it reappears in an unoccupied space you can see within 10 ft.
• **Soul Bond**: While your Familiar is within 100 ft., you can communicate with it Telepathically. As an action, you can use your Familiar's senses in place of your own until you end this effect (no action required) or you are Incapacitated. While you do so, you are blind and deaf to your own surroundings.
• **Spellcasting**: When you cast a spell with a range of touch and your Familiar is within 100 ft., your Familiar can use its reaction to deliver that spell using your Spellcasting ability.

You conjure a Medium spirit from the Feywild in an unoccupied space you can see within range. The spirit lasts for the duration, and it looks like a Fey creature of your choice. When the spirit appears, you can make one melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of it. On a hit, the target takes Psychic damage equal to **3d12** plus your spellcasting ability modifier, and the target has the Frightened or Angered condition until the start of your next turn, with both you and the spirit as the source of the fear or anger.
As a Bonus Action on your later turns, you can teleport the spirit to an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet of the space it left and make the attack against a creature within 5 feet of it.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The damage increases by **2d12** for each spell slot level above 6.

name: Conjure Fey (Alternate)
components: V, S, M (a Tiny object worth at least 50 gold containing the promise of a Fey, willingly gifted to you)

description.value: You grasp the material component of this spell and call its Fey spirit to your aid. While your concentration lasts, the Fey Friendly to you and your allies and obeys your commands to the letter. For the duration, the Fey uses the rules below:

• **Statistics**: The Fey spirit appears in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range. It takes on the appearance and statistics of any Fey of CR 3 or lower.
• **Combat**: The Fey shares your initiative and it acts on your turn. You can give it verbal commands (no action required). If the Fey does not receive any commands, or its commands are completed, it moves and defends itself as best it can.
• **Spellcasting**: If it can cast spells, you can command it to do so, but it uses your spell slots to fuel its spellcasting, even if it would normally be able to cast without spell slots.
• **Control**: If the spell ends because your concentration was broken, the Fey remains, but is no longer under your control. For the duration of the spell, or until reduced to 0 hit points, the Fey acts according to its alignment, and either becomes Hostile toward you and your allies or flees.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the CR of Fey this spirit can take on increases by 1 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Conjure Fiend (Alternate)
components: V, S, M (a Fiend's true name)

description.value: Speaking its true name, you conjure a Fiend of CR 4 or lower to your aid. While your concentration lasts, it is Indifferent to you and your allies and follows your commands to the letter. For the duration, the Fiend uses the rules below:

• **Statistics**: The Fiend appears in an unoccupied space of your choice you can see within range. When it appears, you can force the Fiend to take on the appearance and statistics of another Fiend of your choice equal to its CR, or lower.
• **Combat**: The Fiend shares your initiative and acts on your turn. You can give it verbal commands (no action required). If the Fiend does not receive any commands, or its commands are completed, it can move defend itself with prejudice.
• **Spellcasting**: If it can cast spells, you can command it to do so, but it uses your spell slots to fuel its spellcasting, even if it would normally be able to cast without spell slots.
• **Control**: If your concentration on this spell is broken, the Fiend remains. It instantly returns to its true form and is no longer under your control. For the duration of the spell, or until it is reduced to 0 hit points, it is Hostile to you and your allies, and will act according to its alignment. Devils seek to kill the spellcaster, and Demons kill indiscriminately.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the CR of the Fiends that you can conjure increases by 1 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Conjure Giant
components: V, S, M (a gemstone worth at least 500 gold, personally inscribed with the Rune of a Storm Giant)

description.value: Grasping the material component of this spell, you conjure a portion of that Storm Giants's essence to your aid. While your concentration lasts, it is Friendly to you and your allies and obeys your commands. For the duration, this titanic essence uses the rules below:

description.name: Statistics
description.value: The titanic essence manifests in the form of a Hill Giant, and uses the corresponding stat block. It appears in an unoccupied space of your choice within range.

description.name: Combat
description.value: In combat, this Giant shares your initiative and acts on your turn. You can give it verbal commands (no action required). If the Giant does not receive any commands, or if its commands are completed, it defend itself with prejudice.

description.name: Spellcasting
description.value: If it can cast spells, you can command it to do so, but it uses your spell slots to fuel its spellcasting, even if it would normally be able to cast without spell slots.

description.name: Control
description.value: If your concentration ends, the Giant instantly disappears, the essence returning to the Storm Giant.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: You can cast this spell with higher level spell slots to cause this titanic essence to take on the form of more powerful Giants, as shown in the table below:

name: Conjure Herald
components: V, S, M (a small silver horn worth at least 10 gp, which is consumed)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Magic Mouth__ and __Skywrite__

You create a floating spirit which conveys a message of your choice. The herald appears to be a Medium or Small creature of ghostly form, with you determining its appearance otherwise. The herald knows a fixed message of up to 25 words. When you cast this spell, choose one of the following effects:

• **Ward.** The herald is cast at a particular location, or on a statue or other object with a mouth, and is fixed to that point. It is invisible and motionless until a specific condition is met within 30 feet of its location. When the condition is met, it appears and recites its message. If cast on an object, it moves the object's mouth rather than appearing directly. You determine whether it does so once or disappears again and repeats the message every time the condition is met. When cast in this way, the herald lasts until dispelled.
• **Announcement.** The herald floats through the air up to 100 feet up and 30 feet per round, repeating its message every round. It traverses an area up to a 5-mile radius around its location, conveying its message to every creature it sees. When cast in this way, the herald lasts for 1 hour.

You conjure spirits from the Elemental Planes that flit around you in a 15-foot Emanation for the duration. Until the spell ends, any attack you make deals an extra **2d8** damage when you hit a creature in the Emanation. This damage is Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning (your choice when you make the attack).
In addition, the ground in the Emanation is Difficult Terrain for your enemies.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The damage increases by **1d8** for every 2 spell slot levels above 4.

name: Conjure Minor Fiends
components: V, S, M (100 gp worth of incence mixed with humanoid blood, which the spell consumes)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Summon Lesser Demons__

You recite a dark incantation, summoning a group of minor fiends to do your bidding. You may choose the plane you call them from. The spell conjures two demons which use the __Minor Fiend__ stat block. Alternatively, your GM may choose any number of fiends whose combined challenge ratings are 2 or lower. In combat, the fiends share your initiative count but take their turns immediately after yours.

The fiends are friendly to you and your companions and hostile to all other creatures. If you lose *concentration* on the spell, they do not disappear. Instead, they become hostile toward you and your companions. They can't be dismissed and last for 1 hour after their summoning. A fiend disappears when reduced to 0 hit points.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot above 3rd level, the number of minor fiends or the combined challenge rating of the summoned fiends increases by 1 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Conjure Volley (Alternate)
components: V, S, M (a single piece of ammunition and a ranged weapon, or one thrown weapon)

description.value: You fire one piece of nonmagical ammunition from a ranged weapon or throw a nonmagical thrown weapon into the air and choose a point within the normal range of the weapon.

The ammunition or weapon explodes into a multitude of exact copies of it, which fall in a 30-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder centered on the point you chose. Creatures within that area must make a Dexterity saving throw. They take **6d8** damage of the weapon or ammunition's type on a failed save, and half as much damage on a successful save. ny pieces of ammunition or weapons created by this spell disintegrate once the effects of this spell are resolved.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th-level or higher, the damage of this spell increases by **1d8**, and the radius of the cylinder increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Consecrated Armor
components: V, S, M (a drop of blessed oil)

description.value: You trace a holy symbol on yourself, creating an invisible barrier until the spell ends. Your base AC becomes 12 plus your Dexterity modifier. If you are attacked by an Aberration, Fey, Fiend, or Undead, you add your spellcasting ability modifier to your AC against that attack. The spell ends early if the target dons armor.

You attempt to drain the life force of those around you in a 30-foot radius sphere centered on you. When you cast this spell you may designate any number of creatures you can see to be unaffected by it. When an affected creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes **4d6** necrotic damage. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage. Whenever this spell reduces a creature to 0 hit points or damages a creature currently at 0 hit points, you gain 5 temporary hit points. When you gain temporary hit points from this spell, they stack with any temporary hit points you have already gained from this spell, up to a maximum of 20.
Undead are not affected by this spell

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 and the maximum temporary hit points you can have at a time as a result of this spell increases by 5 for each slot level above 4th.

Your touch inflicts a magical contagion. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take **11d8** Necrotic damage and have the Poisoned condition. Also, choose one ability when you cast the spell. While Poisoned, the target has Disadvantage on saving throws or ability checks made with the chosen ability.

The target must repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns until it gets three successes or failures. If the target succeeds on three of these saves, the spell ends on the target. If the target fails three of the saves, the spell lasts for 7 days on it.
Whenever the Poisoned target receives an effect that would end the Poisoned condition, the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw, or the Poisoned condition doesn't end on it.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The duration doubles for each spell slot level above 5.

You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centered on a point within range. The sphere spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. It lasts for the duration or until a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses it. When a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes **4d6** poison damage and contracts __Cackle Fever__ (DMG chapter 8). On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and suffers no additional effect.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the radius of the fog increases by 20 feet for each slot level above 3rd.

When you cast this spell you must touch a willing creature. The next time that creature would take damage from one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder, that creature gains resistance against that damage (including against the triggering damage). For the rest of the duration, the target has resistance against that damage type and this spell will not grant resistance against any other damage types.
This spell ends immediately if you cast it again.

name: Contract
components: S, M (A contract made of 10gp worth of paper and ink)

description.value: You touch a contract to enchant it. One creature can sign it. If you or a creature that willingly signed the contract violates the terms of the contract then the contract ends, both creatures know the contract has ended and the violator takes **3d8** radiant, psychic or necrotic damage. Choose the damage type when you prepare the spell. The DM might allow you to replace the damage with an equivalent consequence defined in the contract. This consequence might punish the violator or aid an entity in punishing the violator. Whatever the consequence is, it has no effect whenever it would be used for anything other than punishing the violator.

If the contract is destroyed, the spell ends. The contract has AC equal to 5 + your spellcasting ability and hit points equal to 5 times the level your casting this spell at. A remove curse, greater restoration, or wish spell also ends it if it is casted at a level equal to or greater than the level this spell was casted at.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: If you cast this using a 3rd level spell slot or higher, increase the damage by 2d8 for each additional slot level. Additionally, increase the duration if the spell is casted at level 3 (1 day), level 4 (1 week), level 5 (1 month), level 6 (1 year), level 7 (1 decade), level 8 (1 century), level 9 (1 millennium).
You can manipulate fire and use it to assault your foes. When you cast this spell choose one of the following effects:

description.name: Manipulate Fire
description.value: You choose nonmagical flame you can see within range and that fits within a 5-foot cube and cause the flame to grow to fill the cube, extinguish all flame within the cube, change its color, or cause simple animated shapes to appear within the flames, such as creatures or locations.

description.name: Hurl Flame
description.value: You create a small ball of flickering flame in your hand and hurl it at one target that you can see within range, making a ranged spell attack against it. On hit, it takes 1d8 fire damage. Flammable objects that aren't being worn or carried are ignited when hit by this spell attack.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The damage of this Cantrip increases by 1d8 at 5th (2d8), 11th (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).
You choose nonmagical flame that you can see within range and that fits within a 5-foot cube. You affect it in one of the following ways:

• You instantaneously create a new flame within 5 ft of it that fits within a 5-foot cube. Until the end of your next turn the new flame persists without fuel.
• You instantaneously extinguish the flames within the cube.
• You double or halve the area of bright light and dim light cast by the flame, change its color, or both. The change lasts for 1 hour.
• You cause simple shapes—such as the vague form of a creature, an inanimate object, or a location—to appear within the flames and animate as you like. The shapes last for 1 hour.
If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three non-instantaneous effects created by it active at a time, and you can dismiss such an effect as an action.

name: Conviction
components: V, S, M (a bit of parchment with holy text written on it)

description.value: You touch one willing creature and choose one ability score. For the duration of the spell, that creature has advantage on saving throws using that ability score.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you choose one additional ability score for each slot level above 1st.

name: Cordon of Arrows (Alternate)
components: V, S, M (three or more arrows or bolts)

description.value: You plant three pieces of ranged weapon ammunition in the ground within range and transmute them to protect the area. The first creature to move within 30 feet of this enchanted ammunition must make a Dexterity saving throw. The target takes **3d6** piercing damage on a failed save, and half as much piercing damage on a successful save.
As part of casting this spell, you can designate any number of creatures you choose, and the spell ignores them.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd-level or higher, the amount of ammunition that can be transmuted increases by two for each slot level above 2nd. For each additional piece of ammunition you transmute with this spell, the damage increases by **1d6**.

You surround yourself with a protective aura of cold that is harmful to others within a 10-foot radius sphere centered on you. You have resistance to fire damage. Additionally, each creature other than you that starts its turn in your aura must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes **2d10** cold damage and has disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity saves for the next minute, as they begin to shiver uncontrollably. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and suffers no additional effects.
If a creature is no longer in the area of this spell may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the ongoing effect for itself on a successful save.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 3rd.

Your touch transforms a creature into a spongy, amorphous mass, its shape melting and uncontrollably writhing. Choose a creature you can see within range. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes **3d12** psychic damage and is paralyzed and blinded for the duration. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and this spell has no additional effect.
At the end of each of its turns, a paralyzed target takes **3d12** psychic damage and may make another Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, the spell ends.

name: Corpse Candle
components: S, M (a piece of corpse untreated by any manner of preservative)

description.value: A spectral, skeletal floating hand carrying a lit candle appears at a point you choose within range. The candle sheds bright light in a 5-foot radius and dim light for an additional 5 feet. As a bonus action on your turn you can command the hand to move up to 30 feet in any direction. The hand and candle vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.

Any creature within the light cast by this candle is outlined with a sickly greenish light. Invisible creatures within the radius of this spell can't benefit from being invisible and creatures on the ethereal plane appear as wispy outlines
**Replaces:** __Danse Macabre__

Your shadow splits, reaching out and reanimating up to five Tiny, Small or Medium corpses of challenge rating 1/4 or higher that you can see within range. Each corpse immediately transforms into an undead creature of the same size, which takes your choice of form (__Skeleton__ or __Zombie__) using the Corpse Puppet stat block.

The puppets are allies to you and your companions. In combat, they share your initiative count, but take their turns immediately after yours. As a bonus action, you can issue one command to any number of puppets within the spell's range. If you don't issue a command, they take the Dodge action and use their move to avoid danger.
The puppets are under your control until the spell ends, after which they become inanimate once more.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, you animate up to two additional corpses for each slot level above 5th.

name: Corrosive Burst
components: V, S, M (a handful of saltpeter and some copper shavings)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Vitriolic Sphere__

You hurl a ball of dripping acid outward, exploding in a 20-foot radius sphere at a point you can see within range. Every creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking **8d4** acid damage on a failure or half as much on a success. A creature that fails the save takes an additional **4d4** acid damage at the end of each of its turns unless it or another creature within 5 feet spends an action to clear the acid off.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the initial damage increases by **2d4** for each slot level above 4th.

Your hand glistens and smokes as you strike out at a nearby creature. Make a melee spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes **4d4** acid damage and an additional **2d4** acid damage at the end of its next turn.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage (both initial and later) increases by 1d4 for each slot level above 1st.

With a piercing glare and a sinister gesture, you send ribbons of dark magic toward a creature you can see within range. For the duration, the target is cursed and suffers one of the following effects of your choice.

description.name: Dull Reflexes
description.value: The target has Disadvantage on Dexterity checks and saving throws.

description.name: Feeble Fortitude
description.value: The target has Disadvantage on Constitution saving throws and can't regain Hit Points.

description.name: Weak Will
description.value: The target has Disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws and spell attack rolls.

name: Counterspell
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when you see a creature within 60 feet of yourself casting a spell with Verbal, Somatic, or Material components

description.value: You attempt to interrupt the casting of a spell. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. Add the level your casting this spell at minus the level of the spell you're countering to your Spell Save DC. On a failed save, the spell dissipates with no effect, and the action, Bonus Action, or Reaction used to cast it is wasted. If something such as a spell slot was expended to cast the spell, it is not expended.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: Special (see description above).

name: Counterspell (Alternate)
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when you see a creature within 60 feet of you casting a spell

description.value: You attempt to interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell. You and the target both make an ability check with your respective spellcasting abilities. The target adds the level of the spell it is casting to its ability check, and you add the level at which you cast this counterspell to your ability check.
If you know the spell the creature is attempting to cast or if you have it prepared you have advantage on this ability check, unless you are using this spell against another counterspell.
If the result of your ability check is greater then the result of the target's ability check, its spell fails and has no effect.

You conjure a shroud of dark, writhing tentacles around your body. These tentacles do not hinder your movement and provide you with three-quarters cover. You have advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks and can grapple targets without requiring a free hand.

As an action on your turn while this spell lasts, you can command the tentacles to attack one creature within 5 feet of you. In addition, whenever a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, you may use your reaction to have the tentacles strike back at your attacker. With either option, make a melee spell attack against the target, which deals **5d10** bludgeoning damage on a hit.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 5th.

You create a chaotic medley of groans and creaks, as if hundreds of intertwined trees and branches were grinding together. Choose a point within range that you can see. The cacophony affects all creatures that can hear in a 40-foot radius sphere centered on that point. All affected creatures within the area have disadvantage on perception checks that involve hearing and all spellcasters make *Concentration* checks at disadvantage to maintain *Concentration* on spells.

In addition, the cacophony enhances and focuses sound. Creatures in the area that do not have immunity or resistance to thunder damage gain vulnerability to thunder damage until they leave the area of the spell.

name: Create Construct
components: V, S, M (high quality materials worth at least 200 gold per level of the spell, all of which are consumed)

description.value: Using a set of artisan's tools with which you are proficient, you set to work creating a creation of arcane power. Once the spell is complete, the material components are transformed into a __Golem Servant__, which uses the rules below:

description.name: Statistics
description.value: The Golem Servant uses the stat block below. It uses your Spellcasting Ability, the Spell Slot spent to cast this spell, your Spell Attack Modifier, and Proficiency Bonus (PB) in several places throughout the stat block. You choose if your Golem is Medium or Large sized, and its appearance reflects the materials you used in its creation.

description.name: Control
description.value: Your Golem has no mind of its own and obeys you absolutely. In combat, it shares your initiative and acts during your turn. However, unless you give it a command, the Golem Servant remains in its space and will only act in self defense. If you are within 500 feet of your Golem, you can use a bonus action to Telepathically issue it a command, determining how it will act on its turn or to set a general course of action for it (ie: 'defend this creature') until you give it another command.

description.name: Magical Nature
description.value: The Golem cannot benefit from healing spells, nor short or long rests. The only way for it to regain hit points is for a creature to touch it and spend one spell slot. It then regains hit points equal to 10 times the slot's level.

description.name: Creator's Bond
description.value: While the Golem lives, you cannot regain the spell slot you expended to create it, and casting this spell again instantly destroys any previous Golem Servants.

name: Create Homunculus
components: V, S, M (clay, a sapphire worth 500 gold, and blood from the spellcaster, all of which are consumed)

description.value: While muttering incantations, you spill your blood onto the sapphire and place it at the heart of the clay, which you shape into your __Homunculus__. Your maximum hit points are reduced by 2d4 (this can't be lessened in any way), and a Homunculus comes to life under your control using the rules below:

description.name: Statistics
description.value: The __Homunculus__ uses the stat block below. It uses your Spellcasting Ability, the Spell Slot spent to cast this spell, your Spell Attack Modifier, and Proficiency Bonus (PB) in several places throughout the stat block.

description.name: Control
description.value: Your __Homunculus__ is absolutely loyal to you as its creator. It acts independently of you, but you can choose how it acts. In combat, it shares your initiative and your turn.

description.name: Lifeblood Bond
description.value: While your Homunculus lives, you cannot regain the maximum hit points spent in its creation. Casting this spell again instantly destroys any previous Homunculus.

The Homunculus cannot benefit from healing spells, short, or long rests. However, whenever you regain hit points (from a spell or rest), you can forgo regaining any number of those hit points and cause the Homunculus to regain them in your stead, so long as you are on the same plane of existence.
Finally, if you should die, the Homunculus dies instantly.

name: Create Monstrosity
components: V, S, M (the corpses of the appropriate Beasts and blood of the spellcaster, both of which are consumed)

description.value: You spill your blood onto the corpses binding them together into a new form, reducing your maximum hit points by 5 and creating a __Hippogriff__, __Griffon__, or __Peryton__ under your control. Monstrosities created by this spell use the rules below:

description.name: Control
description.value: As a bonus action, you can mentally command any Monstrosities created by this spell, so long as they are within 60 feet. You determine how they act or set a general course of action for them ('defend this dungeon'). Monstrosities follow commands until they are complete. If your Monstrosity is not given a command, it defends itself with extreme prejudice.

description.name: Creator's Bond
description.value: While a Monstrosity is under your control you can't regain the maximum hit points spent in its creation. However, when you finish a long rest, you can release control over a Monstrosity to regain the maximum hit points spent to create it. When released, Monstrosities becomes hostile to all living things, the spellcaster that created it in particular.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: You can cast this spell with a spell slot of a higher level, and expend maximum hit points (Max. HP) to create more powerful Monstrosities, as shown here:

name: Create Ooze
components: V, S, M (a vial of acid and the ground bones of a Medium or larger Beast or Humanoid)

description.value: This spell can only be cast underground. You mix the ground bones and acid, pouring the mixture in an unoccupied space. An Oblex Spawn under your control appears in there. While it exists, this Ooze uses the rules below:

description.name: Control
description.value: Oozes you create with this spell follow commands to the best of their abilities. If not given a command, the Ooze will remain in place and act only to defend itself. In comabt, the Ooze shares your initiative and acts during your turn.

As a bonus action, you can mentally command any number of Oozes you created with this spell so long as they are within 120 feet. You can issue an individual command to each where you determine exactly how it acts, or you set a general course of action for it ('defend this hall'). So long as it is under your control, an Ooze will follow commands until completed.

description.name: Slimy Bond
description.value: While an Ooze is under your control you can't regain the spell slot you spent to create it. However, when you finish a long rest, you can release control over any Oozes you created with this spell to regain the slots spent on them.
When released, Oozes become hostile to all living things, and seek out the closest underground dungeon to live in.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: You can cast this spell with higher level spell slots to create more powerful Oozes as shown below:

name: Create Poppet
components: V, S, M (clay and willow branches)

description.value: When you cast this spell, you fashion the Material components into a Tiny doll (or pull the doll from your shadow if you cast it without Material components). While you hold this doll, you can take any of the following actions: Healing Gift. As a Bonus Action, choose one creature you can see within 15 feet of you. That creature regains Hit Points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

When you use the doll for the third time, it is destroyed, leaving its heart behind in the form of a seed. Until the spell ends, any creature can eat the seed as a Bonus Action. A creature that does so gains 2d8 Temporary Hit Points.

description.name: Cleansing Gift
description.value: As a Bonus Action, choose one creature you can see within 15 feet of you. You can end either one disease or one condition afflicting it. The condition can be Blinded, Deafened, Poisoned, or Stunned.

description.name: Curse-Warding Gift
description.value: As a Reaction when you are targeted by a curse spell, you negate its effect on you.

name: Create Simulacrum
components: V, S, M (snow, the severed finger of the target, and two rubies worth 500 gold, all of which is consumed)

description.value: While maintaining unwavering focus, you sculpt snow into a duplicate of a Humanoid within range for the entire casting. Placing its severed finger in its place and using the rubies as eyes, the Simulacrum comes to life, using these rules:

description.name: Statistics
description.value: The Simulacrum uses the same statistics as the target Humanoid, but its creature type is Construct, it cannot regain hit points or benefit from short or long rests, and it is vulnerable to fire damage (due to being made of snow).

description.name: Control
description.value: The Simulacrum is absolutely loyal to you and it obeys any orders you give it without hesitation. In combat, the Simulacrum shares your initiative and acts during your turn.

description.name: Illusory Being
description.value: The Simulacrum cannot gain experience or levels, and it can't learn new abilities or spells of any kind.
The only way for the Simulacrum to regain hit points is for a creature to touch it and spend a spell slot. The Simulacrum then regains hit points equal to 10 times that slot's level.

description.name: Spellcasting
description.value: If the target creature can cast spells, you can command the Simulacrum to cast them, but it uses your spell slots to fuel its spellcasting, even if it would normally be able to cast spells without expending spell slots.

description.name: Paradoxical Prevention
description.value: Casting this spell again instantly destroys any other Simulacrums you have created. Moreover, each individual creature can only have one Simulacrum of it created at a time. Should another spellcaster uses this spell to craft a Simulacrum of a creature for which a Simulacrum already exists, the spell instantly fails and the slot is wasted.

name: Create Snare (Alternate)
components: V, S, M (30 feet of rope, which the spell consumes)

description.value: You infuse a length of cord or rope with magic, transforming it into a magic Snare, pointing it toward an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet. It unfurls in that space and turns invisible. It can only be detected by a successful Investigation check against your Spell save DC.

The first Small or larger creature to move into that space triggers your Snare and must make a Dexterity saving throw or fall Prone in its space and be Restrained by the Snare. If a creature is unaware of the Snare, it makes this saving throw with disadvantage. If a creature is in the space when you set the Snare, the Snare is instantly triggered.

A Restrained creature makes a Strength saving throw at the end of each of its turns, escaping the Snare on a success. Another creature can use its action to touch the Restrained creature make a Strength check against your Spell save DC, destroying the Snare on a success.
The spell lasts until triggered or dispelled.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: If you cast this spell using a 2nd level spell slot, the Snare deals **2d6** slashing damage whenever a creature fails a saving throw to avoid or escape the Snare.
If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd-level or higher, this damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Create Undead (Alternate)
components: V, S, M (the corpse of a creature slain within the last day and blood from the spellcaster, both of which are consumed by the casting of this spell)

description.value: This spell can only be cast at night. You spill your blood onto the corpse as part of a sinister ritual, reducing your maximum hit points by 2 and creating a Skeleton or Zombie under your control. Undead created by this spell use the rules below:

• **Control**: Undead follow your commands without quesion. If not given a command, an Undead won't move and will only act to defend itself. In combat, any Undead you created share your initiative and act during your turn.
As a bonus action, you can mentally command any number of Undead you created with within 120 feet. You can issue an individual command to each, determining exactly how it will act, or setting a general course of action ('defend this hall'). So long as they remain under your control, your Undead will follow commands until completed.
• **Spellcasting**: If it can cast spells, you can command it to do so, but it uses your spell slots to fuel its spellcasting, even if it would normally be able to cast without spell slots.
• **Undead Bond**: While an Undead is under your control, you cannot regain the maximum hit points you spent to create it. However, when you finish a long rest, you can release control over any Undead that you created to regain the maximum hit points you spent to create them. When freed, Undead become hostil to all living things, the spellcaster in particular.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: You can cast this spell with a spell slot of a higher level, and expend additional maximum hit points (Max. HP) to create more powerful Undead, as shown here:

name: Create Water (Alternate)
components: V, S, M (a drop of water if creating water, or a grain of sand if destroying water)

description.value: You create up to 10 gallons of clean water within range. The water appears in open containers you can see, or falls as rain in a 30-foot radius centered on you, extinguishing all flames.
• **Inverse Casting**:  You can use this spell to destory water. You destroy up to 10 gallons of water in open containers in range, or destroy fog in a 30-foot radius centered on you.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: If you cast this spell with a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can create (or destroy) an additional 10 gallons of water, or the radius of this spell effect increases by 10 feet, for each slot level above 1st.

name: Creeping Cold
components: V, S, M (a small glass or pottery vessel filled with ice)

description.value: You reach out your hand and make a crushing motion, turning the target's sweat to ice as frost forms on and inside their skin. One creature within range that you can see takes 1d6 cumulative cold damage per round for the next three rounds (1d6 on the first round, 2d6 on the second round, 3d6 on the third round). The creature can make a Constitution saving throw each round, halving the damage for that turn on a success.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can concentrate on this spell for one additional round for each slot level above 2nd, with increasing cumulative damage each round (4d6 on round 4, 5d6 on round 5, etc).
Until the start of your next turn, whenever you make a melee weapon attack you deal an extra **1d6** damage and can score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, this spell lasts for one additional round for each slot level above 1st.

You crown yourself with your deity's favor. When you cast this spell, choose one other willing creature as your champion. For the duration of the spell, you are proficient in all charisma based skills. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any Charisma ability check you make.

In addition, the creature designated as your champion is immune to fear, gains 10 temporary hit points at the start  of each of its turns and has advantage on all attack rolls it makes. If any of these temporary hit points remain when the spell ends, they are lost. The creature also can attack twice, instead of once, when it takes the Attack action on its turn. It ignores this benefit if it already has a feature, like Extra Attack, that gives it extra attacks.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 9th level or higher, you may instead designate up to three creatures as your champions.
One creature that you can see within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration. The creature succeeds automatically if it isn't Humanoid.

A spectral crown appears on the Charmed target's head, and it must use its action before moving on each of its turns to make a melee attack against a creature that you mentally choose. You can only choose itself if there are no other targets within its reach. The target can act normally on its turn if you choose no creature. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success.
On your later turns, you must take the Magic action to maintain control of the target, or the spell ends.

You bring the concentrated forces of erosion to bear on an unattended, nonmagical object that isn't being worn or carried, or 5-foot section of a structure. The target takes **10d6** force damage. This damage ignores damage threshold, if the object has it. If this reduces the target to 0 hit points, it crumbles to dust.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 2d6 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Cryptogram
components: V, S, M (a small written message)

description.value: You send a small scroll with a message to a creature of your choice. The recipient must be a creature known to you and also be on the same plane of existence as you. The scroll hovers in front of the recipient, drops into its pocket, or lands atop something nearby. The scroll's message can be up to 8 characters long (spaces count as characters). Once you send a scroll, you can't send another scroll to that recipient for 24 hours.

A creature you touch regains a number of Hit Points equal to 2d4. Once within the next minute before they hit or miss with a weapon attack they can choose to deal extra damage. On a hit, they deal extra damage of the weapon's damage type equal to the amount they were healed plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The healing increases by **2d4** for each spell slot level above 1.

A creature you touch regains a number of Hit Points equal to 2d4. Once within the next minute when they take damage they can reduce the damage by an amount equal to the amount they were healed plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The healing increases by **2d4** for each spell slot level above 1.

A creature you touch regains a number of Hit Points equal to 2d4. Once within the next minute they can increase their movement speed by an amount equal to the amount they were healed plus your spellcasting ability modifier until the start of their next turn.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The healing increases by **2d4** for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Curse Object
components: V, S, M (powdered onyx worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes)

description.value: You bestow a curse upon an object that you touch. The object must be one that isn't being worn or carried and is able to fit within a 5-foot cube. Until the spell ends, the object becomes magical (requiring attunement) and cursed. The fact that the object is cursed is revealed only when an Identify spell is cast on it or a creature attunes to it. When a creature attunes to the object, the curse extends to it for the duration. Choose the curse from the following effects.

description.name: Bleeding
description.value: The attuned creature can't regain Hit Points.

description.name: Frenzied (Weapon Only)
description.value: Whenever the attuned creature deals damage with the cursed weapon, it has the Frenzied condition for 1 minute. A creature with the Frenzied condition loses the ability to distinguish between friend and foe, regarding all creatures it can see as enemies. While Frenzied, the creature chooses the targets for its attacks, spells, and abilities randomly from among the creatures it can see within range, and it must make an Opportunity Attack if any creature provokes one.

description.name: Hobbled
description.value: The attuned creature's Speed is halved and can't take the Dash action.

description.name: Obsessed
description.value: The attuned creature is unwilling to part with the object, keeping it on its person at all times. If the cursed object is a weapon, the attuned creature has Disadvantage on attack rolls with weapons other than the cursed weapon.

description.name: Restless
description.value: Whenever the attuned creature finishes a Long Rest, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or gain no benefits from the rest.

description.name: Speechless
description.value: The attuned creature can't speak.

description.name: Unfortunate
description.value: Whenever the target rolls a 20 on the d20 of a D20 Test, the roll instead becomes a 1.

description.name: Vulnerable
description.value: The attuned creature has Vulnerability to one damage type (choose when you cast this spell).

A creature you touch must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be cursed to age and wither. While cursed, the target ages at ten times the normal rate, becoming ten days older for each day that passes. Additionally, the target has Disadvantage on Strength checks and saving throws.

name: Curse of Binding
components: V, S, M (a body part from the intended target, such as a fingernail, a lock of hair, or a drop of blood)

description.value: You attempt to bind a creature or object to a location. Choose a target and a point within range that you can see. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be cursed to remain within 30 feet of the point. If the target starts its turn further than 30 feet from the point, it must succeed on a Strength (*Athletics*) check against your spell save DC or be dragged 60 feet toward the point. Additionally, if the creature tries to use teleportation or interplanar travel, it must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, the attempt fails and wastes the spell or effect. On a success, the spell ends.
You attempt to drive a creature you can see within range to violence. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be cursed and have the Frenzied condition for the duration.

A creature with the Frenzied condition loses the ability to distinguish between friend and foe, regarding all creatures it can see as enemies. While Frenzied, the creature chooses the targets for its attacks, spells, and abilities randomly from among the creatures it can see within range, and it must make an Opportunity Attack if any creature provokes one.
At the end of its turn, an affected creature can repeat its saving throw, ending the spell early on a success.

A black brand resembling iron shackles appears on a creature you can see within range, which must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be cursed for the duration. While cursed, the target's Speed is 0 and can't increase. The target can take an action to make a Strength (*Athletics*) check against your spell save DC. If it succeeds, the spell ends.

name: Curse of Impending Blades
components: V, S, M (a nail through a piece of leather)

description.value: You curse a creature, causing it to have difficulty avoiding attacks, often seeming to stumble into harm's way. For the duration of the spell, other creatures have advantage on attacks they make against the cursed creature and the cursed creature has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the duration is *Concentration*, up to 10 minutes. If you use a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the Duration is 8 hours. If you use a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the Duration is 24 hours. If you use a 9th level spell slot, the spell lasts until it is dispelled. Using a spell slot of 5th level or higher grants a duration that doesn't require *Concentration*.

name: Curse of Lycanthropy
components: V, S, M (a pint of animal blood, which the spell consumes)

description.value: Dipping your hand in blood, you call upon the curse of lycanthropy to destroy your foe. Make a melee spell attack against one creature in range. On a hit, the creature takes **10d10** necrotic damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points it dies, as 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier giant rats claw their way out of its body. These rats use the giant rat stat block, only a creature bitten by one of them must make a Constitution saving throw or be cursed with wererat lycanthropy (your GM has the creatures' statistics). These rats are not hostile to you and your companions but do not listen to your commands. If there are no other living creatures in the area, they disperse in random directions to spread their disease.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 and the number of wererats created increases by 1d4 for each slot level above 6th.
**Replaces:** __Ray of Enfeeblement__

Ghastly energy flickers within a 10-foot radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range. When a creature starts its turn in the area or moves into the area during its turn, it must make a Constitution saving throw.

On a failure, a creature is cursed with weakness until the end of its turn. While cursed, it has disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws, it deals half damage with weapon attacks that use Strength, and its speed is reduced by 10 feet.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the radius of the sphere increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 2nd.

You reach out your hand and touch a willing creature, raising a smoke-like barrier around it. For the duration, the target has Resistance to Necrotic damage and can't be cursed or possessed. If the target is already under one of these effects, the effect is suppressed until the spell ends.

You draw upon dark powers and whisper a curse as you touch a melee weapon. For the duration, any damage caused by weapon attacks using this weapon can't be healed by any means unless the individual has first received a remove curse or greater restoration spell. The spell ends if you cast it again or dismiss it as an action.

name: Cyclonic Blast
components: V, S, M (a child's spinning top)

description.value: A blast of whirling wind issues forth from your
outstretched fingers, sweeping up all who stand in its way.

The twisting torrent of wind forms a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide in a direction you choose, originating on you. Each creature and object in the line must make a Strength saving throw. A creature takes **6d8** bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone on a failed save. If a creature fails its save by 5 or more, it is also pushed up to 120 feet away from you in a direction following the line following the line. If a creature cannot travel the full distance (for example, if there is a solid barrier in the way), it takes an additional **4d8** bludgeoning damage. On a successful save, a creature takes half the initial damage and is neither pushed nor knocked prone.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the initial and secondary damage each increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 5th.

While you are wielding a pair of daggers, both of those weapons become magic weapons with a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls. In addition, whenever you take the dodge action while holding one of these daggers in each hand you have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. If another creature tries to use one of the daggers to make an attack roll, this spell ends on that dagger.

name: Dancing Lights
components: V, S, M (a bit of phosphorus)

description.value: You create up to four torch-size lights within range, making them appear as torches, lanterns, or glowing orbs that hover for the duration. Alternatively, you combine the four lights into one glowing vague silhouette of yourself. Whichever form you choose, each light sheds Dim Light in a 10-foot radius.

As a Bonus Action, you can move the lights up to 60 feet to a space within range. A light must be within 20 feet of another light created by this spell, and a light vanishes if it exceeds the spell's range.

You create a ribbonlike, weightless unbreakable bridge. This bridge must be anchored at both ends to solid objects, but otherwise can be at any angle. If the anchor points are moved or destroyed, the spell ends. The bridge is 5 feet wide, 1 inch thick, and has a maximum length of 120 feet.

The bridge can support a maximum of 500 pounds. If a creature stepping onto the bridge causes the total weight total to exceed this limit, that creature falls through the bridge as if it weren't there instead. A creature that desires to pass through the Dark Way can do so at will, no action required. The bridge provides no cover from ranged attacks or spells and unattended objects pass freely through it.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the maximum length increases by 60 feet for each slot level above 2nd.

You call forth a nimbus of jet-black energy, which allows you to shoot black bolts of power. When you first cast this spell, or as an action on your turn at any point before this spell ends, you may hurl one or more bolts of dark energy  at targets within range. You may throw a maximum number of bolts equal to 2 + your spellcasting modifier.

If you choose to throw more than one bolt in a single action, they can be at one target or several. A target must make a Dexterity saving throw for each bolt. A creature that fails its saving throw takes **2d8** necrotic damage. In addition, the first time a creature fails its saving throw by 5 or more in a turn, it is also stunned until the end of its next turn.

An undead creature that fails its saving throw instead regains 2d8 hit points and has its movement speed increased by 5 feet until the end of its next turn. A creature can choose to fail its saving throw.
If you stop *concentrating* on this spell before you have thrown the maximum number of bolts, the extra bolts are lost.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the maximum number of bolts you may throw increases by 1 for each slot level above 5th.

Dark flames appear in your hand. The flames remain there for the duration of the spell and harms neither you nor your equipment. They emit no normal light, though can be seen by creatures with darkvision as if they shed the light of a torch. When you cast this spell, or as an action while the spell lasts, you can use these flames to strike at foes. When you do so, you can choose to make a ranged spell attack at a target within 120 feet of you. On a hit, the target takes **5d8** fire damage. Alternatively, you can make a melee spell attack at a target within 5 feet of you, dealing **6d8** fire damage on a hit instead.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 4th.

name: Darkvision, Mass
components: V, S, M (either a pinch of dried carrot or an agate)

description.value: You grant yourself and any number of creatures in range the ability to see in the dark. For the duration, those creatures have darkvision out to a range of 60 feet.

A tiny radiant sun appears above your head and fires a beam of energy toward a creature of your choice within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes **2d6** fire or radiant damage (your choice) and must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of your next turn.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st.
For the duration, sunlight spreads from a point within range and fills a 60-foot-radius Sphere. The sunlight's area is Bright Light and sheds Dim Light for an additional 60 feet.

Alternatively, you cast the spell on an object that isn't being worn or carried, causing the sunlight to fill a 60-foot Emanation originating from that object. Covering that object with something opaque, such as a bowl or helm, blocks the sunlight.
If any of this spell's area overlaps with an area of Darkness created by a spell of level 3 or lower, that other spell is dispelled.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When casted at higher levels, increase the level of spell that this spell can dispel by 1 for each additional spell level.

name: Dazzle
components: V, S, M (a small glass prism)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Color Spray__

You throw open your hand and release a disorienting spray of glittering color motes. Each creature in a 20-foot cone perceives your space as heavily obscured and must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it is blinded and its speed is halved. The spell ends at the end of your next turn.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the cone's size increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 1st.

An 10-foot-radius Sphere of necromantic fog appears centered on a point you can see within range. The fog lasts for the duration or until strong wind (such as the one created by Gust of Wind) disperses it, ending the spell. Its area is Heavily Obscured.

Each creature in the Sphere makes a Constitution saving throw, taking **3d6** Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one. When you cast the spell, you can empower it with your own life force. You can choose to take 10, 20, or 30 Necrotic damage. This damage ignores Resistance and Immunity. When you do so, the spell's damage increases by 1d6 for every 10 Necrotic damage you take, up to a maximum of 10d6.

As a Magic action, you can move the fog up to 30 feet. A creature also makes a save against this spell when the Sphere moves into its space and when it enters the Sphere or ends its turn there. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 3.

You lash out at a creature you can see within range with a glowing white tendril formed of the sinister, necromantic Dead Mists. Make a ranged spell attack roll against a creature within range. On a hit, the target takes **3d8** Necrotic damage.

When you deal damage with the spell, you can also drain some of your life essence to deal extra Necrotic damage to the target. You can choose to take 5, 10, or 15 Necrotic damage. This damage ignores Resistance and Immunity. When you do so, the spell's damage increases by 1d8 for every 5 Necrotic damage you take, up to a maximum of 10d8.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 1.

A tangled mass of logs, huge branches and fallen trees appears in the air, immediately collapsing in on itself and potentially trapping and crushing those caught below. Each creature and object within a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes **15d6** bludgeoning damage, is knocked prone and restrained on a failed save, or takes half as much damage and is only knocked prone on a successful one.
A creature restrained by this spell can use an action on its turn to attempt a Strength check against your spell save DC. On a success, it frees itself.
The spell fails if there is not at least 40 feet of vertical space directly above the point.

This spell leaves behind a considerable amount of dead wood and detritus. This pile of detritus is 5 feet high, with a 20-foot-radius, which counts as difficult terrain. The pile of detritus is flammable. Any 5-foot cube of detritus exposed to fire or lightning damage ignites, burning away over the course of the next hour and dealing **2d8** fire damage to any creature that starts its turn in the fire.

The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack during this spell's duration, your weapon erupts with a blast of sonic energy, and the attack deals an extra **1d8** thunder damage to the target. Additionally, the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be deafened for 1 minute.
A creature deafened by this spell can make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a successful save, it is no longer deafened.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the extra damage dealt by the attack increases by 1d8 for each slot.

name: Death Armor
components: V, S, M (paste made from ground bones)

description.value: Black flames crackle to life around your body, wreathing you in necrotic armor. You can end the spell early by using an action to dismiss it. The armor grants you resistance to necrotic damage. In addition, whenever a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, the armor erupts with necrotic flames, dealing **1d6** necrotic damage to the attacker.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2nd. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, then whenever your shield deals damage to a creature, you gain temporary hit points equal to half that damage.
Calling upon dark powers, you surround yourself in a dragon-shaped cocoon of bones and necrotic energy. This cocoon provides the following benefits:

• You gain 75 temporary hit points. If any of these remain when the spell ends, they are lost.
• You are proficient with your unarmed strikes and your reach with your unarmed strikes increases by 5 feet. Your unarmed strikes deal 2d6+ your spellcasting ability modifier slashing damage plus **4d6** necrotic damage.
• When you make an unarmed strike, you can use your spellcasting modifier, instead of Strength, for the attack and damage rolls.
• You can attack twice, instead of once, when you take the Attack action on your turn.
• You have resistance to necrotic damage, immunity to poison damage and cannot be poisoned.
• You have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

You permit a willing creature to enter into a binding agreement with a deity or other being of power, allowing them to return to life if slain for a price. The being must be known to you: a god, a primordial, a demon prince, or some other being of cosmic power willing to bargain with you.

When the spell is cast, the creature must bargain with the being to determine an appropriate payment. The being is not under any compulsions to make a bargain. Typical payments might include such tasks as: founding a new temple in a major city, recovering a very rare magical item, defeating a powerful cleric of an opposing deity, or making an offering worth at least 25,000 gp. Once a payment has been determined the being sets a length of time, typically no more than a month, for the creature to fulfill its own end. Either the being of power or the creature it is bargaining with can end negotiations before a bargain has been struck with no negative repercussions.

Once, after the bargain has been made and the creature would die for any reason except old age, even if they have not yet fulfilled their end of the agreement, the creature is immediately restored to life with all its hit points. This spell closes all wounds, neutralizes any poison, cures all diseases, and lifts any curses affecting the creature when it died. The spell replaces damaged or missing organs and limbs.

If the creature fails to fulfill its end of the bargain within the allotted time, the creature immediately dies and cannot be restored to life by any means until another creature has fulfilled the bargain on their behalf.
This spell automatically fails if the creature is already under the effects of another casting of Death Pact.
**Replaces:** __Finger of Death__
You send a beam of negative energy at a creature you can see within range. Make a ranged spell attack. The creature takes **8d10 + 30** necrotic damage on a hit, or half as much damage on a miss.

If a humanoid dies from this spell or within 1 minute of being hit by it, it rises as a zombie at the start of your next turn and attacks the closest living creature. The GM may either use the __zombie__ statistics from the Basic Rules, or the zombie template as described in __reanimation__. At the DM's discretion, other creature types may rise as different undead.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th level or higher, the damage increases by **2d10** for each level above 7th.

You imbue a willing creature with vengeful energy. If the target is reduced to zero hit points before the spell ends, this energy bursts forth violently. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on the target must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes **5d6** necrotic damage and **5d6** fire damage on a failed save, of half as much damage on a successful one.
This spell ends if you dismiss it as an action or cast this spell again.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the fire damage and the necrotic damage each increase by 1d6 for each slot level above 5th.
You touch a creature and ward it against the touch of death. The first time the target starts its turn with 0 hit points, but is not dead, it can stand up with 1 hit point, and the spell ends.
If the spell is still in effect when the target is subjected to an effect that would kill it instantly without dealing damage, that effect is negated against the target, and the spell ends.

name: Death Ward, Mass
components: V, S, M (powdered silver worth at least 2,500 gp, which the spell consumes)

description.value: You choose any number of creatures within 30 feet of you and grant them a measure of protection from death.
The first time one of those creatures would drop to 0 hit points as a result of taking damage, the creature instead drops to 1 hit point, and the spell no longer affects that creature.

If the spell is still in effect when one of the creatures is subjected to an effect that would kill it instantaneously without dealing damage, that effect is instead negated against the target, and this spell no longer affects that creature.

Calling upon your link to the natural world, you create an aura of decay, which affect all hostile creatures in a 60-foot-radius sphere centered on you. Until the spell ends, the sphere moves with you, centered on you. Whenever an affected creature within the area takes damage the wound begin to fester, causing that creature to take an additional 3d6 points of necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns until this spell ends. If a creature takes damage while already affected by this spell, they do not suffer any additional effects.

A creature can spend an action on its turn to make a Wisdom (medicine) check against your spell save DC to end this effect on a creature. Any source of magical healing also immediately ends this effect on a creature. This does not prevent the creature from being affected by this spell again if it takes further damage.

You create illusory copies of yourself and any number of allies of your choice within 30 feet of you. The illusory copies appear at any point within range that you can see. The illusion seems completely real, including sounds, smells, and temperature appropriate to the thing depicted. The illusion cannot damage or otherwise cause harm any creature (such as by extremely loud sounds or a troglodyte's stench).
The illusion mimics what you and your allies do, staying a distance away from you that you specify, up to 300 feet. If the illusion takes any damage, it disappears and the spell ends.
Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an
Illusion. A creature that uses its action to examine the image can determine that it is an Illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC.

Additionally, If the terrain differs significantly between that of an illusion and that of the creature it is mimicking, or if any creature takes an action the illusion can't duplicate (such as climbing a tree), then any creature observing the illusion can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the Illusion for what it is, the creature can see through the image, and any noise it makes sounds hollow to the creature.
If one of your allies moves more than 30 feet away from you, that creature immediately disappears from the illusion.

Your lungs fill with air, though you feel no need to exhale. For the duration, you do not need to breathe. When this spell ends, you can continue to hold your breath as if you had just taken a deep breath.

You touch a willing creature to grant it the ability to see in the dark, both magical and nonmagical. For the duration, that creature has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. If a creature already has darkvision, this spell increases the range of their darkvision by 60 feet. Additionally, this spell allows the creature to see in magical darkness as if it were nonmagical darkness.

name: Defenestrating Sphere
components: V, S, M (a gray pearl worth 100gp)

description.value: You create a small, violently swirling sphere of air and launch it at your enemies. When you cast the spell, you can make a ranged spell attack against a creature within range. On a hit, the target takes **5d6** bludgeoning damage and must make a strength Saving throw if the creature is Medium sized or smaller. On a failed save, the creature is also knocked prone. If the creature fails this save by 5 or more, it is swept up by the sphere and thrown 10 feet into the air, landing prone at a random location within 10 feet of their original position and taking falling damage as normal.
As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the sphere up to 30 feet and repeat the attack against a creature.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for every slot level above 4th.

name: Deflect
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when you are hit by an attack or targeted by the magic missile spell

description.value: **Replaces:** __Shield__

A transparent sphere of arcane force appears, averting incoming attacks. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, to a maximum of 21 AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from magic missile.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the bonus to AC (and the maximum AC) increases by 1 for every two slot levels above 1st (for example, when cast with a 5th-level spell slot, you have a +7 bonus to AC, to a maximum of 23 AC).

You draw the moisture out of a creature you can see within range. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. Constructs and Undead aren't affected, and Plants and water elementals make this saving throw with disadvantage. The target takes **6d8** necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Additionally, if the target fails its saving throw 5 by or more, it also suffers one level of exhaustion.
Nonmagical plants within 5 feet of the creature that aren't creatures, such as trees and shrubs, wither and die instantly.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 3rd.

A burst of radiance emanates from you in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes **3d8** radiant damage. An undead that fails this save becomes frightened for 1 minute. An undead can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage with no additional effects.
