A creature has disadvantage on the initial save if it has dealt damage to you or one of your allies in the last 1 minute.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, increase the radiant damage by 1d8 for each slot level above 2nd.

This spell creates delusions within the mind of a  creature you can see, manipulating them into bouts of overconfident recklessness. At the start of each round, the creature must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, nothing happens. On a failed save, the creature is enamored with its own prowess and can take no actions on its turn except for those involving weapon attacks and can't take reactions until the start of its next turn.

name: Demand
components: V, S, M (a snake's tongue and a piece of copper wire)

description.value: This spell projects a select Enchantment spell to a target, regardless of distance. When you cast __Charm Monster__, __Charm Person__, __Command__, __Dominate Beast__, __Dominate Person__, __Geas__, or __Suggestion__, before this spell ends, you modify its casting so that its range becomes unlimited. This spell then ends.

Choose a target with which you are familiar (whether or not you can see it) for the Enchantment spell. If the spell requires a verbal command, the creature hears the command in its mind and recognizes you as the sender if it knows you.

You can project the spell across any distance, and even to other planes of existence, but if the target is on a different plane than you, there is a 5 percent chance that the Enchantment spell fails and has no effect.

You utter ancient words, wreaking havoc on the corporeal form of a creature of evil. Choose one creature you can see within range. If that creature is a Fiend it must make a Constitution saving throw at the beginning of each of its turns while the spell lasts. A Fiend takes **3d10** radiant damage on a failed save. In addition, a Demon that fails  this save is stunned until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and the spell ends.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 3rd.
Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch gains resistance against radiant damage and against bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.

name: Desiccating Bubble
components: S, M (a tiny bag or bladder filled with air and a sprinkle of dust)

description.value: A 15-foot-diameter sphere of supernaturally dry air appears in an unoccupied space of your choice within range and lasts for the duration. Any creature that ends its turn within the sphere must make a Dexterity saving throw. Constructs and undead aren't affected, and plants and water elementals make this saving throw with disadvantage. The creature takes **2d6** necrotic damage on  a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. As a bonus action, you can move the sphere up to 30 feet. If you ram the sphere into a creature, that creature must make the saving throw against the sphere's damage, and the sphere stops moving this turn. When you move the sphere, you can direct it over barriers up to 5 feet tall and jump it across pits up to 10 feet wide.
Nonmagical plants that come into contact with the sphere that aren't creatures, such as trees and shrubs, wither and die instantly.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2nd.

For the duration, you sense the location of poisons, acids, poisonous or venomous creatures, acidic creatures, oozes and magical contagions within 30 feet of yourself. You sense the kind of poison, acid, creature, or contagion in each case.
The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.
**Replaces:** __Find Traps__

You sense the presence of any trap within range. A trap, for the purpose of this spell, includes any object, terrain, or magic that would inflict a sudden or unexpected effect you consider harmful or undesirable. Thus, the spell would sense an area affected by the __alarm__ spell, a __spell glyph__, a hidden pit trap, or a natural sinkhole, but not a creature lying in ambush.

The spell reveals the general presence and vague direction of a trap within its 120-foot range, but not its specific location. If you come within 15 feet of the trap, you detect its presence exactly, and any ability checks you or your companions make to examine it are made with advantage.
The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.
**Replaces:** __Detect Evil and Good__

You sense the presence of unnatural or extraplanar creatures. The spell reveals the existence of any aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, or undead within 30 feet of you, as well as their locations. You also have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Wisdom (Insight) checks against such creatures for the duration.
The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.
Replaced by Detect Chemicals. If you would learn this spell, learn the spell that has replaced it instead.

name: Devil Binding
components: V, S, M (a vial of blood and an obsidian chalice worth at least 665 gp)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Infernal Calling__

You recite a profane chant to summon a devil, which appears in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The devil's challenge rating is at least 4 and no higher than 8. The GM chooses the devil's type, and it is under the GM's control. If you know a devil's true name or possess its talisman, you can attempt to summon that devil regardless of its challenge rating.

The devil typically resents being summoned but will not harm you for the duration. On each of your turns, you can command it. It obeys orders it considers reasonable and fights ruthlessly, but will retreat to preserve its life and rank.

After 10 minutes, the devil can ignore your commands and might choose to remain and pursue its own goals. You may attempt to reason with, persuade, or strike a deal that aligns with its interests. If you maintain *concentration* for the full duration, you may return the devil to whence it came, otherwise, it remains summoned indefinitely.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the devil's possible challenge rating increases by 2 for each slot level above 5th.

You utter ancient words, wreaking havoc on the corporeal form of a creature of evil. Choose one creature you can see within range. If that creature is a Fiend it must make a Constitution saving throw at the beginning of each of its turns while the spell lasts. A Fiend takes **3d10** radiant damage on a failed save. In addition, a Devil that fails this save is stunned until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half damage and the spell ends.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Diamondsteel
components: V, S, M (diamond dust worth at least 50 gp, which the spell consumes)

description.value: You touch a suit of nonmagical metal armor, imbuing it with a sparkling shine. For the duration, any creature that wears the armor gains +2AC in addition to what the armor normally provides. In addition, while you are wearing the armor, any critical hit against you becomes a normal hit.

You manifest a herd of spectral, stampeding dinosaurs to crush your enemies.. When you cast this spell, the spectral stampede erupts from you in a 10-foot-wide, 40-foot-long line, charging in a direction you choose. Each creature in that line must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes **6d10** bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone.
You can create a new stampede as an action while the spell lasts. When you create a new stampede, the point where it originates is where the last stampede ended rather than at you.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 6th.

You fill another creature you can see in range with a feral hunger, to the point where it can think of little else. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. If it fails the saving throw, the target becomes maddened by terrible pangs of hunger for the duration, viewing all creatures as a food source.

The creature's face distends and elongates into a toothy snout filled with serrated teeth. The creature gains a bite attack, which counts as a natural weapon it can use to make unarmed strikes. If it hits with them, it deals piercing damage based on the creature's size instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike, according to the following table:

In addition, the target can't take reactions and must use its action each turn to make a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach using its bite attack. If there is no creature within its reach, it must first move as far as it can towards the nearest creature.
The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

You let forth a wail filled with otherworldly power. Creatures of your choice within 30 feet must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take **4d10** thunder damage and be deafened for the duration. At the end of each turn, targets can make a Constitution saving throw, ending the spell on a success. On a successful save, it takes half damage and is not deafened.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th-level or higher, the damage increases by **1d10** for each slot level above 3rd.

You receive a message of up to 6 words from yourself in the future, warning you of a critical threat or pointing you toward a fruitful avenue. At some point in the future, once you have learned why you sent the message, you must perform a ritual over the course of 10 minutes, which can be done during a Short Rest, to deliver the message back in time to your past self.

Once you cast this spell, you can't cast it again for 7 days or until you perform this ritual. If you cast this spell and receive no message, it indicates that you will never complete the ritual in the future, possibly owing to your death or another hindrance.

name: Dirge of Discord
components: V, S, M (a pinch of ashes from a destrachan)

description.value: You create an unholy, cacophonous dirge that fills your targets' minds with the screams of the dying, the wailing of the damned, and the howling of the mad, which affects all creatures in a 30-foot radius sphere centered on you. When you cast this spell, you can designate any number of creatures you can see to be unaffected by it. An affected creature's speed is halved in the area, and when the creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature has disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws to maintain *Concentration* until the end of its next turn.

name: Discern Shapechanger
components: V, S, M (a balm of honey and lotus flower)

description.value: For the duration, you can see the true form of creatures within 60 feet, including Shapechangers and creatures transformed by magic. In addition, you automatically detect visual illusions and succeed on saving throws against them.
The spell can penetrate most barriers, but it is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range. For each ongoing spell on the target make an ability check using your spellcasting ability and add the level you're casting this spell at. The DC is 10 plus the twice opposing spell's level. On a successful check, the spell ends.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: Special (See description)

You exhale a cloud of starlight motes, which gravitate towards sources of magic within the cloud. For each creature, object or magical effect in a 15-foot cone, any spell of 3rd level or lower ends. For each spell of 4th level or higher, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability. The DC equals 10 + the spell's level. On a successful check, the spell ends.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you automatically end the effects of a spell on the target if the spell's level is equal to or less than the level of the spell slot you used.

name: Dispelling Screen
components: V, S, M (a sheet of fine lead crystal)

description.value: You create a shimmering, immobile screen of violet energy up to 60 feet long, 30 feet high, and 1 inch thick -centered on a point you can see within range. Alternatively, you can shape the wall into a Sphere up to 30 feet in diameter centered on a point you choose within range.

For the duration, whenever a creature, object or magical effect passes through the screen, any spell of 4th level or lower on it ends. For each spell of 5th level or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability. The DC equals 10 + the spell's level. On a successful check, the spell ends.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you automatically end the effects of a spell on the target if the spell's level is equal to or less than the level of the spell slot you used.

You fill the mind of a Humanoid that you can see in range with doubt and suspicion, to the point where it cannot bear to be near other creatures. For the duration of the spell, if any creatures are within 15 feet of the target, the target must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, the target must move so that no creatures are within 15 feet of them before they can take any other actions. If they cannot move in such a way, or if moving would take them into direct danger (such as the edge of a cliff) the creature instead must spend its entire turn taking the dodge action.

Choose an Undead creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make another Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the spell ends on the target.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you can target one additional Undead for each slot level above 3rd. The Undead must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.
**Replaces:** __Banishing Smite__

You empower your weapon, giving it the ability to tear the fabric of the planes. The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack before this spell ends, you tear a hole to another plane and tangle it within the interplanar aether. The attack deals an extra **5d10** force damage, and the target must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, it is partly phased out of the plane, becoming incapacitated and gaining resistance to all damage until the spell ends.
A creature incapacitated by this spell makes another Charisma saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a successful save, the spell ends.

You create a distracting and discordant chant. Each creature other than yourself within a 100 foot radius of you that can hear you has disadvantage on Perception checks that rely on hearing and on Constitution saving throws they make to maintain their *Concentration* on a spell. In addition, each creature other than yourself that is *Concentrating* on a spell at the start of its turn while in the area must make a DC10 Constitution saving throw or else lose *Concentration* on that spell.

You emit a terrible, piercing note. The note pulses in the air, radiating like a shockwave and audible out to 300 feet. Each creature you choose within 10 feet of you must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take **8d6** thunder damage. A creature that succeeds on its saving throw takes half as much damage. A nonmagical object that isn't being worn or carried also takes damage if it's in the spell's area.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.

Choose one creature that you can see within range to make a Constitution saving throw. If it fails, any words the target speaks for the duration come out as meaningless gibberish. Spells requiring verbal components automatically fail and any attempts to communicate verbally are unintelligible. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make a Constitution saving throw. On a success, the spell ends.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

You point at a creature you can see in range. That creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, ambient noises and objects suddenly seem every bit as interesting than the threats before them. The next attack roll made against that creature is made with advantage.

You fire a dazzling ray at a creature in range that you can see. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw, taking **4d8** psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, the target also has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws that they make to maintain their *Concentration* on a spell for the next minute.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 2nd.
You touch one creature, imbuing it with agility and skill in combat. Until the spell ends, the target gains the following benefits:

• The target has advantage on Dexterity ability checks and on attack rolls made using a finesse or a ranged weapon.
• The target can attack twice, instead of once, when it takes the Attack action on its turn. It ignores this benefit if it already has a feature, like Extra Attack, that gives it extra attacks.
• Whenever the target is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.
Your prayer empowers one weapon of your choice within 10 feet of you with divine radiance. Until the spell ends, attacks with that weapon deal an extra **1d4** radiant damage on a hit.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you target one additional weapon within 10 feet of you for each slot level above 1st.

Immediately after making an ability check roll, before knowing the result, you may use your reaction to gain a bonus to that roll equal to your spellcasting ability modifier. Once you have used this ability three times, this spell ends.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you may gain a bonus on two additional ability check rolls before the spell ends for each slot level above 3rd.

You call upon your deity to quell the healing powers of others. Choose a point you can see within range. Creatures within a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on that point can't regain hit points for the duration.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the radius increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 2nd. When you cast this spell with a 5th level spell slot or higher, you can use a bonus action on your turn to move the sphere up to 20 feet in any direction.

Golden light radiates from you in a 15-foot aura. Until the spell ends, the aura moves with you, centered on you. Each allied creature in the aura (including you) gains a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws.

The first time you hit with a melee weapon attack during this spell's duration, you give up a portion of your own life force to empower your strike. The attack deals an extra **5d6** radiant damage to the target. Additionally, you take 10 necrotic damage. The necrotic damage you take ignores resistance and immunity.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the extra damage dealt by the attack increases by 2d6 and the damage you take increases by 4 for each slot level above 1st.
**Replaces:** __Temple of the Gods__
You create a holy sanctuary dedicated to a specific deity at an empty point on the ground you can see within range. The temple occupies a cube up to 60 feet on each side.

The temple has at least one door and is enclosed by wood and stone floors, walls, and a roof. You determine all other aspects of its appearance (as long as it conforms to the worship of the deity to which it is devoted) such as altars, idols, illumination, rooms, scent, temperature, and windows.
Divination spells of 6th level and below can't target creatures within the temple or create sensors inside of it.

When you cast the spell, choose one or more of the following creature types for the temple to oppose: aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, or undead. If such a creature attempts to enter the temple, it must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, it can't enter the temple for 24 hours. On a success, whenever it makes an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw inside the temple, it must roll a d4 and subtract the number rolled from the d20 roll.
Casting this spell on the same spot every day for a year makes the temple permanent.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the casting time increases by 1 hour and the temple's size increases by 60 feet on each side for each spell level above 6th. The temple counters divination spells of a level less than or equal to the slot level used.

name: Divine Wrath
components: V, S, M (a pinch of sulfur)

description.value: You deliver a mote of divine wrath to a point you can see within range. Each creature you choose in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes **4d10** Necrotic or Radiant damage (your choice), or half as much damage on a successful save. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points, the creature is disintegrated into salt and everything it was wearing or carrying falls in its space. The target can be revived only by a True Resurrection or a Wish spell.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 3.
You touch a weapon, imbuing it with a longing for battle. Until the spell ends, weapon attacks made with that weapon score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

You fill a 20-foot-radius sphere with illusory black, creeping mist that vaguely resembles thousands of slender grasping tentacles centered on a point you choose within range. It lasts for the duration or until strong wind disperses the mist, ending the spell. Its area is heavily obscured. When a creature enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, that creature must make a Intelligence saving throw. The creature takes **2d12** psychic damage and is stunned until the start of it's next turn on a failed save, or half as much damage and is not stunned on a successful one.

The mist moves 20 feet away from the point where it was cast at the start of each of your turns, rolling along the surface of the ground. The mist, being heavier than air, sinks to the lowest level of the land, even pouring down openings.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d12 for each slot level above 5th.

name: Downdraft
components: V, S, M (a balsa wood bird carving)

description.value: Each creature flying more than 10 feet above the ground in a 20-foot-radius, 100-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range must make a Strength saving throw. A creature plummets up to 100 feet straight downward on a failed save, taking falling damage if the downdraft causes them to hit the ground or collide with an object. On a successful save, they plummet up to 50 feet instead.

name: Downtick
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when a creature you can see within 90 ft would succeed on an attack roll, ability check or saving throw

description.value: You tick back time a single second, forcing the target to make a wisdom saving throw. If they fail, they roll another d20. Compare the number on the die of both rolls to 3. If the new number's distance from 3 is greater than the old number's distance from 3, it replaces it.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell at a higher level, add 1 to the number your comparing to for each additional slot level.

You bolster yourself or a creature you touch with the might of a dragon. For the duration, the target has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects and can make a Wisdom (Perception) check on its turn as a bonus action. In addition, choose one of the following damage types: acid, lightning, poison, fire, or cold. For the duration, the target's weapon attacks have a +1 bonus to attack rolls and deal an extra 1d6 of the chosen type when they hit.

This spell summons a Dragon. When you cast this spell, you may choose one type of dragon from among the five chromatic (black, blue, green, red or white) or five metallic dragon (brass, bronze, copper, gold, silver) types. If you do, the Dragon is of that type. If you know a specific dragon's name, you can speak that name when you cast this spell to request that creature, though you might get a different creature anyway (GM's choice).

You may ask the dragon to perform one task in exchange for a payment from you. Tasks might range from the simple (fly us across the chasm, help us fight a battle) to the complex (spy on our enemies, protect us on our foray into the dungeon). You must be able to communicate with the dragon to bargain for its services.

The summoned Dragon is under no compulsion to behave in any particular way. It typically requires payment for its services, which takes the form of coins, gems, or other precious objects the dragon can add to its hoard. This payment must be made before the dragon agrees to perform any services.

As a rule of thumb, a task that can be measured in minutes requires a payment worth 100 gp per minute. A task measured in hours requires 1,000 gp per hour. And a task measured in days (up to 10 days) requires 10,000 gp per day. The DM can adjust these payments based on the circumstances under which you cast the spell. If the task is aligned with the creature's ethos, the payment might be halved or even waived (chromatic dragons are more willing to perform tasks that are evil, while metallic dragons are more willing to perform tasks that are good). Non-hazardous tasks typically require only half the suggested payment, while especially dangerous tasks might require a greater gift. Creatures rarely accept tasks that seem suicidal.
At the end of its task, or when the duration bargained for elapses, the creature returns to the place it was summoned from (after reporting back to you, if appropriate and possible).

A creature enlisted to join your group counts as a member of it, receiving a full share of experience points awarded.This spell summons a Dragon. When you cast this spell, you may choose one type of dragon from among the five chromatic (black, blue, green, red or white) or five metallic dragon (brass, bronze, copper, gold, silver) types. If you do, the Dragon is of that type. If you know a specific dragon's name, you can speak that name when you cast this spell to request that creature, though you might get a different creature anyway (GM's choice).

Tasks might range from the simple (fly us across the chasm, help us fight a battle) to the complex (spy on our enemies, protect us on our foray into the dungeon). You must be able to communicate with the dragon to bargain for its services.

At the end of its task, or when the duration bargained for elapses, the creature returns to the place it was summoned from (after reporting back to you, if appropriate and possible).
A creature enlisted to join your group counts as a member of it, receiving a full share of experience points awarded.

name: Dragonbane Aura
components: V, S, M (powdered platinum, which the spell consumes)

description.value: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is protected against Dragons. The protection grants several benefits:

• Dragons have disadvantage on attack rolls against the target.
• The target has advantage on saving throws against Dragon breath weapons.
• The target is can't be frightened.

Your skin toughens and becomes scaly like that of a chromatic dragon of a color that you choose. Your base AC becomes 13+ your Dexterity modifier. Additionally, you gain resistance to one damage type, based on the color of dragon you chose when casting this spell: acid (black), cold (white), lightning (blue), fire (red) or poison (green).
The spell ends if you don armor or if you dismiss the spell as an action.
**Replaces:** __Sapping Sting__

You sap the vitality of one creature you can see in range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes **1d6** necrotic damage and has disadvantage on the next weapon attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.
This spell's damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).
**Replaces:** __Enervation__

You empower yourself with deathly energies, gaining the ability to harvest life from your foes. When you cast the spell, you extend a black tendril out to one creature you can see within range. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it takes **6d8** necrotic damage and has its speed halved until the start of your next turn. On a success, it takes half as much damage and suffers no other effects. You regain hit points equal to half the damage dealt. Until the spell ends, you can use your action on each of your turns to repeat the effect against a creature within range.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 5th.

Whenever you see a creature within 60 feet of you casting a spell before the spell ends, you may end this spell and attempt to interrupt that creature, requiring no action to do so. If the creature is casting a spell of 5th-Level or lower, its spell fails and has no effect. If it is casting a spell of 6th level or higher, make an ability check using your Spellcasting Ability. The DC equals 10 + the spell's level.
On a success, the creature's spell fails and has no effect.

name: Dust Cyclone
components: V, S, M (a pinch of dust)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Dust Devil__
A small cyclone whips up at a point you can see on the ground within range. The cyclone is a 5-foot radius, 30-foot high cylinder centered on that point.

Any creature that starts its turn within the radius of the dust cyclone or enters its radius for the first time during its turn must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes **1d12** bludgeoning damage and is pushed 5 feet away from the center. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't pushed.

As a bonus action, you can move the dust cyclone up to 30 feet in any direction. The first time you pass the dust cyclone through a creature, you can force it to make the saving throw, as if it entered the cyclone's radius. You can continue to move the dust cyclone, but its strength is exhausted until the end of your turn and subsequent creatures are unaffected by it passing through them.
If the dust cyclone moves over sand, dust, loose dirt, or small gravel, it sucks up the material and heavily obscures its radius until the start of your next turn.

name: Earth Forming
components: V, S, M (a tiny silver pickaxe)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Move Earth__

For the duration, you magically command the earth to reshape itself around you. As an action, you can permanently modify up to a 20-foot cube of soft earth you can see within range, such as sand, dirt, or clay, which you can move up to 20 feet over the course of 5 minutes. You can change its elevation or create or destroy trenches, pillars, ramps, walls, or other simple shapes. Because the terrain's transformation occurs slowly, creatures in the area can't usually be trapped or injured by the ground's movement. You can choose a new area to modify at any point, though you can only shape one area at a time; an unfinished formation slowly reverts to its original shape.
The spell can't shape stone, metal, or other hard materials. Rocks, plants, and structures shift or move to accommodate the new terrain, and may become unstable or fall.
When you cast this spell as a ritual, the silver pickaxe must be worth at least 500 gp and is consumed.

name: Earth Leash
components: V, S, M (a tiny orange flag)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Earthbind__

You point at one creature you can see within range and send a lashing tendril of earth to haul it to the ground. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw, or immediately fall prone. If the creature has a flying speed, it loses its flying speed for the spell's duration, causing it to fall even if it can hover. An airborne creature takes falling damage as normal, up to a maximum of 4d6 points of bludgeoning damage.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the number of targets increases by 1 for each slot level above 2nd, and the maximum damage from falling increases by **1d6** for each level above 2nd.

name: Earth Lock
components: V, S, M (a diamond chip worth at least 25 gp embedded in a piece of charcoal, which the spell consumes)

description.value: You cause a 1-foot length of subterranean tunnel to constrict, closing against others who might wish to traverse its length. This spell affects only naturally occurring  tunnels made of stone or earth that are 10 feet in diameter or less. The section of wall constricts, closing entirely over the course of 1 round. Any large or smaller object or creature in the area of this spell is pushed, unharmed, to one side or the other. A creature can decide which side it ends up on, while an object is pushed to a random side. If a huge or larger object or creature is in the area when you cast this spell, it prevents the tunnel from constricting until the creature or object is moved.

As a bonus action, you or the creatures you designate when you cast this spell can command a tunnel you have secured with this spell to open or close, which takes 1 round to complete. A dispel magic spell causes the tunnel to revert to its original shape, while a knock spell temporarily suppresses the spell, causing the tunnel to open for the next 10 minutes.
If a creature burrows through the earth lock or if the tunnel is dug out, the spell ends.

Choose a spot on the ground you can see within range. The ground erupts in a shower of rocks, dirt and fire in a 20-foot radius sphere centered on that point. Each creature and each object that isn't being worn or carried in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw. A target takes 6d6 bludgeoning and **4d6** fire damage and is knocked prone on a failed save, or half as much damage and is not knocked prone on a successful one.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the bludgeoning damage or the fire damage (your choice) increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 5th.
**Replaces:** __Earth Tremor__

You cause the ground immediately around you to shake and roll. Each other creature within 10 feet of you must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes **2d6** bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone. If the terrain is dirt or stone, it becomes difficult terrain for creatures other than you for the next hour.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by **1d6** for each slot level above 1st, and the radius increases by 5 feet for every two slot levels above 1st.

name: Earthen Grace
components: V, S, M (a chunk of granite)

description.value: You grant a creature you touch an affinity for earth and stone. For the duration, The target's speed increases by 10 feet and they can't be knocked prone as long as they are standing on dirt, mud, grass, sand or stone and they have resistance to falling damage when they land on one of these types of materials. In addition, earth elementals have disadvantage on attack rolls against the target.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

You touch a rock formation or stone structure, greatly bolstering its durability. You can bolster up to a 25-foot cube of material, granting it +2 bonus to AC and 25 hit points for the duration. This spell does not function on constructs.
If you cast this spell in the same location every day for one year the effect becomes permanent.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the hit points granted increases by 25 for each slot level above 2nd.

You create a path of handholds and footholds up the surface of a cliff-face, tree trunk, wall, or other vertical obstacle. The handholds can extend down or up the surface, up to a maximum of 100 feet from a point you touch.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the maximum range the handholds will extend increases by 100 feet for each slot level above 2nd.

The undergrowth parts for you and your companions, and paths are abundant and easy to find. For the duration of this spell, each creature you choose within 30 feet of you (including you) is not slowed by difficult terrain and cannot become lost except by magical means.

name: Ebon Eyes
components: V, S, M (a pinch of powdered black gemstone of any type)

description.value: You touch a willing creature to grant it the ability to pierce the deepest gloom. For the duration, that creature has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet and can see in magical darkness as though it were normal darkness.

name: Echo Skull
components: V, S, M (a tiny dried animal skull)

description.value: You touch a dried animal skull, causing it to glow with a green radiance, which quickly fades. For the duration of the spell, as long as you and the skull remain on the same plane, you are telepathically linked to the skull. As an action, you can see and hear through the skull as if you were standing where it is until the start of your next turn.
During this time, you are deaf and blind with regard to your present location.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level, the duration increases to 24 hours, to 1 week at 7th level, to 1 year at 8th level and indefinitely at 9th level.

When you cast this spell, 9 floating silvery spheres the size of your head appear and begin orbiting around your body. As a bonus action on your turn, you may command one or more of these spheres to begin orbiting another creature or call them all back to you.

For the duration, whenever a spell is cast that targets a creature one of these spheres orbits, or includes them in its area of effect, that creature may choose to have one of these spheres absorb the spell instead. A spell absorbed this way fails and has no effect. Once a sphere has absorbed a spell, it fades away.

You strike at the mind of a creature you can see within range, attacking its very sense of self. The target must succeed on an Intelligence saving throw or suffer disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks, and it cannot cast spells. At the end of each of its turns, the target can repeat the saving throw. On a successful save, this effect ends on the target.

name: Eldritch Armor
components: V, S, M (a vial of scorpion venom)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Armor of Agathys__

You protect yourself with an acidic coating that sprays outward when struck. You gain 1d4 + 4 temporary hit points for the duration. If a creature hits you with a melee attack while you have these temporary hit points, the creature takes 2d4 acid damage.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, both the temporary hit points and the acid damage increase by 2d4 for each slot, up to a maximum of 9d4 + 4 temporary hit points and 10d4 damage at 5th level.

You hurl a beam of crackling energy. Make a ranged spell attack against one creature or object in range. On a hit, the target takes **1d10** Force damage and until the end of your next turn it treats willingly moving towards you as difficult terrain. This only applies while they can see you and they are moving towards every creature that inflicted this effect (or equivalent) onto them. Other effects treat this effect the same way they treat the angered condition.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The damage increases by 1d10 when you reach levels 5 (2d10), 11 (3d10), and 17 (4d10).

You fling a ball of eldritch energy at a creature or object within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes **1d8** Force damage and explodes in a 5-foot Emanation. Each creature in the Emanation makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking half the amount of Force damage on a failed save, or none on a successful one.

description.name: Cantrip Upgrade
description.value: The damage increases by 1d8 when you reach levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).
**Replaces:** __Arms of Hadar__

You open a momentary portal to an unknowable void, letting eldritch tentacles slip through to tear at your enemies. Each other creature within 10 feet of you must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 3d4 necrotic damage and is gripped by the tentacles, preventing it from making reactions until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and instead has disadvantage on opportunity attacks until the start of its next turn.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 2d4 for each slot level above 1st, and you can increase the spell's radius by up to 5 feet for each slot level above 1st.

name: Eldritch Tentacles
components: V, S, M (a piece of tentacle from a giant squid)

description.value: Alien tentacles fill a 20-foot square on the ground you can see within range. For the duration, this area is difficult terrain.

When a creature enters this area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take **3d6** bludgeoning damage and be restrained by the tentacles until the spell ends. Any creature that begins its turn in the area and is restrained by the tentacles takes **3d6** bludgeoning damage at the start of its turn.
A creature restrained by the tentacles can use its action to make a Strength or Dexterity check (its choice) against your spell save DC. On a success, it frees itself from the tentacles.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, both instances of damage from this spell increase by **1d6** for each slot level above 4th.

A white-hot electric spark dances on your fingertip and then bolts toward a creature you can see in range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take **1d8** lightning damage. The target has disadvantage on this save if it is wearing armor made of metal.
This spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

name: Electric Loop
components: V, S, M (a loop of copper wire and a magnet)

description.value: Electricity leaps from your fingertips, arcing among foes in a loop around you. Each creature of your choice within 15 feet of you must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take **3d8** lightning damage

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Elemental Blade
components: V, S, M (a charred wooden hilt)

description.value: You evoke an elemental blade in a free hand, choosing one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder. The elemental blade appears as if it were made of the chosen element, and lasts for the duration. If you let go of the blade, it disappears, but you can evoke the blade again as a bonus action without expending a spell slot.

Whenever you would make a melee attack, you can make a melee spell attack with the elemental blade against a target within your reach. On hit, it takes damage of the chosen type equal to 2d6 + your spellcasting modifier.
While in your hand, the blade sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light an additional 10 feet beyond that.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for every two slot levels above 2nd.

name: Elemental Body
components: V, S, M (a suit of plate armor worth at least 1500 gp)

description.value: This spell transforms you into a powerful elemental warrior. The transformation lasts for the duration, until you drop to 0 hit points or die, or until you take an action to end the spell early. The new form can be either an earth, water, air or fire elemental myrmidon (MToF). Your game statistics, including mental ability scores, are replaced by the statistics of the chosen myrmidon. You retain your alignment and personality. You GM has the creatures' statistics.

You assume the hit points of your new form. When you revert to your normal form, you return to the number of hit points you had before you transformed. If you reverted as a result of dropping to 0 hit points, any excess damage carries over to your normal form. As long as the excess damage doesn't reduce your normal form to 0 hit points, you are not knocked unconscious.

You are limited in the actions you can perform by the nature of your new form and you can't cast spells. Your gear melds into the new form, with the exception of the armor used to cast this spell, which your new form fills. Your new form is proficient with this armor. You can't activate, use, wield, or otherwise benefit from any of your other equipment.

A spark leaps from your finger to a creature you touch, spreading in bright cracks across its skin. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be cursed for the duration. The cursed target has Vulnerability to your choice of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage. If the creature has Resistance to the chosen damage type, it instead loses that Resistance. If the target has Immunity to the chosen damage type, it instead has Resistance to that damage type.

name: Elemental Reflection
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when you take acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage

description.value: **Replaces:** __Absorb Elements__

You create an elemental ward, gaining resistance to the triggering damage. When you cast the spell, you can choose to either extend the resistance until the end of your next turn, or you can cause your next weapon attack before the end of your next turn to deal an additional **1d8** damage of the triggering type and an additional effect depending on the triggering damage type.

• **Acid.** The target takes **1d4** acid damage at the end of its next turn.
• **Cold.** The target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of your next turn.
• **Fire.** The attack ignites flammable objects not being worn or carried.
• **Lightning.** The target can't take reactions until the start of its next turn.
• **Thunder.** The target is deafened until the end of its next turn.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the additional damage increases by **1d8** for each slot level above 1st.
**Replaces:** __Primordial Ward__

You create a whirling shield of elemental power around yourself. When you cast this spell, select one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. Until the spell ends, you gain immunity to that damage type, and creatures of your choice within 5 feet of you gain resistance to it. As a bonus action, you can change the shield's damage type.

You touch a willing creature and bestow upon it a magical enhancement as it takes on the physical features of a beast. Choose one of the following effects; the target gains that effect until the spell ends.

• **Charge.** If the creature moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature then hits it with a melee attack on the same turn, the creature takes an extra **2d6** damage and must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC or be knocked prone.
• **Rampage.** When the target reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, it can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make another melee attack.
• **Pack tactics.** The target has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of its allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.
• **Blood Frenzy.** The target has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

One of your hands bursts into an aura of brilliant emerald flame, shedding bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. As an action on your  turn while your fist is alight, you may make a melee spell attack against a creature or object within 5 feet of you. On a hit the target takes **10d10** fire damage and is engulfed by  an aura of flame for the next minute. At the beginning of each of its turns, a target engulfed in flame must make a Constitution saving throw or take **3d10** fire damage. On a success, the fires have been doused and the spell ends. An object engulfed in flame automatically fails this saving throw. Your fist remains alight until you successfully strike a target or you stop *Concentrating* on the spell, whichever comes first.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th level or higher, the initial damage and ongoing damage each increase by 1d10 for each slot level above 7th.

For the next minute, a willing creature you touch has resistance to one damage type of your choice: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. The next time the target hits a creature with a weapon attack before this spell ends, the attack deals an extra **2d6** damage of the chosen damage type to the target, and the spell ends. This spells ends immediately if you cast it again.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2nd.

You release a black needle of crackling energy that suppresses the life force of whatever creature it touches. Make a ranged spell attack against a creature you can see within range. On a hit, the target takes **8d8** necrotic damage. Until the spell ends, you can use your action on each of your turns to automatically deal **8d8** necrotic damage to the target.

The spell ends if you use your action to do anything else, if the target is ever outside the spell's range, or if the target has total cover from you. Whenever the spell deals damage to a target, it's maximum hit points are reduced by half the damage dealt. The maximum hit point reduction lasts until the target receives a greater restoration, heal, wish spell or similar magic.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 7th.
For the duration, the willing creature you touch has immunity to one damage type of your choice: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder

You create a circle of five colored spheres that orbit your head at a distance of 1 foot. These spheres provide as much light as a torch and each one corresponds to a different one of five damage types (acid, cold, lightning, fire, thunder). These spheres can be used offensively or defensively.

When you cast this spell, or as a bonus action on your turn, you can command one of these spheres to strike a creature you can see in range. Make a ranged spell attack against that creature. On a hit, the target takes **5d8** damage of the corresponding damage type.
Alternatively, if you would take damage and still have a sphere of that damage type, you may use your reaction to reduce that damage by 5d8.
Once a sphere has been used either to attack or absorb damage, it is destroyed and cannot be used again.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage dealt or absorbed increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 4th.

name: Energy Transformation Field
components: V, S, M (the central eye from a beholder and 5000 gp with of powdered diamond, which the spell consumes)

description.value: You create a lasting zone of transformative magic that absorbs magic energy from spellcasting in order to power another spell tied to that location. This field extends in a 30-foot radius sphere from a point you choose within range. When you cast this spell, choose another spell you can cast of 5th-level or lower to link to the field. The field absorbs the magic of spells cast within this sphere, causing those spells to fail and have no effect. When the field absorbs a spell, it gains a number of charges equal to the level of the absorbed spell. The field can have a maximum of 10 charges at one time.

When the field has a number of charges equal to or greater than the level of the spell linked to it, it attempts to cast the spell using your spellcasting ability, expending a number of charges equal to the level of the linked spell. The field acts on initiative order 20 and can only cast one spell per round, requiring no components. If the spell requires a target, the field will choose the valid target nearest to the center of the energy transformation field. If a linked spell requires *Concentration* to maintain, the field maintains *Concentration* for the maximum duration before casting the linked spell again. Spells cast by the field are not absorbed by it.

Ongoing spells that were initially cast outside of the area are not absorbed upon entering the field. A dispel magic spell cast on the field is absorbed by the field unless cast with a 9th-level spell slot, and an antimagic field prevents the energy transformation field from absorbing magical energy while it lasts. If two or more field spells share an overlapping area, each field has an equal chance of absorbing a spell effect in that area. Only a wish or similar spell can destroy the energy transformation field.

Energy wells within you and explodes outward in a furious vortex. Choose one of the following damage types: acid, cold, lightning, or fire. Each creature in a 20-foot radius of you other than you must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes **6d8** damage of the chosen type on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
You can choose to include yourself in the vortex. If you do, the damage is increased to 8d8 of the chosen type and creatures (including you) make their saving throws with disadvantage.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 3rd.

You exhale a cloud of living darkness, draining the life from anything it touches. Each creature in a 30-foot cone must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes **12d8** necrotic damage on a failed save and has its maximum hit points reduced by half the damage taken. A creature takes half as much damage on a successful save and does not have its maximum hit points reduced.
Whenever this spell deals damage to a creature, you regain hit points equal to half the amount of necrotic damage dealt.
Until the spell ends, you can use your action on each of your turns to repeat this attack. The spell ends if you use your action to do anything else.

name: Enhance Ability
components: V, S, M (fur or a feather)

description.value: You touch a creature and bestow upon it a magical enhancement. Choose an ability score. For the duration of this spell they add a d6 to ability checks they make that use that ability score. Do not add it if a positive bonus has already been applied to the roll by a spell.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2. You can choose a different ability for each target.

With a touch, you infuse your familiar with power. Until the spell ends, your familiar gains 20 temporary hit points and a +2 bonus to its AC. In addition, your familiar gains the ability to attack, using either an attack from its stat block or a slam attack. This attack is a melee weapon attack it can make against a creature within 5 feet of your itself, which uses your spell attack modifier to hit and deals **1d8** + your spellcasting modifier force damage.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, your familiar gains 5 additional temporary hit points for and increases the damage of its slam attack by 1 for each slot level above 2nd.
**Replaces:** __Heat Metal__

You choose a Medium or smaller object not being worn within range and cause it to rapidly heat to unbearable temperatures. If the object is metal or otherwise not flammable, it glows white-hot; if it is flammable, it is engulfed in flame but not destroyed. If a creature is holding the object, it makes a Constitution saving throw at the start of each of its turns, taking **2d4** fire damage on a failure and suffering disadvantage on any ability checks or attack rolls using the item. If it succeeds on the saving throw, it takes half as much damage and suffers no other effects.
If you maintain *concentration* for the full 1-minute duration, a nonmagical item is melted, reduced to ash, or otherwise destroyed.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the fire damage increases by **1d4** for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Ensnaring Strike (Alternate)
components: V, M (a weapon worth at least 1 sp)

description.value: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can cause the point of impact to explode with a writhing mass of thorny vines. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be restrained by the vines until the spell ends. Creatures that are Large or larger have advantage on this saving throw.

The restrained creature takes **1d6** piercing damage at the start of each of its turns. The restrained creature, or another creature within 5 feet, can use its action to make a Strength check against your Spell save DC, freeing it on a success.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd-level or higher, the damage it takes at the start of each turn increases by **1d6** for each slot level above 1st.
Grasping plants sprout from the ground in a 20-foot square within range. For the duration, these plants turn the ground in the area into Difficult Terrain. They disappear when the spell ends.

Each creature (other than you) in the area when you cast the spell must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have the Restrained condition until the spell ends. At the start of each of the restrained creature's turns it can repeat the saving throw, breaking free on a success. A Restrained creature or a creature it is within reach of can take an action to make a Strength (*Athletics*) check against your spell save DC. On a success, it breaks free.

At your touch, your quarterstaff sprouts wiggling vines that grasp at anything they touch. For the duration, whenever you hit a creature with a melee attack using that weapon, the target is also restrained and has disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. A target restrained in this way can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC. On a success, it frees itself. If you are ever more than 5 feet away from a restrained target, the target is automatically freed.

You can only have one creature restrained at a time and are unable to use that weapon to make attacks until the restrained target frees itself or you command your staff to release the target, which requires no action. When the spell ends, the vines wither and release any target they are currently  restraining.

You weave a distracting string of words, causing creatures of your choice that you can see within range to make a Wisdom saving throw. Any creature you or your companions are fighting automatically succeeds on this save. On a failed save, the target does not notice you casting this spell and has a -10 penalty to Wisdom (*Perception*) checks and Passive *Perception* until the spell ends.

A cocoon of shimmering blue-green force encloses a large or smaller creature you can see in range. When you cast the spell, the creature trapped inside the cocoon is surrounded in a solid barrier, which prevents any matter from passing through it and blocking and spells cast into or out from the area. A creature inside the cocoon can't leave it by nonmagical means. If the creature tries to use any form of teleportation, it must first make a Charisma saving throw. On a success, the creature can use that magic to exit the cocoon. On a failure, the creature can't exit the cocoon and wastes the use of the spell or effect. The cocoon also extends into the Ethereal Plane, blocking ethereal travel.

The cocoon lasts until you either stop *Concentrating* on it or the cocoon is destroyed. The cocoon has an AC of 15 and 100 hit points. The cocoon is too confining to permit much movement and any attacks made by the creature inside the cocoon have disadvantage.
In addition, when you cast this spell, choose one of the following two options:

• The creature inside the cocoon heals 1 hp at the end of each of its turns.
• The creature inside the cocoon takes. **4d6** force damage whenever it hits the cocoon with a melee or ranged attack.
This spell can't be dispelled by a dispel magic spell.

name: Erudition
components: V, S, M (a treatise worth at least 250 gp)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Borrowed Knowledge__

You call on the knowledge of legends, augmenting a skill for the duration. You gain proficiency with the chosen skill. If you were already proficient, you instead gain expertise (doubling your proficiency bonus for any ability check you make with the skill). If you already have expertise, you can instead reroll one of the dice once whenever you have advantage on that ability check. The spell ends early if you cast it again.

Your move speed increases to 60 feet, unless it is higher normally, and you have advantage on Dexterity checks and Dexterity-based weapon attacks. In addition, if you move at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and hit it with a melee weapon attack, that creature must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC or be knocked prone.

You hurl a bolt of pure spirit at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against your target. On hit, it takes **3d6** radiant damage and for the duration, its speed is reduced to 0 as it is pinned in place by the spiritual bolt. As an action on its turn, the creature can make a Strength ability check against your Spell save DC, ending the spell on a success.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the radiant damage increases by **1d6** for each slot level above 1st.
**Replaces:** __Blink__

You thin the fabric of the Ethereal Plane, allowing yourself to slide seamlessly over the boundary. For the duration, roll a d20 at the end of each of your turns. On a roll of 11 or higher, you slip into the Ethereal Plane, returning at the start of your next turn to the space you left. If that space is now occupied, you appear in the nearest unoccupied space. If you rolled an 11 or higher on your prior turn's blink roll, you roll 2d20 and use the lower result. If you rolled 10 or lower, roll 2d20 and use the higher result.

While on the Ethereal Plane, you can't be perceived except by creatures capable of seeing into the Ethereal Plane. You can see and hear your plane of origin out to a range of 60 feet, but you can't interact with anything or affect any creatures there. When the spell ends, you reappear on your plane of origin. You cannot cast this spell while already on the Ethereal Plane.

name: Evard's Black Tentacles
components: V, S, M (a piece of tentacle from a giant octopus or a giant squid)

description.value: Squirming, ebony tentacles fill a 20-foot square on ground that you can see within range. For the duration, flat surfaces in the area are difficult terrain.

Whenever a creature is in the affected area it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or take **3d6** bludgeoning damage and be restrained by the tentacles until the start of its next turn. After making the saving throw they don't need to do so again until the start of their next turn. If the creature leaves the area, they are no longer restrained.

At the start of each of its turns the target can repeat the saving throw, breaking free on a success. As an action the target or a creature the target is within reach of can make a Strength (Athletics) check against the save DC. On a success, the target is no longer restrained.

Your eyes begin to tingle, brimming with dark energy. When you cast this spell, you may target a creature you can see within range with your gaze. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes **8d10** psychic damage and is paralyzed for the next minute. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and is not paralyzed. A paralyzed target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. The creature must be able to see you to be affected. A creature immune to the frightened condition is immune to this spell.
On each of your turns until the spell ends, you can use your action to target another creature with your gaze. You can't target the same creature twice with a single casting of this spell.

You touch a willing creature. Until the spell ends, that creature's ranged weapon attacks ignore half and three quarters cover, and attacking at long range doesn't impose disadvantage on their ranged weapon attack rolls. In addition, the target's ranged weapon attacks deal an additional **1d8** damage.

name: Excavate
components: V, S, M (a pinch of excavated earth)

description.value: A passage appears at a point that you can see in range on a wooden, plaster, or stone surface (such as a wall, a  ceiling, or a floor) within range. You choose the opening's dimensions: up to 10 feet wide, 10 feet tall, and 60 feet deep. The passage creates no instability in the structure surrounding it.

name: Executioner
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when a creature you can touch gets damaged by a creature within 10 ft

description.value: A willing creature of your choice within 10 ft moves up to their movement speed straight towards the damager and can spend their reaction to make a melee attack against them.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell at a higher level, the distance the damager and the creature you choose can be within increases by 10 ft for each additional spell level.

Choose an unoccupied 20-foot square on the ground within range. This spell causes one pile of Humanoid bones to rise out of the ground within that square. If you cast this spell within a burial place such as a graveyard, mausoleum, or barrow, 1d4 corpses or piles of bones are exhumed. The ground itself isn't disturbed by this spell; the bones simply appear out of the ground.

name: Explosive Cascade
components: V, S, M (bat guano, sulphur and copper packed into a metal tube with one closed end)

description.value: You cause a bright ball of flame to manifest and streak across the battlefield, immolating anything it touches. The flame appears at a point you can see within range and extends up to 60 along a path you choose, filling each 5-foot cube it passes through with fire. Each creature and unattended object within this path must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes **9d6** fire damage, or half as much damage on a successful save. A creature or object can be affected only once by each casting of this spell.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 and the path extends for 10 additional feet for each slot level above 5th.
**Replaces:** __Elemental Bane__

Select one creature you can see within range, and one damage type that isn't bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing. The target must make a Charisma saving throw or lose any resistance to that damage type for the duration. The first two times each round that the target takes damage of the chosen type, it takes **2d6** additional damage of that type.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the number of times each round the additional damage can occur increases by 1 for every two slot levels above 4th.

name: Expulsion
components: V, S, M (an item the target abhors)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Banishment__

You brandish a repellent item at a creature you can see within range and attempt to expel them from this plane. The target must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, it is partly wrenched off its current plane. For the duration, it becomes incapacitated and gains resistance to all damage.

The target makes another Charisma save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on a success. A creature on its home plane continues making saves for the duration. An extraplanar creature failing its second Charisma save disappears from its current plane entirely. An extraplanar creature failing its third Charisma save is banished back to its home plane and stops making saving throws. If you maintain *concentration* for the full duration, this banishment becomes permanent.
A target that returns reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 4th.

name: Eye of Power
components: V, S, M (a bit of bat fur)

description.value: You create an invisible, magical eye within range that hovers in the air for the duration. You mentally receive visual information from the eye, which has both normal vision and darkvision out to 60 feet. The eye can see in every direction. As an action, you can move the eye up to 30 feet in any direction. There is no limit to how far away from you the eye can move, but it can't enter another plane of existence. A solid barrier blocks the eye's movement, but the eye can pass through an opening as small as 1 inch in diameter.

In addition, you can cast any spell of 3rd level or lower that has a range other than Self through the eye. Any spell cast in this manner functions as though it had been cast from the eye's location rather than yours.

For the duration, your eyes become an inky void. One creature of your choice within 60 feet of you that you can see must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be affected by one of the following effects of your choice for the duration.
On each of your turns until the spell ends, you can take a Magic action to target another creature but can't target a creature again if it has succeeded on a save against this casting of the spell.

description.name: Asleep
description.value: The target has the Unconscious condition. It wakes up if it takes any damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.

description.name: Panicked
description.value: The target has the Angered condition. On each of its turns, the Angered target must take the Dash action and move away from you by the safest and shortest route available. If the target moves to a space at least 60 feet away from you where it can't see you, this effect ends.

description.name: Sickened
description.value: The target has the Poisoned condition for one day. Each time it fails the saving throw, increase it by a day.

name: Eyes of the King
components: V, S, M (a bit of bat fur)

description.value: You summon four Fiendish servants, which appear in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. They look like medium-sized bats that blaze with a faint ghoul-green light and use the Eye of the King stat block below. One of these creatures disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends.

The bats are allies to you and your companions. In combat, the bats share your initiative count, but take their turns immediately after yours. You can telepathically communicate with the bats and they obey your mental commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, they take the Dodge action and use their move to avoid danger. Additionally, as an action, you can choose one of your bats to see through their eyes and hear through their ears until the start of your next turn gaining the benefits of their blindsight. During this time, you are deaf and blind with regard to your own senses. While doing so, you can freely switch between different bats, no action required.

Select a gathering point of interest. Gathering checks on that point of interest and crafting checks using only materials from that point of interest during the duration of this spell take a 60th as long.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: Increase the duration to an hour if you cast this at 5th or higher.
You place an invisible sigil on a willing target you can see within range. This sigil lasts until the spell ends.

For the duration, you can take a Magic action to project your face onto the marked creature until you dismiss the effect (no action required). When you do so, you can see, hear, and speak through the marked creature as if you occupied its space. You use your senses instead of those of the marked creature.

name: Faith Healing
components: V, S, M (a vial of powdered silver worth 25 gp)

description.value: A creature you can see within range regains a number of hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on Undead or Constructs.

As part of casting this spell, you can have it consume the material component used. If you do, this spell instead restores hit points equal to 4 + your spellcasting ability modifier and the range is increased to 30 feet.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the healing increases by 1d4 for each slot level above 1st, or an additional 4 hit points for each slot level above 1st if your material component is consumed.

name: False Death
components: V, S, M (a vial of corpse wax)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Feign Death__
You touch a willing creature, charging it with necrotic magic and allowing it to mimic death. The target gains 10 temporary hit points for the duration.

As an action, or as a reaction to being hit with an attack or taking damage, the target can appear dead to all outward inspection and to spells used to determine the target's status. If the target breathes, its respiration is undetectable.

While in this false state, the target drops prone, can see and hear normally, and has resistance to all damage except psychic damage. The false state ends if the target moves or takes an action, bonus action or reaction.
The spell ends once the target has left the false state. Additionally, you can use an action to touch the target and dismiss the spell.
If the target is diseased or poisoned when you cast the spell or becomes diseased or poisoned while under the spell's effect, the disease and poison have no effect until the spell ends.

name: False Foes
components: V, S, M (a piece of a broken mirror)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Enemies Abound__

You cause a creature to be unable to tell friend from foe. The target must make an Intelligence saving throw, automatically succeeding if it is immune to the frightened condition. On a failure, it treats every other creature as its enemy and fights them with its typical tactics, and must use its reaction to make an opportunity attack against any creature that provokes one.
Each time the target takes damage, it repeats the saving throw against the spell. If the saving throw succeeds, the spell ends.

name: False Gravity
components: V, S, M (a pair of magnets)

description.value: You touch a willing creature. The target can travel on any solid surface as though that surface possessed its own gravity. As a bonus action, a creature can choose a solid surface it can see to begin to "fall" towards it. A character falling in this fashion approaches the surface at 30 feet per round, taking no falling damage when it lands on that surface.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Familiar Pocket
