components: V, S, M (a tiny golden needle and a strip of fine cloth)

description.value: You touch a small container or a garment with a pocket. The space inside the container or pocket becomes a pocket dimension that lasts until the spell ends. The inside of the pocket is a 2-foot-by-2-foot extradimensional space. As an action, you can command the space to seal or unseal itself. When sealed, the pocket becomes airtight and waterproof. The pocket will remain sealed until you spend an action to unseal it or a creature inside the pocket opens it. The air inside the space lasts for 1 hour so long as the pocket is sealed.
Anything inside the extradimensional space drops out when the spell ends.

You sprout vampire-like fangs. These fangs are natural weapons, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. If you hit with them, you deal piercing damage equal to 1d6 + your Strength modifier, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike. Additionally, once per turn when you hit with these fangs, you deal an additional **3d6** necrotic damage and gain temporary hit points equal to half the damage dealt.

name: Fantastic Machine
components: V, S, M (500 gp worth of scrap metal, which the spell consumes)

description.value: You create a mechanical Construct, which manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. This Construct uses the Fantastic Machine stat block below. When you cast the spell, you can choose whether the machine is Small, Medium or Large, as well as how many limbs it has, up to a maximum of 8. In addition, you may choose one of the following:

• The machine's speed is increased to 50 feet.
• The machine gains a climbing speed equal to its walking speed. It can climb up, down and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings.
• The machine gains a fly speed of 25 feet.

When you cast the spell, you may specify any number of cantrips you can cast. While the machine lasts, it has the ability to cast these spells. In addition, you may choose one 1st level spell you can cast. The machine can cast this spell once per hour without requiring any components a number of times equal to your spellcasting ability modifier. If a spell the machine casts uses an ability modifier or requires a spell save DC, it uses your spellcasting ability modifier.

The machine follows orders given by you, but will not willingly harm another creature. It is intelligent enough to recognize basic cause and effect and will refuse commands that cause harm to a creature indirectly (for example: grappling a creature inside an area of effect that deals damage). The machine will act independently to protect its own existence so long as such protection does not involve disobeying a command or harming another creature (for example, it will walk out of a burning building unless ordered to stay inside).

In combat, the machine shares your initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It can move and use its reaction on its own, but the only action it takes on its turn is the Dodge action, unless you take a bonus action on your turn to command it to take another action, provided that action does not involve dealing damage to another creature.
When the spell ends, the machine is reduced to 0 hit points, or if you cast this spell again, it collapses into a pile of scrap metal worth 500 gp.
**Replaces:** __True Strike__
You touch a willing creature, foretelling an accurate strike. The next attack the creature makes before the end of your next turn hits regardless of any modifiers or the target's AC.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the number of attacks that creature makes which automatically hit increases by one for every two slot levels above 1st.

You touch a willing creature. So long as this spell lasts, the creature suffers none of the effects of several conditions. These conditions are blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned,  stunned, unconscious, or exhaustion. Favor of the Martyr does not remove those conditions, nor does it prevent those conditions from being applied to the target after this spell has been cast. Once this spell ends, the target is affected by those conditions again normally.
Each creature in a 30-foot Cone must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or drop whatever it is holding and have the Frightened condition for the duration.

A Frightened creature takes the Dash action and moves away from you by the safest route on each of its turns unless there is nowhere to move. At the end of each of its turns it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success.
**Replaces:** __Cause Fear__

You bewitch a creature's mind, terrifying it. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of you for the duration. It can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A target that is more than 90 feet away from you has advantage on its saving throw.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

name: Feather Fall
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when a creature within 60ft falls
components: V, M (a small feather or piece of down)

description.value: The falling creature makes a dexterity saving throw, which they can choose to fail. If they fail, their rate of descent slows to 30 feet per round until the spell ends. If the creature lands before the spell ends, it takes no damage from the fall, and the spell ends for that creature.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: You can target an additional creature for each additional spell level.

name: Fell the Greatest Foe
components: V, S, M (a dragon's claw or giant's fingernail)

description.value: You touch a willing creature. The target gains the ability to deal greater damage against larger creatures. For every size category of an opponent larger than the target of the spell, they deal an extra 1d6 points of damage with melee weapon attacks.

When you cast this spell and at the start of each of your turns while the spell lasts, each creature other than you in a 30-foot radius sphere centered on you must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes **8d6** necrotic damage, or half as much damage on a successful save. Then, each creature with 5 or fewer hit points within range that failed its saving throw dies.
Creatures with 0 hit points make this save with disadvantage.
A humanoid that dies within the radius of this spell
immediately rises as a ghoul under your control. The ghouls created by this spell are under your control for 24 hours, after which they stop obeying any commands you've given them.

name: Field of Icy Razors
components: V, S, M (a silver shuriken shaped like a snowflake, with at least 50 gp)

description.value: Razor sharp ice crystals surround any number of creatures within range. Each of these creatures must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes **6d10** cold damage and **6d10** slashing damage and its speed is reduced by 20 feet for 1 minute on a failed save. On a successful save a creature takes half as much damage and is not slowed.

name: Fiendform
components: V, S, M (a vial of blood, or a bit of flesh or bone from a Fiendish creature, which this spell consumes)

description.value: This spell transforms you into the form of the Fiendish creature whose blood, flesh or bone you used when casting this spell. The transformation lasts for the duration, or until you drop to 0 hit points or die. The new form can be any Fiend whose Challenge Rating is 5 or lower. Your game statistics, including mental ability scores, are replaced by the statistics of the chosen Fiend. You retain your alignment and personality.

You assume the hit points of your new form. When you revert to your normal form, you return to the number of hit points you had before you transformed. If you revert as a result of dropping to 0 hit points, any excess damage carries over to your normal form. As long as the excess damage doesn't reduce you to 0 hit points, you aren't knocked unconscious.

You are limited in the actions you can perform by the nature of your new form. You can't speak or take actions that require hands or speech unless your new form possesses the ability to do so and you can only cast spells that your new form can cast.
Your gear melds into the new form. You can't activate, use, wield, or otherwise benefit from any of your equipment.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the CR of fiend you can transform into increases by 1 for each slot level above 5th.

Green-white fog rises from the ground as you cast this spell, and great feline shadows take shape within the misty cloud. When you cast this spell, you summon up to 6 celestial spirits that take the form of lions and appear in unoccupied spaces that you can see within range. Your GM has the creatures' statistics.

These lions are considered both Beasts and Celestials, and disappear when they drop to 0 hit points or when the spell ends. The summoned lions are friendly to you and your companions. The lions have their own turns, which they take immediately after you. They obey any verbal commands that you issue to them (no action required by you). If you don't issue any commands to them, they defend themselves from hostile creatures, but otherwise take no actions.
As action on your turn, you can summon up to six more lions in unoccupied spaces that you can see within range. You can have a maximum of six lions summoned by this spell at a time.

name: Fiery Blade
components: V, S, M (one flake of dried chili pepper)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Flame Blade__

You evoke a fiery blade in your free hand. The blade is similar in size and shape to a scimitar, and it lasts for the duration. It counts as a simple melee weapon with which you are proficient, and provides bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.

It deals **2d6** fire damage on a hit and has the finesse, light, and thrown properties (range 20/60). If you hit a flammable creature or object, it ignites, taking **1d6** fire damage at the start of each of its turns until a creature uses its action to douse the flames on itself or another creature.
If you drop the weapon or throw it, it dissipates at the end of the turn. Thereafter, while the spell persists, you can use a bonus action to cause the blade to reappear in your hand.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the blade's damage increases by **1d6** and the ignite damage by **1d6** for every two slot levels above 2nd.
**Replaces:** __Flame Arrows__

You enchant a quiver of ammunition with a fiery boon. For the duration, ammunition drawn from this quiver deals an extra **2d6** fire damage on a hit. Only one piece of ammunition can be affected at a time, and the spell ends after 6 pieces of ammunition have been used or if you cast the spell again.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the number of pieces of ammunition you can affect with this spell increases by one for each slot level above 3rd.

You gain the service of a familiar, an otherworldly spirit which manifests as a little animal in an unoccupied space you can see within range. This creature uses the __Otherworldly Familiar__ stat block. If you already have a familiar from this spell, it is replaced by the new one.

When you prepare the spell, choose the familiar's creature type: Celestial, Fey, or Fiend. It can choose to also be treated as a beast by specific effects. Whenever you cast the spell, choose the familiar's environment: Air, Land, or Water. The familiar resembles a Tiny animal of your choice—such as an owl, a cat, or a frog—that is native to the chosen environment. Both choices—creature type and environment—determine certain traits in the stat block. The familiar is your ally and obeys all of your commands.

description.name: Disappearance of the familiar
description.value: The familiar disappears if it drops to 0 hit points or if you die. When it does, it leaves behind anything it was wearing or carrying. If you cast this spell again, you decide whether you summon the familiar that disappeared or a different one.

description.name: Remote Scouting
description.value: As a Bonus Action, you can see through the familiar's eyes and hear what it hears while it is within 120 ft of you until the start of your next turn, gaining the benefits of any special senses it has.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: Use the spell slot's level for the spell's level in the stat block.
Removed. If you are granted this spell, learn Find Steed instead.

name: Find in Nature
components: V, S, M (a tuft of hound's fur)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Locate Animals or Plants__

This spell helps you locate a specific kind of beast or plant, which you can either name or describe. You learn the direction and distance to the closest creature or plant of that kind within 1 mile, if any are present.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level, the range of the spell increases to 5 miles. If you use a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the range increases by 5 miles for each slot level above 2nd.

You summon an otherworldly being that appears as a loyal steed in an unoccupied space you can see within range. The steed resembles a Large, rideable animal of your choice, such as a horse, a camel, a dire wolf, or an elk. If you already have a steed from this spell, it is replaced by the new one.

When you prepare this spell, choose the steed's creature type—Celestial, Fey, or Fiend. It can choose to also be treated as a beast by specific effects. This creature uses the __Otherworldly Steed__ stat block. When you cast the spell, choose the steed's mythology—Idyllic, Biblical, or Exalted—which determines certain traits in the stat block. The steed is your ally and obeys all of your commands.

description.name: Disappearance of the Steed
description.value: The steed disappears if it drops to 0 Hit Points or if you die. When it disappears, it leaves behind anything it was wearing or carrying. If you cast this spell again, you decide whether you summon the steed that disappeared or a different one.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: Use the spell slot's level for the spell's level in the stat block.

You conjure a spirit in an unoccupied space within range that assumes the form of a supernaturally intelligent, strong, and loyal steed, which is instantly bonded to you. The Steed takes on the form of a Medium or Large quadrupedal (four-legged) Beast of CR ½ or lower without a flying speed. You must have seen a living specimen of this Beast before.

description.name: Statistics
description.value: Your Steed uses the stat block of the creature you chose for it, but its creature type changes to reflect your alignment: Celestial (good), Fey (neutral), or Fiend (evil). The Steed's Intelligence score becomes 6 (if it was lower), and it can understand one language that you speak.

description.name: Control
description.value: You control your Steed and decide how it acts, both in and out of combat In combat, it shares your initiative and acts during your turn. While riding it, you can make any spell you cast that targets only you also target your Steed.
While you and your Steed are within 1 mile of one another, you can use a special form of Telepathy to communicate.

If your Steed is reduced to 0 hit points it disappears. You can also use a bonus action to dismiss your Steed, causing it to disappear. Should you cast this spell again you can choose to either conjure the same Steed, and it reappears in range at its maximum hit points, or to conjure a new Steed, releasing your previous Steed from its bond in the process.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell with a slot of 4th-level or higher, you can choose for your Steed to take the form of a Medium or Large Beast, Celestial, or Monstrosity of CR 2 or lower that you have seen before. The form the Steed takes must be quadrupedal or winged.

While this spell lasts, you can sense the direction of the nearest temple to your god. If there is none within the spell's area, the spell instead shows you the direction of the nearest temple dedicated to a god of the same alignment as yours. You can also choose a specific temple to search for, but you must have visited the temple personally at some point in the past.
You touch a willing creature, granting it the ability to perceive weak points in their opponent's defenses. The target's first melee or ranged weapon attack each turn has advantage.

You sense any trap within range that is within line of sight. A trap, for the purpose of this spell, includes any object or mechanism that was created to cause damage or other danger. Thus, the spell would sense the __Alarm__ or __Glyph of Warding__ spell or a mechanical pit trap, but it wouldn't reveal a natural weakness in the floor, an unstable ceiling, or a hidden sinkhole.
This spell reveals that a trap is present and the direction it is in but not its location. You do learn the general nature of the danger posed by a trap you sense.

This spell transforms tails, tentacles, fins, or other extremities used for swimming into humanoid legs. The target loses its swim speed for the duration and gains a walking speed of 30 feet. In addition, it gains the ability to breathe air. An unwilling creature can make a Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, the creature is unaffected.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you may target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Fire Shield, Mass
components: V, S, M (A bit of phosphorus or a firefly)

description.value: You touch up to 3 willing creatures. Thin and wispy flames wreathe their bodies for the duration, shedding bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. You can end the spell early by using an action to dismiss it.

The flames provide a target with a warm shield or a chill shield, as you choose. The warm shield grants a target resistance to cold damage, and the chill shield grants a target resistance to fire damage.

In addition, whenever a creature within 5 feet of you hits a target with a melee attack, the shield erupts with flame. The attacker takes **2d8** fire damage from a warm shield, or **2d8** cold damage from a cold shield.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, you may target one additional creature for each slot level above 6th.

name: Fire Shuriken
components: V, S, M (a shuriken coated with pine sap and sulfur)

description.value: You touch up to three weapons with the thrown property and imbue them with magic. You or someone else can make a ranged weapon attack with one of the weapons by throwing it. On a hit, the target takes regular weapon damage and an additional **4d6** fire damage. Hit or miss, the spell then ends on that weapon.
If you cast this spell again, the spell ends early on any weapons still affected by it.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you may enchant one additional weapon for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Fire Spiders
components: V, S, M (a pinch of sulfur)

description.value: You call forth a teeming mass of Tiny fire elementals the size of common spiders. The spiders spread across the ground in a 10-foot-radius centered on a point you can see within range. Each creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Dexterity saving throw. A target takes **6d6** fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

As a bonus action on your turn, you can command the swarm to move up to 30 feet. At the end of each turn where you do not command the swarm to move, the swarm moves up to 15 feet towards the nearest hostile creature if one isn't already in the affected area.

When the swarm moves, it can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, as well as jump across pits up to 10 feet wide. The spiders ignite flammable objects not being worn or carried, and shed bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the damage increases by 2d6 for each slot level above 6th

You gain the ability to step into fires and move from one fire to another. The fires you enter must be at least as big around as you are. Fire elementals are not considered "fires" for the purpose of this spell, nor are sources of great heat, such as pools of lava.

While standing in a fire, you instantly know the locations of all suitable fires within 500 feet and can transport yourself to one of them as a bonus action. If a fire's location doesn't offer enough space for you (for example, a fire contained inside a furnace too small to hold you or a fire already occupied by a large cauldron), it is not a viable destination and you don't sense it's location.
Fire Stride provides no protection against fire.

name: Fire Wings
components: V, S, M (the feather of a bird)

description.value: You transform your arms into wings of flame, granting you a flying speed of 60 feet for the duration. The flames do not damage you or any items you carry. While your arms are transformed in this way, you cannot hold items in your hands or cast spells that require somatic components.

These wings are natural weapons, which you can use to make unarmed strikes, using your spellcasting modifier rather than strength for attack rolls. On a hit, you deal fire damage equal to 2d6 + your spellcasting modifier, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.
When the spell ends, you fall if you are still aloft, unless you can stop the fall.

name: Fireblast
components: V, S, M (a bit of peat and quicklime)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Fireball__

A marble-sized ball of flame appears in your hand before darting out and exploding at a point you choose within range. Every creature within 20 feet of the point must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking **7d6** fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
The blast spreads around corners and ignites flammable objects that aren't being worn or carried.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by **1d6** for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Firebrand
components: V, S, M (a flask of alchemist's fire, which the spell consumes)

description.value: You cause the ground to erupt in a fiery burst at four different points you can see within range. Each creature in a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on each point you choose must make a Dexterity saving throw. The sphere spreads around corners. A creature takes **10d6** fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature in the area of more than one fiery burst is affected only once.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 5th.

name: Fireburst
components: V, S, M (a bit of sulphur)

description.value: With a circular gesture the air around you fills with flame, exploding outward a moment later. Each creature other than you in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on you must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes **4d6** fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The fire ignites any flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2nd.
You touch a creature, purging it of one or more debilitating effects of your choice. The effects removed can be any of the following:

• An effect that charmed or petrified the target.
• A curse, including the target's attunement to a cursed magic item.
• A reduction to one of the target's ability scores.
• An effect reducing the target's hit points.
• A disease.
• Any of the following conditions: blinded, deafened, paralyzed or poisoned.
For each effect purged beyond the first, the creature takes **1d8** fire damage. The maximum number of effects you can purge at once is equal to your spellcasting ability modifier.

You create a protective ward, spreading from a point you choose to fill a 20-foot sphere for the duration. When you cast this spell, all fires, both magical and nonmagical, are extinguished in the area and each creature gains resistance to fire damage so long as it remains in the area. For the duration, no new fires can be lit in the area and any creature that enters the area gains resistance to fire damage so long as it remains in the area. In addition, when a fire elemental enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Constitution saving throw. That creature takes **6d8** cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Fist of Stone
components: V, S, M (a pebble inscribed with a stylized fist design)

description.value: You transform one of your hands into a mighty fist of living stone. While transformed, your fist cannot be used to hold or use objects. This fist can be used as a melee weapon, which deals bludgeoning damage equal to 1d8 + your strength modifier. Attacks with this fist count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, then the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st.

You touch a quiver containing ranged weapon ammunition. The first twelve pieces of ammunition drawn from the quiver deal fire damage in place of their normal damage type, plus an additional **1d6** fire damage on hit. If fired into a flammable object, it bursts into flame on hit. The magic of this spell ends for each piece of ammunition when it hits or misses, and the spell ends after twelve pieces of ammunition are fired.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th-level or higher, you can draw two additional pieces of ammunition from the quiver for each slot level above 3rd.

The blade of a dagger you are holding bursts alight with flame. For the duration, you can use your spellcasting ability instead of Strength or Dexterity for the attack and damage rolls of melee attacks using that weapon. That weapon deals fire damage instead of piercing. If you let go of the weapon, the spell ends at the end of the current turn. The spell ends immediately if you cast it again.

name: Flame of Faith
components: V, S, M (a lump of phosphorous)

description.value: A nonmagic weapon you touch bursts into flames. These flames do not harm whoever wields the weapon. For the duration, the weapon deals an additional **1d8** fire damage on a hit. In addition, when you hit a Fiend or an Undead creature with this weapon, the target takes an additional **1d8** radiant damage.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot 4th level of or higher, the extra fire and radiant damage each increase by 1d8 for every two slot levels above the 3rd.

name: Flame Whip
components: V, S, M (a charred wooden hilt)

description.value: In place of an attack, you can evoke a whip of pure flame in a free hand. It lasts for the duration and sheds bright light out to a 10-foot radius. If you let go of the whip, it disappears, but you can evoke the Flame Whip again in place of an attack without expending a spell slot.

Whenever you could make an attack, you can instead make a melee spell attack with your Flame Whip against one target within 10 feet that you can see. On hit, it takes fire damage equal to 1d10 + your spellcasting modifier, and if the target is Large or smaller you can instantly grapple it with the Whip.

You cannot attack with the Whip while it is grappling a creature, but a grappled creature takes 1d10 fire damage at the start of its turns and can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC, escaping on a success.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, both instances of fire damage dealt increase by **1d10** for every two slot levels above 2nd.

Your forelimbs transform into flaming whips. When you cast this spell, or as an action on your turn while the spell lasts, you may make up to two melee spell attacks against a creature or object within 15 feet of you. Each melee attack can be at the same target at different ones. On a hit, a target takes **6d6** fire damage.
While this spell lasts, you cannot cast spells with material components, nor can you carry items with your forelimbs.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 4th.

name: Flashburst
components: V, S, M (a pinch of sulfur or phosphorus)

description.value: You create a blinding, dazzling flash of light. Each creature other than you within a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on you must success on a Constitution saving throw or be blinded for a 1 minute. A blinded creature can repeat this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. In addition, any creature within 15 feet of you that fails its saving throw by 5 or more is stunned until the end of its next turn.

name: Flawed Reconstruction
components: V, S, M (a needle and thread)

description.value: You stitch together the wounds of a creature you touch, which regains 3d6 Hit Points. However, the mending is imperfect, and the target's Hit Point maximum is reduced by 1d6, to a minimum of 1.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The healing increases by 2d6 and the reduction increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Flawed Resurrection
components: V, S, M (a drop of blood, a piece of flesh, and a pinch of bone dust)

description.value: You touch a dead Humanoid that has been no longer than 10 days and revive it as an intelligent Undead creature. The creature returns to life with 1 Hit Point. This spell closes all mortal wounds, but it doesn't restore missing body parts.

The creature's type becomes Undead and it gains Immunity to Poison damage and the Poisoned condition. It doesn't need to eat, drink, sleep, or breathe, though it must still rest for 8 hours to gain the benefits of a Long Rest.

The Undead body deteriorates over time. Whenever the creature finishes a Long Rest, its Hit Point maximum permanently decreases by 1. The creature's Hit Point maximum can only be restored by the __Greater Restoration__ spell. If the creature dies and is later targeted by Resurrection or similar magic, it can be returned to life with its original creature type.
**Replaces:** __Arcane Gate__

You create linked magical gates that you can control for the duration. Select two unoccupied points on the ground that you can see within 500 feet of you. Glowing 10-foot diameter gates open over each point.

You choose whether the gates are visible and usable from both sides or only one side. Any creature or object entering one gate exits the other as if the two were adjacent to each other. You can use a bonus action to close, open, and move one or both gates up to 60 feet. The spell ends if a gate moves more than 500 feet from the caster's original location.

With a cruel utterance, you unleash terrible energies that can literally tear flesh from bones to inflict incredible pain and psychological trauma. A creature you can see within range must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes **6d10** necrotic damage, **6d10** psychic damage and has disadvantage on Charisma and Constitution checks and saving throws for the next minute. On a successful save, the target takes half damage and has no additional penalties.

On each of your turns for the duration, you can use your action to force the target to make another Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes **6d10** necrotic damage and **6d10** psychic damage, or half this much on a successful save.
The spell ends if you use your action to do anything else, if the target is ever outside the spell's range, or if it has total cover from you.

name: Fleshshiver
components: V, S, M (a bone, which the spell consumes)

description.value: You snap a bone you hold in your hand, and the sound is echoed from your target. One creature you can see within range must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes **10d8** necrotic damage and is incapacitated for the duration of the spell. On a successful saving throw, the target takes half as much damage and is not incapacitated.
If the target has a Challenge rating of 5 or lower (or level, if it doesn't have a Challenge rating), it automatically fails its initial saving throw.
An incapacitated target must make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a successful save, it is no longer incapacitated.

name: Flickering Strikes
components: V, S, M (a melee weapon you are proficient with worth at least 1 sp)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Steel Wind Strike__

You brandish the weapon used in the casting before disappearing, instantly teleporting to and striking up to 5 targets within range. Make a melee weapon attack against each target. On a hit, a target takes the weapon damage from the attack, plus an additional ** 6d6** force damage.
You can then teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 5 feet of any target of the spell.

name: Flight of the Dragon
components: V, S, M (a dragon's wing claw)

description.value: You touch a willing creature. The target gains a flying speed of 80 feet for the duration. When the spell ends, the target falls if it is still aloft, unless it can stop the fall.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 4th.

name: Floating Disk, Greater
components: V, S, M (a vial of mercury worth 100 gp, which the spell consumes)

description.value: This spell creates a circular, horizontal plane of force, 3 feet in diameter and 1 inch thick, that floats 3 feet above the ground in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range. The disk remains for the duration, and can hold up to 2000 pounds. If more weight is placed on it, the spell ends, and everything on the disk falls to the ground.

The disk is immobile while you are within 20 feet of it. If you move more than 20 feet away from it, the disk follows you so that it remains within 20 feet of you. It can move across uneven terrain, up or down stairs, slopes and the like, but it can't cross an elevation change of 10 feet or more normally. You may use your action to command the disk to move up to 20 feet in a round in any direction. If you move more than 100 feet from the disk (typically because it can't move around an obstacle to follow you), the spell ends.

You enchant up to three creatures of your choice within range. Whenever one of those creatures makes an attack roll or saving throw before the spell ends, that creature cannot have disadvantage on the roll.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

name: Force Buckler
components: V, S, M (a specially-prepared gauntlet worth 5+ GP)

description.value: You summon a translucent field of force, which springs forth from the gauntlet used in the spell's casting. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +2 bonus to your Armor Class while you aren't wielding a Shield. This spell ends early if you are hit by an attack.

name: Force Chest
components: V, S, M (a 2-inch square glass cube)

description.value: You create a lidded box of force at a point you choose within range. When you create the box, you can choose whether the box is translucent, or if it and its contents are invisible. The sides and lid of the box are solid walls of force, and it can contain up to 12 cubic feet of nonliving material (3 feet by 2 feet by 2 feet). The box cannot be opened unless a creature first speaks the password determined by you when you cast the spell.

Nothing can physically pass through the box. It is immune to all damage and can't be dispelled by dispel magic. A disintegrate spell destroys the box instantly. The box also extends into the Ethereal Plane, protecting its contents.
You can cast this spell on an existing force chest to extend its duration by a week. If a force chest lasts for 1 year, the spell becomes permanent.

name: Force Claw
components: V, S, M (a small, dried claw)

description.value: You create an invisible claw made out of force at a point you can see in range. When you cast this spell, you can designate any number of creatures you can see to be unaffected by it. The claw defends a 10-foot-radius sphere, centered on that point. When a creature enters this area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, the claw attacks it. Make a melee spell attack against the creature. On a hit, the target takes force damage equal to 2d8+ your spellcasting ability modifier.
As a bonus action on your turn, you can command the claw to move to a new point within 20 feet of its current location.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for every two slot levels above 4th.

name: Force Dart
components: V, S, M (a specially-prepared gauntlet worth 5+ GP)

description.value: You fling a dart of magical force at a creature within range. Make a Ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes **1d10** Force damage.

description.name: Cantrip Upgrade
description.value: The damage increases by 1d10 when you reach levels 5 (2d10), 11 (3d10), and 17 (4d10).

name: Force Ladder
components: V, S, M (a miniature silver ladder worth 50 gp)

description.value: You create an immobile, invisible ladder of force to spring into existence at a point you choose within range. The ladder is 2 feet wide and extends straight up anywhere between 10 to 60 feet tall, with rungs spaced 1 foot apart. Though the ladder is solid for any creatures that interact with it, objects pass harmlessly through the ladder. The ladder is immune to all damage and can't be dispelled by dispel magic. A disintegrate spell destroys the ladder instantly, however.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the maximum height of the ladder increases by 30 feet for each slot level above 2nd.

You create two powerful missiles of magical force. Each missile hits a creature of your choice that you can see within range. A missile deals **2d6** force damage to its target. The missiles all strike simultaneously, and you can direct them to hit one creature or several. After striking a target, each missile explodes in a 10-foot radius sphere. Each creature within range of one of these explosions, including the target, must make a Dexterity saving throw (a creature only makes one save regardless of how many explosions it is in the area of). On a failed save, a creature takes **2d6** force damage for each missile it was in the area of. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.
This spell is counted as magic missile for the purpose of spells such as shield.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the spell creates one more missile for every two slot levels above 4th

name: Force Weapon
components: V, S, M (a specially-prepared gauntlet worth 5+ GP)

description.value: You conjure a blade of magical force in the air, which strikes at a creature within range. Make a melee spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes **1d10** Force damage. The blade remains in existence for a short time; until the start of your next turn, you can make a single strike with your mystical blade as an Opportunity Attack.

description.name: Cantrip Upgrade
description.value: You make an additional attack when you reach levels 5 (2 attacks), 11 (3 attacks), and 17 (4 attacks). These attacks can target the same creature or different ones.
**Replaces:** __Magic Weapon__
You touch a weapon, imbuing it with magic until the spell ends. A nonmagical weapon becomes magical, and the weapon gains a +1 bonus to attack rolls and deals an extra **1d4** force damage.

A creature wielding an amplified weapon can use a bonus action to make it start or stop glowing. The wielder chooses the color and amount of bright light from a 5-foot radius to a 30-foot radius, with dim light for an additional equal distance.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the bonus increases to +2 and the force damage increases to 1d6. When you use a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the bonus increases to +3 and the force damage increases to 1d8.

name: Forcecage
components: V, S, M (ruby dust worth 1,500+ GP, which the spell consumes)

description.value: An immobile, Invisible, Cube-shaped prison composed of magical force springs into existence around an area you choose within range. The prison can be a cage or a solid box, as you choose.

A prison in the shape of a cage can be up to 20 feet on a side and is made from 1/2-inch diameter bars spaced 1/2 inch apart. A prison in the shape of a box can be up to 10 feet on a side, creating a solid barrier that prevents any matter from passing through it and blocking any spells cast into or out from the area.

When you cast the spell, any creature that is completely inside the cage's area is trapped. Creatures only partially within the area, or those too large to fit inside it, are pushed away from the center of the area until they are completely outside it.

A creature inside the cage can't leave it by nonmagical means. If the creature tries to use teleportation or interplanar travel to leave, it must first make a Charisma saving throw. On a successful save, the creature can use that magic to exit the cage. On a failed save, the creature doesn't exit the cage and wastes the spell or effect. The cage also extends into the Ethereal Plane, blocking ethereal travel. The cage has an AC of 5 and 240 hit points.
This spell can't be dispelled by Dispel Magic.

name: Forcecage (Alternate)
components: V, S, M (an ornate jade box worth 1,500 gp)

description.value: A shimmering, immobile, cube-shaped prison composed of magical force springs into existence around an area of your choice within range. You choose whether this magic prison is shaped like a cage with bars or a solid box.

description.name: Shape
description.value: If you choose cage, it can be up to 20 feet on a side and made from 1/2-inch diameter bars spaced 1/2 inch apart. If you choose box, it can be up to 10 feet on a side, creating a solid barrier that prevents any matter from passing through it and blocking any spells cast into or out of the area. The cage extends into the Ethereal Plane, blocking ethereal travel.

description.name: Creatures Inside
description.value: When you cast the spell, any creatures that are completely inside the area of the cage are trapped. Any creatures partially within the area, or too large to fit are pushed away until they are completely outside of the cage.

A creature inside the cage cannot leave it by non-magical means. If the creature tries to use teleportation or interplanar travel to leave the cage, it must first make a Charisma saving throw. The spell or effect is wasted on a failed save, but on a success the creature uses the spell or effect to escape.

description.name: Statistics
description.value: The cage's Armor Class equals your Spell save DC and it has 200 hit points. It is immune to poison, psychic, and non-magical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, vulnerable to force and magical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, and resistant to all other damage types. It cannot be dispelled by a __dispel magic__ spell, but a __disintegrate__ spell destroys the cage it instantly.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th-level or higher, the hit points of the cage created by this spell increase by 25 for each spell slot level above 7th.

name: Forcewave
components: V, S, M (a small piece of string and a drop of water)

description.value: Unleashing a wave of force, you attempt to send your enemies tumbling away from you. Each creature within 10 feet of you must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature is pushed back 30 feet and falls prone. If a creature fails its save by 5 or more, it is also stunned until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature is pushed back 15 feet, but is not knocked prone. When casting this spell, you can choose any number of creatures to automatically pass their saving throw.

If a creature pushed by this spell impacts another object or creature as a result, the target takes **1d6** bludgeoning damage for every 5 feet it was pushed before impact. If the target impacts another creature, that creature takes half as much damage as the target.

You grasp the stone firmly and point your fist outward as a huge, silent explosion ripples through the earth. A shockwave radiates from you in 20-foot radius sphere, centered on you. Each creature other than you in that area that is touching the ground must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone. If the ground in that area is loose earth or stone, it becomes difficult terrain until cleared, with each 5-foot-diameter portion requiring at least 1 minute to clear by hand.

In addition, this shockwave deals **6d8** force damage to any structure, unattended object made of dirt, clay or stone as well as any earth elemental. An earth elemental that passes its saving throw takes half as much damage in addition to not being knocked prone.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 3rd.
**Replaces:** __Investiture of Flame__
You become elemental fire, shedding bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. Until the spell ends, you gain the following benefits:

• You are immune to fire damage.
• You can move through the space of other creatures and ignore difficult terrain. The first time on your turn you enter the space of another creature, it takes **2d6** fire damage.
• If a creature within 5 feet hits you with a melee attack, it takes **2d6** fire damage.
• You can use your action to create a line of fire 30 feet long and 5 feet wide extending from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes **6d6** fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
• During your turn, if you roll fire damage, you can maximize one die of the fire damage dealt.
**Replaces:** __Investiture of Ice__
You freeze over, taking on a form of elemental ice. Until the spell ends, you gain the following benefits:

• You are immune to cold damage.
• You can move across difficult terrain created by ice or snow without spending extra movement.
• The ground in a 15-foot radius around you is icy and is difficult terrain for creatures other than you. The radius moves with you.
• You can use your action to create a 30-foot cone of freezing wind extending from your outstretched hand in a direction you choose. Each creature in the cone must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes **4d8** cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails its save against this effect has its speed halved until the start of your next turn.
• During your turn, if you roll cold damage, you gain temporary hit points equal to one die rolled (your choice).
**Replaces:** __Investiture of Stone__
You become made of stone. Until the spell ends, you gain the following benefits:

• You have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
• You can move across difficult terrain made of earth or stone without spending extra movement. You can move through solid earth or stone as if it was air and without destabilizing it, but you can't end your movement there. If you do so, you are ejected to the nearest unoccupied space, this spell ends, and you are stunned until the end of your next turn.
• You can use your action to call spikes of stone to raise from the ground. All creatures of your choice within 15 feet of you must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes **4d8** piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Its space becomes difficult terrain either way.
**Replaces:** __Investiture of Water__
You become a surge of elemental water. Until the spell ends, you gain the following benefits:

• You have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
• You can move through the space of other creatures and ignore difficult terrain; the first time you move through a Large or smaller creature, it must pass a Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
• You can use your action to unleash a blast of water 15 feet long and 5 feet wide extending from you in a direction of your choice. Each creature in the line must make a Strength saving throw. A creature takes **5d6** bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone on a failed save, or half as much and isn't knocked prone on a successful one.
**Replaces:** __Investiture of Wind__
You become a gust of elemental wind. Until the spell ends, you gain the following benefits:

• You have a flying speed of 60 feet.
• You can move through and occupy the space of other creatures, and you ignore difficult terrain.
• You are invisible.
• You can use your action to unleash a powerful blast of wind in a 30 foot cone. Each creature in the cone must make a Strength saving throw. A creature takes **4d8** bludgeoning damage and is knocked 15 feet away from you on a failed save, or takes half as much damage and isn't knocked backward on a successful one.

You touch a friendly creature, suffusing them with a golden glow that quickly fades. The next time that creature is reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, it regains 80 Hit Points and ends the blindness or deafness conditions or any diseases affecting the target. This spell has no effect on Constructs or Undead.

name: Fortune
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when a creature you can see within 60 feet fails with an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw

description.value: **Replaces:** __Silvery Barbs__ (in part)
You magically reshape causality for the triggering creature, positively influencing its efforts. The triggering creature must reroll the d20 and use the higher roll.

You call upon the strength of the earth to rise and lend its stability to a creature of your choice within range. The target has advantage on Strength saving throws for the duration. In addition, the target is considered to have half cover, as earthen ramparts rise around it to protect it from harm. If the creature moves or is no longer standing on solid ground (for example, if it is hovering), it loses these benefits until the start of its next turn.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you may target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

You and all creatures of your choice, within range feel a sudden increased will to fight for each other. Each affected creature will have advantage on attack rolls if an ally is within 5-feet of their target, provided they are not Incapacitated.

As an action a bright flash of fox-fire erupts all around you. Each creature within 20-foot emanation, originating from you, must succeed a Constitution saving throw. A target takes **5d8** Radiant damage and is Blinded until the start of your next turn. On a success the target takes half as much damage and is not Blinded.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The extra damage increases by **1d8** for each level after 3rd.

You conjure forth the luminous light of the fox-fire to lash down your foe. Make a melee spell attack roll against a target within 15-feet of you. On a hit it takes **1d6** Radiant damage and is Blinded until the start of their next turn.
In addition to that, any creature underneath the cloud has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

description.name: Cantrip Upgrade
description.value: The damage increases by **1d6** when you reach levels 5 (**2d6**), 11 (**3d6**), and 17 (**4d6)**
You conjure forth the luminous light of the fox-fire covering a weapon you touch. Until the spell ends, attacks made with that weapon deal an extra **1d4** Radiant damage on a hit.

You convert an object into coins of the same value. Choose one non-magical object, that is at most medium in size (5-foot cube), to turn into as many coins as it is worth. You can choose which coin type it will turn into.

After 1 hour has passed the money will transform back into the original object. If all coins are within 5-feet of each other, then it returns undamaged. If the coins are further than 5-feet apart, then each coin will try to transform back into the object, as complete as possible. For example, if you had transformed a trapdoor and kept the coins apart in two equal amounts, you get two halves of a trapdoor.

You fire a thin blue ray at a creature you can see within range. That creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes **10d8** cold damage and is encased on ice. On a success, the creature takes half as much damage and is not encased on ice. While encased on ice, the creature is restrained, cannot cast spells that require somatic components and has total cover. The creature takes an additional **2d8** cold damage at the end of each of its turns while encased.

An encased creature can use an action on its turn to attempt to break free, making a Strength check against your spell save DC. Alternatively, another creature can attempt to free the encased creature. The ice encasing the creature has an AC of 15 and 50 hit points. The creature is freed if the ice is reduced to 0 hit points, and any excess damage dealt to the ice carries over to the creature.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the initial damage increases by 2d8 for each slot level above 6th.

A bank of freezing mist billows out in a 15-foot-radius sphere, centered on a point you can see within range. This sphere spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. It lasts for the duration or until a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses it. The fog is so thick that a creature moving through the area must spend 4 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves.

When a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes **6d6** cold damage. If a creature fails its save by 5 or more it also falls prone. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and does not fall prone.

As a bonus action on your turn, you can designate a new point you can see within range. At the end of each of your turns, the Freezing Fog moves 5 feet towards the current point, until it is centered on it or you use another bonus action to choose a new point.
Freezing Fog coats all solid surfaces with a slick, icy rime as it passes. After Freezing Fog has left a space, the ground is coated in slippery ice for the next minute.
Slippery ice is difficult terrain. When a creature moves onto slippery ice for the first time on a turn, it must succeed on a DC10 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check or fall prone.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the damage increases by 2d6 for each slot level above 6th.

name: Frenzy
components: V, S, M (a drop of fresh blood)

description.value: With a gesture, you reduce a crowd to base instinct and violence. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you choose within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature has the Frenzied condition for the duration.

A creature with the Frenzied condition loses the ability to distinguish between friend and foe, regarding all creatures it can see as enemies. While Frenzied, the creature chooses the targets for its attacks, spells, and abilities randomly from among the creatures it can see within range, and it must make an Opportunity Attack if any creature provokes one.
The Frenzied condition ends after 1 minute, or when the spell ends. At the end of its turn, an affected creature can repeat its saving throw, ending the condition on itself early on a success.

You magically emanate a sense of friendship toward one creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration. The target succeeds automatically if it isn't a Humanoid, if you're fighting it, or if you have cast this spell on it within the past 24 hours.
The spell ends early if the target takes damage or if you make an attack roll, deal damage, or force anyone to make a saving throw. When the spell ends, the target knows it was Charmed by you.

name: Friends (Alternate)
components: S, M (a small amount of makeup applied to the face as this spell is cast)

description.value: You lace your words with soothing magic and force a creature of your choice that can hear and understand you to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, you have advantage on all Charisma checks directed at that creature for the duration.

On a successful save, the creature realizes that you used magic to attempt to influence it and becomes hostile toward you. A creature prone to violence might attack you, and other creatures might seek retribution against you in other ways.

name: Frigid Blade
components: S, M (a Melee weapon with which you have proficiency and that is worth 1+ CP)

description.value: Encasing the weapon used in the spell's casting in ice, you make one attack. The attack uses your spellcasting ability for the attack and damage rolls instead of using Strength or Dexterity. The weapon's damage die increases by 1 step (d4 → d6 → d8 → d10 → d12 or 2d6, your choice). The weapon's damage dice don't increase if it has more than one weapon damage die. If the attack deals damage, it can be Cold damage or the weapon's normal damage type (your choice).

description.name: Cantrip Upgrade
description.value: Whether you deal Cold damage or the weapon's normal damage type, the attack deals extra Cold damage when you reach levels 5 (1d6), 11 (2d6), and 17 (3d6).

As you exhale across your cupped hands, your breath shoots forth tinged with frost and crystals of ice. Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes **3d8** cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. In addition, any creature that fails its save by 5 or more is stunned until the end of its next turn by the sudden shock of cold.
Creatures that have resistance or immunity to cold damage cannot be stunned by this spell.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Frost Shuriken
components: S, M (a palmful of water and a piece of iron)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Ice Knife__

You form a bladed disk of ice and throw it at one creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes **1d4** piercing damage and **2d8** cold damage. The shuriken then explodes (whether you hit or miss). Each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take **2d8** cold damage.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the cold damage increases by **1d8** for each slot level above 1st.
You create a discordant cacophony of haunting and alien music. When you cast this spell, you can designate any number of creatures you can see to be unaffected by it.

When an affected creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes **2d12** psychic damage and suffers a random additional negative effect. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and there is no additional effect.
To determine the additional negative effect for a creature that fails its save, roll a d6 for each creature to determine which of the following effects the creature suffers from:

rows: The affected creature can't move this turn.
The affected creature is knocked prone.
The affected creature can't take actions this turn.
The affected creature uses its action to make a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach. If there is no creature within its reach, the creature does nothing this turn.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d12 for each slot level above 4th.

name: Gahoul's Glorious Gothic
components: V, S, M (a decorated gothic manor miniature worth 1,000+ GP)

description.value: A rift opens, pouring forth tons of brick and stonework that neatly assembles into a vast gothic estate. The estate consists of a manor surrounded by a 200-by-200-foot courtyard and a 10-foot tall wrought iron fence around the perimeter. Any creature within the estate's area is escorted away by harmless but forceful specters.

You can create any floor plan you like for the manor, but the space can't exceed 50 contiguous 10-foot Cubes or contain more than five floors. The manor is adorned with barred windows and decorative gargoyles, but is furnished and decorated as you choose. Once the manor is first created, these details are recorded in the miniature manor used to cast the spell and can't be changed. The manor contains sufficient food to feed up to 100 people for seven days. Furnishings and other objects created by this spell dissipate into smoke if taken beyond the estate's perimeter.

The manor is staffed by 50 Skeletons obedient to you, and contains enough food to serve 50 people each day for a week. The skeletons can perform any task a normal human servant could perform, but they can't attack or take any action that would directly harm another creature. Any skeleton that leaves the estate's perimeter dies. Any Humanoid buried in the manor's courtyard rises 24 hours later as a Ghoul indefinitely under your control. You can have up to 10 such ghouls at once. If given no instructions, these ghouls patrol the estate. Any Undead created by this spell dies if it leaves the estate's perimeter.

When the spell ends, the manor is magically drawn back into the rift. If you cast the spell once every seven days for 365 days in the same location, the manor becomes permanent and can't be dispelled.

name: Gahoul's Scapegoat
components: V, S, M (black chalk, paint, or oil)

description.value: You trace a complex arcane symbol on the flesh of a willing creature you touch, marking it for sacrifice. When you are hit by an attack roll during the spell's duration and the marked creature is within 60 feet of yourself, you can take a Reaction to teleport, swapping places with the creature and forcing it to be hit by the attack instead of you. The spell then ends.

You throw a cackling skull at a point you can see within range, which emits a mortifying shriek audible out to 300 feet. Each creature in a 10-foot Cube takes **3d4** Thunder damage, without making a saving throw.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The damage increases by 1d4 for each spell slot level above 1.

You conjure a whirling phantasmal scythe in your open hand and throw it through the air. The scythe travels in a 60-foot-long, 10-foot-wide Line, coming to rest hovering in the air at the end of its line or before it strikes a solid surface. Each creature within the area while the scythe is moving makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking **6d8** Necrotic damage on failed save or half as much damage on a successful save. A creature has Disadvantage on this saving throw if the scythe comes to rest in the creature's space.
If you are within 120 feet of the scythe at the start of your next turn, it returns to you in a 10-foot-wide Line, forcing creatures within its area of travel to make the save against it.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 6.

You magically compel a creature within range that can hear and understand you to a nonmagical game with vital consequences. An unwilling creature can make a Wisdom saving throw to resist this effect. On a failed save, the creature is compelled to join you in the game.

The loser of the game takes **6d6** Psychic damage. If no player loses or has won by the end of the spell's duration, both you and the target take this damage. If you or one of your Allies harms the target, you forfeit the game, and vice versa if the target or one of its Allies harms you. Additionally, you and the target creature can negotiate for greater stakes. You can wager for higher Psychic damage (up to a maximum of 12d6), property, or more esoteric rewards, such as bestowal of a noble title. The spell reveals if a creature attempts to bet property it doesn't own. A bet is finalized when you and the target agree on the bet, solidifying the bet with a handshake or similar gesture. Property or currency bet on the game is teleported to the winner at the game's conclusion. The loser is also magically compelled to take any action (such as bestowing a noble title) wagered as part of a bet.
Lastly, no spell, magical effect, or creature other than you and the target can influence the game's outcome.

You give a verbal command to a creature that you can see within range, ordering it to carry out some service or refrain from an action or a course of activity as you decide. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration. The target automatically succeeds if it can't understand your command. If you concentrate on the spell for the full duration, the effect lasts for 30 days.
While Charmed, the creature takes **5d10** Psychic damage if it acts in a manner directly counter to your command. It takes this damage no more than once per 10 minutes.

You can issue any command you choose, short of an activity that would result in certain death. Should you issue a suicidal command, the spell ends. You can end the spell early by using an action to dismiss it.
A Remove Curse, Greater Restoration, or Wish spell ends this spell.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th or 8th level and concentrate on it for the full duration, the effect lasts for 1 year. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 9th level and concentrate on it for the full duration, the effect lasts until it is ended by one of the spells mentioned above.

name: Gem Barrier
components: V, S, M (variable gp worth of gemstones, which the spell consumes, see text)

description.value: The gemstones in your hand crumble to dust, granting a creature you touch resistance to one or more damage types of your choice: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. For each damage type chosen, you must spend 50gp worth of gemstones.

name: Gembomb
components: V, S, M (a gem worth at least 1gp, which the spell consumes)

description.value: You turn a gem into a bomb, hurling it at a point you can see within range. Each creature within a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes **4d6** force damage on a failed save, of half as much on a successful save.

The more valuable the gem, the more powerful the explosion. For every 10gp of value in the gem consumed for this spell, you may either increase the radius by 5 feet or the damage by 1d6. You can enhance either of these traits a maximum of 2 times each in this fashion .

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the base damage increases by 1d6, and the maximum number of times a trait can be enhanced increases by one for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Gemjump
components: V, S, M (a gem worth at least 250 gp)

description.value: You create a bond between yourself and the gem used to cast this spell. When you cast this spell, choose a trigger word. As an action any time after you have created this bond, you may speak the command word to instantly teleport yourself and up to three willing creatures within 10 feet of you to unoccupied spaces closest to the gem, provided you and the gem are both on the same plane.
Once you have used the trigger word, the gem shatters and the spell ends.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, you may bring one additional creature with you when you teleport for each slot level above 6th.

Each Undead creature within a 120-foot-radius sphere centered on you must make a Charisma saving throw. On a successful save, the creature is unaffected. On a failed save, the creature is either frightened of you or charmed by you (your choice). A creature charmed or frightened by this spell may repeat this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

If a creature with a Challenge Rating of 5 or less (or the creature's level, if it doesn't have a challenge rating) fails its save, you may have that creature fall under your control instead. It will obey verbal commands you give, no action required. You decide what action the creature will take and where it will move during its turn, or you can issue a general command. If you issue no commands, the creature only defends itself against hostile creatures. Once given an order, the creature continues to follow it until its task is complete.
An Undead creature with a Challenge rating of 1 or lower automatically fails its saving throw.

name: Ghastly Flight
components: V, S, M (the powdered remains of a creature)

description.value: You release a malevolent spirit that flies out from you in a direction of your choice in a 60-foot long, 5-foot wide line, at which point it fades away. Each creature within the line must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, creatures take **2d8** necrotic damage and cannot regain hit points until the start of your next turn. On a success, creatures take half as much damage and can regain hit points as normal.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd-level or higher, the damage increases by **1d8** for each slot level above 1st.

name: Ghost Lights
components: V, S, M (a bit of tungsten or hickory, or a firefly)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Dancing Lights__

You create up to four small lights within range that hover in the air for the duration. Each light may appear as you wish (torch, lantern, glowing orb, etc.) and can be colored as you like. Whichever form you choose, each one sheds dim light in a 15-foot radius.

As a bonus action on your turn, you can extinguish or move any or all of the lights up to 60 feet within range. A light must be within 30 feet of another light created by this spell, and a light winks out if it exceeds the spell's range. If you cast this spell again, any current lights you created with this spell instantly wink out.
**Replaces:** __Chill Touch__

You create an intangible, cadaverous hand that latches onto a creature within range, assailing its life force. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes **1d8** necrotic damage, and it can't regain hit points until the start of your next turn.
If you hit an undead target, it has disadvantage on attack rolls against you until the end of your next turn.
This spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

name: Ghost Trap
components: V, S, M (rare herbs worth 50gp, which the spell consumes)

description.value: You create a field of protective energy, in a 100-foot radius sphere centered on a point you choose in range, which extends into the Ethereal plane. Any creature on the Ethereal plane that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is stunned until the start of its next turn and is forcefully returned to the plane it originated from. If it occupies the same spot as a solid object or creature when this happens, it is immediately shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and takes force damage equal to twice the number of feet is it moved. On a successful save, the creature is incapacitated until the start of its next turn but remains on the Ethereal plane.
This spell has no effect if you cast it while you are on the Ethereal Plane or a plane that doesn't border it, such as one of the Outer Planes.
You can create a permanent ghost trap by casting this spell in the same location every day for one year.

You channel the spectral resonance of sounds once  heard in your vicinity, attempting to recreate them. When you cast this spell, you set your musical instrument down and choose a point in time up to 24 hours ago. If you choose a time 8 or more hours ago, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability. The DC equals the number of hours ago you chose. On a success, or if the point chosen was fewer than 8 hours previous, the musical instrument begins to play itself, only rather than music, it begins to  play any sounds audible from that location at the chosen point in time for the duration of the spell. Verbal components of spells and other magical effects (such as bardic inspiration) sound garbled and unintelligible and bestow none of their original magical effects. On a failure, nothing happens.

You are invisible until you've moved 5ft, the turn ends, or you harm a creature. Undead creatures can still see you. Additionally, you show up in reflections, photography, and other similar things. If something can see you while you're invisible, you appear ghostly and translucent.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The distance you can move increases by 5ft when you reach levels 5 (10 ft), 11 (15 ft), and 17 (20 ft).

Your touch causes a creature to begin transforming into a ravening, flesh-eating ghoul. Make a melee spell attack against a creature within your reach. On a hit, the target takes **8d6** necrotic damage.

For the next minute, the creature's body continues the transformation into a ghoul. At the start of each of its turns, the target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes **4d6** necrotic damage. On a successful save, the target takes no additional damage and the spell ends.

If the target dies while under the effects of this spell, it immediately rises as a ghoul under your control. (The GM has game statistics for these creatures.) As a bonus action on each of your turns, you can mentally command any creature you animated with this spell if the creature is within 120 feet of you (if you control multiple creatures, you can command any or all of them at the same time, issuing the same command to each one). You decide what action the creature will take and where it will move during its next turn, or you can issue a general command, such as to guard a particular chamber or corridor. If you issue no commands, the creature only defends itself against hostile creatures. Once given an order, the creature continues to follow it until its task is complete. The creature is under your control for 24 hours, after which it stops obeying any command you have given it.

name: Ghoul Gesture
components: V, S, M (a pinch of dirt from a ghoul's lair)

description.value: A greenish ray stabs from your pointing finger to strike at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes **4d8** necrotic damage and must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it is also incapacitated until the end of your next turn. If it fails it's save by 5 or more, it is paralyzed until the end of your next turn.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Ghoul Light
components: V, S, M (a bit of rendered fat)

description.value: You touch one object that is no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. Until the spell ends, the object is wreathed in a sickly greenish flame. These flames provide bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. The flames provide no heat and cannot be smothered or quenched, but completely covering the object with something opaque blocks the flames from providing light. The spell lasts for the duration or until you dismiss it as an action. If you target an object held or worn by a hostile creature, that creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw to avoid the spell.
In addition to providing light, all undead within a 20-foot radius of the object have advantage on Wisdom saving throws.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the duration is 1 hour. When you use a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the duration is 8 hours. When you use a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the duration is 24 hours. When you use a 9th level spell slot, the spell lasts until it is dispelled.
