You touch one to three pebbles, infusing them with powerful magic. You or someone else can make a ranged spell attack with one of the pebbles by throwing it or hurling it with a sling. If thrown, it has a range of 60 feet. If someone else attacks with the pebble, that attacker adds your spellcasting ability modifier, not the attacker's, to the attack roll.

Whether thrown or hurled with a sling, the pebbles transform into boulders mid-flight. On a hit, the target takes bludgeoning damage equal to 3d10 + your spellcasting ability modifier. Hit or miss, the spell then ends on the stone.
If you cast this spell again, the spell ends early on any pebbles still affected by it.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Gift of Gab
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when a creature within 90ft hears you speak

description.value: You attempt to skillfully reshape the memories of a listener. The target makes an Intelligence Saving Throw. If they fail, they forget everything you said within the last 6 seconds, including the verbal components of spells, and remember that you actually said the words you speak as the verbal component of this spell. Additionally, it does not notice you performing the somatic components of this spell.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: You can target one additional creature per additional spell level.

name: Girallon's Blessing
components: V, S, M (a few strands of girallon hair)

description.value: You touch a willing creature. The target sprouts a pair of arms, ending in clawed hands with opposable thumbs.

These arms function like your primary arms. In addition, the claws are natural weapons, which the target can use to make unarmed strikes. On a hit, the target deals **1d6** + Strength modifier slashing damage instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you may target one additional creature for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Glacial Orbs
components: V, S, M (a pinch of blue sand)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Otiluke's Freezing Sphere__

You conjure five bitterly cold balls in your hand. A creature can hold a ball, hand it to another creature, throw it up to 60 feet, or use it as ammunition for a sling or appropriate weapon. A ball shatters on impact and explodes in a 15-foot radius.

Each creature within the area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it takes **3d8** cold damage and its speed is halved until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half as much damage and suffers no other effects. When the spell ends, any remaining orbs evaporate.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, you create an additional ball for each slot level above 6th.

You touch one creature with an unfathomable cold hand. Make a melee spell attack, on a hit the target takes **8d10** cold damage and is Paralyzed for the duration of the spell or only take half as much damage on a success. The creature can be freed from its frozen form early by dealing at least 30 Fire damage to it, in one turn.
If the damage from this spell kills a target, they are turned into a Petrified ice statue.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The Cold damage increases by **1d10** for each level above 5th.

The moisture in the area coalesces and momentarily solidifies into a chunk of ice at a point you choose within range. Each creature in a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking **1d12** cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature who fails the saving throw also has its speed reduced to 0 until the end of your next turn.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d12 for each slot level above 1st.
You touch a willing creature. The target gains a glide speed of 30 feet for the duration. When the spell ends, the target falls if it is still aloft, unless it can stop the fall.

name: Glimpse the Immemorial
components: V, S, M (an hourglass-shaped diamond worth at least 1,000 gp)

description.value: You can see and hear into the past, glimpsing events that happened previously at your current location. The level of detail you see and hear depends on the span of time you wish to observe, chosen from the following options:

• **Days.** You sense the events of the past, up to seven days previously. You gain detailed knowledge of the people, conversations, and events that transpired.
• **Weeks.** You gain a summary of the events of the past, up to one year previously. Exact wording and details are lost, but you know all the participants and highlights of the conversations and events that took place.
• **Years.** You gain a general idea of the events of the past, up to 100 years previously. You notice only noteworthy events such as deaths, battles, scenes of great emotion, important discoveries, and significant happenings.
• **Centuries.** You gain a general idea of the events of the past, up to 1000 years previously. You notice only the most remarkable of events, such as coronations, deaths of important personages, major battles and other truly historic happenings.

You project a beam of twinkling lights at a creature or object within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes **1d8** radiant damage. Until a creature uses an action to remove the glitter, a target hit by this spell emits bright light in a 5-foot radius and has disadvantage on any Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks it makes to hide or conceal itself.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The damage of this spell increases by 1d8 at 5th (**2d8**), 11th (**3d8**), and 17th level (**4d8**).

name: Glowing Orb
components: V, S, M (a fist-sized glass sphere worth 50 gp, which the spell consumes)

description.value: You touch the glass sphere, creating a permanent magical light source inside it. The orb emits bright light in a 15-foot radius and dim light for another 15 feet. You can use an action to expand or reduce its radius of bright and dim light by 5 feet, to a maximum of 40 feet each or a minimum of 5 feet. In addition, you can use an action to make the light visible only to the orb's controller for 1 minute. If a glowing orb is smashed, the magic is lost.

As a bonus action on your turn, you can give control of the glowing orb to another creature. If the creature that controls the glowing orb dies, any creature can attempt to gain control of the glowing orb as an action by succeeding on a DC 15 Intelligence check.

name: Glyph of Power
components: V, S, M (500 gp worth of gem dust, dependent on effect, which the spell consumes)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Symbol__

When you cast this spell, you mark a fixed surface with an arcane inscription, occupying a 5-foot diameter circle. When a creature enters the glyph's space or otherwise disturbs it, the glyph triggers.
You can refine the trigger by specifying or exempting creatures or creature types, or by specifying a password a creature can speak as a reaction to prevent the glyph from triggering.

The glyph is nearly invisible and requires a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to be found. A creature has advantage on this check if it is able to perceive magical effects, such as by casting detect magic. If a creature uses its action to destroy the glyph, or the surface is destroyed, the spell ends without triggering.

When you create the glyph, choose one of the options below, expending its material component. When the glyph triggers, it flares with colored light until destroyed. The effect immediately occurs, targeting every non-exempt creature within 60 feet.

• **Weakness (Amethyst).** Each target must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, it suffers crippling weakness for 1 hour. Its speed drops to 15 feet, and all its weapon attacks deal damage as if it rolled the minimum result.
• **Binding (Topaz).** Each target must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it is restrained by magical lines of force for 1 hour.
• **Death (Black Sapphire).** Each target must make a Constitution saving throw, dropping to 0 hit points on a failure or suffering **10d8** necrotic damage on a success.
• **Bafflement (Citrine).** Each target must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, it loses its ability to understand the world for 1 hour. It cannot cast spells and has disadvantage on all ability checks and attack rolls.
• **Rage (Garnet).** Each target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it becomes hostile to all other creatures and attacks the nearest target. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns.
• **Stupor (Emerald).** Each target must make a Charisma saving throw, or enter a dazed state, its mind disconnected from its body. A creature takes no actions, and its speed is reduced by half. It recovers after 1 hour or when it takes any damage.

You touch another willing creature who isn't wearing armor, and a shining set of barding appears on it until the spell ends. The target's base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier and its speed increases by 10 feet. The spell ends if the target dons regular armor, ends its turns more than 5 feet away from you, or if you dismiss the spell as an action.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the target's base AC becomes 15+ its Dexterity modifier instead. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the target gains a flying speed equal to its walking speed.

name: Goodberry
components: V, S, M (a sprig of mistletoe)

description.value: Ten berries appear in your hand and are infused with magic for the duration. A creature can take a Bonus Action to eat one berry. Eating a berry restores 1 Hit Point.
Uneaten berries disappear when the spell ends.

name: Goodberry (Alternate)
components: V, S, M (up to 10 fresh-picked berries, which are consumed by the casting of this spell)

description.value: You hold up to ten berries in your hands and infuse them with primal magic. As an action, a creature can eat a berry. It then regains 1 hit point and nourishment for one day.
The berries wither and lose their potency if they have not been consumed within 24 hours of the casting of this spell.

You touch a willing creature, bathing it in a silvery glow. For the duration, the target's speed increases by 10 feet, and it sheds bright light in a 5-foot radius and dim light for an additional 5 feet. In addition, whenever the target hits with a melee weapon attack, it deals an additional **1d4** radiant damage.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d4 for each slot level above 3rd and target's speed increases by an additional 5 feet for every two slot levels above 3rd.
Spectral skeletal arms emerge from the ground in a 15-foot-radius circle on the ground that you can see within range. The area becomes Difficult Terrain for the duration.

Each creature you choose in the area makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it takes **3d6** Force damage and has the Prone condition. Whenever a creature you can see enters the area or ends its turn there, you can force it to make a save against the spell. A creature makes that save only once per turn.
When a creature tries to leave the area, you can force it to make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, its Speed is 0 until the start of its next turn.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 4.

You cause a vine to sprout from the ground in an unoccupied space you can see within range. When you cast this spell, the vine strikes at a target you can see within 30 feet of it. Make a melee spell attack against the target, and on hit, it takes **2d8** bludgeoning damage. If the target is Large or smaller, then it is pulled up to 30 feet toward the vine and Restrained by it.
As an action, a Restrained creature can make a Strength or Dexterity check against your Spell save DC to escape.
As a bonus action on each subsequent turn, you can cause the vine to strike at another target. If the vine is Restraining a creature, it instead deals **2d8** bludgeoning damage to it.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: If you cast this spell with a spell slot of 4th-level or higher, the vine deals an additional **1d8** damage on hit for each slot level above 3rd.
**Replaces:** __Toll the Dead__

You gesture at one creature within range and chant a brief dirge, hastening its doom. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take **1d8** necrotic damage. If it is below half its maximum hit points, the damage increases to **1d12**.
This spell's damage increases by one die when you reach 5th level (2d8 or 2d12), 11th level (3d8 or 3d12), and 17th level (4d8 or 4d12).

name: Gray Gaze
components: V, S, M (a pebble with a hole in it)

description.value: You turn your gaze on one creature you can see within range. If the target can see your eyes, their body stiffens and cracks as if it were turning to stone. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take Necrotic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus and have Disadvantage on the next Dexterity saving throw it makes before the end of its next turn.

A skull-shaped cloud of sickly gray energy wraps around a creature you can see in range. That creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes **8d8** necrotic damage and is enshrouded in gray radiance for the next minute. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage and is not enshrouded.

While enshrouded, a creature cannot regain hit points or cause another creature to regain hit points through spells or magical abilities. At the end of each of its turns, a creature makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes **2d8** necrotic damage and remains enshrouded. On a successful save, the effect ends.
**Replaces:** __Tsunami__

You create a giant, overwhelming wave at a point you can see, summoning a 50-foot long, 50-foot high, 10-foot thick wall of water. You can increase the casting time when casting the spell up to a maximum of 6 rounds; each round increases the wall's size by 50 feet in length and height, and 10 feet in thickness (up to a maximum of 300 feet long, 300 feet high, and 60 feet thick).

The wall lasts for the duration. When the wall appears, each creature within its area must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes **6d10** bludgeoning damage, or half as much damage on a successful save.

At the start of each of your turns after the wall appears, the wall, along with any creatures in it, moves 50 feet along the ground in a direction of your choice. Any Huge or smaller creature inside the wall or whose space the wall enters when it moves must succeed on a Strength saving throw or take **5d10** bludgeoning damage. A creature can take this damage only once per round. At the end of the turn, the wall's height is reduced by 50 feet, and the damage creatures take from the spell on subsequent rounds is reduced by 1d10. When the wall reaches 0 feet in height, the spell ends.

A creature caught in the wall can attempt to swim through it by making a successful Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC. If it fails the check, it can't move. A creature that moves out of the spell's area falls to the ground.

name: Greater Restoration
components: V, S, M (diamond dust worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes)

description.value: You touch a creature and magically remove one of the following effects from it:

• 1 Exhaustion level
• The Charmed or Petrified condition
• A curse with a spell level equal to or less than this spell's level or their attunement to a cursed magic item.
• Any reduction to one of the target's ability scores
• Any reduction to the target's Hit Point maximum

name: Green-Flame Blade
components: S, M (a melee weapon worth at least 1 sp)

description.value: You brandish the weapon used in the spell's casting and make a melee attack with it against one creature within 5 feet of you. On a hit, the target suffers the weapon attack's normal effects, and you can cause green fire to leap from the target to a different creature of your choice that you can see within 5 feet of it. The second creature takes fire damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: This spell's damage increases when you reach certain levels. At 5th level, the melee attack deals an extra **1d8** fire damage to the target on a hit, and the fire damage to the second creature increases to **1d8** + your spellcasting ability modifier. Both damage rolls increase by **1d8** at 11th level (**2d8** and **2d8**) and 17th level (**3d8** and **3d8**).

name: Green-Flame Blade (Alternate)
components: V, M (a simple or martial melee weapon)

description.value: As a bonus action, you wreathe the melee weapon used in the casting of this spell with emerald flames. Until the start of your next turn, your attacks with that weapon deal fire damage in place of the weapon's normal damage type.
Once per casting when you deal fire damage with this spell, you can cause the flames to leap to another creature you can see within 5 feet of your target, dealing **1d6** fire damage to it.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The fire damage dealt to the second creature by this spell increases at 5th level (**1d8**), 11th level (**1d10**), and 17th level (**1d12**).

name: Guidance
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when a willing creature within 10 feet would fail an ability check

description.value: Add a d4, potentially turning it into a success. Do not add it if a positive bonus has already been applied to the roll by a spell. You can cast this once and regain all uses after a short rest.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The number of uses increases by 1 at 5th level (2 uses), 11th level (3 uses), and 17th level (4 uses).
You touch another creature and infuse it with otherworldly knowledge of a skill of your choice. For the duration, it gains a 1d4 bonus to any ability checks it makes with that skill.
If you are proficient in the skill, this bonus becomes 1d6.
You seize the air and compel it to create one of the following effects at a point you can see within range:

• One Medium or smaller creature that you choose must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away from you.
• You create a small blast of air capable of moving one object that is neither held nor carried and that weighs no more than 5 pounds. The object is pushed up to 10 feet away from you. It isn't pushed with enough force to cause damage. Until the end of your next turn it is held aloft as long as it is not holding anything else aloft
• You create a harmless sensory effect using air, such as causing leaves to rustle, wind to slam shutters closed, or your clothing to ripple in a breeze.

name: Hail of Stone
components: V, S, M (a piece of jade)

description.value: You create a rain of stones in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you can see. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes **4d4** bludgeoning damage on a successful save, or half as much damage on a successful save.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 2d4 for each slot level above 1st.

When you hit a creature within range with a ranged weapon attack, you can cause the piece of ammunition to explode into a hail of thorns. In addition to the normal effect of the attack, the target of your attack and each creature within 5 feet must make a Dexterity saving throw. Creatures take **1d10** piercing damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd-level or higher, the damage increases by **1d10** for each slot level above 1st.

name: Hailstones
components: V, S, M (a handful of crystal spheres)

description.value: You create three frigid hailstones and hurl them at targets within range. You can hurl them at one target or several. Make a ranged spell attack for each hailstone. On a hit, the target takes **2d8** cold damage and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. This effect can stack if a creature is hit by more than 1 hailstone.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you create one additional hailstone for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Hailstorm
components: V, S, M (a piece of onion and a droplet of water)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Ice Storm__

Balls of ice slam to the ground in a 20-foot radius, 40-foot high cylinder centered on a point within range for the duration. The balls of ice turn the storm's area of effect into difficult terrain. Any creature starting its turn in the cylinder must make a Dexterity saving throw. It takes **5d4** bludgeoning damage and **5d4** cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the bludgeoning and cold damage each increase by **1d4** for each slot level above 4th. Additionally, the radius and height increase by 5 feet for each slot level above 4th.

name: Hallucination
components: V, S, M (a small glass bottle)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Phantasmal Force__

You afflict a creature you can see within range with an illusory phantasm. The target immediately perceives an object, creature, or other phenomenon which you specify. The phantasm lasts for the duration, must be smaller than a 10-foot cube, and is imperceptible except to the target. It seems real, including sound, smell, and any other properties as needed. The spell has no effect on undead or constructs. It can't cause damage or inflict conditions. The target behaves as if the phantasm is real, and can inspect the phantasm as an action, making an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC. If it is close enough to touch the phantasm, it has advantage on this check. On a success, the spell ends.
As a bonus action while you are within range, you can adjust the phantasm (for instance, moving a creature up to 30 feet, opening a door, or shattering a window.)

A ring of flame ignites above your head and emits heat in a 5-foot Emanation originating from you. Whenever the Emanation enters the space of a creature you can see and whenever a creature you can see enters the Emanation or ends its turn there, you can force that creature to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes **2d8** Fire damage, or half as much damage on a successful save. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 2.

name: Hamatula Barbs
components: V, S, M (a barb from a hamatula)

description.value: You cause a willing creature to sprout slender, sharp-edged barbs from their body and clothing. These barbs do not hinder their movement or actions. If a creature hits the target with a melee attack while within 5 feet of the target, that creature takes **1d10** piercing damage. In addition at the start of each of its turns, the target deals **1d10** piercing damage to any creature it is grappling or that is grappling it.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 3rd.

You touch a willing creature, beseeching your deity to bestow a fragment of their power upon them. For the duration, the target can cast a single spell of your choice using your spellcasting modifier without using a spell slot. The chosen spell can be any spell that you can prepare of 2nd level or lower. Alternatively, the chosen spell may be Cure Wounds (if you are good or neutral) or Inflict Wounds (if you are evil). Once the target has cast the chosen spell, this spell ends.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the level of spell you can grant your target increases by one level for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Hardening
components: V, S, M (an ointment made of diamond dust worth 10 gp, which the spell consumes)

description.value: Your touch strengthens an object, making it resistant to harm. The object gains a damage threshold of 5. This spell has no effect on objects that already have a damage threshold, or on objects that are larger than 10 cubic feet.

You create a mantle of harmonious tones, bolstering the spellcasting capabilities of your allies. For the duration, whenever you or a friendly creature within 15 feet of you casts a spell using a 1st level spell slot or higher which deals damage or restores hit points, they roll one of the spell's dice an additional time and add the extra damage or healing to the spell. If the spell affects multiple creatures, the extra damage or healing only affects one of those creatures (the creature casting the spell chooses which one).
With a few quick words, the world moves a bit slower around you. Until the start of your next turn, your speed is doubled, you gain a +2 bonus to AC, you have advantage on Dexterity saving throws.
In addition, on the turn you cast this spell, you gain an additional action. That action can be used only to take the Attack (one weapon attack only), Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Use an Object action.

Choose a creature you can see within 30 ft. While you are within 15 ft of the target you cannot be seen or heard except by the target and undead creatures. You show up in reflections, photography, and other things that instantly capture your likeness. If someone can see you or your likeness is captured while you are within the affected area, you appear ghostly and translucent. This spell ends if you harm a creature while you're within the affected area.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell at higher levels, target an additional creature for each additional spell level. All of the targets can see and hear you regardless of which radius you're in.

You weave magic into your music, enough to make even the most hard-hearted quail. When you cast this spell, you can designate any number of creatures you can see within 30 feet of you to be unaffected by it. Whenever a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature has disadvantage on the first attack roll or ability check it makes that turn. A creature that can't hear is unaffected by this spell.
You send forth a string of haunting words, such as prophesying its death, to a creature within range. That creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take **1d10** Psychic damage.

description.name: Cantrip Upgrade
description.value: The spell can target two creatures when you reach level 5, three at 11, and four at 17. You can target multiple creatures or the same one. If the same creature is targeted multiple times it only rolls the saving throw once, but takes damage as if targeted that many times.

You enhance your eyesight, causing distant objects and creatures to seem closer and more distinct. For the duration, the short and long range of ranged weapons you wield is doubled and you ignore penalties for attacking at your weapon's long range. You can see up to 1 mile away with no difficulty, able to discern even fine details as though looking at something no more than 100 feet away from you. In addition, you have a +5 bonus to Wisdom (Perception) checks.

You call upon your natural healing arts to guide your magic. If you are proficient in the Medicine skill, any spell you cast that restores hit points to a single target restores additional hit points to that target equal to your proficiency bonus.
You call forth a nature spirit to soothe the wounded. The intangible spirit appears in a space that is a 5-foot cube you can see within range. It looks like a transparent beast or fey.

You can cause the spirit to restore 1d6 temporary hit points to yourself or a creature you can see (no action required). The target must be within the spirits space. If you do, you cannot heal the target in that way again until the start of its next turn. The spirit can heal a number of times equal to 1 + your spellcasting ability modifier (minimum of twice). After healing that number of times, the spirit disappears.
As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the Spirit up to 30 feet to a space you can see.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the temporary hit points increase by 3 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Healing Sting
components: V, S, M (five dried wasp bodies)

description.value: Make a melee spell attack against a creature within your reach. On a hit, the target takes **2d12** necrotic damage and you regain hit points equal to the damage dealt.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d12 for each slot level above 2nd.

You transfer some of your life essence to a willing creature. When you cast this spell, you may spend up to three Hit Dice. For each hit dice spent this way, you roll that die. The target regains hit points equal to twice that number plus your spellcasting modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the maximum number of Hit Dice you may spend increases by 1 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Heart of Stone
components: V, S, M (a carved heart made of precious stones worth 5,000 gp)

description.value: You exchange your own living heart for a finely carved heart of stone used in the casting of this spell. Your living heart can be stored or hidden anywhere you like, where it continues to beat for the duration of the spell. While the spell lasts, you gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks, as well as resistance to cold, fire and lightning damage.

If your living heart is destroyed, you die. When the spell ends, your living heart instantly returns to its proper place in your body and the stone heart is transported to where your living heart had been located. If you die from causes other than your living heart being destroyed, this spell ends 1 minute later.

Choose a Humanoid that you can see within range. That creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes **3d10** force damage and is stunned for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and is not stunned. A creature stunned by this spell can make another constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
A creature of challenge rating 1 (or level, if it does not have a challenge rating) or less that fails its saving throw instantly dies as its heart bursts out of its body.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 and the challenge rating (or level, if it does not have a challenge rating) at which a creature dies increases by 1 for each slot level above 4th.

A flickering red fire bursts in the area, wreathing creatures in flame. Each creature in a 20-foot cube within range must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is outlined in fire. For the duration, a creature outlined in fire takes **2d6** fire damage at the start of each of its turns, sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet and cannot benefit from being invisible.
A creature can use an action to extinguish the flames on an outlined creature, ending the effect on that creature.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2nd.

You drain the heat from your foes in order to strengthen yourself. Each creature of your choice in a 20-foot radius sphere centered on you must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes **20d6** cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. In addition, you gain 10 temporary hit points for each creature damaged by this spell, up to a maximum of 100.

name: Heat Metal
components: V, S, M (a piece of iron and a flame)

description.value: Choose a manufactured metal object, such as a metal weapon or a suit of heavy or medium metal armor, that you can see within range. You cause the object to glow red-hot. Any creature in physical contact with the object takes **2d8** fire damage. The creature can drop the object to avoid taking the damage if they can.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The damage increases by **1d8** for each spell slot level above 2.

A creature you can see within range begins to suffer from the full brunt of the desert sun. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save the target takes **6d8** fire damage and gains a level of exhaustion. On a successful save the target takes half as much damage and does not suffer from exhaustion.
If the target has resistance to fire damage, it does not gain a level of exhaustion, even on a failed save.

name: Hellfire Trap
components: V, S, M (any form of non-magical container)

description.value: You touch a container to imbue it with fire, to trap those who shouldn't have access to it. When you cast this spell, speak a command word. When a creature tries to obtain something from the container without speaking said command word, they must succeed a Dexterity saving throw or take **6d8** Fire damage or half as much on a success. After being activated the spell ends.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The Fire damage increases by **1d8** for each level above 3rd.

name: Hellish Rebuke
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take in response to a creature you can touch taking damage from a creature that you can see within 60 feet of yourself

description.value: The damager is momentarily surrounded by green flames. It makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking **2d10** Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The damage increases by **1d10** for each spell slot level above 1.

You give a rousing call to distract your enemies and inspire your allies. Each creature of your choice within a 20-foot radius sphere centered on you increases their speed by 10 feet while the spell lasts. If they leave the sphere, this increased speed lasts until the end of their next turn. In addition, each creature of your choice that enters the area for the first time in a turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have its speed halved for the duration. A slowed creature that is no longer in this area can repeat this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
One creature you can see within range makes a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the target can't make Opportunity Attacks until the spell ends at the end of your next turn.

One creature you can see within range makes a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature becomes Indifferent about creatures of your choice that it is Hostile toward. This indifference ends if the target takes damage or is forced to make a saving throw. When the spell ends at the end of your next turn, the creature's attitude returns to normal.

One creature you can see within range makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, each time the target takes damage until the spell ends at the end of your next turn, it takes an extra **1d4** Necrotic damage. If the target is *Bloodied*, it takes an extra **1d6** Necrotic damage instead.

You mark a creature you can see within range with a sinister blood curse. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be cursed until the spell ends at the end of your next turn. If the target takes damage while cursed and has fewer than 5 Hit Points after taking damage, it drops to 0 Hit Point.

description.name: Cantrip Upgrade
description.value: The threshold of Hit Points under which the target drops to 0 Hit Points increases by 5 when you reach levels 5 (10 Hit Points), 11 (15 Hit Points), and 17 (20 Hit Points).

One creature you can see within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. It does so with Advantage if you or your Allies are fighting it. On a failed save, the target has the Charmed condition until the spell ends at the end of your next turn. The spell ends early if you or your Allies deal damage to the target. When the spell ends, the target knows it was Charmed by you.

One creature you can see within range must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take **1d6** Necrotic damage. This damage ignores Resistance and Immunity. The creature takes this damage again at the end of each of its turns. The spell ends at the end of your next turn.

description.name: Cantrip Upgrade
description.value: The damage increases by 1d6 when you reach levels 5 (2d6), 11 (3d6), and 17 (4d6).
One creature you can see within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target must subtract 1d4 from attack rolls it makes until the spell ends at the end of your next turn.

description.name: Cantrip Upgrade
description.value: The die subtracted from attack rolls changes when you reach level 5 (1d6), 11 (1d8), and 17 (1d10).

You touch a willing creature. The first time the target would drop to 0 Hit Points before the spell ends at the end of your next turn, the target instead drops to 1 Hit Point, and the spell ends. This spell has no effect if you have cast this spell on the target within the past 24 hours.

You create an illusory duplicate of yourself in your space. When a creature hits you with an attack before the spell ends at the end of your next turn, roll a d6. On 4 or higher, the attack strikes the duplicate instead of you and the spell ends. The duplicate otherwise ignore all other damage and effects. A creature is unaffected by this spell if it has the Blinded condition, Blindsight, or Truesight.
One creature you can see within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the Frightened condition until the spell ends at the end of your next turn.
You touch a willing creature. Until the spell ends at the end of your next turn, the target has Advantage on saving throws.

One creature you can see within range makes a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature can't speak coherently or cast spells with a Verbal component until the spell ends at the end of your next turn.

Repeating an ancient chant, you have the Invisible condition until the spell ends at the end of your next turn. Creatures within 10 feet of yourself that can hear can detect your location for the spell's duration. The spell ends early if you make an attack roll, deal damage, or cast a spell.

One creature you can see within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or suffer from hallucinations until the spell ends at the end of your next turn. Whenever a hallucinating target makes a D20 Test, you can take a Reaction to give the roll Disadvantage.

One creature you can see within range makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature's Speed is reduced to 10 feet until the spell ends at the end of your next turn. If the target is flying, it falls, unless it has the ability to hover.

You gesture at a creature you can see within range and choose a damage type. The creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or lose Resistance to that damage type, if it has Resistance to it. If it has Immunity to that damage type, it instead has Resistance to it. The spell ends at the end of your next turn.

You transform the ground in a 30-foot Emanation originating from you into murky swamp, which is Difficult Terrain until the spell ends at the end of your next turn. This Difficult Terrain doesn't cost you extra movement.
Choose one creature you can see within range. Until the spell ends at the end of your next turn, whenever the target rolls a 20 on the d20 of a D20 Test, the roll instead becomes a 1.

With an uplifting speech or an encouraging musical number, each creature you choose in a 30-foot Emanation originating from you gains 1d6 Temporary Hit Points. These Temporary Hit Points last until this spell ends at the end of your next turn, but vanish early for a creature that ends its turn outside of the Emanation.

description.name: Cantrip Upgrade
description.value: The Temporary Hit Points increase by 1d6 when you reach level 5 (2d6), 11 (3d6), and 17 (4d6).

You produce fog in a 20-foot Emanation originating from you. The fog spreads around corners, and its area is Heavily Obscured. This fog lasts until the spell ends at the end of your next turn or until a strong wind (such as one created by __Gust of Wind__) disperses it, ending the spell.

You create a 30-foot Emanation originating from you that locks weapons to their containers. The weapons and ammunition of each creature within the Emanation become fixed in their sheaths, quivers, or holsters until the spell ends at the end of your next turn. A creature can take a Utilize action to make a Strength (*Athletics*) check against your spell save DC, freeing an item from its container on a success.
One creature you can see within range makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the Poisoned condition until the spell ends at the end of your next turn.
One creature you can see within range makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target has a -2 penalty to AC until the spell ends at the end of your next turn.

description.name: Cantrip Upgrade
description.value: The penalty to AC increases by 1 when you reach levels 5 (-3), 11 (-4), and 17 (-5).

One creature you can see within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the Incapacitated condition until the spell ends at the end of your next turn. The spell ends on a target if it takes damage or someone within 5 feet of it takes an action to shake it out of the spell's effect. Once the spell ends on a target, it is immune to this spell for the next 24 hours.

You touch a nonmagical object within range that isn't being worn or carried and that can fit within a 1-foot Cube. It transforms into an edible candy replica. You choose the type of candy it is made out of, such as gingerbread, candy cane, licorice, or a combination of various candies. If the candy is not eaten or destroyed when the spell ends at the end of your next turn, it reverts to its original material. Once the spell ends on a target, it is immune to this spell for 1 minute.

A miniature earthquake shakes the ground in a 5-foot Emanation originating from you. Each creature on the ground in the Emanation must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have the Prone condition. A creature that enters the Emanation or ends its turn there must also succeed on that save or fall Prone. This spell ends at the end of your next turn.
You touch a willing creature. Each time the target takes damage before the spell ends at the end of your next turn, the damage it takes is reduced by 2.

description.name: Cantrip Upgrade
description.value: The damage reduction increases by 1 when you reach levels 5 (-3), 11 (-4) and 17 (-5).

name: Hidden Lodge
components: V, S, M (a small crystal bead)

description.value: A 10-foot-radius immobile dome of force springs into existence around and above you and remains stationary for the duration. The spell ends if you leave its area.

Nine creatures of Medium size or smaller can fit inside the dome with you. The spell fails if its area includes a larger creature or more than nine creatures. Creatures and objects within the dome when you cast this spell can move through it freely. All other creatures and objects are barred from passing through it. Spells and other magical effects can't extend through the dome or be cast through it. The atmosphere inside the space is comfortable and dry, regardless of the weather outside.

Until the spell ends, you can command the interior to become dimly lit or dark. The dome is transparent from the inside and almost perfectly camouflaged from the outside. At any distance of more than 30 feet, the dome is completely indistinguishable from natural terrain. A creature within 30 feet that is searching for the dome must first succeed on an Intelligence saving throw to recognize the hut as an artificial dwelling and not part of the landscape.

With a few whispered words, this spell sends creatures into a magical slumber. Each creature within 20 feet of a point you choose within range must make a Wisdom saving throw or fall unconscious until the spell ends, the sleeper takes damage, or someone uses an action to shake or slap the sleeper awake. A creature with a challenge rating of 3 or less (or level, if it doesn't have a challenge rating) automatically fails this saving throw.
Undead and creatures immune to being charmed aren't affected by this spell.

You conjure minor paranormal phenomena and other ominous effects. Choose the effect from the options below. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its effects active at a time.

description.name: Grave Mists
description.value: A rolling fog gathers on the ground in a 15-foot Cube for 1 minute.

description.name: Ominous Lights
description.value: You cause all candles, torches, and other open flames to darken and flicker for 1 minute.

description.name: Paranormal Chill
description.value: You can chill or warm the air in a 10-foot Cube by 10 degrees for 1 minute.

description.name: Poltergeist Activity
description.value: You cause small, unattended objects to rattle or levitate an inch off the ground for 1 minute.

description.name: Spirit Orbs
description.value: You create up to four fist-sized spectral, glowing orbs, which float around within range for 1 minute. The orbs don't provide light, apart from a dim glow.

description.name: Spooky Noises
description.value: You create a quiet sound that originates from a point of your choice within range, such as ominous whispers, the drone of insects, or the sound of crying. The sound lasts for 1 minute.

Tendrils of vitality-draining mist extend from your fingertips. A creature you can see within range makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes **2d6** Necrotic damage and is cursed for the duration. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only.

On each of your subsequent turns, you can take a Magic action or Bonus Action to deal damage to the cursed creature. The damage equals **2d6** Necrotic damage if you took the Magic action or half as much if you took a Bonus Action.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The damage increases by 2d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Holy Fire
components: V, S, M (a pinch of ash from burnt incense)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Flame Strike__

A column of holy fire roars down from the heavens to smite your foes, striking all creatures within a 40-foot high, 10-foot radius cylinder. When you cast this spell, choose if it deals radiant damage, fire damage, or both. All creatures within the cylinder must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes **8d8** damage of the chosen type (4d8 of each type if both were selected) on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
Targets gain no benefit from cover for this saving throw.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the damage increases by **2d8** (or **1d8** of each type) for every two slot levels above 5th.

You create a glowing mote of energy that stays near your shoulder, which sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. The mote has three charges, which can be expended in the following ways:

• **Spell Turning** If you are targeted by a magic missile, a line spell, or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll of 5th level or lower, you may use your reaction and spend a charge to reflect the effect back at the caster as though it originated from you, turning the caster into the target.
• **Protection** If you are hit by an attack, you may use your reaction and spend a charge to grant yourself +10 AC, including against the triggering attack, until the start of your next turn.
• **Fire Star** As an action on your turn, you may spend a charge to make a ranged spell attack against a creature you can see within 90 feet of you. On a hit, the target takes **12d6** fire damage.
When you have expended all charges, the spell ends.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th level or higher, you start with two additional charges for each slot level above 7th.

name: Holy Storm
components: V, S, M (a flask of holy water worth at least 25 gp)

description.value: A driving rain begins to fall in a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range. The area inside the cylinder is lightly obscured and any ranged attacks into or through the area have disadvantage. Any unprotected flames in the area are extinguished. Any Fiend that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes **4d6** radiant damage. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 3rd.
A charge of holy energy courses through you, surrounding you in a barely perceptible golden aura as you assume a mantle of celestial power. For the duration, you gain the following benefits:

• Your creature type becomes Celestial.
• You gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed and can hover.
• You have darkvision out to a range of 60 feet.
• Your weapon attacks are magical.
• When you hit with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra **1d4** radiant damage.
• You gain the ability to speak and understand Celestial.

name: Horrible Taste
components: V, S, M (a piece of rotten meat)

description.value: You touch a willing creature. Until the spell ends, any creature that successfully hits the target with a bite attack must make a Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. Creatures with an Intelligence score of 4 or lower will instinctively avoid the target and avoid biting them unless provoked.

name: Howling Chain
components: V, S, M (a small, platinum length of chain worth at least 500 gp)

description.value: A blood-red chain made of force appears in an unoccupied space you can see in range.

The chain attacks any creature hostile to you that moves to a space within 15 feet of the chain for the first time on a turn. When the chain attacks, make a melee spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes **4d6** + your spellcasting ability modifier force damage and must make a Wisdom saving throw. The target is frightened for the next minute on a failed save.

While frightened by the chain, a creature must take the Dash action and move away from the chain by the safest available route on each of its turns, unless there is nowhere to move. If the creature ends its turn in a location where it doesn't have line of sight to the chain, the creature can make a Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, that creature is no longer frightened.

You open a gateway to the dark between the stars, a region infested with unknown horrors. A 20-foot-radius sphere of blackness and bitter cold appears, centered on a point with range and lasting for the duration. This void is filled with a cacophony of soft whispers and slurping noises that can be heard up to 30 feet away. No light, magical or otherwise, can illuminate the area, and creatures in the area are blinded.

The void creates a warp in the fabric of space, and the area is difficult terrain. Any creature that starts its turn in the area takes **2d6** cold damage. Any creature that ends its turn in the area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take **2d6** acid damage as milky, otherworldly tentacles rub against it.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the radius of the spell increases by 5 feet and both the cold and acid damage each increase by **1d6** for each slot level above 3rd.

You magically mark one creature you can see within range as your quarry. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra **1d6** Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage to the target the first time you hit it with an attack roll on any turn. You choose the damage type when you prepare the spell. You also have Advantage on any Wisdom (Perception or Survival) check you make to find it.
If the target drops to 0 or less Hit Points before this spell ends, you can take a Bonus Action to move the mark to a new creature you can see within range.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd or 4th level, you can maintain your *concentration* on the spell for up to 8 hours, and the extra damage increases to 2d6. When you use a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you can maintain your *concentration* on the spell for up to 24 hours, and the extra damage increases to 3d6.

You grant yourself an instinctive ability to strike for your enemies weak point. The next time you hit a creature with a ranged weapon attack, you can roll the weapon's damage dice one additional time and add it to the damage total.
Once you have successfully hit a creature with a ranged weapon attack, the spell ends.

You touch a nonmagical melee weapon. Until the spell ends, that weapon gains the thrown property with a range of 30/60 and becomes a magic weapon with a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls. Once during your turn, you may recall the weapon, causing it to appear in your hand, no action required.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you may target one additional melee weapon for each slot level above 2nd.

You strike up a rousing, inspirational song that boosts  the spells cast by any number of creatures in a 30-foot radius sphere centered on you. Whenever one of those creatures casts a spell of 1st level or higher, it is considered to be cast at 1 spell slot higher than the spell slot used by the caster.

You create a twisting pattern of colors in a 30-foot Cube within range. The pattern appears for a moment and vanishes. Each creature in the area who can see the pattern must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration. While Charmed, the creature has the Incapacitated condition and a Speed of 0. At the end of each of its turns the creature can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success.
The spell ends for an affected creature if it takes any damage or if someone else uses an action to shake the creature out of its stupor.

name: Hypnotic Pattern (Alternate)
components: S, M (a glowing stick of incense)

description.value: You create a twisting pattern of colors that weaves through the air inside a 30-foot cube within range. This psychedelic pattern appears for a moment and vanishes. Each creature in the area who sees the pattern must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature becomes charmed for the duration. While charmed by this spell, the creature is incapacitated and has a speed of 0.

An affected creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. The spell also ends for an affected creature if it takes any damage or if someone else uses an action to shake it out of its stupor.

Choose a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take **9d6** cold damage and suffer one level of exhaustion. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and does not suffer from exhaustion.
If the target has resistance to cold damage, it does not gain a level of exhaustion, even on a failed save

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 4th.

name: Ice Axe
components: V, S, M (a shard of ice, glass or crystal)

description.value: You create a battleaxe-shaped formation of jagged, swirling ice shards in your hand. This magic axe lasts until the spell ends and counts as a simple melee weapon with which you are proficient. The axe deals **2d12** cold damage on a hit and you can use your spellcasting modifier instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls. In addition, if you score a critical hit with the axe, the axe shatters, dealing an additional 8 cold damage to the target.
If you drop the weapon, it shatters into icy fragments at the end of turn, which quickly dissipate. While the spell persists, you can use a bonus action to cause the axe to reappear in your hand.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d12 for each two slot levels above 3rd.

name: Ice Blade
components: V, S, M (a drop of water or a piece of ice)

description.value: You evoke a blade made of ice in your free hand. The blade is similar in size and shape to a rapier, and it lasts for the duration. If you let go of the blade, it disappears, but you can evoke it again as a Bonus Action.
As a Magic Action, you can make a melee spell attack with the ice blade. On a hit, the target takes Cold damage equal to **2d6** plus your spellcasting ability modifier.
On a hit the target's speed is halved and it can't use its Reaction until the end of their next turn.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The Cold damage increases by **1d6** for each level above 2nd.

name: Ice Claw
components: V, S, M (a white leather glove and a piece of clear rock crystal)

description.value: You create an icy spectral claw within range that lasts for the duration or until you cast this spell again. When you cast this spell, you can make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of the claw. On a hit, the target takes **4d8** + your spellcasting ability modifier cold damage and is grappled by the claw (escape DC is your spell save DC) if it is up to one size category larger than you. Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained and has disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.

As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the claw up to 20 feet and repeat the attack against a creature  within 5 feet of the claw (including any creature it is currently grappling). If the claw moves while grappling a creature, it can drag the grappled creature with it. If you choose not to have the claw drag the creature it is currently grappling with it when it moves, or order it to attack a different creature, that creature is no longer grappled.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 7th.

You cause ambient moisture to coalesce into delicate flowers of ice for a brief moment before exploding in a shower of deadly ice shards. Choose three different points you can see within range. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on each point you choose must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes **5d6** cold damage and **5d6** slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature in the area of more than one icy burst is affected only once.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the cold and slashing damage each increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 6th.

A sheen of white frost coats your fist, exploding into a spray of fine icy slivers when you strike. Make a melee spell attack against a creature you can reach. On a hit, the target takes **1d4** + your spellcasting modifier cold damage and has disadvantage on the next attack it makes before the end of its next turn.
The spell's damage increases by 1d4 when you reach 5th level (2d4), 11th level (3d4), and 17th level (4d4).

name: Icelance
components: V, S, M (a clear quartz gemstone worth at least 50 gp)

description.value: You launch a large shard of ice at a creature you can see within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes **6d8** cold damage and must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it is also stunned until the end of its next turn.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Icey Floor
components: V, S, M (a drop of water or a handful of snow)

description.value: For the duration, magical ice covers the ground from a point you choose within range, which fills a 15-foot-radius circle. When a creature tries to move across the ice, it is considered Difficult Terrain, and they must succeed a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure they fall prone and lose their remaining movement.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the spell's radius increases by 5 feet for each level above 2.
You unleash a storm of conflicting desires within the mind of one creature you can see within range. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be incapacitated for the duration.
The creature can repeat this Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns and each time that it takes damage, ending the effects of this spell on a successful save.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st. The creatures must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.

name: Identify
components: V, S, M (a pearl worth 100+ GP)

description.value: You touch an object throughout the spell's casting. If the object is a magic item or some other magical object, you learn its properties and how to use them, whether it requires Attunement, any curses placed on it and how many charges it has, if any. You learn whether any ongoing spells are affecting the item and what they are. If the item was created by a spell, you learn that spell's name.
If you instead touch a creature throughout the casting, you learn which ongoing spells, if any, are currently affecting it.

You touch a creature's temple and attempt to erase its identity. One creature you touch makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the Unconscious condition for 1 hour and is cursed to forget its identity. When the target awakens, it loses all its personal memories, though it retains its general knowledge, proficiencies, and other statistics. The target doesn't realize it has any class features, feats, or magical abilities, and so doesn't willingly use them unless it rediscovers them. If left to its own devices, the target will quickly adopt a new name and begin to build a new identity. When the spell ends, the target regains its past memories.

By gathering threads of shadow material from the Shadowfell, you create a Huge shadowy dragon in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The illusion lasts for the spell's duration and occupies its space, as if it were a creature.

When the illusion appears, any of your enemies that can see it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of it for 1 minute. The frightened creature has disadvantage on attack rolls while the source of its fear is within its line of sight. If a frightened creature ends its turn in a location where it doesn't have line of sight to the illusion, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the illusion up to 60 feet. At any point during its movement, you can cause it to exhale a blast of energy in a 60-foot cone originating from its space. When you create the dragon, choose a damage type: acid, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, or poison. Each creature in the cone must make an Intelligence saving throw, taking **7d6** damage of the chosen damage type on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

The illusion is tangible because of the shadow stuff used to create it, but attacks miss it automatically, it succeeds on all saving throws, and it is immune to all damage and conditions. A creature that uses an action to examine the dragon can determine that it is an illusion by succeeding on an Intelligence (*Investigation*) check against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the creature can see through it and has advantage on saving throws against its breath.

name: Illusory Feast
components: V, S, M (a piece of trail rations)

description.value: A magnificent feast appears, spread lavishly across a 40-foot cube within range, the contents of which shift and change to appear the most tantalizing to each observer.

Each creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a successful save, the creature is immune to this casting of the spell. On a failed save, the creature becomes charmed for the duration. While charmed by this spell, a creature is incapacitated and can only move closer to the center of the area as it begins attempting to consume the illusory food and drink.
The spell ends for an affected creature if it takes any damage or if someone else uses an action to shake the creature out of its stupor.

The ground seems to simply fall away as you create the illusions of three impossibly deep pits at three locations you can see within range. Each pit is a 10-foot cube and must be centered on a solid surface. Each creature that enters one of the areas for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is stunned until the start of its next turn as it flails around wildly, believing it is falling. On a successful save, the creature sees through the illusion and is immune to this casting of the spell.

Creatures that are flying, hovering or otherwise not standing on the ground in the area of this spell are unaffected, and creatures with a fly speed have advantage on their Intelligence saving throws.
**Replaces:** __Elemental Weapon__

You touch a melee weapon and enhance it with elemental power. Choose one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, or lightning. For the duration, the weapon deals **1d6** bonus damage on a hit, and the weapon's base damage is changed to the chosen type. In addition, once per round after a creature takes damage from the weapon, it suffers an effect based on the damage type chosen:

• **Acid:** The target takes **2d4** acid damage at the end of its next turn.
• **Cold:** The target's movement speed is halved until the end of its next turn.
• **Fire:** The target takes **1d6** additional fire damage.
• **Lightning:** The target can't take reactions until the end of its next turn.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the bonus damage increases by **1d6** for every two slot levels above 3rd.

Flames wreathe one creature you can see within range. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw. It takes **8d6** Fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, the target is also on fire for the spell's duration. The burning target sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the saving throw. It takes **4d6** Fire damage on a failed save, and the spell ends on a successful one. These magical flames can't be extinguished by non-magical means.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The end of turn Fire damage increases by **1d6** for each level above 5th.
**Replaces:** __Bones of the Earth__

You haul up to six mighty spikes of rock out of the ground, erupting at locations you can see within range. Each spike occupies a 5-foot space, is up to 30 feet tall, and has AC 11 and 30 hit points. Any creature above a spike when the spell is cast must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it takes **5d10** piercing damage and is impaled if it is Large or smaller, becoming restrained at the top of the spike. Huge creatures can be restrained if targeted with two or more spikes, and Gargantuan creatures with six or more. On a success, a target suffers half as much damage and no other effects. A creature in the area of more than one spike is only damaged once.

An impaled target can use its action to attempt to free itself with a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against your spell save DC. On a success, it is no longer restrained and falls. A target is also freed if all spikes impaling it are destroyed.
If a creature is slammed into a ceiling or other obstacle when it gets impaled, it takes an additional **2d10** bludgeoning damage, and attempts to free itself are made with disadvantage.
The spikes crumble back into the earth after 1 hour.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, you can create two additional spikes for each slot level above 6th.

Motes of dark energy dance before your eyes, evoking terror in those you focus your gaze upon. When you cast this spell, and as an action on subsequent turns, you may focus your gaze on a creature you can see within range. That creature must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes **10d6** psychic damage and is frightened of you for the next minute. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and is not frightened. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
A creature that is unable to see you cannot be targeted by this spell.

name: Improvisation
components: V, S, M (a pair of dice)

description.value: You grant yourself a pool of luck, which you can use to manipulate the outcomes of tasks you perform. The pool consists of two points, which you can spend as a reaction before you make an attack roll or ability check to gain advantage on that roll.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, your pool increases by 1 for every two slot levels above 1st.
**Replaces:** __Immolation__

You channel agonizing flames, wreathing a creature you can see within range. At the start of each of its turns, the target must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking **10d6** fire damage on a failure. On a success, it takes half as much damage and the spell ends for that creature. While a target is on fire, it casts bright light for 30 feet and dim light for an additional 30 feet.

As a bonus action, you can spread the flames from any target creature to another within 10 feet of it, making that creature an additional target. If damage from this spell reduces a target to 0 hit points, the target is turned to ash.
Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on a point in range cannot ready actions or take readied actions for the duration of the spell.

You grant yourself unyielding fortitude, allowing you to endure blows that would otherwise kill you. For the duration, whenever you would drop to 0 hit points as a result of taking damage, you instead drop to 1 hit point.

name: Inexorable Sarcophagus
components: V, S, M (a miniature sarcophagus worth 1,000+ GP)

description.value: You toss a palm-sized sarcophagus at a Large or small creature you can see within range, which must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw as the sarcophagus grows to full size and attempts to trap it within. On a failed save, the target has the Blinded and Incapacitated conditions, its Speed is 0, and it has Total Cover from attacks and effects outside of the sarcophagus for the duration.
The sarcophagus is an object of the same size as the target creature with AC 15 and 100 Hit Points. It has Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. If it is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the spell ends.
A target within the sarcophagus makes another Dexterity saving throw at the end of each of its turns.

If it successfully saves against this spell three times, it escapes the sarcophagus and the spell ends. If it fails its saves three times, the sarcophagus crushes it and deals 100 Bludgeoning damage to it. The successes and failures needn't be consecutive; keep track of both until the target collects three of a kind.
A creature killed by this spell rises at the start of your next turn as a Mummy that follows your verbal orders.

You summon a pack of devils from the Nine Hells to serve you. These demons appear in unoccupied spaces that you can see within range. Choose any number of Fiend (devil) creatures with a combined Challenge rating of 8 or lower. No individual creature may have a Challenge Rating below 1 or above 4. For example: the caster might choose  to summon two CR3 Bearded Devils and two CR1 Imps  or alternatively four CR2 Spined Devils. The summoned creatures are friendly to you and your companions. Roll initiative for the summoned creatures as a group, which has its own turns. They obey any verbal commands that you issue to them (no action required by you). If you don't issue any commands to them, they defend themselves from hostile creatures, but otherwise take no actions.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a 9th-level spell slot, you can summon a number of Fiend (devil) creatures with a combined Challenge rating of 16 or lower. No individual creature may have a Challenge rating below 1 or above 4.

You create a pulsing, powerful rhythm that infuses your allies with infernal power. Whenever you or an allied creature in range that can hear you deals fire damage to another creature, that creature takes 2d6 additional fire damage.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the extra damage increases by 1d6 for every 2 slot levels above 3rd.

You touch a nonmagical weapon. Until the spell ends, wounds caused by that weapon continue to smolder with infernal flames. Once per turn, when a creature is hit with an attack using this weapon, it leaves a lingering wound. At the start of a wounded creature's turns, it takes **1d4** fire damage for each time it has been wounded and must make a Constitution saving throw, ending the effect of all such wounds on itself on a success.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d4 for every two slot levels above 2nd.

name: Infestation of Maggots
components: V, S, M (a handful of dead, dried flies)

description.value: You brush your hand across a creature, infesting that creature with hundreds of writhing maggots in their flesh. Make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of you. On a hit, that creature takes **6d6** poison damage  and is poisoned until the spell ends. At the end of each of  its turns while the spell lasts, the target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes **4d6** poison damage. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and the spell ends. If a creature dies while under the effects of this spell, their corpse ruptures in a burst of maggots and noxious gasses. When this happens, each creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for the remaining duration of the spell.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the initial and ongoing damage each increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.
**Replaces:** __Contagion__

Your touch inflicts disease. Make a melee spell attack against a creature within your reach. On a hit, the target is afflicted with one of the diseases listed below (your choice). The spell has no effect on constructs, undead, or creatures immune to disease. The disease is magical and can only be cured by the __heal__ spell or equivalent magic.

At the end of each of the target's turns, it must make another Constitution saving throw. If it succeeds, it suffers no effects from the disease until the end of its next turn. When the target has succeeded on three of these saving throws, it is no longer diseased. When it has failed on three of these saving throws, the disease sets in, and lasts for 7 days, or until treated by an appropriate means. Once the target has either three successes or three failures on these saving throws, it stops making saves for this spell.

• **Muscle Weakness.** The creature's arms become unbearably weak. It has disadvantage on Strength checks, Strength saving throws, and attack rolls that use Strength. Its attacks using Strength deal half damage.
• **Trembling Spasms.** The creature is overcome with terrible tremors. It has disadvantage on Dexterity checks, Dexterity saving throws, and attack rolls that use Dexterity. Its attacks using Dexterity do half damage.
• **Skinslough.** The creature's skin becomes paper-thin and causes agonizing pain when it tears. It has disadvantage on Constitution checks and Constitution saving throws, except those caused by this spell. In addition, when the creature takes damage, its speed is reduced to 10 feet until the end of its next turn.
• **Mindrot.** The creature becomes disoriented and confused. The creature has disadvantage on Intelligence checks and Intelligence saving throws and cannot tell friend from foe in combat.
