• **Fire-eyes Fever.** The creature's eyes turn milky white and are searingly painful. It has disadvantage on Wisdom checks and Wisdom saving throws and is blinded.
• **Flesh Rot.** The creature's flesh decays. It has disadvantage on Charisma checks and Charisma saving throws and takes 5 additional points of damage when it suffers bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage.

name: Inhibit
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when a creature you see rolls for initiative

description.value: A creature you can see within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, subtract 2d6 from the target's initiative roll, or half as much on a successful save.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you may target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.
**Replaces:** __Geas__

You magically bind a creature that can understand you within range to either complete or abstain from some action or activity. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become charmed by you for the duration. Once per turn while charmed in this way, the target's current and maximum hit points are reduced by 5d10 if its behavior contradicts your instructions. This reduction lasts until the spell ends.
You can issue any command you choose, though the spell ends if you issue a suicidal command. The creature's death does not end the spell.

As an action, you can end the spell early. Remove curse cast at the spell's level also ends the spell. Greater restoration ends the reduction of the target's hit point maximum, but it does not end the spell. This spell can't be dispelled by __dispel magic__.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The spell reduces maximum hit points by an additional **1d10** for each slot level above 5th. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th or 8th level, the duration is 1 year. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 9th level, the spell lasts indefinitely.

You recite a foolhardy ditty, tapping your foot in time. A creature you can see in range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the tune repeats endlessly in their head, making it difficult to concentrate. For the duration of the spell, the target has disadvantage on Intelligence checks and Constitution saving throws made to maintain *Concentration* on a spell.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you may target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 9th level, the spell is no longer *Concentration* and instead lasts until it is dispelled.

You concentrate on bolstering yourself and your allies, ensuring their success. Whenever a friendly creature within 15 feet of you has advantage on a roll, that creature can reroll one of the dice once.

name: Instant Refuge
components: V, S, M (a concoction made from rare herbs and demon skin worth 250 gp, which the spell consumes)

description.value: You create a set of specific triggers, allowing you to escape in an instant should the need arise. When you cast this spell, specify a location and up to six specific conditions that trigger the spell. When any of these situations occur, you and everything you are wearing or carrying are teleported to the chosen location. The location must be somewhere you have previously visited, even on another plane. Deities and other planar rulers can prevent you from teleporting into their presence or into their domains.

name: Interplanar Telepathic Bond
components: V, S, M (pieces of eggshell from two different kinds of creatures)

description.value: You forge a telepathic link among up to eight willing creatures of your choice within range, psychically linking each creature to all the others for the duration. Creatures with Intelligence scores of 2 or less aren't affected by this spell.

Until the spell ends, the targets can communicate telepathically through the bond whether or not they have a common language. The communication is possible over any distance and extends to other planes of existence.

name: Intrusive Thought
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when you see a creature within 60 feet of yourself making an attack roll

description.value: You attempt to distort a creature's thinking. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or automatically miss with the triggering attack.

name: Invisibility Purge
components: V, S, M (a pinch of powdered silver)

description.value: A 120-foot Emanation originating from you disrupts invisibility. Each creature within the Emanation is outlined with a magical aura and can't benefit from the Invisible condition. Invisible objects within the Emanation are rendered visible.

You or a willing creature you touch becomes invisible and virtually undetectable until the spell ends. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is invisible as long as it is on the target's person. While invisible, the target exudes no scent and radiates an aura of silence that absorbs all sounds in a 5-foot radius sphere centered on the target, preventing detection by Tremorsense or blindsight. Casting spells that require verbal components in this radius is impossible.

This invisibility is effective even against spells and abilities that normally see through invisibility or reveal invisible creatures (such as faerie fire). Only a creature with truesight can see through your superior invisibility.
You become invisible until the spell ends. Anything you are wearing or carrying is invisible as long as it remains on your person. The spell ends if you attack or cast a spell.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the duration changes to *Concentration*, up to 1 minute. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the duration increases to *Concentration*, up to 1 hour.

name: Iron Bones
components: V, S, M (a miniature skull made out of iron or steel)

description.value: You touch up to three willing Undead creatures, bolstering their resilience. Each of those creature's base AC becomes 16 and it doesn't add its Dexterity modifier to its armor class.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you may target two additional creatures for each slot level above 3rd.

You touch a willing creature, causing the joints of their armor to move smoothly and silently. For the duration, the target does not suffer disadvantage to Dexterity (stealth) checks made as a result of their armor.

name: Ironguard
components: V, S, M (a small nugget of adamantine worth 100 gp)

description.value: A willing creature you touch becomes immune to nonmagical metal. Metal items (including metal weapons) simply pass through you, and you can walk through metal barriers such as iron bars. If the spell expires while metal is inside you, the metal object is shunted out of your body (or you are shunted away from the metal).

The final words of your spell boom outward in a thunderous roar, knocking the foes in your path off their feet. Each creature in a 30-foot cone must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
**Replaces:** __Sickening Radiance__
You create an eerie, pulsating blue light within a 30-foot radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range. The bright light spreads around corners, and lasts until the spell ends.

When a creature moves into the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Constitution saving throw. Constructs automatically succeed on saving throws against this spell.

On a failure, the creature's hit point maximum is reduced by 7d4, its speed is reduced by 5 feet, and it receives a -2 penalty to attack rolls, ability checks, saving throws, and save DCs. A creature suffers cumulative effects with each failed saving throw. If a creature fails its saving throw five times, it dies.
Additionally on a failure, the creature emits light in a 5-foot radius and can't benefit from being invisible. Each subsequent failed save increases the radius by 5 feet.
All effects caused by this spell (except death) end when the spell ends.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the hit point maximum reduction increases by **1d4** per slot level above 4th.

You force a creature that can hear you within range to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it begins a comic dance in place: shuffling, tapping feet, and capering for the duration. Creatures that can't be charmed are immune to this spell.

This creature must use all its movement to dance without leaving its space and has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws and attack rolls. While the target is affected by this spell, creatures have advantage on attack rolls against it. As an action, a dancing creature makes a Wisdom saving throw to regain control of itself, ending the spell on a success.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th-level or higher, you target one additional creature who can hear you within range for each slot level above 3rd.
At your touch, you magically enhance the natural weapons of a willing creature. For the duration, the target scores a critical hit on a 19 or 20 with attacks made using its natural weapons.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you may target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Jaws of the Wolf
components: V, S, M (one carving of a worg for each worg you wish to create, worth 25 gp each)

description.value: You scatter small wooden carvings on the ground, which immediately grow into adult worgs in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. You create one worg for each statue you scatter, up to a maximum of four. The GM has the creatures' statistics. These worgs disappear when they drop to 0 hit points or when the spell ends, leaving a carving in their space. If a worg disappears as a result of dropping to 0 hit points, the carving is destroyed.

The worgs are friendly to you and your companions. They obey any mental or verbal commands that you issue to them (no action required by you) and take their turns immediately after you in initiative. If you don't issue any commands to them, they defend themselves from hostile creatures, but otherwise take no actions.
You have advantage on attack rolls against any creature so long as there is at least one of your summoned worgs within 5 ft. of that creature and the worg isn't incapacitated.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using certain higher-level spell slots, the maximum number of worgs you can create increases: twice as many with a 5th-level slot, three times as many with a 7th-level slot, and four times as many with a 9th-level slot.

name: Jethro's Instant Reload
components: V, S, M (a spent bullet casing)

description.value: One Ranged weapon you touch becomes enchanted to reload itself automatically. If the weapon has the Cooldown, Loading, or Reload, you ignore the property for the duration. When the weapon's ammunition is depleted, ammunition you are carrying teleports into the weapon.

You create waves of pleasing sounds to resonate in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on you. The sphere moves with you and negates any spell of magical effect that prevents sounds from being created within the area. In addition, any friendly creature in the area has advantage on skill checks involving musical instruments and Charisma (Performance) checks involving music.

name: Jump
components: V, S, M (a grasshopper's hind leg)

description.value: You touch a willing creature. Until the start of your next turn, their jump distance increases by 10 ft. Additionally, once within the duration they can move up to 10 ft during a jump without spending movement.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level 2 or higher, their jump distance and the distance they can move without spending movement increases by 10ft for each slot level above 1st.

name: Jump (Alternate)
components: V, S, M (a grasshopper's hind leg)

description.value: You touch a willing creature and greatly alter its buoyancy. Once on each of its turns until the spell ends, the target can spend 10 feet of its movement to jump up to 30 feet.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd-level or higher, the distance of this magical jump increases by 10 feet for each slot level above 1st.

You release an arc of lighting at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack roll against the target. On hit, the target takes **4d8** Lightning damage, and you can cause the spell to jump to another target within 20 feet of the first target making a new attack roll for each target. The spell cannot hit the same target twice or jump to a target out of the spell's range. The spell can jump a maximum of five times.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The Lightning damage increases by **1d8** for each level above 4th.

name: Junglerazer
components: V, S, M (a pinch of ash from a burnt plant)

description.value: You send an invisible blast of destructive energy forth in a line 120 feet long and 5 feet wide in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes **4d10** necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A Plant, Fey or Beast that fails its save takes an additional **2d10** necrotic damage. Plants that die as a result of damage from this spell instantly crumble to dust.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Kelpstrand
components: V, S, M (a piece of dried seaweed)

description.value: You create long strands of kelp, sending them streaking out to envelop foes. Choose up to three creatures you can see within range. For each creature, make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target is restrained until the spell ends if it is huge or smaller. A restrained creature can use its action to attempt to break free, making a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC.
If you cast this spell while within 300 feet of an ocean, you have advantage on these attacks and restrained creatures have disadvantage on their Strength saving throws.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you may target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

Your eyes flash with a golden light as you survey your opponents, gauging who is the strongest among them. For the duration, you have an impression of the general strength of creatures within 60 feet that you can see. You gain an impression based on each creature's Challenge Rating (or the creature's level, if it doesn't have a Challenge Rating) according to the following chart:
When you cast this spell, or as a bonus action on your turn, you may choose a creature you can see in range and learn one of the following characteristics about the creature:

• What damage immunities it has.
• What damage resistances it has.
• What condition immunities it has.
• What damage vulnerabilities it has.

The ground seems open and swallow you and up to three willing Medium size or smaller creatures within 5 feet of you, as you all descend into a protective chamber in the earth below where you were standing. The chamber is 10-foot square and exists 5 feet beneath the surface. While inside the chamber, you can't see what is happening  outside and have total cover from those outside. The chamber generates air to breathe.
The can only be cast on an area of unworked stone, dirt, or similar natural material large enough to accommodate the chamber.

If cast as a ritual, the duration increases to 8 hours and does not require *Concentration*. When the spell ends, any creatures or objects in the chamber are returned to the surface where you initially entered, leaving no trace of the chamber behind.

A creature you can see within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target has disadvantage on ability checks, saving throws and attack rolls for the duration. In addition, at the start of each turn, roll a d20, on an 11 or higher, the creature cannot move or take actions that turn.
At the end of each of its turns, the target makes another Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, the spell ends.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you may target one additional creature for each slot level above 4th.
**Replaces:** __Grasping Vine__

You cause a magical vine to burst forth from the ground, wall, or ceiling in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range. The vine is an object that has an AC and hit points equal to your spell save DC. When you cast this spell, and as a bonus action on your subsequent turns for the duration, you can direct the vine to pull a Large or smaller creature within 30 feet of it that you can see. That creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be pulled 20 feet directly toward the vine. The spell ends if you cast it again or dismiss it as an action.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the range and distance the vine can pull a creature increases by 10 feet for each slot level above 2nd. If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the vine can attempt to pull a Huge or smaller creature.

name: Last Breath
components: V, S, M (Rare oils and unguents worth at least 500 gp, which the spell consumes)

description.value: You touch a creature that has died within the last minute, restoring them to life. The magic fashions a new body for the creature to inhabit, which likely causes the creature's race to change. The GM rolls a d100 and consults the following table to determine what form the creature takes when restored to life, or the GM chooses a form.

The creature recalls its former life and experiences. It retains the capabilities it had in its original form, except it exchanges its original race for the new one and changes its racial traits accordingly.

You touch a Tiny unattended object, that weighs less than 5 pounds, causing it to launch at a creature or object you can see in range. On a hit the target takes **1d4** + your spellcasting ability modifier bludgeoning damage. Hit or miss, the object also takes the same amount of damage, potentially breaking it.

If you miss the target, roll 1d8 to determine where the object lands for a Medium or smaller target or 1d12 for a Large target, with 1 being the space straight back towards you, counting clockwise around the creature. If the creature is Huge or larger, the object lands in the same square as the target.

The spell allows you to launch multiple objects at higher levels: two objects at 5th level, three objects at 11th level, and four objects at 17th level. You can direct the objects at the same target or at different ones. Make a separate attack roll for each object.

A 10-foot Emanation springs into existence around you and remains stationary for the duration. The spell fails when you cast it if the Emanation isn't big enough to fully encapsulate all creatures in its area.

Creatures and objects within the Emanation when you cast the spell can move through it freely. All other creatures and objects are barred from passing through it. Spells of level 3 or lower can't be cast through it, and the effects of such spells can't extend into it.

The atmosphere inside the Emanation is comfortable and dry, regardless of the weather outside. Until the spell ends, you can command the interior to have Dim Light or Darkness (no action required). The Emanation is opaque from the outside and of any color you choose, but it's transparent from the inside.
The spell ends early if you leave the Emanation or if you cast it again. The dome has an AC of 5 and 60 hit points. A disintegrate spell destroys it instantly.

You channel your own life force into golden beams of energy, which you fire at targets within range. Create one primary beam of energy, then spend 1 hit die to create two additional beams. You can fire these beams at one target or several. Make a ranged spell attack for each beam. On a hit, the target takes **3d8** radiant damage from the primary beam, or **1d8** radiant damage from a secondary beam.
Undead and Constructs can't cast this spell.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage from the primary bolt increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 2nd. In addition, the damage from each secondary bolt increases by 1d8 for every two slot levels above 2nd.
**Replaces:** __Vampiric Touch__

You send tendrils of necrotic energy out, sucking the life essence from your foes. Select up to three creatures within range that aren't constructs or undead. Make a ranged spell attack against each target, dealing **3d6** necrotic damage on a hit. You regain hit points equal to half the damage dealt.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by **1d6** for every two slot levels above 5th.

You touch a willing creature, causing symbols of warding and safety to flow from you to cover the creature in a web  of protective magic before fading from sight. For the duration, the target is immune to necrotic damage and cannot have its hit point maximum reduced. In addition, the target is immune to effects that would kill it instantaneously without dealing damage.

You touch a willing creature. If it takes damage or you spend your action to activate the spell while the target is within 20 ft of you it teleports to an unoccupied space within your reach. If no such place exists, it teleports to the nearest unoccupied space. After it teleports back, the spell ends.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell at higher levels increase the range the target can be teleported back from by 20 ft for each additional level.

You invoke the powers of Celestia, emanating silvery radiance for the duration. This radiance provides bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. As an action on your turn, you may fire bolts of radiance at a creature you can see within 120 feet. To do this, make a ranged spell attack, dealing **1d10** radiant damage on a hit and an additional **1d10** radiant damage if the target is a Fiend.

Once you have fired a bolt of radiance, the light you emanate is reduced to a 15-foot radius of bright light and dim light for an additional 15 feet. Once you have fired a second bolt of radiance, the spell ends.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage and bonus damage against Fiends each increase by 1d10 for each slot level above 1st.
You grant yourself a momentary burst of nimbleness. When you cast this spell, your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks for the rest of the turn.

As part of a ranged weapon attack, you can transmute a piece of ammunition, or the thrown weapon, into a bolt of lightning. On hit, the target takes the normal damage of the attack, plus a bonus **4d8** lighting damage. On a miss, the target takes half as much lightning damage, and none of the normal damage.

Regardless if this attack hits or misses, all creatures within 10 feet of the target must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, creatures take **2d8** lighting damage, and half as much lighting damage on a success. The piece of ammunition or thrown weapon then returns to its normal form.
Any creature that takes lighting damage from this spell cannot take reactions until the beginning of your next turn.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th-level or higher, the damage for both effects of the spell increases by **1d8** for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Lightning Beam
components: V, S, M (a piece of quartz and a bit of fine dust)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Lightning Bolt__
A brilliant, blue-white beam of lightning flashes forth from your fingertips, forming a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide in a direction you choose.

You can cause the beam to bounce once off of a solid, non-conductive object that you can see (such as a stone wall) in a new direction you choose equal to the beam's remaining length. Each creature in the beam's path must make a Dexterity saving throw. A target creature takes **4d12** lightning damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success.
The lightning ignites flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.
The lightning ignites flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by **1d12** for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Lightning Blade
components: V, S, M (a small copper rod)

description.value: You evoke a lightning blade in your free hand. The blade is similar in size and shape to a shortsword, and it lasts for the duration If you let go of the blade, it disappears, but you can evoke it again as a Bonus Action.
As a Magic Action, you can make a melee spell attack with the lightning blade. On a hit, the target takes Lightning damage equal to **2d6** plus your spellcasting ability modifier.
On a hit the target gets disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws until the start of their next turn.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The Lightning damage increases by **1d6** for each level above 2nd.

A field of static lightning is created originating from a point you choose within range. A creature that starts its turn within the 20-foot-radius sphere centred there, must succeed a Constitution saving throw or take **4d8** Lightning damage and move up to half their speed in a random direction or only take half as much damage on a success.
As a Bonus Action on your turn, you can move the Lightning field up to 20 feet in any direction, within the spell's range.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The Lightning damage increases by **1d8** for each level above 5th.
**Replaces:** __Lightning Lure__

You create a whip of crackling electricity and crack it outwards at a creature you choose that you can see within 30 feet. Make a melee spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d6 lightning damage and is ensnared by the lightning leash. If the target moves outside of the spell's range before the start of your next turn, you can use your reaction to yank on the leash. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or take **1d6** lightning damage and have its speed halved until the start of your next turn. Once it is outside of the spell's range, the leash dissipates.
Both damage rolls increase by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).

You create a lash of arcane lightning and strikes at a creature of your choice you can see within 15 feet. It must succeed on a Strength saving throw or take **1d8** lightning damage and be pulled in a line to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The range of this spell increases at 5th level (20 feet), 11th level (25 feet), and 17th level (30 feet).

You transform yourself into a bolt of lightning and teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Each creature within 5 feet of the line created between your starting point and final destination must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take **4d6** Lightning damage or half as much on a success.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The Lightning damage increases by **1d6** for each level above 4th.

name: Lightning Ring
components: V, S, M (a small glass ring and a bit of animal fur)

description.value: A crackling ring of electricity circles around you, granting you resistance to lightning damage. When you cast this spell, and at the start of each of your turns for the duration, the ring pulses. When the ring pulses, each creature other than you in a 5-foot radius sphere centered on you must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes **12d6** lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

In addition, as an action on your turn you can fire a bolt of lightning from the ring. These bolts originate from you and form a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes **8d6** lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Lightning Surge
components: V, S, M (two bits of copper wire)

description.value: A dazzling array of lightning bolts erupts from you. Each creature within a 5-foot Emanation must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take **1d6** Lightning damage.

description.name: Cantrip Upgrade
description.value: The damage increases by 1d6 when you reach levels 5 (2d6), 11 (3d6), and 17 (4d6).

name: Lightning Tendril
components: V, S, M (a twig from a tree that has been struck by lightning)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Witch Bolt__

Crackling beams of blue energy leap from your hands. For the duration of the spell, as an action, you can direct them toward a creature within range, dealing **1d12** lightning damage to that creature.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a 2nd- or 3rd-level spell slot, the damage increases to 2d12 and the range increases to 30 feet. When you cast it using a 4th- or 5th-level spell slot, the damage increases to 3d12 and the range increases to 60 feet. When you cast it using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases to 4d12 and the range increases to 120 feet.

You strike a foe with the fury of a lion. As part of casting this spell, you may move up to 20 feet, then make a melee attack against one creature within 5 feet of you. On a hit, the target suffers the weapon attack's normal effects and an additional **2d10** radiant damage. In addition, the creature must make a Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
You have advantage on this attack if you have moved at least 20 feet already in the turn when you cast it.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 2nd.

You let loose a tremendous roar, loud as a mountain falling. Each hostile creature in a 60-foot radius sphere centered on you must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes **10d8** thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails its save by 5 or more is also stunned until the end of its next turn.

In addition, each allied creature in the spell's area that can hear you is no longer frightened or charmed and has advantage on the next attack roll or saving throw they make before the end of your next turn.

name: Lionheart
components: V, S, M (a hair from a lion's mane)

description.value: You touch a willing creature, removing the frightened condition from it. For the duration, the target is immune to being frightened.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you may target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

name: Listening Coin
components: V, S, M (a pair of coins, each worth at least 1 cp)

description.value: You rub the two coins used for casting this spell together, turning them into magical hearing devices: one a sensor and the other a receiver. For the duration, anyone who holds the receiver up to their ear can hear anything audible from the sensor's location as if they were present in that location.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a higher level spell slot, the duration increases: 1 week with a 5th level slot, 1 month with a 7th level spell slot, until dispelled with a 9th level spell slot.

Conjuring forth a marching tune, you exhort your allies to struggle on. Choose up to three creatures you can see in range to be affected by this spell. An affected target's speed increases by 15 feet until the spell ends. If a creature takes any action other than the dash action, this spell ends on that target at the end of their turn.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target two additional creatures for each slot level above 2nd.

You touch a willing humanoid, imbuing it with the power of undeath. For the duration, the target's creature type becomes undead, and the target is immune to poison damage and the poisoned condition. If the target is already under the effects of a poison when this spell is cast, they can ignore its effects while the spell lasts. You can use an action to end this spell early.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using certain higher-level spell slots, the duration increases: one week with a 5th-level slot, one month with a 7th-level slot, and until dispelled with a 9th-level slot.

name: Locate Creature (Alternate)
components: V, S, M (a magnet dipped in holy water)

description.value: Describe or name a specific kind of beast or plant. It can be a specific creature known to you, or the nearest creature of a specific kind (such as a bear, oak, or horse), so long as you have seen such a creature within 30 feet at least once.

If one is within 1 mile, the material component of this spell points to it as if it were a compass. If the target is in motion, it points to it for as long as it remains in range. If the creature is in a different form, such as under the effect of the polymorph spell, this spell doesn't locate the creature.
This spell can't locate its target if any thickness of lead or 10 feet of running water blocks a straight line to the target.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd-level or higher, the range and the type of creature you can locate increase as show in the table below:

name: Lock/Unlock
components: V, S, M (a piton, which the spell consumes)

description.value: You touch one closed door, window, gate, chest, or another entryway, and either lock or unlock it, using the rules below:

description.name: Lock
description.value: You and the creatures you designate when you cast this spell can open the object normally. You can also choose a password that, when spoken aloud within 5 feet of the object, suppresses the spell for 1 minute. This lock can be bypassed by a successful Strength check or thieves' tools check against your Spell save DC, at which point the spell is dispelled.

description.name: Unlock
description.value: If the object is held shut by a mundane lock or it is stuck or barred, it is instantly unlocked, unstuck, or unbarred. If the object has multiple locks, only one of them is unlocked. Regardless, when you cast the spell, a loud knock, audible out to 300 feet, emanates from the target object.

You create a dirge of despair, unleashing it in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a Wisdom saving throw. A creature takes **6d6** psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature charmed by you has disadvantage on its saving throw.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.
With divine words, glowing silver runes encircle your allies' heads. For the duration, you and up to two willing creatures of your choice are immune to being charmed, frightened or possessed.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you may target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Lucent Lance
components: V, S, M (a clear glass or crystal rod)

description.value: Ambient light coalesces around the rod in your hand, then erupts in a coruscating beam of radiance shaped like a needle-sharp lance. A creature within range that you can see must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target is blinded until the end of its next turn and takes damage based on the light available in your space when casting this spell. This damage is 12d8 in bright light, or 12d6 in dim light. On a successful save, the target takes half damage and is not blinded. The spell fails automatically if your space is in darkness.

Your eyes glow with an unearthly radiance. Until the  spell ends, you shed bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. In addition, creatures that rely on vision have disadvantage on attack rolls against you.
**Replaces:** __Branding Smite__

The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack before this spell ends, the weapon flashes with otherworldly light, dealing **2d8** additional radiant damage. Until the spell ends, the target can't be invisible, isn't obscured by a __darkness__ spell, and sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the extra damage increases by **1d8** for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Lunar Beam
components: V, S, M (a small pearl or quartz disc)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Moonbeam__
You call down a beam of shimmering moonlight at a point within range. The beam takes the shape of a 5-foot radius, 40-foot high cylinder of dim light.

When a creature starts its turn in the beam or moves into the beam during its turn, it is seared by the pale light. It must make a Constitution saving throw, taking **2d10** radiant damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. A shapechanger or other creature susceptible to silver has disadvantage on this saving throw, takes an additional **1d10** damage on a failure, and cannot change its form while within the beam.
As an action on each of your subsequent turns, you can move the beam up to 60 feet in any direction within the spell's range.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by **1d10** for each slot level above 2nd.

With an incomprehensible word and a touch of a hand wrapped in black magic, you reduce your foe to a screaming lunatic. For the duration, the target has disadvantage on saving throws. In addition, at the start of each of its turns for the next minute, the target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is incapacitated until the start of its next turn and uses all of its speed moving in a direction of your choice.

Your muttered words burrow unto your foes' minds like hungry maggots, spawning dark and disturbing thoughts. Each creature of your choice within a 30-foot-radius of you must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature is subjected to one of the following effects for the next minute:

• **Hysteria:** The creature falls into fits of uncontrollable laughter or crying. It is incapacitated and takes **4d6** psychic damage at the start of each of its turns.
• **Panic:** The creature becomes frightened of all other creatures.
• **Violent Hallucinations:** The creature uses its action each turn to make a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach. If there is no creature within its reach, the creature uses its movement to move as close as it can to the nearest creature it is aware of first.
• **Stupor:** The creature falls prone as it curls up on the floor, oblivious to what is going on around it. While the spell lasts, it is paralyzed.
You may choose a different effect for each target. An affected creature may make a Wisdom save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

name: Mage Armor, Greater
components: V, S, M (a piece of cured leather)

description.value: You surround yourself with a protective magical force until the spell ends. Your AC becomes 15+ your Dexterity modifier. The spell ends if you don armor or if you dismiss the spell as an action.

name: Mage Armor, Mass
components: V, S, M (a piece of cured leather)

description.value: You choose up to three willing creatures you can see in range who aren't wearing armor, and a protective magical force surrounds each one until the spell ends. Each of those target's base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends on a target if the target dons armor or if you dismiss the spell as an action.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you may target one additional creature for each slot level above 3rd.

A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you can see within range. The hand lasts for the duration or until you dismiss it as an action. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.

When you cast this spell and as an action you can control the hand. If you do, you can move it up to 30 ft and have it perform one object interaction. The hand can hold one object that is 10 pounds or less, cannot exert more than 10 pounds of force, cannot deal damage and has no sense of touch.

With a flourish, you conjure two daggers composed of magical force and flick them at targets within range. You can throw the daggers at one target or multiple within range. Make a separate ranged spell attack roll for each dagger, dealing **1d6** Force damage on a hit. The daggers vanish after the attack.

description.name: Cantrip Upgrade
description.value: This spell creates an additional dagger and you make an additional attack when you reach level 5 (3 attacks), 11 (4 attacks), and 17 (5 attacks).

name: Magic Fruit
components: V, S, M (up to 10 pieces of freshly picked fruit)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Goodberry__

You infuse the components used in the spell's casting with magic. The fruit gains minor healing properties for the duration. A creature can use its action to eat one fruit and restore 1 hit point. If a creature eats 10 infused fruits, the magic combines to provide enough nourishment to sustain a creature for one day.

name: Magic Jar
components: V, S, M (a gem, crystal, or reliquary worth 500+ GP)

description.value: Your body falls into a catatonic state as your soul leaves it and enters the container you used for the spell's material component. Any soul that inhabits the container is aware of their surroundings as if they were in the container's space. They cannot move or take actions, reactions, bonus actions or similar acts. You in particular can use your action to attempt to possess the body of a humanoid you can see within 100 ft.

If you attempt to possess a creature, it makes a charisma saving throw. On a failure, your soul moves into the target's body, and the target's soul becomes trapped in the container. They target automatically fails the saving throw if it has no soul. On a success, the target resists your efforts to possess it, and you can't attempt to possess it again for 24 hours. Creatures warded by a protection from evil and good or magic circle spell can't be possessed.

The spell ends on any creature that possesses its own body. A creatures can control the body it is possessing. Its Hit Points, Hit Point Dice, Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Speed, and senses are replaced by the body's. It otherwise keeps its game statistics.
While possessing a body, you can take a Magic action to return to the container if it is within 100 feet of you. If there is already a soul in the container, it moves to the body you left.
If the following happens to a body or container, the soul it contains moves to a different body or to the container (whichever is closest):

• the container or body is destroyed
• the body drops to zero hit points, dies or ceases to be humanoid
• the spell ends on a body or the container
The target it moves to must not have a soul and must be within a mile. If a soul remains in a dead body it dies with it.
When the spell ends, the container is destroyed.

name: Magic Miasma
components: V, S, M (a small piece of quilted cloth)

description.value: A thick, sparkling cloud of billowing mist rolls into being, filling a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point of your choice within range. The sphere spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. The fog is so thick that any creature that starts its turn in the fog or enters the fog for the first time on a turn has its speed reduced by 30 feet, to a minimum of 5 feet. If a falling creature passes through the area, it reduces falling damage it would take by 1d6 for every 10 feet it falls through the cloud.

Magic Miasma greatly dampens the effectiveness of magic spells. A creature standing in the fog has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects and spell attack rolls made by a creature within the fog or targeting a creature within the fog have disadvantage. In addition, spells cannot be cast using a spell slot of 6th level or higher within the fog.
A wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour) temporarily disperses the fog, which reforms 1 round later.

name: Magic Net
components: S, M (a length of wire, string, cord, or rope worth at least 5 sp, which the spell consumes)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Snare__

You construct a magical 5-foot radius, 10-foot high cylinder snare trap at a point on the ground within range. The trap is barely visible but can be detected with a successful Intelligence check against your spell save DC. If a creature detects the trap, it is immune to the spell. When a creature moves into the cylinder, it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or become restrained and be magically lifted 10 feet up into the air, where it hangs upside down. Huge or larger creatures automatically succeed. As an action, a creature can attempt to free itself by making a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against your spell save DC, ending the spell on a success.

You touch one to three pebbles and imbue them with magic. You or someone else can make a ranged spell attack with one of the pebbles by throwing it or hurling it with a sling, slingshot or warsling. If thrown, it has a range of 60 feet. If someone else attacks with the pebble, that attacker adds your spellcasting ability modifier, not the attacker's, to the attack roll. On a hit, the target takes bludgeoning damage equal to 1d6 + your spellcasting ability modifier. Hit or miss, the spell then ends on the stone. If you cast this spell again, the spell ends early on any pebbles still affected by it.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The attack's damage die changes when you reach levels 5 (d8), 11(d10), and 17 (d12).
You touch a nonmagical weapon and imbue it with arcane power. For the duration, it becomes a magical weapon with a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd-level or higher, the bonus is +2. When you use a spell slot of 6th-level or higher, the bonus increases to +3.

name: Make Manifest
components: V, S, M (hair, blood, or another similar token from the target, which the spell consumes)

description.value: You attempt to draw a creature from another plane of existence to your own. You must be familiar with the target, who is immediately aware of you when you are casting the spell. The target may make a Charisma saving throw if it is unwilling. On a successful save, the target is unaffected. On a failed save, or if the target chooses not to resist the spell, the target appears in an unoccupied space you can see within range. This space must be on a solid surface. Deities and other planar entities can prevent this spell from affecting them or any creature in their domain.
When the spell ends, the target returns to its original location.

name: Malevolent Miasma
components: V, S, M (three polished gray stones)

description.value: A brief burst of gray fog tinged with dark, malevolent streaks explodes in a 15-foot radius sphere centered on a point you can see within range. Each creature within the area must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes **4d8** poison damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but unconscious for 1 hour or until it regains hit points.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 2d8 for each slot level above 2nd.
You create a glowing dart of necrotic energy which strikes a target you can see within range, dealing **1d4** Necrotic damage.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The damage increases by 1d4 when you reach warlock levels 5 (2d4), 11 (3d4), and 17 (4d4).

You shape-shift a vegetable into a Large magical carriage, complete with reins and two quasi-real horses. The carriage is luxurious and carries up to six passengers—four within and two atop it at the coach's seat. Creatures within the carriage have Total Cover from external effects, but can see outside through a pair of windows composed of magical force. While sitting in the coach's seat, a creature can control the carriage, which has a Speed of 100 feet and can travel 10 miles in an hour, or 13 miles at a fast pace.
The carriage and horses count as a single object with 12 AC and 100 Hit Points. The spell ends early if the carriage and horses are reduced to 0 Hit Points.

description.name: Duration
description.value: This spell's duration varies depending upon when and where it was cast. If cast in a location where time passes normally, the spell lasts until the twelfth stroke of the next midnight, however long that may be. Elsewhere, the spell lasts for 24 hours. When the spell ends, the carriage's occupants are ejected into adjacent unoccupied spaces, the carriage shrinks back into a vegetable, and the quasi-real horses vanish.

name: Mandy's Feral Follower
components: V, S, M (a small servant's bell)

description.value: You touch a Small or smaller Beast. The Beast then transforms into a Humanoid with the statistics of a Commoner and an appearance of your choosing. The commoner is friendly to you and your Allies, has a basic understanding of all simple unskilled tasks, and can understand the languages you speak, but doesn't speak. The commoner wears Fine Clothes, but has no other equipment.

description.name: Combat
description.value: The commoner is an Ally to you and your Allies. It rolls its own Initiative and acts on its own turn. It behaves as though it is dutifully employed by you.

description.name: Duration
description.value: This spell's duration varies depending upon when and where it was cast. If cast in a location where time passes normally, the spell lasts until the twelfth stroke of the next midnight, however long that may be. Elsewhere, the spell lasts for 24 hours.

description.name: Ending the Transformation
description.value: The transformation lasts for the duration, or until the commoner drops to 0 Hit Points or dies. When it reverts to its true form, the Beast returns to the number of Hit Points it had before it transformed and its clothes dissipate into smoke. If it reverts as a result of dropping to 0 Hit Points, any excess damage carries over to its true form. As long as the excess damage doesn't reduce the Beast's normal form to 0 Hit Points, it isn't knocked Unconscious.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: You can transform one additional Beast for each spell slot above 4.

name: Mandy's Marvelous Dress
components: V, S, M (a glass slipper worth 100+ GP)

description.value: A willing creature you touch is instantly clothed in a fabulous ball gown, perfectly tailored and complete with a set of glittering jewelry. You can choose for the dress to sit atop the creature's clothing or armor, or for it to magically replace its outfit. The creature can't remove the dress until the spell ends; similarly, the jewelry vanishes if it is removed.

description.name: Elegant Flair
description.value: Until the spell ends, when the wearer makes a D20 Test using Charisma, it can replace the number it rolls with a 10.

description.name: Glamorous Ward
description.value: If the wearer of the dress is attacked by a creature that can see it, the attacker must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or miss with the attack. On a success, the attacker is immune to this effect until the spell ends.

description.name: Duration
description.value: This spell's duration varies depending upon when and where it was cast. If cast in a location where time passes normally, the spell lasts until the twelfth stroke of the next midnight, however long that may be. Elsewhere, the spell lasts for 24 hours. When the spell ends, the dress vanishes in a puff of sparkles, and the creature becomes clothed in its original outfit.

name: Manifest Ghost
components: V, S, M (a crystal ball worth at least 300gp)

description.value: You temporarily break the barrier between life and death to call forth a ghost in an unoccupied space in range. This ghost uses the __Manifested Ghost__ statblock. When you cast this spell, choose a ghost type: Chilling, Energised, Hateful, Poltergeist, or Possession. The ghost resembles the type you have chosen, which determines which determines certain details in its statblock. The ghost disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or the spell ends.

The ghost is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, the ghost shares your initiative count, but it takes its turns directly after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, it takes the Dodge action and uses its movement to avoid danger.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher use that spell level in the statblock
**Replaces:** __Mold Earth__
You mold earth you can see within range, causing it to twist and buckle to your command. Select one of the following effects:

• You can excavate a 5-foot cube of loose dirt or soil and move it along the ground to another unoccupied space within 5 feet.
• You can make minor alterations to dirt or stone, such as changing its color or carving small, simple shapes.
• You can turn a 5-foot square of earth or stone into difficult terrain for 1 hour. You can create up to three patches of difficult terrain this way; if you create additional patches, the first one you created returns to normal terrain.
**Replaces:** __Control Flames__
You control fire you can see within range, causing it to bend to your command. Select one of the following effects:

• You can grant a creature of your choice within range resistance to fire damage until the start of your next turn.
• You can spark or spread fire in a 5-foot cube, as long as there is fuel that can be ignited within the area.
• You can douse fire within a 5-foot cube.
• You can adjust a flame's brightness (halving or doubling it), color (turning the flames to any color of your choice), or shape (forming simple shapes) within a 5-foot cube for 10 minutes.
**Replaces:** __Shape Water__
You shape water you can see within range, causing it to move at your command. Select one of the following effects:

• You can move or direct the flow of a 5-foot cube of water in a direction of your choice, but the water will revert back to its natural flow at the start of your next turn unless you concentrate on keeping it in place.
• You can mold the water into small shapes or simple animations. This change lasts for 1 minute.
• You can change the color or opacity of a 5-foot cube of water. This change lasts for 1 hour.
• You can freeze up to a 5-foot cube of unoccupied water or thaw up to a 5-foot cube of ice. The water unfreezes or refreezes naturally based on the environmental conditions (usually taking an hour or more to completely melt or freeze unless in extreme conditions).
**Replaces:** __Gust__
You create a small gust within range, causing the air to surge and swirl to your command. Select one of the following effects:

• The next ranged weapon attack against a creature of your choice within range has disadvantage.
• One Large or smaller creature of your choice within range must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 5 feet or knocked prone (your choice).
• You can increase the next jump made by a creature of your choice within range by 5 feet.
• You manipulate the wind in a minor way, such as pushing a light object up to 10 feet, rustling plants, slamming a door, or similar effects. These aren't powerful enough to move creatures or deal damage.

name: Mantle of the Icy Soul
components: V, S, M (500 gp worth of powdered sapphire, which the spell consumes)

description.value: You permanently imbue a willing creature with icy resilience. The creature's skin takes on a subtle blue tint, and its breath does not frost in cold temperatures. The creature is immune to cold damage and vulnerable to fire damage.

name: Manyjaws
components: V, S, M (a pair of shark teeth)

description.value: You clamp your teeth together as a trio of spectral disembodied jaws appear at a point you can see in range and begin to float towards your foes, gnashing their teeth. When you cast this spell, and as an action on your turn while the spell lasts, you may command each of these jaws to fly up to 30 feet and make a melee a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of it. You may direct each set of jaws to attack the same target or different targets. On a hit, a target takes **2d6** force damage.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you summon one additional set of jaws for each slot level above 3rd.

You invoke the ancient words of anathema and touch a creature, which must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, your touch leaves an indelible mark on the subject's face. A marked creature has disadvantage on all Charisma ability checks while the spell lasts.
If you concentrate on the spell for the full duration, the mark remains even after the spell ends, though it no longer has any additional effect.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you may target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.
You hold an object in your hands, reciting ancient words of power to grant yourself knowledge about that item.
When you cast this spell, choose one of the following options:

• **Track Object.** For the duration, you sense the direction of the object, regardless of distance. If you are within 100 feet of the object, you know its precise location. This spell ceases to function if the object is on another plane of existence or if any thickness of lead, even a thin sheet, blocks a direct path between you and the object.
•  **Discern Owner.** For the duration, you can call to mind an image of the object's owner in clear detail. If the object is a magic item that requires attunement, the owner is always considered to be the creature currently attuned to the item. If the object is non-magical or does not require attunement, the owner is determined by the DM.

name: Martial Transformation
components: V, S, M (a small statuette of a warrior)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Tenser's Transformation__
You empower yourself with the physical prowess and battle knowledge of famous warriors. Until the spell ends, you can't cast spells or concentrate on them, and you gain the following benefits:

• You gain 50 temporary hit points for the duration.
• You have advantage on attack rolls that you make with simple and martial weapons.
• You have advantage on all weapon attacks, and when you hit a target with a weapon attack, it takes an extra **2d12** force damage.
• You have proficiency in all armor, shields, simple weapons, martial weapons, and with Strength and Constitution saving throws.
• You can attack twice, instead of once, when you take the Attack action on your turn, unless you already have a feature (such as Extra Attack) which gives you extra attacks.
• You can conjure and equip (as part of the action used to cast the spell) any armor and any simple or martial weapon of your choice. These items have no strength requirements and are magical in nature, but otherwise have the same properties as their nonmagical counterparts. The equipment vanishes when the spell ends.
Immediately after the spell ends, you must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or suffer one level of exhaustion. You can end the spell as a bonus action.

A wave of healing energy washes out from a point you can see within range. Choose up to six creatures in a 30-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point. Each target regains Hit Points equal to 5d4. Once within the next minute before they hit or miss with a weapon attack they can choose to deal extra damage. On a hit, they deal extra damage of the weapon's damage type equal to the amount they were healed plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The healing increases by **1d4** for each spell slot level above 5.

A wave of healing energy washes out from a point you can see within range. Choose up to six creatures in a 30-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point. Each target regains Hit Points equal to 5d4. Once within the next minute when they take damage they can reduce the damage by an amount equal to the amount they were healed plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The healing increases by **1d4** for each spell slot level above 5.

A wave of healing energy washes out from a point you can see within range. Choose up to six creatures in a 30-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point. Each target regains Hit Points equal to 5d4. Once within the next minute they can increase their movement speed by an amount equal to the amount they were healed plus your spellcasting ability modifier until the start of their next turn.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The healing increases by **1d4** for each spell slot level above 5.
**Replaces:** __Otiluke's Freezing Sphere__ (in part)

You choose a point within range and cause all the warmth to vanish from its vicinity. Each creature in a 20-foot radius sphere centered on that point must make a Constitution saving throw. A target takes **4d8** cold damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success.

If a creature fails the saving throw, it is frozen in place, locked down by sheets of ice. It takes **1d8** cold damage at the start of each of its turns, and is restrained. It may reattempt the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

You attempt to transform up to 10 creatures that you can see within range into Beasts. Each target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or shape-shift into Beast form for the duration. At the start of each of their turns the target can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on them on a success.

When you prepare this spell, choose 5 stat blocks with the beast creature type that have a CR equal to or less than 18 plus your spellcasting modifier. Choose one of these stat blocks to transform each target into, and you can choose the same form or different ones for each target. The target's game statistics are replaced by the stat block of the Beast, but the target retains its alignment, personality, creature type, saving throw modifiers, Hit Points, and Hit Point Dice. You can prepare this spell multiple times, but you must pick different stat blocks each time.

Each target gains a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to the Hit Points of the Beast form. The spell stops affecting the target if it has no Temporary Hit Points left. It looses these temporary hit points if the spell ends.
The target is limited in the actions it can perform by the anatomy of its new form, and it can't speak or cast spells.
The target's gear melds into the new form. The creature can't use or otherwise benefit from any of that equipment.

name: Master Air
components: V, S, M (a wing feather from a bird)

description.value: Currents of air circle around you, willing to aid you should the need arise. For the duration, whenever you fall, your rate of descent slows to 60 feet per round and you always land on your feet, taking no falling damage. As a bonus action, you can grant yourself a flying speed equal to your walking speed until the end of your next turn.

name: Master Earth
components: V, S, M (a fossil of any animal)

description.value: The ground beneath your feet suddenly seems insubstantial as you sink beneath the surface, moving through dirt and stone as easily as if you were flying through the air. When you cast this spell, you, along with everything you are wearing or carrying, are instantly transported to a destination of your choice on the same plane of existence as you travel straight through the earth itself, appearing in the nearest unoccupied space in contact with earth or stone. You may travel to any place you are familiar with, though if you do not have an exact location you are transported to the periphery of the general area you choose.
This spell only functions on the Material Plane or the Elemental plane of earth.
As you cast this spell, you touch a single weapon or  shield to grant yourself an intuitive understanding of how to wield it. For the duration, you have proficiency with that weapon or shield.

name: Maw of Chaos
components: V, S, M (a jawbone with teeth)

description.value: You create a yawning area of roiling purple-red energy, filling a 20-foot radius sphere centered on a point you can see within range. When a creature other than you enters the affected area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, the creature must make a Charisma saving throw. A creature that fails its save takes **10d6** psychic damage and **10d6** force damage and is incapacitated until it ends a turn outside of the affected area. On a successful save a creature takes half as much damage and is not incapacitated.

You touch a single natural stone opening or point in a passageway no larger than 15 feet wide or 15 feet tall, causing the rock to come alive. For the duration, the maw attempts to attack any creatures that try to pass through it. Make a melee spell attack whenever the maw attacks a creature, dealing **10d8** bludgeoning damage on a hit.

The maw can only make one attack each round and will continue to attack creatures attempting to pass through it for the duration of the spell, even if you are no longer nearby. You can command the passageway not to attack certain creatures or groups of creatures. While not attacking, the maw is indistinguishable from the surrounding passageway.
You force a creature to succeed on an intelligence saving throw or be banish into an everchanging labyrinthine demiplane.

The target can take a Study action to try to escape. When it does so, it makes a DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) check. If it succeeds three times in a row, it escapes, and the spell ends. For every 30 ft it moves while in the maze it can use its action in this way without expending an action.
When the spell ends, the target reappears in the space it left or, if that space is occupied, in the nearest unoccupied space.

You touch a willing creature, causing their mind to feel clearer and more organized. For the duration, the target is proficient in Intelligence and Wisdom saving throws and has a +5 bonus to Intelligence checks. However, the target becomes emotionally detached, and makes all Charisma checks with disadvantage.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you may target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Memorize
components: V, S, M (a page of written text and a length of silver string worth 10+ GP, tied in a knot, which the spell consumes)

description.value: While casting this spell, your eyes pass over the words on a page, which are committed to your memory. For the next year, you remember the exact details of all information on the page. After that time, you have advantage on all Intelligence checks you make to recall this information.

You exhale a cloud of glowing yellow spores, which float around you in a 15-foot-radius for the duration. On the turn when you cast Memory Rot, and as an action while the spell lasts, you may cause these spores to infest the brain of any number of creatures in the area. Each affected creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the spores begin to infest that creature's brain, causing it to have disadvantage on all Intelligence-based skill checks and saving throws. In addition, the creature automatically fails saving throws against divination spell cast against them. On a successful save, nothing happens, and the creature is immune to Memory Rot for 1 minute.

Once the spores have begun to grow in a creature's brain, they last indefinitely. Any spell or magical effect that removes a disease kills the spores and ends the effect for that creature. A creature that is immune to disease is unaffected by Memory Rot.

This spell repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch, such as a broken chain link, two halves of a broken key, a torn cloak, or a leaking wineskin. As long as the break or tear is no larger than 1 foot in any dimension, you mend it, leaving no trace of the former damage.
This spell can physically repair a magic item, but it can't restore magic to such an object.

Your eyes glow with a warm, friendly fire, enrapturing those around you. Each creature in a 30-foot cone that can see you must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature becomes charmed for the duration.

While charmed by this spell, the creature must make a Wisdom saving at the start of each of its turns. On a successful save, it can act normally that turn. On a failed save, it spends the entire turn staring blankly at you.
The spell ends for an affected creature if it takes any damage or it can no longer see you.
You point toward a creature within range and whisper a message. The target (and only the target) hears the message and can reply in a whisper that only you can hear.

You can cast this spell through solid objects if you are familiar with the target and know it is beyond the barrier. Magical silence; 1 foot of stone, metal, or wood; or a thin sheet of lead blocks the spell.

You touch a willing target and expend one of its hit dice. Roll it. They regain a number of Hit Points equal to the roll plus your spellcasting modifier. You can this once and regain all uses on a short rest.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: You gain an additional use when you reach levels 5 (2 uses), 11 (3 uses), and 17 (4 uses).

name: Metal Melt
components: V, S, M (a drop of mercury in a vial)

description.value: You alter the physical properties of a non-magic metal object of Medium size or smaller so that it runs like water. The melted metal does not change temperature but flows as a liquid before returning to its normal solid state at the beginning of your next turn, usually in a form resembling a puddle. If the target is being worn or carried by another creature, that creature may make a Dexterity saving throw. On a success, the target is unaffected.

You hiss out a red mist that streaks toward your target, clawing into their mouth and nose. A creature you can see within range must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target's mouth and throat are filled with an unbreathable gas. For the duration, the target is poisoned, can't breathe or speak, and begins suffocating at the start of its next turn.

A creature that is choking can survive for a number of rounds equal to its Constitution modifier (minimum of 1 round). At the start of its next turn, it drops to 0 hit points and is dying, and it can't regain hit points or be stabilized until it can breathe again.
A creature that does not need to breathe that fails its save is still unable to speak but otherwise unaffected.

You intone the words of this spell, sending forth a wave of entropy in a 30-foot cone originating from you. Within the area all wood, leather and other natural materials decay at an accelerated rate. All such nonmagical objects in the area of Medium size or smaller that are not being worn or carried rot into a slimy, pulpy mass and are destroyed.

name: Might of the Abyss
components: V, S, M (a small, black strip of ribbon)

description.value: You channel power from the Lower Planes, enhancing three creatures other than yourself within range. Whenever it deals damage with a weapon, it deals an extra **1d4** Necrotic damage.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Mind Link
components: V, S, M (a piece of sea coral and a spiderweb)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Telepathy__

You form a mental connection with another creature. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw modified by its location and your familiarity. The target is aware of the contact and can choose to fail its saving throw.

On a failure, you and the target can communicate via the link, and the target recognizes you as a creature it is communicating with. Additionally, you can cast any divination or illusion spell of 4th level or lower that targets a creature on the creature you have linked to, regardless of the spell's range requirement, such as __detect thoughts__ or __major image__, but the spell only affects that creature. Finally, you can use your action to use its senses instead of your own until the start of your next turn.
If you cast a spell in this manner, the target may repeat its saving throw against this spell at the end of each of its turns.

You infect a creature with a poison that erodes mental capabilities. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be affected for the duration. While affected, the target has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls and saving throws that use Wisdom or Intelligence.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the duration is 8 hours. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the duration is 24 hours. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 9th level or higher, the spell lasts until dispelled.

You assault the mind a creature within range with a torrent of psionic power. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On hit, the creature takes 1d10 psychic damage and it cannot take reactions until the start of your next turn.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: This spell's damage increases by 1d10 at 5th level (2d10), 11th level (3d10), and 17th level (4d10).

Choose a Humanoid you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be filled with rage for the duration. While filled with rage, the creature can only use its movement to attempt to move to a space within 5 feet of you, and can only use its action to make a melee attack against you or attempt to get closer to you if it cannot reach you.

At the end of each of its turns, the target may make a Wisdom saving throw, ending the effect on a success. The target has disadvantage on this save if it can see you. If the target ends its turn and was unable to move or attack since the end of its last turn (for example: if it does not know where you are or you are in the air or otherwise inaccessible to it), the spell ends.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you may target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

You magically create minor, cosmetic changes in your appearance. For example: you might add color to hair, paint wrinkles on your face, give yourself a scar, or darken your teeth. This spell does not change the actual structure of either your features or body. A creature that has seen you before can make an Intelligence saving throw to see through your disguise. This spell ends early if you cast it again or dismiss it as an action.
**Replaces:** __Ray of Sickness__ (with __Touch of Filth__)

You send a pulse of necrotic energy towards a target, sucking its life essence away. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes **3d6** necrotic damage, and you gain half the damage dealt as temporary hit points. These temporary hit points fade after 1 minute.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by **1d6** for each slot level above 1st.
You create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration. See the descriptions below for the effects of each. The illusion ends if you cast this spell again.

If a creature takes a Study action to examine the sound or image, the creature can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (*Investigation*) check against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the illusion becomes faint to the creature.

description.name: Sound
description.value: If you create a sound, its volume can range from a whisper to a scream. It can be your voice, someone else's voice, a lion's roar, a beating of drums, or any other sound you choose. The sound continues unabated throughout the duration, or you can make discrete sounds at different times before the spell ends.

description.name: Image
description.value: If you create an image of an object—such as a chair, muddy footprints, or a small chest—it must be no larger than a 5-foot Cube. The image can't create sound, light, smell, or any other sensory effect. Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, since things can pass through it.

You attempt to drain life energy from a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take **1d6** Necrotic damage. You gain Temporary Hit Points equal to the amount of Necrotic damage dealt.

description.name: Cantrip Upgrade
description.value: The damage increases by 1d6 when you reach levels 5 (2d6), 11 (3d6), and 17 (4d6).

name: Misdirection
