casting_time: Action or 1 reaction, which you take when you are hit by an attack

description.value: **Replaces:** __Mislead__

As an action, or as a reaction when you are hit by an attack, you become invisible, hidden and create an illusory double of yourself in your space. The double can move at your speed, can gesture or speak as you choose, and mimics any action you take (your attacks or spells appear to originate from the double). The double has the same AC as you.

Any time a creature would damage the double, or perceives the double making an attack or casting a spell, it makes an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC. If the check succeeds, it realizes the double is an illusion and you are no longer invisible to that creature.

As an action, you can use the double's senses instead of your own until you use your action to return to your normal senses, or until the spell ends. While you do so, you are blinded and deafened to your own surroundings.

You choose one creature and one object you can see within range. The creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become consumed by a powerful desire to possess the object. For the duration of the spell, the creature must spend each turn attempting to obtain the object, going so far as to attack anyone wearing or carrying it.
If the creature obtains the object, it protects it greedily, attacking any other creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the object or attempts to take the object.
If the creature has the object in its possession, it can make a Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on a success.

When you cast this spell, choose a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become cursed for the duration of the spell. While the target is cursed, it is compelled to give away all of its wealth, possessions, and positions of power to those who lack them, gifting at least ten percent of its wealth to each non-Beast creature it encounters.

If the target has broken its end of a bargain with you, or refused your polite request for food and shelter despite having done it no harm, you can cast this spell as an action and the effect is permanent, ending only when the curse is broken or the target has nothing but rags to its name.

name: Misfortune
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when a creature you can see within 60 feet succeeds with an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw

description.value: **Replaces:** __Silvery Barbs__ (in part)
You magically reshape causality for the triggering creature, negatively influencing its efforts. The triggering creature must reroll the d20 and use the lower roll.
Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 10 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell at higher spell levels, increase the distance you teleport by 10 ft for each additional level.
You choose a portion of dirt or stone that you can see within range and that fits within a 5-foot cube. You manipulate it in one of the following ways:

• If you target an area of loose earth, you can instantaneously excavate it, move it along the ground, and deposit it up to 5 feet away. This movement doesn't involve enough force to cause damage. Until the end of your next turn it is held aloft as long as it is not holding anything else aloft.
• You create a sculpture out of the stone or dirt that weighs 5 lbs or less and consist of simple shapes. The changes last for 1 hour.
• If the dirt or stone you target is on the ground, you cause it to become difficult terrain. Alternatively, you can cause the ground to become normal terrain if it is already difficult terrain. This change lasts for 1 hour.
If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have no more than two of its non-instantaneous effects active at a time, and you can dismiss such an effect as an action.
You can manipulate the earth and use it to assault your foes. When you cast this spell choose one of the following effects:

description.name: Manipulate Earth
description.value: You manipulate loose earth and stone in a 5-foot cube within range, harmlessly excavating, moving, and depositing it up to 5 feet away, changing it into difficult terrain, or changing difficult terrain into normal terrain.

description.name: Hurl Stone
description.value: You create a small ball of loose stone and dirt in your hand and hurl it at a target you can see within range, making a ranged spell attack against it. On hit, it takes your choice of either 1d6 bludgeoning or piercing damage, and if the target is Small or smaller it is knocked prone.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The damage of this Cantrip and the size of targets that it knocks prone increases by 1d6 at 5th (2d6, Medium), 11th (3d6, Large), and 17th level (4d6, Huge).

name: Moment of Clarity
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when another creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself fails a Wisdom saving throw or ability check

description.value: With a word of encouragement, you grant a creature you can see within range a burst of unexpected clarity. The creature must reroll the triggering ability check or saving throw and use the higher roll.

When you cast this spell, you briefly stop time for everyone but yourself. You can take one additional action and move around in your space while no time passes for other creatures. That action can be used only to take the Search, Study, or Utilize action. Furthermore, you can't affect or damage any creature or object, other than objects you are wearing or carrying. If an object leaves your hand, it also becomes frozen in time.

Translucent red chains fly from your outstretched hands to wrap around the target before fading away. Choose one creature you can see within range. That creature must make a Wisdom saving throw; a creature can choose to fail this saving throw if it wishes.

If the creature fails this save, it is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form for the duration of the spell. Additionally, if the creature is a Shapechanger, it reverts to its original form and can't assume a different form while the spell lasts.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target an additional creature for each slot level above 2nd. The creatures must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.

A blazing sword of moonlight springs forth from your hand. This magic sword lasts until the spell ends and counts as a simple melee weapon with which you are proficient. The sword uses your spellcasting ability modifier for the attack and damage rolls, dealing **3d8** psychic damage on a hit. The sword leaves no visible wounds to living creatures, but against Undead, the sword deals an additional **1d8** fire damage on a hit as their substance boils away.

A successful hit with the moon blade also temporarily disrupts magic. When a Shapechanger is hit by an attack from the moon blade, it must make a Constitution saving throw, reverting to its original form on a failure. In addition, a creature hit by an attack from the moon blade has disadvantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain *Concentration* on spells until the end of its next turn.
If you drop the weapon, it dissipates at the end of the turn. While the spell persists, you can use a bonus action to cause the sword to reappear in your hand.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a 4th or 5th-level spell slot, the psychic damage increases to 3d8. When you cast it using a 6th or 7th-level spell slot, the psychic damage increases to 4d8 and the fire damage increases to 2d8.

Picturing the full moon in your mind, you call upon the cyclical energies of the celestial body to create a bolt of shimmering moonlight, which streaks unerringly from your outstretched hand to strike a creature you can see in range. The target must make a Constitution saving throw, taking **6d10** radiant damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one. In addition, an Undead creature that fails its save is paralyzed for 1 minute. A paralyzed creature can make another Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a success, it is no longer paralyzed.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 4th.

name: Moon Lust
components: V, S, M (a silver ingot worth 5gp)

description.value: Presenting a silver ingot in your hands, you instill an obsessive fascination with the moon in a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed for the duration. A Shapechanger has disadvantage on this saving throw.

While charmed by this spell, the target is incapacitated and has a speed of 0. The spell ends for the target if it takes any damage or if someone else uses an action to shake the creature out of its stupor.
A creature that cannot see the moon is unaffected by this spell.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you may target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

You create a ribbon of glowing white translucent force to form either a bridge or set of stairs between two points you choose in range. When you initially create the bridge, you can choose to have the path be at least 5 feet and up to 20 feet wide, as well as whether or not the width varies across the path.

When you create the path, you may designate up to four creatures to receive extra protection as for as long as it is standing on the path. A protected creature has advantage on saving throws. In addition, any creature that targets a protected creature with an attack or a harmful spell must first make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must choose a new target or lose the attack or spell. This doesn't protect the warded creature from area effects. If a protected creature makes an attack or casts a spell that affects a hostile creature or deals damage, they are no longer protected by the path and lose all additional benefits for the remaining duration of the spell.
Nothing can physically pass through the pass. It is immune to damage, but can be dispelled by dispel magic and is instantly destroyed by a disintegrate spell.

name: Moonbow
components: V, S, M (a small piece of moonstone)

description.value: Motes of light flit among your fingers before coalescing into three glowing orbs in your space. They float in the air and orbit you for the spell's duration, providing dim light in a 20-foot radius so long as at least one orb remains. When you cast the spell, and as a bonus action on each of your turns while the spell lasts, you can fire one or more of these orbs at a creature or object you can see within 120 feet.
Make a ranged spell attack for each orb. On a hit, the target takes **4d8** radiant damage. If the target is Undead, you have advantage on this attack.
At the end of the duration, any orbs you didn't fire vanish.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the number of orbs created increases by two for each slot level above 5th.

A cone of fiery white moonlight springs from your hand. Each creature in a 30-foot cone must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes **20d6** radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Undead and Shapechangers make their save with disadvantage. In addition, a creature that is damaged by this spell immediately reverts to its normal form (this includes Shapechangers, polymorphed creatures or other magic or effects that grant a creature a different form).

name: Morph Earth
components: V, S, M (a handful of rice and water)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Transmute Rock__
You transform up to a 40-foot cube of earth with one of the following effects:

description.name: Create Mud
description.value: Rock and dirt in the area becomes mud for the spell's duration. Creatures sink into the ground, and each foot that a creature moves costs 4 feet of movement. If a creature is on the ground when you cast the spell, moves into the area for the first time, or ends its turn there, it must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, the creature is restrained. As an action, a restrained target or another creature within 5 feet can end the restrained condition.

description.name: Create Rock
description.value: An area of wet earth less than 10 feet deep becomes rock for the spell's duration. Any creature standing in the mixture when it hardens must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a success, a creature moves to an unoccupied space on the rock's surface. On a failure, a creature is restrained. As an action, a restrained target or another creature within 5 feet can end the restrained condition by succeeding on a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC. The rock has AC 15 and 25 hit points and is immune to poison and psychic damage.

Calling upon the primordial powers of elemental earth, you grant a willing creature the stubborn determination of mountains. The target can choose to root itself to the ground on its turn, no action required. While rooted, the creature has advantage on any ability check or saving throws made to resist being grappled, knocked down, or moved involuntarily. The target can only root itself to the ground once per turn and is no longer rooted if it voluntarily moves.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you may target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

name: Muddy Servant
components: V, S, M (a pinch of earth and a drop of water)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Maximilian's Earthen Grasp__

You take control of loose soil and rock and mold it into a small construct, creating a Medium mud golem which occupies a 5-foot space within range. The mud golem has AC 12 and 20 hit points. It can immediately grab at a Large or smaller creature within 5 feet, forcing the target to make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, the target becomes restrained and takes **2d6** bludgeoning damage.

As long as the mud golem is within 30 feet of you, you can mentally command it as an action. If it is restraining a target, you can command it to squeeze. The target makes a Strength saving throw, taking **2d6** bludgeoning damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. Alternatively, you can command the golem to dissolve and reform (with full hit points, even if it has been destroyed) anywhere within the spell's range and attempt to grab a creature within 5 feet. You can order the golem to let go of a creature at any time (no action required).
To break out, a restrained target can use its action to attempt a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against your spell save DC. On a success, it is no longer restrained.

You batter a creature within range with psionic force, forcing it to make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 1d6 force damage and it knocked prone. Large and larger creatures have advantage on this Strength saving throw.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The damage of this Cantrip and size of creature that makes the saving throw normally grows at 5th level (2d6, Large), 11th level (3d6, Huge), and 17th level (4d6).
You project a violent bolt of mental power at a creature you can see within range. You do not need to see the target if you speak its name as part of the verbal component of this spell.

The creature must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 4d6 psychic damage and is incapacitated until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much psychic damage and is not incapacitated.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by **1d6** for each slot level above 2nd.
You infuse a willing Beast with the spirit of nature. Until the spell ends, the target can't cast spells and gains the following benefits:

• The target gains 100 temporary hit points.
• The target has advantage on Strength, Dexterity and Constitution based ability checks as well as attack rolls that it makes with unarmed attacks.
• The target's unarmed attacks deal an additional **2d12** damage and count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance or immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.
• The target's size doubles in all dimensions, and its weight is multiplied by eight. It increases its size by one size category.
• The target can take an additional action on each of its turns, which can only be used to take the attack, dash, disengage, or hide action.
The target can end this spell for itself at any point, no action required.

You lend a willing creature your own natural ability. Choose an ability score. For the duration, you have disadvantage on all ability checks, attack rolls and saving throws that use that ability score. The target gains advantage on all ability checks, attack rolls and saving throws using that same ability score.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you may choose one additional ability score and target one additional creature for each slot level above 4th.

With a touch of your hand, you imbue up to three Beasts with magic. For each target, their natural weapons count as magic weapons for the purpose of overcoming damage resistance and immunities and have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the bonus increases to +2. When you use a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the bonus increases to +3.
**Replaces:** __Wrath of Nature__

You summon the power of the natural world to assault your foes. For the duration of the spell, all terrain within 60 feet of you is difficult terrain except for creatures you specify. When you cast the spell and as a bonus action on your subsequent turns, you can create one of the following effects, targeting any point you can see within 60 feet of you.

• **Trees.** A tree erupts from the ground and reaches out to rake your enemies with its branches. Each creature of your choice within 10 feet must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take **6d6** slashing damage.
• **Roots.** Roots erupt from the ground, seizing creatures within a 10-foot radius. Each creature must make a Strength saving throw or become restrained. Any creature within 5 feet of a restrained creature can use an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC, ending the effect on a success.
• **Rocks.** You conjure a boulder and hurl it at a creature. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes **6d10** bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone if it is Large or smaller.
• **Wind.** You summon a mighty gust. The gust takes the shape of a line 60 feet long and 20 feet wide, originating at a location you can see and traveling in a direction of your choice. All Large or smaller creatures within the area must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be swept 25 feet in the direction of the gust and knocked prone.
**Replaces:** __Antilife Shell__

Your surrounding natural environment accommodates your movement while creating obstacles to protect you in a 10-foot radius. Until the spell ends, the aura moves with you, centered on you. The area within the aura provides three-quarters cover, and is difficult terrain for creatures other than you.

As a bonus action (or as a reaction to a creature entering the aura), you can cause the elements to powerfully surge away from you. Large or smaller creatures within the aura must make a Strength saving throw. On a success, a creature is pushed out of the aura's area to the nearest unoccupied space. On a failure, the creature also falls prone.

name: Nature's Rampart
components: V, S, M (a small quartz gem engraved with the image of a castle, worth at least 100 gp)

description.value: With a wave of your hand, the ground beneath your feet trembles and the landscape shifts into a new form. You can affect up to 10 5-foot spaces in range, each of which must be contiguous with one another. You shape a natural setting into a formidable defensive position, the nature of which depends on the kind of terrain:

• **Outdoor Site or Cavern.** A rampart or dike of earth and stone rises 5 feet high on one side, with a 5 foot deep ditch on the other side.
• **Marshy or Low-Lying Site.** In areas such as marsh, bog, swamp or tundra, you create a water-filled ditch 5-feet deep. A creature forced to wade the ditch must spend 4 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves.

Artificial structures and features (such as buildings and paved roads) are not affected. If you maintain your *Concentration* on this spell for its whole duration, the rampart becomes permanent and can't be dispelled.
Otherwise, the rampart disappears when the spell ends.

Using the sight granted by the powers of life, you can detect the presence of Plants and Beasts within 30 feet of you and you can sense if they are suffering from any conditions or diseases, as well as how close to death they are.

As an action before the spell ends, you can choose a Beast within 30 feet of you that isn't hostile towards you to form a mental bond with. This bond lasts until the spell ends, the target moves more than 100 feet away from you or you break the bond (no action required). While this bond lasts, you see through the target's eyes and hear what it hears, gaining the benefits of any special senses that the target has. During this time, you are deaf and blind with regards to your own senses. You have no control over the actions of the target.

name: Nauseating Breath
components: V, S, M (a piece of fish at least one day old)

description.value: You exhale a great gout of putrid-smelling green gas. Each creature in a 30-foot cone must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for the next minute. Creatures that don't breathe are unaffected by this spell. At the end of each of its turns, a poisoned creature can make another Constitution saving throw. On a success, the creature is no longer poisoned.

name: Necromantic Infusion
components: V, M (a handful of bone chips)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Negative Energy Flood__ (in part)

You open a conduit to a plane of death, infusing one creature you can see within range with a jolt of negative energy. A living target must make a Constitution saving throw, taking **5d8** necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success. An undead target gains 5d8 temporary hit points. While it has these temporary hit points, it has advantage on its attacks.

name: Necromantic Storm
components: V, M (a piece of tattered black silk)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Negative Energy Flood__ (in part)

You tear a rift to a plane of death at a point within range, summoning forth a flood of negative energy. All non-undead creatures within 10 feet of the rift must make a Constitution saving throw, taking **6d8** necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success. If a creature is killed by this spell, the blast spreads, affecting a 10-foot radius around that creature as well. A creature cannot be damaged twice by the spell, and the spell ends after damaging 10 creatures.

If a humanoid dies from this spell, it rises as a zombie at the start of your next turn and attacks the closest living creature. The GM may either use the __zombie__ statistics from the Basic Rules, or the zombie template as described in __reanimation__. At the GM's discretion, other creature types may rise as different undead.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell with a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the maximum number of creatures damaged increases by 2 for each slot level above 5th.
**Replaces:** __Circle of Death__

You send a pulse of necromantic power radiating outward in a 60-foot radius from a point you can see within range. The pulse rips the life force out of up to eight creatures, starting from the center of the area and moving outward (prioritizing targets with fewer hit points). Each affected creature must make a Constitution saving throw, taking **8d8** necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the number of creatures affected increases by four for each slot level above 6th.

You speak ancient words as an aura of black, crackling energy surrounds you and extends 10 feet around you for the duration. When a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes **4d6** necrotic damage. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage.

Constructs are not affected by this spell. When an Undead creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it does not take damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to your spellcasting modifier.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 4th.

name: Nerveskitter
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when you or an ally makes an initiative roll

description.value: You suffuse a willing ally with a brief, blue glow, enhancing their reactions. The target rolls an additional d20 and uses the higher roll for their initiative.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you may target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

The surrounding shadows shift at your command, flying towards a creature you can see in range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be wrapped in shadows for the duration. While wrapped in shadows the target is heavily obscured and is blind beyond 5 feet.
At the end of each of its turns, the target can make an Intelligence saving throw. On a success, the spell ends on the target.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you may target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

Your touch sheds darkness, disrupting the life force of living creatures. Make a melee spell attack against a creature within your reach. On a hit, the target takes **8d12** necrotic damage and has its hit point maximum reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

Against an Undead creature, this spell deals no damage. Instead, the target is frightened of you and must spend its turns trying to move as far away from you as it can. It cannot take reactions and the only action it can take is the dash action or try to escape from an effect that prevents it from moving. If there's nowhere to move, the creature can use the dodge action. This effect lasts for one minute or until the target takes damage.

You twist the perception of a creature you can see within range, placing it in a surreal, sleepwalking state. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be affected for the duration. While affected, the target cannot take reactions and must roll a d10 at the start of each of its turns to determine how it acts this turn.
At the end of each of its turns, the target can make another Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the spell ends on the target.

rows: The target briefly sees through the nightmare and can move and act normally.
The target babbles incoherently and doesn't move or take actions this turn.
The target is terrified of you and cannot take actions. It must use all of its movement to move as far away from you as possible.

The target sees twisted enemies all around and uses its action to make a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach. If there is no creature within its reach, the target does nothing this turn.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you may target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.
A field of shadowy energy cloaks your body. For the duration, whenever you take radiant damage, that damage is reduced by 2. In addition, you take no damage from magic missile spells.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage reduction is increased by 2 for each slot level above 1st.

name: Nightstalker's Transformation
components: V, S, M (a cat's claws and whiskers)

description.value: You bestow yourself with the prowess of a creature of stealth and shadow. Until the spell ends, you can't cast spells, and you gain the following benefits:

• You gain a climbing speed equal to your walking speed and can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check
• You ignore the first 30 feet when determining how much falling damage you would take.
• You have proficiency with simple weapons, hand crossbows, rapiers, longswords, and short swords.
• You have advantage on all Dexterity checks and Dexterity saving throws.
• Once per turn, you can deal an extra **5d6** damage to one creature you hit with an attack if you have advantage on the attack roll. The attack must use a finesse or a ranged weapon. You don't need advantage on the attack roll if another enemy of the target is within 5 feet of it, that enemy isn't incapacitated, and you don't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

A glittering corona of light surrounds your body. While the spell lasts, you shed bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. As a bonus action while the spell lasts, you may command the light to coalesce in your hand and fling it at a creature or object you can see within 60 feet of you. When you do so, make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes **2d10** radiant damage and the spell ends. You have advantage with this attack while the target is in an area of bright light.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 1st.

As an action you touch one creature, on which nine fox tails appear, glowing full of magical energy. When you are concentrating on this spell, the target can use a bonus action to use up the magic from one of the nine tails. When they do so, that tail vanishes and grants one of the following effects, of its choice:

• **Flash**: Fox-fire erupts in a 20-foot radius around the target. Any creature in that area must succeed a Constitution saving throw or take **7d6** Radiant damage. Half as much on a successful save.
• **Fly**: The target gains a flying speed of 60 feet, until the end of its next turn.
• **Invisibility**: The target becomes invisible until the end of its next turn.
• **Recover**: The target heals itself for 5d6 Hit Points.
• **Zoom**: You make the object that the creature will end up holding appear as if it is the original object it was holding. When the creature tries to use it or stops holding it, the illusion fades.

This spell makes you seem unremarkable to others, though it doesn't change your actual appearance. For the duration, a creature that sees or hears you is unable to recall specific details about you, though it can remember actions you took or events that transpired around you.

name: Numbing Wind
components: V, S, M (a handful of powder)

description.value: Freezing wind, forming a line of 120 feet long and 20 feet wide, blasts from a point you choose within range. Each creature that starts its turn in the line must succeed a Strength saving throw or be pushed 30 feet away from the point. Creatures that fail the saving throw also take **1d12** Cold damage and are considered Grappled until the start of their next turn. If the spell is cast during cold or rainy weather, creatures make the saving throw with disadvantage.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The Cold damage increases by **1d12** for each level above 3rd.
**Replaces:** __Barkskin__

You magically encase your body in a hard shell of bark. You gain 6 temporary hit points at the start of each of your turns, and while you have these temporary hit points, you can calculate your AC as 15 + your Dexterity modifier (maximum of +2).

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, your AC increases by 1 for each two slot levels above 2nd. The temporary hit points increase by 3 for every slot level above 2nd.

You forge a bond between yourself and your mount, instinctively supporting one another. For the duration,  while you are mounted, you and your mount can communicate telepathically (even if neither of you share a language) and have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Intelligence (Investigation) skill checks that either of you make. In addition, your mount can use your ability modifier for Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saving throws instead of its own.

As you cast this spell you are bathed in a golden-green light from above. As it fades, you feel in touch with your natural surroundings as you forge a powerful link with nature. For the duration, you always know which way is North and have advantage on Wisdom (Animal Handling), Wisdom (Survival), and Intelligence (Nature) skill checks.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level, the duration is 4 hours. If you use a spell slot of 4th level, the duration is 8 hours. If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the duration is 24 hours.

name: Onyx Door
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when a large or smaller creature you can see within 10 ft falls prone

description.value: A door made of onyx manifests under the creature and opens for them to fall through. They must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (they can choose to fail), or they are teleported to an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range. They cannot be teleported further than half their movement speed (ignoring any effects that are setting their movement speed to 0). You can cast this spell at the moment you fall prone from going unconscious.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The spell's range increases by 10 ft when you reach levels 5 (20 feet), 11 (30 feet), and 17 (40 feet).

Upon casting this spell, you reach out to surround an Ooze you can see in range with magical strands, placing it under your control. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be controlled by you for the duration. While controlled, an Ooze cannot move or take actions or reactions unless directed to by you. On your turn, you may mentally direct the Ooze as a bonus action, dictating where it will move and what action it will take on its next turn. You must be able to see the Ooze to mentally direct it.
If a controlled Ooze splits for any reason, you retain control over one of the resulting Oozes (chosen randomly).
An Ooze with an Intelligence score of 4 or higher may attempt a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success

Your eyes glow with a pearly light as you smite a creature you can see in range with your deadly gaze. That creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. A creature paralyzed by this spell can make another Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature automatically succeeds on its saving throw if it is a Fey or if it can no longer see you.

If a creature with 10 hit points or fewer fails its initial saving throw, it dies instantly and each hostile creature that isn't a Fey within 20 feet of the target must make a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of you for the next minute. A creature frightened by this spell can make a Wisdom  saving throw at the end of each turn, ending the effect on a success.

name: Orb of Elements
components: V, S, M (a diamond worth at least 50 gp)

description.value: You hurl a 6-inch-diameter sphere of energy at a creature that you can see within range. You choose acid, cold, fire, force, lightning or thunder for the type of orb you create, then make a ranged spell attack against the target. If the attack hits, the creature takes **6d8** damage of the type you chose and must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or suffer an additional effect based on that element:

• **Acid.** The target is poisoned until the end of its next turn.
• **Cold.** The target's speed is reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn.
• **Fire.** The target takes an additional **2d8** fire damage and each creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take **1d8** fire damage.
• **Force.** The target is pushed 10 feet directly away from you.
• **Lightning.** The target is blinded until the end of its next turn.
• **Thunder** The target falls prone.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 4th.
You teleport up to five feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You cannot teleport through solid objects or out of manacles and similar restraints.

You channel necrotic spiritual power to your hand, changing it into a withered specter of itself. Make a melee spell attack against one creature within your reach. On hit, it takes 1d8 necrotic damage, and you can choose to gain temporary hit points equal to half the necrotic damage dealt.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The damage of this spell increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (**2d8**), 11th level (**3d8**), and 17th level (**4d8**).

name: Otyugh Swarm
components: V, S, M (ruby dust worth 1000 gp, which the spell consumes)

description.value: You conjure forth a pack of 1d4 + 4 Otyughs to serve you from a large area of refuse or filth that you can see in range. You must cast this spell in an area containing at least 6,000 pounds of sewage, refuse, or offal. The DM has the Otyugh's statistics.

The Otyughs are friendly to you and your companions. The Otyughs have their own turns and act immediately after you in initiative. They obey any verbal commands that you issue to them (no action required by you). If you don't issue any commands to them, they defend themselves from hostile creatures, but otherwise take no actions. When the duration ends, or an Otyugh is reduced to 0 hit points, it sloughs back into a pile of offal.

Immediately after you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you may use your bonus action to deal extra damage to it. This extra damage is equal to **2d8**. The damage type is force or psychic (your choice).

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The extra damage increases by **1d8** for each level after 1st.

You touch a willing creature, channeling positive energy to wipe away afflictions. You immediately end any diseases affecting it, as well as any of the following conditions: blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned. In addition, the target gains 2d8 + your spellcasting modifier temporary hit points.

name: Pass Without Trace (Alternate)
components: V, S, M (Ashes from a burned leaf of mistletoe)

description.value: A veil of shadows and silence radiates from you, masking you and your companions from detection. For the duration, you and creatures of your choice within 30 feet are considered to be lightly obscured and gain a bonus to all Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks equal to your Spellcasting modifier. Creatures under the effect of this spell leave no track or trace of their passing.

name: Pearly Gate
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when a large or smaller creature you can see within 10 ft gets up from prone

description.value: A lustrous white gate manifests above the creature for them to rise through. They must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (they can choose to fail), or they pass through the gate and are teleported to an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range. They cannot be teleported further than the movement they spent getting up from prone.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The spell's range increases by 10 ft when you reach levels 5 (15 feet), 11 (20 feet), and 17 (25 feet).

name: Perfect Aim
components: V, S, M ((a piece of non-magical ammunition or a throwing weapon worth at least 5 cp)

description.value: You imbue one piece of ammunition or a throwing weapon with perfect aim. Instead of making a ranged weapon attack, you deal the weapon's normal damage, using your spellcasting modifier, instead of the weapon's, to 4 targets. These targets can be different creatures, the same one, or a mix of both, provided they are within 30 feet of you.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you may choose one additional target for each slot level above 4.

name: Perforating Shot
casting_time: Bonus action, which you take immediately after hitting or missing with a ranged attack using a weapon

description.value: As your attack hits or misses the target, the weapon or ammunition transforms into a 5-foot-wide Line of magical energy that extends out to the weapon's normal range. The Line includes the attack's original target.
Each creature within the Line makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking Force damage equal to the weapon's normal damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The weapon's damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1.

name: Persistent Blade
components: V, S, M (a small silver dagger)

description.value: You bring a tiny blade of force into being, which floats around you in your space for the duration. When a creature moves into a space within five feet of you, or when a creature within five feet of you attacks or casts a spell, you may use your reaction to command the blade to lash out at that creature. When it does so, make a melee spell attack against that creature. On a hit, the target takes force damage equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting modifier.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d4 for each slot level above 1st.

name: Petrify
components: V, S, M (a pinch of chalk, water, and dirt)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Flesh to Stone__

You attempt to petrify a creature that you can see within range. If the target's body is made of flesh, the creature must make a Constitution saving throw. If it fails its saving throw by 5 or more, the creature is instantly petrified; otherwise, a creature that fails the save begins to turn to stone and is restrained.

A creature restrained by this spell must make another Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If it successfully saves against this spell three times, the spell ends; if it fails its save, it is petrified.
The petrification lasts until the creature is freed by the __greater restoration__ spell or other magic.
If the creature is physically broken while petrified, it suffers from similar damage if it reverts to its original state.

name: Phantasm
components: V, S, M (a small piece of lambs' wool)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Phantasmal Force__

You plant a debilitating phantasm into the mind of a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or it believes the phantasm to be real and capable of hindering and harming it. When you cast the spell, select one of the following options:

• **Blinded.** Your phantasm blocks the target's sight, blinded it.
• **Restrained.** Your phantasm entangles the target, restrained it.
• **Terrified.** Your phantasm takes the form of the target's greatest fears, making it frightened.
• **Assailed.** Your phantasm is real enough to cause harm. The target takes **2d10** psychic damage at the start of each of its turns.
The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on a success.

You point at a creature you can see in range. Instantly, shadowy shapes only visible to the target form at your flank and rush toward the creature you indicate, surrounding and attacking it. The target must make an Intelligence saving throw, taking **4d8** psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. In addition, if the target fails its saving throw by 5 or more it is distracted by the assailants and any attack rolls made against the target before the end of your next turn have advantage.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 2nd.

You weave an illusion that is only visible to a creature you can see within range, which takes the form of their most hated enemy. You choose a space in range, which the phantasmal decoy appears in. As a bonus action on your turn, you may command the phantasmal decoy to move up to 30 feet in any direction. The phantasmal decoy can occupy the same space as another creature and its movement is not hindered by difficult terrain or other obstacles.

At the start of each of its turns while the spell lasts, the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be unable to target a creature with an attack or harmful spell unless it includes the phantasmal decoy as a target. The target has advantage on this saving throw if the phantasmal decoy is in the same space as another creature or not visible to the target.

You create an area of ever-shifting phantasmal terrain and landmarks in a 150-foot cube in range that confuse anyone attempting to move through the affected area. The entire area is considered lightly obscured. When you cast the spell, you can designate any number of creatures you can see to be unaffected by it.

An affected creature's speed is halved in the area, and when a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there it must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the terrain shifts and twists around the creature, seeming to move of its own accord. The creature finds it nearly impossible to move in a straight line and instead all movement is made in a random direction. To determine the direction, roll a d8 and assign a direction to each die face. The creature can only move in that direction while it remains in the area this turn. On a successful save, the creature can move normally.
**Replaces:** __Phantasmal Killer__

You select a creature you can see within range and create an illusion of its worst nightmares, which only it can see. At the start of each of the target's turns, it must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it takes **4d10** psychic damage and is frightened. On a success, the spell ends.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by **1d10** for each slot level above 4th.
**Replaces:** __Weird__

You create horrifying illusions in the minds of creatures you can see. Select any number of creatures within 30 feet of a point you can see within range. Each target must make a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for the duration. While frightened in this way, at the start of a creature's turn, it takes **6d10** psychic damage and must roll 1d10, suffering an effect from the table below. Unless noted, effects last until the start of the creature's next turn.
A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell for itself on a success.

rows: The creature believes itself dead and falls unconscious until it takes damage or is awoken as an action.
The creature is paralyzed with fear.
The creature's speed is reduced to 0.
The creature screams uncontrollably and can make no other sounds.

name: Phantasmal Thief
components: V, S, M (a spool of green thread)

description.value: A shapeless, invisible force springs into existence in an unoccupied space on the ground within range. It has an AC of 10, 25 hit points, a fly speed of 30 feet, blindsight for 60 feet, a Strength of 8 and an Intelligence of 8. It can't attack and if it drops to 0 hit points the spell ends. The phantasm can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain and takes 5 (**1d10**) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

Once on each of your turns as a bonus action, you can mentally command the phantasm to obtain medium or smaller-sized objects for you, as well as a location you wish it to take them from. These can be specific objects and locations (for example: the jeweled dagger in the mayor's desk) or a general kind of object or location (for example: daggers anywhere in this town). The phantasm acts immediately after you in initiative and will spend each of its turns searching the directed area and attempting to obtain the object(s) you specify. The phantasm cannot obtain objects that are being worn or carried, or objects that weigh more than 120 pounds. When the phantasm successfully obtains an object, it stores it in an extradimensional space that only the phantasm can access. This extradimensional space can hold up to 500 pounds, and cannot exceed a volume of 64 cubic feet.

When this extradimensional space is full, or until you use a bonus action to command the phantasm to return, it will spend each of its turns moving towards you. When the phantasm reaches you, it deposits the objects it has obtained one at a time at your feet. If the spell ends, all the objects in the extradimensional space immediately spill forth where in the space where the phantasm occupied.

The phantasm always knows what direction you are and will not voluntarily move more than 500 feet away from you and if it does so (if you are teleported elsewhere, for example) then it will spend its turns moving towards you until it is within 500 feet.

name: Phantom Foe
components: V, S, M (a tiny pewter figure of a warrior worth 10 gp)

description.value: Choose a creature you can see in range. The target must succeed on an Intelligence saving throw or be assailed by illusory duplicates of creatures hostile to the target for the duration. While these illusory duplicates last, the target has difficulty determining which image is real. Each time the target makes an attack roll during the spell's duration, roll  a d20 to determine whether the attack instead targets one of the duplicates. On a 10 or lower, the target has struck a duplicate and their attack does nothing.
A creature is unaffected by this spell if it can't see, if it relies on senses other than sight, such as blindsight, or if it can perceive illusions as false, as with truesight.

You conjure a chain and hook made of magical force, which you propel at a creature or unoccupied space you can see within range. When you target a space or a creature of Huge size or larger, your grapnel pulls you to that target in a straight line. You provoke Opportunity Attacks for this movement as normal. When you target a creature of Large size or smaller, the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 10 feet toward you.

Opening your palm, you release a puff of dust containing the pestilence of mummy rot. One creature you choose within range must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be cursed for the duration. While cursed, the target can't regain Hit Points, its Hit Point maximum doesn't return to normal when finishing a Long Rest, and its Hit Point maximum decreases by 3d6 every 24 hours that elapse. A creature dies and turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points by this curse.
You cause up to two pillars of stone to burst forth from places on the ground that you can see within range. Both pillars are cylinders with a diameter of 5 feet and a height up to 30 feet.

The ground where a pillar appears must be wide enough for its diameter, and you can target ground under a creature if that creature is Medium or smaller. Each pillar has an Armor Class of 5 and 30 hit points. If reduced to 0 hit points, a pillar crumbles into rubble, creating an area of difficult terrain with a 10-foot radius. This rubble lasts until cleared.
If a pillar is created under a creature, that creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be lifted by the pillar. A creature can choose to fail the save.

If a pillar is prevented from reaching its full height because of a ceiling or other obstacle, any creature on the pillar takes 6d6 bludgeoning damage and is Restrained, pinched between the pillar and the obstacle. A Restrained creature can use its action to make either a Strength or Dexterity check against your Spell save DC. On a success, it is no longer Restrained and must either move off the pillar or fall off it.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: If you cast this spell with a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you create two additional pillars for each slot level above 4th.

name: Plague of Undead
components: V, S, M (A black sapphire worth 5000 gp)

description.value: Unleashing a cold rush of necromantic energy, you cause a host of Undead to rise from the bodies of the fallen.

Choose any number of corpses you can see in range with a combined challenge rating (or level, if they do not have a challenge rating) equal to or less than your level. Those corpses rise as a Reanimated using the template in info tab. A creature remains reanimated and under your control until the spell is dispelled or the creature is reduced to 0 hit point.

You summon swarms of Fey creatures, which appear in unoccupied spaces that you can see within range. Choose any number of swarms with a combined Challenge Rating of 2 or lower. No individual swarm may have a Challenge Rating below ¼ or above 2. Your choices of swarms may include: bats, insects, poisonous snakes, quippers, rats, or ravens (your GM might allow other swarms to be summoned). The summoned creatures are friendly to you and your companions. Roll initiative for the summoned creatures as a group, which have their own turns. They obey any verbal commands that you issue to them (no action required by you). If you don't issue any commands to them, they defend themselves from hostile creatures, but otherwise take no actions.
A summoned swarm disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends. The GM has the creatures' statistics.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the maximum combined challenge rating increases by 2 for each slot level above 5th.

name: Planar Bubble
components: V, S, M (a sprinkling of silver dust)

description.value: You create a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on either a willing creature or point you can see in range, which emulates an environment you choose. If the target is a creature, then the area moves with the target. The environment chosen, along with the effects it provides are chosen from the following (your GM may make more environments available):

• **Material Plane.** The atmosphere is comfortable and dry inside the bubble. In addition, the area is lit by sunlight, which provides bright light throughout the entire area.
• **Feywild.** All sensations, both sensory and emotional are heightened within the area and magic runs more freely. Once per turn, when a creature casts a spell using a spell slot of 1st level or higher inside the area they must roll on the Wild Magic Surge table to create an additional magical effect.
• **Shadowfell.** Colors and light seem to leech away in the bubble, and those inside the area are filled with a persistent sense of dread. Any light source in the area that would normally produce bright light produces dim light instead and all sources of dim light are darkness. In addition, creatures in the area have vulnerability to necrotic damage.
• **Ethereal Plane.** The bubble is filled with swirling fog that limits vision. Anything further than 10 feet away in the area is heavily obscured and no sound can pass into or out of the area. In addition, creatures in the area have a flying speed equal to their walking speed.
• **Astral Plane.** The bubble becomes a silvery void, where creatures and objects stop aging and do not suffer from hunger or thirst. As a plane of thought, each creature's walking speed is equal to 3x their Intelligence score as long as they remain in the area.
• **Elemental Plane of Air.** Powerful winds whip throughout the bubble, causing any ranged attacks into or out of the area to be made with disadvantage. Any creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet directly away from the center of the area. If this spell is cast on a creature, that creature is immune to being pushed by this spell
• **Elemental plane of Earth.** The entire bubble is filled with constantly churning sediment, blinding any creature as long as it remains in the area while also providing total cover. There is no air present in the area, so a creature that needs to breathe must hold its breath or begin to suffocate. In addition, a creature moving through the area must spend 4 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves unless it has a burrowing speed.
• **Elemental plane of Fire.** The bubble is filled with a sweltering heat. Any creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there; it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take **1d8** fire damage. Creatures wearing medium or heavy armor, or who are clad in heavy clothing, have disadvantage on the saving throw. Flammable objects in the area that are not being worn or carried ignite.
• **Elemental plane of Water.** The entire bubble is filled with water drawn from frigid, crushing depths. While in the area, a creature suffers from the normal effects of Frigid Waters (see "Unusual Environments" in chapter 5 of the Dungeon Master's Guide).

You transform yourself into a new form, which lasts for the duration or until you drop to 0 hit points or die. The new form can be any nonmagical Plant of Huge size or smaller or any Plant creature whose Challenge Rating is equal to or less than your level. If your new form is a creature, your game statistics, including mental ability scores, are replaced by the statistics of the chosen creature. If your new form is a nonmagical plant, you retain your mental ability scores and the rest of your game statistics are replaced by the statistics of the chosen plant.

You are limited in the actions you can perform by the nature of your new form and you can't speak, cast spells, or take any other action that requires hands or speech unless your new form is normally able to do so.
Your gear melds into your new form. You cannot activate, use, wield, or otherwise benefit from any of your equipment.

A point you choose within range starts to exude a strong magnetic force. Each creature within a 20-foot-radius sphere centred there must succeed a Strength saving throw or be pulled 10 feet towards the centre and take **4d8** Force damage or the creature doesn't move and only takes half as much on a success. Loose objects are also moved 10 feet towards the centre.
Objects and creatures that collide both take an additional **2d8** Bludgeoning damage.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The force damage increases by **4d8** for each level above 3rd.
**Replaces:** __Poison Spray__

You conjure a spectral snake that bites down on one creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take **1d12** poison damage and be poisoned until the start of its next turn.
This spell's damage increases by 1d12 when you reach 5th level (2d12), 11th level (3d12), and 17th level (4d12).
You spray toxic mist at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes **1d12** Poison damage.

description.name: Cantrip Upgrade
description.value: The damage increases by 1d12 when you reach levels 5 (**2d12**), 11 (**3d12**), and 17 (**4d12**).
You raise your hand and project a toxic mist at a creature you can see within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On hit, the target takes 1d12 poison damage.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: This spell's damage increases by 1d12 when you reach 5th level (**2d12**), 11th level (**3d12**), and 17th level (**4d12**).

name: Poison Thorns
components: V, S, M (a dried black rose)

description.value: Black, glistening thorns emerge from your skin, endangering those who draw too close. For the duration, your natural weapons and unarmed attacks deal an additional **2d6** poison damage on a hit. In addition, any creature that starts its turn grappling you or grappled by you takes **2d6** poison damage.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for every two slot levels above 5th.

name: Poison Vines
components: V, S, M (a crown of ivy leaves)

description.value: Glistening green vines spring up at your command, covering the ground in a 20-foot radius area centered on a point within range you can see. The area is difficult terrain while the spell lasts. In addition, any creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes **5d8** poison damage and is poisoned until it leaves the area. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and is not poisoned.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 4th.

You attempt to transform a creature that you can see within range into a Beast. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or shape-shift into Beast form for the duration. At the start of each of their turns the target can repeat the saving throw, ending the spell on a success.

When you prepare this spell, choose 3 stat blocks with the beast creature type that have a CR equal to or less than twice this spell's level plus your spellcasting modifier. Choose one of these beasts to transform the target into. The target's game statistics are replaced by the stat block of the Beast, but the target retains its alignment, personality, creature type, saving throw modifiers, Hit Points, and Hit Point Dice. You can prepare this spell multiple times, but you must pick different stat blocks each time.

The target gains a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to the Hit Points of the Beast form. The spell ends early on the target if it has no Temporary Hit Points left. It looses these temporary hit points if the spell ends.
The target is limited in the actions it can perform by the anatomy of its new form, and it can't speak or cast spells.
The target's gear melds into the new form. The creature can't use or otherwise benefit from any of that equipment.

You attempt to transform a creature you can see within range into a Beast using the rules below. An unwilling target makes a Charisma saving throw to resist this effect. Shapechangers automatically succeed on this saving throw.

description.name: Form
description.value: The new form can be any living Beast you have seen before. Creatures can only be transformed into a Beast with a CR equal to (or lower then) half its level or CR.

description.name: Statistics
description.value: The creature's game statistics are replaced by those of the Beast. However, while transformed, it retains its alignment, personality, its Hit Points, and Charisma score.

description.name: Actions
description.value: The creature can only take the actions that would be available to that Beast. It cannot speak, cast spells, or take any actions that require hands or speech.

description.name: Equipment
description.value: Its clothing, weapons, armor, and objects it is holding meld into the new form. However, it can't activate, use, wield, or otherwise benefit from any of its equipment.

description.name: Reverting
description.value: The creature instantly reverts to its true form if it is reduced to 0 hit points. It can also repeat this Charisma saving throw at the end of each of its turns, reverting to its true form on a successful save.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell with a slot of 5th-level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 4th. You can choose the Beast that you transform each target into individually.

An aura of soothing white energy surrounds you. At the end of each of your turns while the spell lasts, each creature in a 10-foot radius sphere centered on you regains a number of hit points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier.
This spell has no effect on constructs or undead.

You can possess anything at a whim. When you cast this spell, you move 5 feet, directly into the area of a non-incorporeal creature or an object, provided it is not two sizes larger or smaller than you, to possess it. A creature must succeed a Charisma saving throw or become possessed.

A creature possessed by you becomes Incapacitated but is aware of its surroundings. While possessing a creature, you cannot be targeted by an attack, spell, or other effect. You retain all your own statistics, apart from Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, and Speed, which uses the creature's. You now control the creature you possess and take actions as them.
While possessing an object, you may move  it 30 feet a turn, provided the object isn't secured to another surface.
The spell ends after a minute, if the creature or object drops to 0 HP, if you use a Bonus Action to end it, or if the creature, upon taking damage, succeeds a Charisma saving throw.
Once the possession ends, you appear in the closest unoccupied space.

You can possess anything at a whim. When you cast this spell, you move 5 feet, directly into the area of a non-incorporeal creature or an object, provided it is not two sizes larger or smaller than you, to possess it. A creature must succeed a Charisma saving throw or become possessed.

A creature possessed by you becomes Incapacitated but is aware of its surroundings. While possessing a creature, you cannot be targeted by an attack, spell, or other effect. You retain all your own statistics, apart from Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, and Speed, which uses the creature's. You now control the creature you possess and take actions as them.
While possessing an object, you may move  it 30 feet a turn, provided the object isn't secured to another surface.
The spell ends after a minute, if the creature or object drops to 0 HP, if you use a Bonus Action to end it, or if the creature, upon taking damage, succeeds a Charisma saving throw.
Once the possession ends, you appear in the closest unoccupied space.
**Replaces:** __Catnap__

You command up to three willing prone creatures of your choice that you can see within range to sleep. The spell ends for a target if it wakes up, such as through damage or being shaken awake as an action. If a target remains unconscious for the full duration, that target gains the benefit of a short rest, and it can't benefit from this spell again until it finishes a long rest. The spell's duration is one-fifth the time normally required for a short rest (for example, 12 minutes for a one-hour rest).

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you can target one additional willing creature for each slot level above 3rd.

When you cast this spell, you can cause any of your body hair to grow up to 15 feet in length. Your hair becomes supernaturally tough and you can magically use it to extend your reach for the duration. Using your hair, you can cast spells with a range of Touch, take the Help or Utilize action, or perform simple tasks out to a range of 15 feet. Your hair can't wield weapons, Shields, or carry objects heavier than 10 pounds. Your hair returns to its normal length when this spell ends.
You create a magical effect within range. Choose the effect from the options below. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its non-instantaneous effects active at a time.

description.name: Sensory Effect
description.value: You create an instantaneous, harmless sensory effect, such as a shower of sparks, a puff of wind, faint musical notes, or an odd odor.

description.name: Fire Play
description.value: You instantaneously light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a small campfire.

description.name: Clean or Soil
description.value: You instantaneously clean or soil an object no larger than 1 cubic foot.

description.name: Minor Sensation
description.value: You chill, warm, or flavor up to 1 cubic foot of nonliving material for 1 hour.

description.name: Magic Mark
description.value: You make a color, a small mark, or a symbol appear on an object or a surface for 1 hour.

description.name: Minor Creation
description.value: You create a nonmagical trinket or an illusory image that can fit in your hand. It lasts until the end of your next turn. A trinket can deal no damage and has no monetary worth.

Calling upon ancient and timeless magical energies of the elements, you assume a primal elemental form. You transform into any Elemental whose challenge rating is equal to or less than your level (or challenge rating, if you don't have a level). The transformation lasts for the duration, or until you drop to 0 hit points or die.

Your game statistics, including mental ability scores, are replaced by the statistics of the chosen Elemental. You retain your alignment and personality. You assume the hit points of your new form. When you revert to your normal form, you return to the number of hit points you had before you transformed. If you revert as a result of dropping to 0 hit points, any access damage carries over to your normal form. As long as the excess damage doesn't reduce your normal form to 0 hit points, you aren't knocked unconscious.

You are limited in the actions you can perform by the nature of your new form, and you can only speak, cast spells, or take other actions that require hands or speech if your new form can also do so. Your gear melds into the new form. You can't activate, use, wield, or otherwise benefit from any of your equipment.

Your fingers transform into sharp claws until the start of your next turn. As part of the action used to cast this spell you can make a melee spell attack with these claws. On hit, they deal slashing damage equal to 1d6 + your spellcasting modifier.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The number of attacks you make with the claws as part of the action to cast this spell increases at 5th level (two), 11th level (three), and 17th level (four).
**Replaces:** __Chaos Bolt__

You send a blast of chaotically shifting energy at one creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the bolt deals **1d8** damage. The number rolled on the die determines the damage type, additional damage, and additional effects. If you roll more than 1d8 (for instance, by a critical hit or casting at a higher level), you may select which d8 determines the table result.

rows: The target takes 2d4 acid damage immediately, and 3d4 acid damage at the end of its next turn.
The target takes 2d8 cold damage and has its speed halved until the end of its next turn.
The target takes 3d4 force damage and is knocked prone if it is Large or smaller.
The target takes 1d12 lightning damage and can't take reactions until the start of its next turn.
The target takes 1d12 poison damage and is poisoned until the end of its next turn.
The target takes 2d8 psychic damage and is charmed by you until the end of its next turn.
The target takes 2d8 thunder damage and is deafened until the end of its next turn.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the initial damage roll increases by **1d8** for each slot level above 1st.

name: Prismatic Eye
components: V, S, M (a polished, rainbow-hued abalone shell)

description.value: With a popping sound, an apple-sized eye with a rainbow-hued iris appears in the air. The eye orbits you in your space for the duration. When you cast this spell, or as a bonus action on your turn you may command the eye to fire a beam of colored light at a creature you can see within 120 feet. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw.
Then, roll a d8 to determine the color of the ray affecting the creature.

rows: Red. The target takes 10d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Orange. The target takes 10d6 acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Yellow. The target takes 10d6 lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Green. The target takes 10d6 poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Blue. The target takes 10d6 cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Indigo. On a failed save, the target is Restrained. It must then make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If it successfully saves three times, the spell ends. If it fails its save three times, it permanently turns to stone and is subjected to the Petrified condition. The successes and failures don't need to be consecutive, keep track of both until the target collects three of a kind.

Violet. On a failed save, the target is Blinded. It must then make a Wisdom saving throw at the start of your next turn. A successful save ends the blindness. If it fails that save, the creature is transported to another plane of existence of the GM's choosing and is no longer Blinded. (Typically, a creature that is on a plane that isn't its home plane is banished home, while other Creatures are usually cast into the Astral or Ethereal planes.)
Special. The target is struck by a ray of your choice.

description.value: A single beam of brilliantly colored light shoots from your outstretched hand at a creature you can see in range. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw. Roll a d8 to determine the color and effect of the beam.

rows: Red.  The target takes 10d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Orange.   The target takes 10d6 acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Yellow.  The target takes 10d6 lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Green. The target takes 10d6 poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Blue. The target takes 10d6 cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Indigo. On a failed save, the target is restrained. It must then make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If it successfully saves three times, the spell ends. If it fails its save three times, it permanently turns to stone and is subjected to the petrified condition. The successes and failures don't need to be consecutive; keep track of both until the target collects three of a kind.

Violet.  On a failed save, the target is blinded. It must then make a Wisdom saving throw at the start of your next turn. A successful save ends the blindness. If it fails that save, the creature is transported to another plane of existence of the GM's choosing and is no longer blinded. (Typically, a creature that is on a plane that isn't its home plane is banished home, while other creatures are usually cast into the Astral or Ethereal planes.)
Special. The target is afflicted by multiple effects. Roll twice more, rerolling any 8.

description.value: A shimmering, multicolored plane of light forms a vertical opaque wall—up to 90 feet long, 30 feet high, and 1 inch thick—centered on a point within range. Alternatively, you shape the wall into a globe up to 30 feet in diameter centered on a point within range. The wall lasts for the duration. If you position the wall in a space occupied by a creature, the spell ends instantly without effect.

The wall sheds Bright Light within 100 feet and Dim Light for an additional 100 feet. You and creatures you designate when you cast the spell can pass through and be near the wall without harm. Whenever another creature that can see the wall moves is within 20 feet of it, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the Blinded condition for 1 minute. After a creature makes this saving throw it does not need to do so again until the start of its next turn.

The wall consists of seven layers, each with a different color. When a creature reaches into or passes through the wall, it does so one layer at a time through all the layers. Each layer forces the creature to make a Dexterity saving throw or be affected by that layer's properties as described in the Prismatic Layers table. After a creature makes a saving throw for a layer, it does not need to make a saving throw for that layer again until the start of its next turn.

The wall, which has AC 10, can be destroyed one layer at a time, in order from red to violet, by means specific to each layer. If a layer is destroyed, it is gone for the duration. __Antimagic Field__ has no effect on the wall, and __Dispel Magic__ can affect only the violet layer.

value.title: Prismatic Layers
rows: Red. Failed Save: 12d6 Fire damage. Successful Save: Half as much damage. Additional Effects: Nonmagical ranged attacks can't pass through this layer, which is destroyed if it takes at least 25 Cold damage.

Orange. Failed Save: 12d6 Acid damage. Successful Save: Half as much damage. Additional Effects: Magical ranged attacks can't pass through this layer, which is destroyed by a strong wind (such as the one created by Gust of Wind).
Yellow. Failed Save: 12d6 Lightning damage. Successful Save: Half as much damage. Additional Effects: The layer is destroyed if it takes at least 60 Force damage.

Green. Failed Save: 12d6 Poison damage. Successful Save: Half as much damage. Additional Effects: A Passwall spell, or another spell of equal or greater level that can open a portal on a solid surface, destroys this layer.
Blue. Failed Save: 12d6 Cold damage. Successful Save: Half as much damage. Additional Effects: The layer is destroyed if it takes at least 25 Fire damage.
