Indigo. Failed Save: The target has the Restrained condition and makes a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If it successfully saves three times, the condition ends. If it fails three times, it has the Petrified condition until it is freed by an effect like the Greater Restoration spell. The successes and failures needn't be consecutive; keep track of both until the target collects three of a kind. Additional Effects: Spells can't be cast through this layer, which is destroyed by Bright Light shed by the Daylight spell.

Violet. Failed Save: The target has the Blinded condition and makes a Wisdom saving throw at the start of your next turn. On a successful save, the condition ends. On a failed save, the condition ends, and the creature teleports to another plane of existence (DM's choice). Additional Effects: This layer is destroyed by Dispel Magic.

description.value: For the duration of the spell, you can reach out with your thoughts to access the memories and knowledge of certain creatures. For the duration, you can detect the presence of thinking creatures within 30 feet of you, including ones you can't see. The spell can penetrate barriers, but 2 feet of rock, 2 inches of any metal other than lead, or a thin sheet of lead blocks you. You can't detect a creature with Intelligence 3 or lower.

When you cast this spell and as an action on each turn until the spell ends, you can focus on a creature you can see within 30 feet. If the creature you choose has an Intelligence of 3 or lower it is unaffected. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you learn the surface thoughts of the target, as well as the answers to up to five specific questions taken from the target's knowledge and memories. On a successful save, you can only read the surface thoughts of the target but nothing deeper and the target is immune to this casting of Probe Thoughts. Success or failure, the target is unaware of the intrusion.

name: Protect Threshold
components: V, S, M (an ounce of salt for each foot of the warded portal's perimeter)

description.value: Tracing arcane sigils along its boundary, you can ward a doorway, window, or other portal from entry. For the duration, an Invisible eldritch creature stalks the warded portal. Any creature that attempts to pass through the portal makes a Wisdom saving throw or takes **4d6** Psychic damage, or half as much on a successful save.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 2.
You use your bonus action to temporarily increase the AC and Dexterity saving throw bonus of a creature you can see within 30 feet, by 3. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The bonus increases by 2 for each spell slot level above 1st.

You grant a willing creature a portion of your own expertise. Choose one skill, tool, or instrument that you have proficiency in. For the duration, the target gains proficiency in the chosen skill, tool or instrument if it didn't already have it. In addition, whenever you or the target take the help action to aid the other using the chosen skill and that roll does not have disadvantage, the creature being helped may reroll one of the dice once.

Make a crafting check to make an object. Failing the crafting check does not negatively affect the materials. If the object you craft can be attuned to, the first attempt to attune to it is instantaneous. The object has no uses of any magical limited-use features that do not regain uses at dawn, after a long rest or after a short rest. After an hour, the object turns back into the materials it was crafted out of.

You psionically overwhelm the mind of one creature you can see within range. The target must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, it takes **12d6** psychic damage and is stunned for 1 minute. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't stunned.
The stunned target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

As part of an unarmed strike, you manifest a blade of psionic energy in your hand. On hit, the target takes psychic damage equal to **1d6** + your Strength modifier, in place of the normal damage of your unarmed strike. Your hand immediately reverts to its normal appearance at the end of the attack.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The damage die of this spell increases at 5th level (**1d8**), 11th level (**1d10**), and 17th level (**1d12**).

For a moment, the colors in a 20-foot Emanation originating from you shift in a rainbow swirl. Each creature you choose in the Emanation has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes against you until the spell ends at the end of your next turn. Additionally, the colors of objects you choose within range change randomly and remain brightly and unnaturally colored for 1 hour.

You exert the full force of your will on a creature. The target must make a Strength saving taking **5d8** force damage on a failure, and half as much on a success. At the end of each of its turns, it must repeat the saving throw. It takes **2d8** force damage on a failed save, and on a success, the spell ends.
If this spell reduces a creature to 0 hit points they are crushed into a ball the size of your fist.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th-level or higher, the initial force damage increases by **1d8** for each spell slot level above 5th.
**Replaces:** __Mind Spike__

You pierce the mind of one creature you can see within range. The target must make an Intelligence saving throw, taking **3d8** psychic damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success. On a failure, you psychically pin the target and link yourself to its mind. For the duration, you can use a bonus action to mentally twist the skewer, causing the creature to subtract 1d4 from the next saving throw it makes before the end of your next turn.

Additionally, you have perfect knowledge of the target's location as long as you are on the same plane of existence. The target can't be hidden from you and gains no benefit from the invisible condition against you. If you maintain *concentration* for the full duration, this knowledge persists 1 hour after the spell ends.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by **1d8** for each slot level above 2nd.
**Replaces:** __Telekinesis__
You attempt to mentally manipulate a creature or object you can see within range. Choose one of the following effects:

• **Creature.** You attempt to move a Huge or smaller creature, including yourself. The creature must make a Strength saving throw. A creature can willingly fail this save. On a failure, you move the creature up to 30 feet in any direction within the spell's range, and you may restrain the creature until the end of your next turn.
• **Object.** You attempt to move an object that weighs up to 1,000 pounds and can exert fine control on it. If the object isn't being worn or carried, you move it up to 30 feet in any direction within the spell's range. If the object is worn or carried by a creature, the creature must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, you pull the object away from that creature and can move it up to 30 feet in any direction within the spell's range.
A creature or object moved into mid-air will hover until the end of your next turn.

On each of your turns after you cast this spell, you can use an action to attempt to continue the effect (with the target repeating the saving throw) or choose a new target. You can only affect one object or creature at a time.

Strings of silver energy, invisible to all but you, extend from your fingers toward a humanoid you can see in range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be ensnared for the duration. While ensnared, the creature cannot take actions or reactions and its speed is zero unless it is being directed by you.

When you cast this spell, or as an action on your turn,  you may telepathically command the target to take an action of your choice that it can perform, which it does on its next turn. In addition, whenever you use your movement, the target immediately uses its reaction to mirror that movement to the best of its ability, (for example, if you move East 10 feet, the target also attempts to move East 10 feet).
At the end of each of its turns, the target may make another Wisdom saving throw, ending the effect on a success.
You remove poison, rot, and acids from food and drink in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range. The poison or acid cannot be worth more than 5gp.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell at higher levels, multiply the worth of the poison or acid that can be removed by 3 for each additional level.

The ground within a 15-foot-radius area of a point you choose within range begins to rapidly shake. The area becomes difficult terrain for the duration. When a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall prone. As an action, you can move the quake's origin point to another spot within range.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the radius for the area of effect increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 1st.
Your feet and those of up to six creatures you can see in range glow with a yellow nimbus of light. Until the start of your next turn, each affected creature's walking speed increases by 30 feet.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, affected creature's walking speed is increased by an additional 30 feet for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Quick Potion
components: V, S, M (a container filled with water)

description.value: Coppery sparks drop from your fingertips and suffuse a flask, jar, vial, or other similarly sized container filled with water. As the sparks dissolve fully into the container, you choose another spell you can cast of 2nd level or lower that targets only one creature (including spells with a range of self), and has a casting time of 1 action. For the next hour, any creature can drink the contents of the flask as an action to be affected by the chosen spell, using your spellcasting modifier or spell save DC where necessary. If the spell requires *Concentration*, the creature that drinks the potion must concentrate on the spell, up to the full duration.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the level of spell you can choose increases by one for each slot level above 2nd.
This spell imparts a flash of speed. Your Speed increases by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

Needle-sharp quills emerge from your skin before spraying in all directions. Each other creature in a 20 foot radius sphere centered on you must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking **10d6** piercing damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures that are Small size or smaller have advantage on their saving throw, while creatures that are Large size or larger have disadvantage on their saving throw.

If a creature fails its save by 5 or more then several of the quills become lodged in the target, giving it disadvantage  on attack rolls and ability checks until it or another creature uses an action to pull the quills free. When a creature pulls these quills free it takes an additional **2d6** piercing damage.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the initial damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 5th.

You draw upon the power of nature, as the back of your hand and arms bristle with a spike-like growth of quills that lasts until the spell ends. These quills count as a simple melee weapon with which you are proficient. They deal 2d8 piercing and **2d8** poison damage on a hit and have the finesse, light and thrown properties (range 20/60). New quills immediately sprout to replace ones thrown.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the piercing damage or the poison damage (your choice) increases by 1d8 for every two slot levels above 3rd.

name: Radiant Assault
components: V, S, M (an eye from a Fiend or Celestial creature)

description.value: With an outstretched hand, you gesture toward a point you can see in range, releasing a rainbow-colored burst of light in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point.

Choose one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. Each creature in the area must make a Wisdom saving throw, taking **6d6** radiant damage and **6d6** damage of the type you chose on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If a target fails its save by 5 or more, it is stunned until the end of its next turn.

You inflame existing fires in a 60-foot radius sphere centered on yourself. All existing fires, both magical and mundane, flare up, burning hotter and brighter. If a fire provides light, the radius of illumination they provide is doubled (for example: a torch would cast bright light in a 40-foot radius and dim light for an additional 40 feet). If a fire causes damage, that damage is increased by 1d4.
These effects last for 1 minute. When the spell ends, affected nonmagical flames are extinguished, having burnt themselves out.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level, the effects of this spell last for 1 hour. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level, the effects of this spell last for 8 hours.
**Replaces:** __Fire Storm__

You create a whirling storm of fire in the air, calling down destruction upon your enemies. The firestorm appears at a height of your choice between 20 and 300 feet above you, centered above your current location.

When you cast the spell, and as a bonus action on subsequent turns, you can call down a 5-foot radius cylinder of fire at five points you can see within 120 feet. Creatures within an area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking **8d6** fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success. A creature in more than one area is affected only once. The fire ignites flammable objects that aren't being worn or carried.

name: Rainbow Beam
components: V, S, M (a small crystal prism worth at least 5 gp)

description.value: You fire a ray of swirling, multihued light at a creature you can see in range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. If the attack hits, roll a d8 to determine what kind of damage the target takes. The target takes **3d8** damage of the chosen type and must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it is also blinded until the end of its next turn.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Rainbow Blast
components: V, S, M (a small crystal prism worth at least 50 gp)

description.value: You unleash a beam of multihued light. The beam originates from you and forms a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes **2d6** cold damage, **2d6** fire damage, and **2d6** lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a higher level spell slot, the beam deals additional damage of different damage types: **2d6** thunder damage at 4th level, **2d6** poison damage at 5th level, **2d6** acid damage at 6th level, **2d6** necrotic damage at 7th level, **2d6** radiant damage at 8th level, **4d6** force damage at 9th level.

name: Raise Dead
components: V, S, M (a diamond worth 500+ GP, which the spell consumes)

description.value: You touch creature that has been dead for no longer than 10 days and wasn't Undead when it died. It must make a DC 10 death saving throw.

On a success, it is revived with 1 Hit Point. If its also a natural 20, the spell does not consume its material component. On a failure, this spell cannot be used to revive this creature. This restriction ends if the creature is revived through other means. If its also a natural 1, it can never be revived.

Any poisons that affected the revived creature at its time of death are neutralized. All mortal wounds on the revived creature are closed, but it doesn't restore missing body parts. If the creature is lacking body parts or organs integral for its survival—its head, for instance—the spell has no effect.
Coming back from the dead is an ordeal. The revived creature takes 2 levels of exhaustion.

You grant magical buoyancy to a water vehicle you can see in range. For the duration, the target cannot sink and floats effortlessly on the surface of the water. If the target is already below the water (such as a shipwreck), then it rises towards the surface at a speed of 150 feet each round.
When cast to raise a shipwreck, the spell raises all surviving fragments of the ship in range.

You touch a willing creature, bolstering its strength. While the spell lasts, the target has advantage on Strength checks. In addition, ridged, hornlike ripples appear over the knuckles, nails and backs of the target's hands. For the duration, their hands count as natural weapons, which they can use to make unarmed strikes. If they hit with them, they deal bludgeoning damage equal to 1d4 + their Strength modifier.
If the target moves 20 feet straight towards a creature and hits it with an unarmed attack on the same turn, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

A crackling ray leaps from your outstretched hand at a creature you can see in range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes **2d6** necrotic damage and has disadvantage on Dexterity skill checks and saves for the duration of the spell. The target can make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you may target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

A copper-red ray bursts from your outstretched hand towards a creature you can see in range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes **8d8** force damage. If this attack hits a construct, it is automatically a critical hit.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 4th.

You release a drab violet ray from your palm at a creature you can see in range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target is struck with intense feelings of vertigo. On each of its turns, it can use either an action or a bonus action,  but not both. The target can make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you may fire one additional ray, targeting one additional creature, for each slot level above 1st.

You release a crackling black ray at a creature you can see in range, filling the air with the smell of decay. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes **12d8** necrotic damage and has disadvantage on all Strength, Dexterity and Constitution checks and saves for 1 minute as their life energy is consumed. The target can make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 6th.

A brilliant ray of light lances from your palm towards a creature you can see in range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes **12d8** radiant damage and is blinded for 1 minute. A creature blinded by this spell can make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 6th.

You shoot a greenish ray at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes **2d8** Poison damage and has the Poisoned condition until the end of your next turn. The poisoned creature has disadvantage on saving throws to maintain *Concentration*.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The damage increases by **1d8** for each spell slot level above 1.

A dark ray flies forth from your hand towards a creature you can see in range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target has its vitality drained. For the duration, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls and its speed is reduced by 10 feet (to a minimum of 5 feet). The target can make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you may fire one additional ray, targeting one additional creature, for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Reality Maelstrom
components: V, S, M (a golden hoop at least 1-inch across)

description.value: With a rending sound as loud as thunder, a tear in reality opens at a point you can see in range. Everything in a 20-foot radius sphere centered on that point is drawn inexorably toward the tear. Any creature or object that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be drawn into the maelstrom. A creature can choose to fail this save. Any unattended object weighing less than 100 pounds in the area is automatically drawn into the maelstrom. In addition, when you initially cast the spell, each creature and unattended object in a 40-foot sphere centered on the point must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pulled 20 feet towards the point.
When a creature is drawn into the maelstrom, it is sent to a random plane of existence. Roll a d20 to determine where a creature or object ends up:
The maelstrom lasts until the start of your next turn. A reality maelstrom is a one-way portal, so nothing ever emerges from the hole the spell makes.
**Replaces:** __Animate Dead__

You channel necromantic energy to raise a corpse as an undead servant. Choose a pile of bones or corpse within range, which belonged in life to a humanoid of challenge rating 2 or lower. The target is raised as a skeleton or zombie, respectively, applying the Skeleton or Zombie template to its former stat block.

On each of your turns, you can use a bonus action to mentally command any or all minions you have created through this spell within 60 feet. You select an action for each creature and where it will move. If you issue no command, the creature moves to attack any creatures hostile to it or takes the Dodge action if it cannot detect any.

The creature is under your control for 24 hours, after which it becomes hostile to you and all living things. You can control a number of minions up to your proficiency bonus through this spell, but their combined challenge rating cannot exceed 3, and you must wait 24 hours after creating one before you can create another. If you cast the spell while you have any controlled reanimated servants, you may renew the duration of their control rather than creating a new one.
*Note that if applied to commoners or other minimal-threat humanoids, these will produce ordinary skeletons and zombies.*

description.name: Skeleton Template
description.value: When reanimated as a skeleton, a creature receives the following modifications:

• Its type becomes Undead.
• Its Strength becomes 10 if it was lower.
• Its Dexterity becomes 14 if it was lower.
• Its Constitution becomes 15, Its Intelligence becomes 6, its Wisdom becomes 8, and its Charisma becomes 5.
• It gains vulnerability to bludgeoning damage, immunity to poison damage, and immunity to the exhaustion and poisoned conditions.
• It has 60-foot darkvision.
• Its hit points become 13 if they were lower than 13.

It retains its weapon and armor proficiencies, and any damage resistances or immunities. It loses all languages, but can understand its creator's speech. It retains any natural weapon attacks. Other features are generally lost, but may be retained at your GM's discretion.

description.name: Zombie Template
description.value: When reanimated as a zombie, a creature receives the following modifications:

• Its type becomes Undead.
• Its Strength becomes 13 if it was lower.
• Its Dexterity becomes 6 if it was higher.
• Its Constitution becomes 16, Its Intelligence becomes 3, its Wisdom becomes 6, and its Charisma becomes 5.
• Its speed is reduced by 10 feet.
• It gains immunity to poison damage, and immunity to the poisoned condition.
• It has 60-foot darkvision.
• Its hit points become 22 if they were lower than 22.
• It gains the trait: Undead Fortitude. If damage reduces the zombie to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 hit point instead.

It retains its weapon and armor proficiencies, and any damage resistances or immunities. It loses all languages, but can understand its creator's speech. It retains any natural weapon attacks. Other features are generally lost, but may be retained at your GM's discretion.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the target's maximum challenge rating and the combined maximum challenge rating of your minions both increase by 1 for each slot level above 3rd. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of a 4th level or higher, you can also reanimate beast corpses. If you use a slot of 5th level or higher, you can reanimate giant or monstrosity corpses.

You summon a mighty surge of necromantic power to revive the dead as undead servants. Choose a number of bone piles or corpses within range up to your proficiency bonus, which belonged in life to a creature of challenge rating 6 or lower. Each target is raised as a skeleton, zombie, or ghoul, applying the appropriate template to its former stat block.

On each of your turns, you can use a bonus action to mentally command any or all minions you created through this spell within 60 feet. You select an action for each creature and where it will move. If you issue no command, the creature moves to attack any creatures hostile to it or takes the Dodge action if it cannot detect any.

The targets are under your control for 24 hours, after which they become hostile to you and all living things. You can control a number of minions up to your proficiency bonus through this spell, but their combined challenge rating cannot exceed 10. You can cast this spell without any targets to renew the duration of control on all your current minions, as well as any created through __reanimation__. Minions created through __reanimation__ also count towards the challenge rating limit of 10.
*Note that if applied to commoners or other minimal-threat humanoids, these will produce ordinary skeletons, zombies, and ghouls.*

description.name: Skeleton Template
description.value: When reanimated as a skeleton, a creature receives the following modifications:

• Its type becomes Undead.
• Its Strength becomes 10 if it was lower.
• Its Dexterity becomes 14 if it was lower.
• Its Constitution becomes 15, Its Intelligence becomes 6, its Wisdom becomes 8, and its Charisma becomes 5.
• It gains vulnerability to bludgeoning damage, immunity to poison damage, and immunity to the exhaustion and poisoned conditions.
• It has 60-foot darkvision.
• Its hit points become 13 if they were lower than 13.
• Its challenge rating becomes 1/4 if it was lower than 1/4.

A reanimated creature retains its weapon and armor proficiencies and any damage resistances or immunities. It loses all languages, but can understand its creator's speech. It retains any natural weapon attacks. Other features are generally lost, but may be retained at your GM's discretion.

description.name: Zombie Template
description.value: When reanimated as a zombie, a creature receives the following modifications:

• Its type becomes Undead.
• Its Strength becomes 13 if it was lower.
• Its Dexterity becomes 6 if it was higher.
• Its Constitution becomes 16, Its Intelligence becomes 3, its Wisdom becomes 6, and its Charisma becomes 5.
• Its speed is reduced by 10 feet.
• It gains immunity to poison damage, and immunity to the poisoned condition.
• It has 60-foot darkvision.
• Its hit points become 22 if they were lower than 22.
• Its challenge rating becomes 1/4 if it was lower than 1/4.
• It gains the trait: **Undead Fortitude.** If damage reduces the zombie to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 hit point instead.

A reanimated creature retains its weapon and armor proficiencies and any damage resistances or immunities. It loses all languages, but can understand its creator's speech. It retains any natural weapon attacks. Other features are generally lost, but may be retained at your GM's discretion.

description.name: Ghoul Template
description.value: When reanimated as a ghoul, a creature receives the following modifications:

• Its type becomes Undead.
• Its Strength becomes 13 if it was lower.
• Its Dexterity becomes 15 if it was higher.
• Its Constitution becomes 10, Its Intelligence becomes 7, its Wisdom becomes 10, and its Charisma becomes 6.
• It gains immunity to poison damage, and immunity to the charmed, exhausted, and poisoned conditions.
• It has 60-foot darkvision.
• Its hit points become 22 if they were lower than 22.
• Its challenge rating becomes 1 if it was lower than 1.
• It gains a bite attack, which deals **2d6** damage on a hit.
• It gains a claw attack, which deals **2d4** damage on a hit and can use its Dexterity modifier in place of Strength. Additionally, once on each of its turns when it hits with this attack, it can force the target to make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for one minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Elves and the undead are immune to this effect.

A reanimated creature retains its weapon and armor proficiencies and any damage resistances or immunities. It loses all languages, but can understand its creator's speech. It retains any natural weapon attacks. Other features are generally lost, but may be retained at your GM's discretion.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level, its duration increases to 1 week. If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th level or higher, its duration is permanent.

Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range. Any spell of 9th level or lower on the target ends. For each spell that you dispel of 5th level or lower, you can reave that spell instead. When you reave a spell, all of that spell's effects are redirected to you for the remaining duration, as though you had been the original target of the spell. If a spell you reave requires *Concentration*, you must concentrate to maintain the spell's effects as if you had cast it yourself. This spell does not allow you to concentrate on any additional spells, and if you reave multiple spells that require *Concentration*, you may choose which one to concentrate on.

name: Rebuke
components: V, S, M (a stick at least 1 foot long)

description.value: With a harsh word and a sharp gesture, a creature you can see in range must make a Wisdom saving throw. The target takes **2d10** psychic damage and is incapacitated until the start of your next turn on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10  for each slot level above 2nd. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the target instantly dies instead of being incapacitated on a failed save if its Challenge Rating is equal to or less than 5 (or the target's level, if it does not have a Challenge Rating).

name: Reciprocal Gyre
components: V, S, M (a tiny loop of copper wire)

description.value: You manipulate the magical aura of a creature or object you can see in range, creating a damaging feedback of arcane power. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. The target takes **8d6** force damage and an additional **2d6** force damage for each spell currently affecting the target on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage per spell increases by 2d6 for each slot level above 5th.

name: Reclaimed Shrapnel
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take immediately before or after a creature you can touch would fail a saving throw

description.value: You push a piece of shrapnel into each wound where they melt into golden light. Heal the target 2d2 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell at higher levels, add 2d2 for each additional level.

A surging wave of thick, red seawater washes over everything in an area within range. The area can be up to 120 feet long, up to 20 feet wide and up to 10 feet tall. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw.

On a failed save, a creature takes **12d8** bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. On a successful save the creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone. The wave extinguishes unprotected flames.

In addition, a creature damaged by this spell is poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, a creature takes **2d8** poison damage at the end of each of its turns and must make a Constitution saving throw. On a successful save the creature is no longer poisoned.

name: Reflect
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take before a creature you can touch is targeted by a spell.

description.value: The spell your reflecting must choose specific targets or be a line area of effect. The creature that casted the spell must make a constitution saving throw. Subtract the level of the spell you're reflecting from half the level your casting this spell at rounded up. Add the total to your Spell Save DC. On a failure, the spell is reflected. If the spell chooses specific targets, change the target to a creature you can see within the reflected spell's remaining range. If the spell is a line area of effect, change its direction starting at a point on the line you can touch.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: Special (see description)

You cover yourself in a special form of glamer. For the duration, or until you use your action to dismiss the spell, any creature that sees you perceives you as the same species and gender as itself, dressed in an outfit that they would consider appropriate for the current scenario and speaking in a voice that sounds appropriate to your appearance. The changes fail to hold up to physical inspection and a creature that uses its action to inspect your appearance must succeed on an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to see through your glamer.
This spell has no effect on creatures with an Intelligence of 3 or less and on creatures more than one size category larger or smaller than you.

name: Refusal
components: V, S, M (a pinch of dust from a wizard's tomb)

description.value: You create a special ward that prevents unauthorized spellcasters from entering a 20-foot radius sphere centered on a point in range. For the duration, any creature that can currently cast a 1st level spell or higher must make a Charisma saving throw when attempting to enter the area. On a failed save, the creature is halted by an invisible barrier that prevents passage for 1 hour.

If a creature attempts to use any teleportation spell or effect to enter the warded area it must first make a saving throw, being shunted harmlessly to the nearest unoccupied space outside the warded area on a failure.

When you first cast this spell you can designate any number of creatures to be unaffected. In addition, you may choose to designate a password or special condition by which creatures can enter the warded area.

With a stern word and a sharp gesture, you send your enemies flying away from you. Each creature of your choice in a 30-foot cone must make a Strength saving throw. A creature is pushed 60 feet directly away from you on a failed save, or half as far on a successful one. If a creature is pushed into an object or solid surface, it takes 1d6 points of bludgeoning damage for every 5 feet it was pushed and falls prone.
**Replaces:** __Regenerate__

You touch a creature and imbue it with miraculous life, causing its flesh to knit back together and repair itself. For the duration of the spell, the target gains 10 hit points at the start of each of its turns. If you reach your hit point maximum while affected by this spell, then scars are healed, missing limbs or digits regrow, and permanent wounds are fully mended.
The spell ends early if the target takes a single instance of fire or acid damage equal to or greater than twice your level.

name: Rejuvenation Cocoon
components: V, S, M (a cocoon of a butterfly)

description.value: You touch a willing creature, drawing a cocoon of glowing yellow-green energy around them. At the start of each of its turns, the target regains 10 hit points and is cured of one disease or the poisoned condition. As an action, you or the creature inside the cocoon can end the spell prematurely. While inside the cocoon, the target cannot move or speak, has total cover, and the only action it can take is to end the spell. The cocoon has an AC of 10 and 50 hit points. If it is destroyed, the spell ends immediately.
This spell has no effect on Constructs or Undead.

name: Relay
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when a willing creature targets you with a ranged effect

description.value: You help guide a projectile, spell, or other ranged effect to its true target. Change the target to a creature or object you can see within a number of feet equal to the effect's remaining range.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell at higher levels, add 10 to the distance you can choose a new target within for each additional level.

At your touch, all curses with a spell level of 3 or less affecting one creature or object end. If the object is a cursed magic item, its curse remains, but the spell breaks its owner's Attunement to the object so it can be removed or discarded.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell at higher levels, increase the level of curse it can remove by 1 for each additional level.

name: Renewal Pact
components: V, S, M (a topaz worth at least 500 gp, which the spell consumes)

description.value: You bind a protective spell to a willing creature. The pact remains dormant until the target is subjected to one of the following effects, at which point the spell is triggered:

• One effect that charmed or petrified the target.
• One curse, including the target's attunement to a cursed magic item.
• Any reduction to one of the target's ability scores.
• One effect reducing the target's hit point maximum.
When triggered, the effect that triggered the pact immediately ends and the target gains 4d8 temporary hit points. A creature can only be subject to one Renewal Pact at a time.
A Construct or Undead creature you touch regains a number of hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the healing increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st.
For the duration, the willing creature you touch has resistance to one damage type of your choice: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you may target one additional creature for each slot level above 3rd. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, it no longer requires *Concentration*.

name: Resistance
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when a willing creature within 10 feet would fail a saving throw

description.value: Add a d4, potentially turning it into a success. Do not add it if a positive bonus has already been applied to the roll by a spell. You can cast this once and regain all uses after a short rest.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The number of uses increases by 1 at 5th level (2 uses), 11th level (3 uses), and 17th level (4 uses).
You weave a protective mantle of magic around one willing creature you touch. Once per turn, when the target is forced to make a saving throw it can gain a 1d4 bonus to its roll.

You unleash a tremendous bolt of thunderous energy from your open hand in a 60-foot long, 5 foot wide line in a direction you choose. Each creature and object in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes **8d6** thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Resonating Bolt can easily shatter or break interposing barriers. If the bolt deals enough damage to destroy a barrier, creatures behind it gain no benefit from the cover it would have provided.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.
You touch a willing creature and instantly end one disease or one of the following conditions currently afflicting it: blinded, deafened, frightened, paralyzed, or poisoned.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd-level or higher, the conditions and effects you can end increase, but the spell requires you to expend diamond dust of a certain value, which is consumed during casting:

value.title: Restoration
rows: Reduction to one Ability Score or Hit Point Maximum
Petrified, One Curse, or Attunement to a Cursed Item

name: Restoration, Mass
components: V, S, M (diamond dust worth at least 1000 gp, which the spell consumes)

description.value: You imbue up to ten creatures in range with positive energy to undo a debilitating effect. You can reduce a target's exhaustion level by one, or end one of the following effects on a target:

• One effect that charmed or petrified the target.
• One curse, including the target's attunement to a cursed magic item.
• Any reduction to one of the target's ability scores.
• One effect reducing the target's hit point maximum.

name: Restore Youth
components: V, S, M (gold dust worth 500+ GP, which the spell consumes)

description.value: You perform a complex ritual for a creature you touch, reducing its apparent age by 2d10 years, to a minimum of 18 years. This spell doesn't extend the creature's lifespan.

You appeal to a greater power to grant up to three creatures of your choice within range a second chance. Each target chooses one ongoing spell or magical effect that allows a saving throw at the beginning or end of their turn. The target re-rolls their saving throw, ending the spell or effect for that creature on a successful save.

name: Resurrection
components: V, S, M (a diamond worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes)

description.value: You touch a creature that has has been dead for no longer than a century, didn't die of old age, and wasn't Undead when it died. It must make a DC 10 death saving throw.

On a success, it is revived with all of its Hit Points. If its also a natural 20, the spell does not consume its material component. On a failure, this spell cannot be used to revive this creature. This restriction ends if the creature is revived through other means. If its also a natural 1, it can never be revived.
Any poisons that affected the creature at its time of death are neutralized. All mortal wounds on the revived creature are closed and any of the revived creature's missing body parts are restored.
Any poisons that affected the revived creature at its time of death are neutralized. All mortal wounds on the revived creature close and any missing body parts are restored.
Coming back from the dead is an ordeal. The revived creature takes 2 levels of exhaustion.
Successfully reviving a creature that has been dead for 365 days or longer taxes you. Until you finish a Long Rest, you can't cast spells again, and you have Disadvantage on D20 Tests.

You touch the body of a creature that has been dead for up to three days, calling on the living memory of the creature to reveal information about the events that led up to its death. The corpse speaks tersely in its native language, using no more than a dozen words or so in a round. In the first round, it describes the last thing it saw. In the second, it describes its dying wish. In the third, it describes the attack that killed it. In the fourth, it tells who killed it. In the fifth, it tells why it believes it was killed. The spell automatically fails if cast on a creature that did not speak any languages.

You touch a creature that has died within the last hour. If its soul is free and willing, the target returns to life with half of its maximum hit points. This spell can't return to life a creature that has died of old age, nor can it restore any missing body parts. While the spell lasts, the target has advantage on all attack rolls against the creature that killed them. If the target kills the creature that killed them, or at the end of the duration, the spell ends and the target dies.

name: Reverse Arrows
components: V, S, M (a piece of tortoise shell and a ball of tree sap)

description.value: A silver radiance flecked with blue lines surrounds you. For the duration, whenever you are hit by a ranged weapon attack, the damage you take from the attack is reduced by 1d6 + your spellcasting modifier.

In addition, when a ranged weapon attack misses you, you can use your reaction to turn the attack back upon the creature that fired it. Make a ranged spell attack against the attacker. On a hit, the target suffers the weapon attack's normal effects and takes an additional **2d8** force damage.
As a bonus action you can heal a creature of your choice, you can see within 30 feet. The creature regains 2d6 Hit Points.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The extra damage increases by **2d6** for each level after 1st.

name: Revivify
components: V, S, M (a diamond worth 300+ GP, which the spell consumes)

description.value: You touch a creature that has been dead for no longer than a minute. It must make a DC 10 death saving throw.

On a success, the creature is revived with 1 Hit Point. If its also a natural 20, the spell does not consume its material component. On a failure, this spell cannot be used to revive this creature. This restriction ends if the creature is revived through other means. If its also a natural 1, the creature can never be revived.
This spell can't revive a creature that has died of old age, nor does it restore any missing body parts.
You invoke your divine power, bursting alight with a golden radiance. For the duration, you shed bright light in a 30-foot-radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet.

If you are reduced to 0 hit points while the aura lasts, you unleash a final explosive blast of divine power and the spell ends. Each creature of your choice in a 20 foot-radius sphere centered on you must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes **6d10** radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

You call a holy aura around yourself that glows golden red. You gain 20 temporary hit points and have advantage on attack rolls that you make with simple and martial weapons while the spell lasts. These temporary hit points are lost when the spell ends.

You fire your allies and companions with divine fury. Choose up to four willing creatures you can see in range. For the duration, whenever one of those creatures takes the attack action, it can make one additional attack as part of that action.

You conjure forth a ring of swirling metal blades in a 10-foot radius sphere centered on you, which moves with you. When a creature other than you enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Dexterity saving throw. The creature takes **5d6** slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.
**Replaces:** __Tidal Wave__

You conjure a sudden wave in a 20-foot square on the ground or in a body of water which you can see within range. Each creature in the area must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it takes **4d8** bludgeoning damage and a Huge or smaller creature is knocked prone. On a success, it takes half as much damage and is not knocked prone. All creatures failing the save are moved 15 feet in a direction of your choice.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell with a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by **1d8** and the distance moved on a failed save increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Rope Trick
components: V, S, M (a segment of rope)

description.value: You touch a rope. One end of it hovers upward until the rope hangs perpendicular to the ground or the rope reaches a ceiling. At the rope's upper end, an Invisible 3-foot-by-5-foot portal opens to an extradimensional space that lasts until the spell ends. That space can be reached by climbing the rope As an action, the roped can be pulled into or dropped out of that space.

The space can hold up to eight Medium or smaller creatures. Attacks, spells, and other effects can't pass into or out of the space, but creatures inside it can see through the portal. Anything inside the space drops out when the spell ends.
**Replaces:** __Blight__

You infuse a creature with a powerful burst of necrotic power, causing its flesh to blacken and fall away. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target takes **9d8** necrotic damage and has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of your next turn. On a success, it takes half as much damage and suffers no other effects.
Constructs and undead automatically succeed on this saving throw, while plants have disadvantage.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by **1d8** for each slot level above 4th.

A red haze clouds the eyes of a creature that meets your gaze. A creature you choose within range must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be cursed for the duration. While cursed, the target can see normally out to a range of 5 feet, but has the Blinded condition beyond this range.

name: Ruin Delver's Fortune
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when you fail an ability check or saving throw

description.value: With a desperate word, you imbue yourself with a bit of extra luck when you need it most. For the duration of the spell, you gain a bonus to the ability check or saving throw that triggered this spell equal to your spellcasting ability modifier. This bonus applies to the triggering roll.

You magically spread a rumor of 10 words or less in a 100-foot Emanation centered on you. Any creature within the Emanation that is near three or more other creatures that share a common language believes that they hear the rumor being repeated by someone nearby. Different creatures hear the rumor from different people, so a concrete origin point is impossible to discern. Generally, creatures won't become Hostile upon hearing even the most vicious rumors, but hearing a rumor can affect their attitude positively or negatively.

name: Rust Ray
components: V, S, M (a piece of a rust monster antenna)

description.value: You unleash a russet ray at an object you can see in range. If the object is made of nonmagical metal and is not being worn or carried, a 1-foot cube of it is destroyed. If the object is being worn or carried by a creature, the creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a successful save, nothing happens. On a failed save, the item begins to corrode. If the object is either metal armor or a metal shield, it takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 or a shield that drops to a +0 bonus is destroyed. If the object is a held metal weapon, it takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage tolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. If the target is any other kind of object, it takes 10 force damage, ignoring the damage threshold of the target.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the penalty for weapons, armor and shields increases by -1 and the damage to other objects increases by 10 for every two slot levels above 1st.

You conjure a potent acid at your fingertips, which can corrode metal and burn flesh. Make a melee spell attack against a creature or object within your reach. On a hit, a creature takes **6d4** Acid damage and it has a -3 penalty to its AC, to a minimum of 10, for 1 hour.
If you target a nonmagical metal object with this spell that isn't being worn or carried, you corrode and destroy parts of the object you choose that can fit within a 1-foot Cube.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The damage increases by 2d4 for each spell slot level above 3. If you target a nonmagical object, you can destroy an additional cubic foot for each slot level above 3.

name: Sacred Circle
components: V, S, M (a piece of turquoise mounted in silver)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Dispel Evil and Good__

You create a 60-foot radius, 120-foot tall cylinder of resonating planar energy centered on a point on the ground that you can see within range. Until the spell ends, aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead have disadvantage on attack rolls against three creatures of your choice within the cylinder.
As an action, you may remove any charm, fear, or possession effects caused by creatures of those types from a creature of your choice within the cylinder.
Additionally, you can choose whether to allow or block teleportation, interplanar travel, or creatures being summoned within the cylinder.

You shield one willing creature with a nimbus of holy energy, granting it a +2 bonus to AC. In addition, you gain an awareness of the target's health and location. For the duration, you are aware of the direction and distance to the creature so long as it is on the same plane of existence and know any conditions affecting them. These benefits last for the duration or until you cast this spell again.
While the spell lasts, you can use a bonus action to immediately teleport the target to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you, provided it is on the same plane of existence as you.
**Replaces:** __Divine Favor__
You ask for a divine blessing on your weapon, empowering it against your foes. For the duration, your weapon attacks deal an extra **1d6** radiant damage.

You ward a 15-foot radius sphere, centered on a point you can see in range, against attack. The area is dimly lit by tiny glittering motes reminiscent of fireflies. Until the spell ends, any creature who targets a creature in the area with an attack or harmful spell must first make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must choose a new target outside the area or lose the attack or spell. A  creature has disadvantage on its saving throw if it is in the area. This spell doesn't protect the warded creatures from area effects, such as the explosion of a fireball. If a warded creature makes an attack, casts a spell that affects an enemy creature, or deals damage to another creature, they are no longer warded by the safe clearing and may be attacked normally.
The area lasts for the duration or until you use an action to end the spell early.

name: Safekeeping
components: V, S, M (a thread of flax covered with powder from precious gems worth at least 1000 gp per target, which the spell consumes)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Sequester__
You touch up to 8 willing creatures or objects, hiding each target for the duration. You can turn each target invisible or into an object of the same size, such as a statue or full-length portrait.
Divination spells can't locate or perceive the target. A creature is incapacitated and doesn't age or need to breathe, eat, or drink. The spell ends on a target if it takes any damage.
You can also define a condition for the spell to end early (your GM must approve the condition).

A thin shaft of whirling salt crystals lances out from your crooked finger to strike and shred a creature you can see in range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes **3d8** slashing damage and must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it is also incapacitated until the end of its next turn.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Sanction
components: V, S, M (a drop of blood)

description.value: You fling a drop of blood at a creature you can see within range, which must succeed a Constitution saving throw or be marked for the duration. Whenever you take damage, the marked target takes **1d8** Necrotic or Radiant damage (your choice). The spell ends early if you end your turn more than 30 feet away from the target.

Whipping your hand in a wide arc, you spray sand from your fingers in a powerful blast. Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes **2d6** piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. In addition, a creature that fails its saving throw is blinded for 1 minute or until it uses an action to clear its eyes.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st.

name: Sarcophagus of Stone
components: V, S, M (a fragment of a sarcophagus)

description.value: The ground shakes as stone erupts around a Large or smaller creature or object you can see in range, taking the form of a sarcophagus that snaps shut around them. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be entombed. While entombed, the target is restrained and has total cover from other creatures.
The sarcophagus is airtight and only just large enough to hold the target, containing 1 hour worth of air. The sarcophagus is an object with an AC of 17, 50 hit points and a damage threshold of 5.

Choose a willing creature you can see. For the duration any creatures angered, frightened or charmed by you treat the target as the source of their anger, their fear or the charm while it is within 10 ft of you.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: If you cast this spell at a higher level, increase the range by 10 ft for each additional level.

Choose a small collection of up to six objects in range that aren't being worn or carried, each of which must weigh less than 1 pound. Each object flies up to 30 feet in a direction you choose before falling to the ground, stopping only if it impacts against a solid surface. If the object would strike a creature, that creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the object strikes the target and stops moving. When the object strikes something, both the object and the target each take **1d4** piercing damage.
Each of the six objects may fly in different directions or the same.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you may target two additional objects for each slot level above 1st.
**Replaces:** __Prismatic Spray__

You send a shimmering wave of force outward, striking each creature within a 60-foot cone with a random blast of magic. Roll 1d8 on the table below for each target struck by the blast. That creature must make a Dexterity saving throw, suffering the effects below on a failure or half the initial damage and no additional effects on a success.

rows: The target takes 12d4 acid damage and another 12d4 acid damage at the end of its next turn.
The target takes 9d8 cold damage and is restrained until the end of its next turn.
The target takes 6d12 lightning damage, and until the end of its next turn, cannot take reactions and has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.
The target takes 6d12 poison damage and is poisoned until the end of its next turn.
The target takes 9d8 psychic damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn.
The target takes 9d8 thunder damage, is knocked backwards 30 feet, and falls prone.
The target is struck by multiple blasts. Roll twice more, rerolling any 8's.

description.value: Your skin glistens and shimmers with a silvery protective aura reminiscent of scales. For the duration, your armor class equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your spellcasting ability modifier so long as you are not wearing any armor.

A tiny sphere streaks from your fingers to a point you can see in range, trailing the smell of ozone, and detonates into a burst of spherical lightning. Each creature and object not being worn or carried in a 20-foot radius sphere centered on that point must make a Constitution saving throw. A target takes **8d6** lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Scorch
components: V, S, M (a red dragon's scale)

description.value: A jet of roaring flame bursts from your outstretched hand in a 30 foot long, 5 foot wide line in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes **3d10** fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The flames ignite flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Scourge
components: V, S, M (a black whip or riding crop)

description.value: You choose up to three creatures you can see in range, causing their bodies to erupt with painful and debilitating boils, lesions, seeping abscesses and malignant cysts. Each target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes **10d6** necrotic damage and is infected with a magical disease, reducing its Strength and Dexterity scores by 2d6. The reduction caused by this spell lasts until the disease is cured. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage, and suffers no additional effects.

While it is infected, a target must make a Constitution saving throw at the start of each day. On a failed save, the target has its Strength and Dexterity reduced by an additional 1d6. The disease lasts until the target succeeds on three of these saves or until it reaches 0 Strength or Dexterity, at which point the target dies.
This spell has no effect on Undead or Constructs.

You discern minute details concerning one creature you can see within range. You learn two of the following pieces of information of your choice about the target: its Armor Class, Speeds, Immunities (if any), Resistances (if any), highest ability score, lowest ability score, and enchantments (which reveals which spells, if any, are currently affecting the target). The GM must share with you the chosen information.

A nonmagical object you choose within range sprouts legs and runs away. You can't target an object that weighs more than 10 pounds, nor can you target one that is being worn; however, you can target certain objects that are being carried, as long as they aren't affixed entirely around a creature's body or being held in a hand. For example, you can't target a creature's helmet or a sword it is wielding, but you can target a drawstring pouch it is wearing or a dagger that is sheathed at its side.

The object animates, wriggles free of its owner (if it has one), sprouts two legs, and moves 20 feet in a direction you choose. At the start of each of your turns, you can choose which direction the object moves. The object has an AC of 10, if its AC wasn't already higher. The spell ends early if the object is reduced to 0 Hit Points or is picked up.

name: Seal Away
components: V, S, M (a sculpted or painted likeness of the target, and black emeralds worth at least 200 gp per Hit Die of the target)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Imprisonment__

You prepare a magical prison, trapping a creature you can see within range for eternity. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be imprisoned. On a success, it is immune to this spell for 1 year. While imprisoned in this way, the target does not age, does not need to eat, breathe, or drink, and cannot be found by any divination magic. You select the form of the prison when you cast the spell. Common options would be a sealed demiplane, miniaturized within a gemstone, or trapped in a cavity deep below the ground.

When you cast the spell, you must specify the condition by which the target can be freed. The condition can be as elaborate or as specific as you desire, but it must be reasonable and possible (your GM must approve the condition). The condition can involve a creature's name, identity, or characteristics, but not game concepts such as level, class, or hit points. Dispel magic cannot free the target. If the condition comes to pass, the target is instantly freed.

You create a 20ft diameter circle centered on a point you touch. As a bonus action you can force every aberration, fey, fiend, celestial, elemental or undead adjacent to or overlapping the circle to make a charisma saving throw. If it fails three times in a row, it is imprisoned in a harmless demiplane. While imprisoned, the target doesn't need to breathe, eat, or drink, and it doesn't age. Divination spells can't locate or perceive the imprisoned target, and the target can't teleport. If you concentrate on this spell for the full duration, you no longer need to concentrate on it, you can no longer use your bonus action to activate it and it lasts for a day. When the spell ends, the creatures reappears in an occupied space nearest to the seal.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell at a higher level, increase how long the seal lasts after *Concentrating* on it for the full duration to a week at 6th level, 30 days at 7th level, a year at 8th level or until dispelled at 9th level.
You channel minor spirits, allowing them to work through you so that they may once again affect change in the material world. You create one of the following effects within range:

• You create an instantaneous, harmless sensory effect, such as a flickering azure flame, an unnaturally chill breeze, rhythmic chanting, or the smell of incense.
• A minor spirit briefly appears and fades away.
• You instantaneously light or snuff out a candle, torch, or a small campfire.
• A mote or iridescent light points to the closest place of spiritual power, recent death, or new birth.
• Ley lines within range briefly reveal themselves as they flicker with otherworldly light.

name: Séance
components: V, S, M (a crystal ball, deck of tarot cards, or ouija board, and incense worth 50+ GP)

description.value: You and three or more willing creatures lock hands to conjure a spirit from the afterlife to answer your questions. Describe or name a creature that is familiar to you. If the creature's soul is free and willing, it manifests as a ghostly specter. This spell fails if the spirit was the target of this spell within the last 10 days.

Until the spell ends, you can ask up to three questions of the specter. The specter knows only what it knew in life, including the languages it knew. Answers are usually brief, cryptic, or repetitive, and the specter is under no compulsion to offer a truthful answer if you are hostile to it or it recognizes you as an enemy. There is a 5 percent chance that this spell contacts the wrong spirit, one which will answer questions untruthfully or ambiguously.

name: Searing Smite (Alternate)
components: V, M (a melee weapon worth at least 1 sp)

description.value: When you hit with a melee weapon attack you can cause the weapon to ignite with white-hot intensity. This attack deals **1d8** additional fire damage and the target bursts into flames. At the start of each of its turns, it must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes **1d8** fire damage, but on a success, the flames are extinguished. Another creature can use an action to extinguish these magical flames.
If your target is a plant, both the initial fire damage and the fire damage dealt on a failed saving throw increase by **1d8**.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd-level or higher, both the initial fire damage dealt by the attack and the fire damage dealt to the creature on a failed saving throw increase by **1d8** for each slot.

name: Secret Enclave
components: V, S, M (a tiny, silver bell)

description.value: You conjure a shimmering, 10-foot wide multicolored portal within range that leads to a demiplane. When you cast the spell, you also enchant an object that can fit within an 5-foot Cube, which becomes the demiplane's portal key.

The demiplane is a 1,000-foot Cube that resembles a magical forest of the Feywild. The floor is made of fertile soil that can't be burrowed through. The portal into the demiplane and the matching portal out of the demiplane opens only while the portal key is within 60 feet of the portal. Once the demiplane is created, the location of its portal is fixed and it can only be opened from that same location.
You or anyone else within 60 feet of the portal can open the portal by casting this spell again. You can also create a replacement portal key or a duplicate one by casting this spell again.
The portal key and any creature within the demiplane can't be targeted by any Divination spell, though a Wish spell can reveal the location of the portal key.
You can create Secret Enclaves within Secret Enclaves, but only if the original demiplane was created by you.

name: Secret Missive
components: S, M (magical ink worth at least 10 gp, which the spell consumes)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Illusory Script__

You pen a secret message on a parchment, paper, or other writing material. When you write the message, choose a password or passphrase; when a creature speaks this code while holding the parchment, the secret message appears for 10 minutes before fading again. Alternatively, you can specify a creature. The message automatically appears when it holds the parchment. You can write any other text on the parchment, which becomes invisible anytime the secret message is displayed. When the spell ends, the secret message disappears forever.
Creatures with truesight can see the secret message. A dispel magic cast on the parchment ends the spell without revealing the secret message.

The spell's duration is related to the quality of ink used. Magical ink worth 10 gp gives it a duration of 10 days. More expensive ink lasts an additional day for each 1 gp spent; if 100 gp worth of magical ink is used, the duration becomes permanent.

name: See Invisibility
components: V, S, M (a pinch of talc)

description.value: For the duration, a creature you can see within 30 ft can see creatures and objects that have the Invisible condition as if they were visible, and you can see into the Ethereal Plane. Creatures and objects there appear ghostly.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The number of creatures you can choose increases by 1 for each spell slot above 3

name: Sensory Deprivation
components: V, S, M (black silk cloth tied like a blindfold)

description.value: You surround a foe with a black aura, creating an illusion of absolute nothingness. Choose one creature that you can see within range to make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target is surrounded in dark, clinging shadows for the duration. The shadows block all auditory, olfactory, taste and visual sensations, leaving the target blinded and deafened. In addition, the target gains no benefit from blindsight or Tremorsense and automatically fails Perception checks based on scent.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 4th.
You imbue yourself with an ethereal quality, inducing others to trust what you say. For the duration, you have a +5 bonus to Charisma (Deception) and Charisma (Persuasion) checks.

name: Servant Horde
components: V, S, M (a small crossbar to which many lengths of knotted thread are attached)

description.value: This spell creates a number of invisible, mindless, shapeless forces that perform simple tasks at your command. Each servant springs into existence in an unoccupied space on the ground within range. A servant has AC 10, 1 hit point, and a Strength of 2, and it can't attack. If a servant drops to 0 hit points, the servant dissipates. The spell ends when your last servant dissipates or you cast this spell again.

Once on each of your turns as a bonus action, you can mentally command any number of servants to move up to 15 feet and interact with an object. A servant can perform simple tasks that a human servant could do, such as fetching things, cleaning, mending, folding clothes, lighting fires, serving food, and pouring wine. Once you give the command, a servant performs the task to the best of its ability until it completes the task, then waits for your next command.
If you command a servant to perform a task that would move it more than 300 feet away from you, the servant dissipates.

name: Shadow Binding
components: V, S, M (a few links of iron chain)

description.value: You cause a multitude of ribbonlike shadows to explode outward in a 15-foot radius sphere centered on a point you can see in range. Each creature in the area must make an Intelligence saving throw. A creature takes **4d6** psychic damage and is incapacitated until the start of your next turn on a failed save, or takes half as much damage and is not incapacitated on a successful one.

In addition, each creature that fails its saving throw is restrained by the shadows for the duration. A creature restrained by the shadows can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC. On a success, it frees itself.

name: Shadow Form
components: V, S, M (a small piece of black cloth taken from a funeral shroud)

description.value: Shadows rise from the ground to envelop you, lightly obscuring whatever space you are in for the duration. In addition, you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) and Dexterity (Acrobatics) skill checks. Standing in an area of sunlight suppresses this spell until you leave the area.

As an action while the spell lasts, you can slip through a solid object or barrier up to 5 feet thick, taking up to 1 willing creature you touch with you. Once you have done so a number of times equal to your spellcasting modifier, the spell ends.

You infuse the nearby landscape with power siphoned from the Shadowfell, making the surrounding terrain a more savage, dangerous place. The terrain in a 1-mile radius centered on the location where you cast this spell is affected for the duration.

The entire area becomes considerably more dangerous (Light undergrowth becomes wild and filled with thorns, cliffs become slippery and treacherous, canopies of rotting leaves block the sun, etc). The entire area is considered difficult terrain and all Wisdom (Survival) checks are made with disadvantage. In addition, any rolls for random weather or environmental hazards are made twice, with the more severe option being chosen. When you initially cast this spell, you may designate any number of creatures to be immune to these effects. Any shadow guardians are also immune to these effects.

You can call forth shadow guardians so long as you remain in the area. As an action, you can call forth up to four beasts of challenge rating 2 or lower. These guardians are fey spirits that take the form of beasts and appear in unoccupied spaces that you can see within range. A shadow guardian disappears when it drops to 0 hit points, when the spell ends, or 1 hour after being summoned. The shadow guardians are friendly to you and your companions. The shadow guardians take their own turns as a group, immediately after you in initiative. They obey any verbal commands that you issue to them (no action required by you). If you don't issue any commands to them, they defend themselves from hostile creatures, but otherwise take no actions. The shadow guardians will not leave the area and disappear immediately if something forces them to leave. The GM has the creatures' statistics. You can only summon shadow guardians once every hour.
If you concentrate on this spell for the full duration, the land becomes permanently tainted by contact with the Shadowfell and the effects last until dispelled.

name: Shadow Mask
components: V, S, M (a mask of black cloth)

description.value: You cause a protective mask of shadows to form around your face. For the duration, sunlight and bright light cannot impose disadvantage on your Perception checks or attack rolls. In addition, you have advantage on rolls against a spell or magical effect that requires you to see the source (such as a Medusa's petrifying gaze).
