You touch a willing creature, temporarily transposing some of their body with shadow-stuff and causing their flesh to take on a wispy, insubstantial appearance. For the duration, the target has resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.

You create a blast of bright light, filling a 20-foot radius sphere centered on a point in range. While the spell lasts, each creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make an Intelligence saving throw or be blinded until the start of its next turn.

name: Shadow Spray
components: V, S, M (a handful of black ribbons)

description.value: As you finish casting this spell, ribbonlike shadows burst outward in the midst of your foes. Each creature in a 5-foot radius sphere centered on a point you can see in range must succeed on a Constitution saving throw. A target takes **4d8** necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one. In addition, on a failed save, a target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken.

You create a well of shadows, which transforms your foe's own shadow into a miniature gateway into the Shadowfell. Each creature in a 10-foot radius sphere centered on a point you can see in range must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be drawn into its own shadow and become trapped in its own pocket realm within the Shadowfell. Inside a pocket realm, a target is incapacitated and sees a deserted, gloomy duplicate of the real world, where shadowy phantasms stalk and taunt them without causing actual harm.
A target remains in the pocket realm until the spell ends, at which point the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.

name: Shadowy Grappler
components: V, S, M (a dried squid tentacle)

description.value: You create a spectral force, which appears as an intangible shadow being beside you. When you cast this spell, and as a bonus action on subsequent turns, you can choose a creature you can see in range. At the start of each of the current target's turns, they must make an Intelligence saving throw as the shadow being rushes them. On a failed save, they are knocked prone and restrained. As an action, a creature restrained by a shadow being can attempt an Intelligence saving throw. On a successful save, the target is no longer restrained.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, you create one additional shadow being, which can target the same or different creatures, for each slot level above 6th.
You choose an area of water that you can see within range and that fits within a 5-foot cube. You manipulate it in one of the following ways:

• You instantaneously move or otherwise change the flow of the water as you direct, up to 5 feet in any direction. This movement doesn't have enough force to cause damage. Until the end of your next turn the water is held aloft as long as it is not holding anything else aloft.
• You cause the water to form into simple shapes and animate at your direction. This change lasts for 1 hour.
• You change the water's color or opacity. The water must be changed in the same way throughout. This change lasts for 1 hour.
• You freeze the water, provided that there are no creatures in it. The water unfreezes in 1 hour.
If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have no more than two of its non-instantaneous effects active at a time, and you can dismiss such an effect as an action.
You can manipulate water and use it to assault your enemies. When you cast this spell choose one of the following effects:

description.name: Manipulate Water
description.value: You manipulate water in a 5-foot cube within range, harmlessly changing the direction it is flowing, altering its color or opacity, causing simple animated shapes to appear, or if there are no creatures in it you can freeze it.

description.name: Hurl Wave
description.value: You create a small orb of tempestuous water in your hand and hurl it at one target you can see within range, forcing it to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 1d8 cold damage, and any non-magical flame it is holding, or within 5 feet of it, is instantly extinguished.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The damage of this Cantrip increases by 1d8 at 5th (2d8), 11th (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).
**Replaces:** __Control Winds__

You seize control of the air in a cube up to 300 feet on a side you can see within range, bending it to your will. Choose one of the following effects. The effect persists until the spell ends, or until you use your action to pause it or change it to a different effect. You can resume a paused effect as an action.

**Gale.** A steady wind blows in a horizontal direction of your choice. Every foot of movement against the wind costs 2 extra feet, and ranged attacks made against the wind automatically miss. Creatures moving with the wind can move 1 extra foot for each foot of movement spent. When a creature or projectile moves within the area, you can use your reaction to change the wind's direction. As a bonus action, you can create a gust. All creatures within the area must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 30 feet in the wind's direction.

**Turbulence.** You whip the wind into a chaotic vortex. Ranged attacks passing through the wind are made with disadvantage. Any creature that flies into the wind's area, starts its turn flying there, or takes flight there has its flying speed halved, and must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

**Thermal Column.** You direct the wind to blow upwards. All creatures suffering fall damage within the wind can reduce that damage by five times your spellcasting ability modifier. When a creature within the wind makes a vertical jump, its jump height is tripled.

name: Shapechange
components: V, S, M (a jade circlet worth 1,500+ GP)

description.value: You shape-shift into another creature for the duration or until you take a Magic action to shape-shift into a different eligible form. The new form must be of a creature that has a Challenge Rating no higher than your level or Challenge Rating. You must have seen the sort of creature before, and it can't be a Construct or an Undead.
When you shape-shift, you gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to the Hit Points of the form. The spell ends early if you have no Temporary Hit Points left.

Your game statistics are replaced by the stat block of the chosen form, but you retain your creature type; alignment; personality; Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; Hit Points; Hit Point Dice; proficiencies; and ability to communicate. If you have the Spellcasting feature, you retain it too. You do not gain any traits of the new form that allow for casting spells or changing shape.
Upon shape-shifting, you determine whether your equipment drops to the ground or changes in size and shape to fit the new form while you're in it.

name: Shapechange (Alternate)
components: V, S, M (three interwoven circlets of gold, platinum, and lead, worth at least 1,500 gold)

description.value: You place the material component of this spell on your head and transform into a creature of CR equal to half your level, or lower. It cannot be a Construct or Undead, and you must have seen a living specimen of that creature before. It is an average specimen of that creature, and it cannot have class levels or the Spellcasting feature.

description.name: Statistics
description.value: Your game statistics are replaced by the chosen creature's, though, you retain your alignment, personality, hit points, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. You retain your proficiencies and gain those of the creature. If you both share a proficiency, you can use the higher bonus.
You cannot use Legendary Resistances, Legendary Actions, or Lair Actions even if the chosen creature has them.

description.name: Features
description.value: You retain your features and can use them so long as the chosen creature is capable of doing so. You don't retain special senses, but use the senses of the creature.

description.name: Equipment
description.value: You choose whether your equipment falls to the ground, merges with your new form, or is worn by it. Your equipment does not change size to fit your new form, and you only retain its benefits if the creature you transform into can wear and use the object.

description.name: Shifting
description.value: While the spell lasts, you can use your action to transform again, taking the shape of another creature of your choice, following the same rules and restrictions above.

name: Shard Storm
components: V, S, M (a small shard of glass or crystal)

description.value: You choose a point you can see in range, causing translucent shards of arcane energy to blast outward in a 20-foot radius sphere centered on that point and filling the air with the chiming sound of shattering glass. When you cast this spell, and at the start of each of your turns while the spell lasts, each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes **8d6** force damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
At the start of your turn, you may suppress the storm for 1 round, no action required. When you do so, it deals no damage until the start of your next turn.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 5th.
**Replaces:** __Feeblemind__

You blast the mind of a creature that you can see within range, attempting to shatter its intellect and personality. The target takes **4d6** psychic damage and must make an Intelligence saving throw.

On a failure, the creature's Intelligence and Charisma scores become 1. It can only take the most instinctive actions, such as fighting with unarmed strikes or natural weapons, or running away in a straight line. It can't cast spells, activate magic items, understand language, use weapons or tools, or communicate in any way. It can understand when another creature means it harm.

After one day has passed, a creature can repeat its saving throw, ending the spell on a success. Each time it fails the saving throw, it adds one additional day onto the time interval before it can repeat its save.
The spell can also be ended by __greater restoration__, __heal__, or __wish__.

name: Shatterfloor
components: V, S, M (a miniature hammer and a bell)

description.value: You create a loud, thrumming vibration that builds to a painful crescendo before fading. Each creature and object in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you can see in range must make a Constitution saving throw. A target takes **6d6** thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. In addition, if the floor of the area is made of stone or any softer material, the floor is pulverized to a depth of six inches. The resulting area is considered difficult terrain until properly cleared.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 2d6 for each slot level above 3rd.

You touch a willing creature, imbuing them with a warm, protective glow. For the duration, the target cannot gain levels of exhaustion and cannot have its ability scores or maximum hit points reduced.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you may target one additional creature for each slot level above 4th.

name: Shield
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when you see a creature you can touch get hit by an attack or targeted by the Magic Missiles spell

description.value: A spectral shield appears and protects the creature you touched for one minute. They can gain 2 AC against one attack of their choice that would hit them. They can choose to instead gain immunity to 4 magic missiles (from the Magic Missiles spell) of their choice that target them. They do not apply the bonus to their AC if a positive bonus is already being applied to it by a spell.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell at higher levels, the number of attacks or magic missiles they can choose increases by one for each slot level above 1.

name: Shield (Alternate)
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when you are hit by an attack you can see or targeted by __magic missile__

description.value: A shimmering barrier of magical force appears to protect you. Until the end of the current turn, you gain a bonus to your Armor Class equal to 1 + your Spellcasting modifier and you take no damage from the __magic missile__ spell.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd-level or higher, the bonus to your Armor Class increases by 1 for each slot level above 1st.

name: Shield of Faith, Mass
components: V, S, M (A small parchment with a bit of holy text written on it)

description.value: A shimmering field appears and surrounds each creature of your choice within range, granting them a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you may target one additional creature for each slot level above 4th.
You touch a nonmagical shield. Until the spell ends, a creature gains a +1 bonus to Armor Class while wielding that shield.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the bonus increases to +2. When you use a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the bonus increases to +3.

You touch a shield and point to a creature you can see within range. For the duration, the shield floats in the air and follows the target around, attempting to protect them from harm. The shield acts immediately after you in initiative and can move up to 30 feet in a round, ignoring difficult terrain. The shield can occupy the same space as another creature without hindering that creature. While in the same space as the target, the target gains the benefit of wielding a shield, even if their hands are full or they are not normally proficient with shields.

The path before you becomes shrouded in shadows and false underbrush, even as a new path appears in a direction you designate, wandering off in a different direction. While the spell lasts, the path you are following is covered in an illusory veil, as well as any tracks or other signs of passage left by you or any creature of your choice within 30 feet of you.

Meanwhile, an illusory trail continues from the point where you cast this spell in the direction you indicated to the limit of the spell's range, where it ends abruptly. The illusory path avoids minor obstacles and provides no bridges, ladders, stairs, or other means of traversing such obstacles. If the path reaches a large obstacle, such as a ravine or deep river, it ends abruptly, but picks up again on the other side directly across from where it left off provided the maximum range is not exceeded.
A creature that spends at least 10 minutes closely examining the illusory trail can make an Intelligence saving throw, seeing through the illusion on a success.

A Club, Greatclub, Warclub, Staff or Quarterstaff you are holding is imbued with nature's power. For the duration, you can use your spellcasting ability instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls of melee attacks using that weapon, and the weapon's damage die becomes a d8. If the attack deals damage, it can be Force damage or the weapon's normal damage type (your choice).
The spell ends early if you cast it again or if you let go of the weapon.

description.name: Cantrip Upgrade
description.value: The damage die changes when you reach levels 5 (**d10**), 11 (**d12**), and 17 (**2d6**).

You blast a creature you can see in range with a sudden, impressive jolt of electricity . The target must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking **4d6** lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. In addition, if the target fails its saving throw by 5 or more, it is frightened of you for 1 minute. A creature frightened by this spell can make a Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st.

Lightning springs from you to a creature that you try to touch. Make a melee spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes **1d10** Lightning damage, and it can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The damage increases by 1d10 when you reach levels 5 (**2d10**), 11 (**3d10**), and 17 (**4d10**).
You release a blood-curdling screech in a 5-foot Emanation. Each Large or smaller creature you choose within the Emanation is pushed 5 feet away from you.
Touch a willing creature you can see. Until the end of your next turn, dim light is darkness while within 5 ft of that creature.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The duration is extended by one round when you reach levels 5 (2 rounds), 11 (3 rounds) and 17 (4 rounds)

name: Shroud of Undeath
components: V, S, M (dust or bone fragments from any undead creature)

description.value: You shroud yourself with necromantic energy, causing Undead to recognize you as one of their own. While the spell lasts, Undead creatures with an Intelligence score of 3 or lower perceive you as a fellow Undead creature, completely ignoring you. In addition, you have advantage on Charisma checks while interacting with Undead creatures with an Intelligence score of 4 or greater. The spell ends if you make an attack or cast a spell that affects an enemy Undead.
Dim, greenish light spreads within a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range. The light spreads around corners, and it lasts until the spell ends.

When a creature moves into the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, that creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it takes **4d10** radiant damage, and increases its exhaustion by 1. Additionally, it emits a dim, greenish light in a 5-foot radius. This light makes it impossible for the creature to benefit from being invisible. The light and any increases to exhaustion caused by this spell go away when the spell ends.

Touch a willing creature to create a 5 ft radius of silence centered on them until the end of your next turn. While creatures are in the affected area they cannot create sound, cast a spell that includes a verbal component or deal thunder damage.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The duration is extended by one round when you reach levels 5 (2 rounds), 11 (3 rounds) and 17 (4 rounds)

You touch a single portal (door, window, gate, drawer, chest lid, and so on), which can be no larger than 10 feet in any dimension, negating any sounds it would make from being opened for the duration. Silent portal only covers normal and nonmagical means of opening or closing the portal. Breaking a window, kicking a door in or casting a spell such as knock still makes noise, but opening a door that is falling off its hinges does not. The spell lasts for the duration or until you dismiss it as an action.
Portals composed of magical energy are not affected by this spell.

name: Silvery Barbs
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself succeeds on an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw

description.value: This spell has been replaced by the Downtick and Uptick spells. If a feature would teach you this spell, learn Downtick or Uptick instead.

name: Simulacrum
components: V, S, M (powdered ruby worth 1,500+ GP, which the spell consumes)

description.value: You force a Beast or Humanoid that is within 10 feet of you for the entire casting of the spell to make a wisdom saving throw. On a failure, you create a simulacrum of them. You finish the casting by touching both the creature and a pile of ice or snow that is the same size as that creature. That pile turns into the simulacrum, which is a creature. It uses the game statistics of the original creature at the time of casting, except it is a Construct, its Hit Point maximum is half as much, it can't cast spells and it can't change shape.
The simulacrum is Friendly to you and creatures you designate. It obeys your commands. The simulacrum can't gain levels, and it can't take Short or Long Rests.

If the simulacrum takes damage, the only way to restore its Hit Points is to repair it as you take a Long Rest, during which you expend components worth 100 GP per Hit Point restored. The simulacrum must stay within 5 feet of you for the repair.
The simulacrum lasts until it drops to 0 Hit Points, at which point it reverts to snow and melts away. If you cast this spell again, any simulacrum you created with this spell is instantly destroyed.

You cause a creature to lose its natural buoyancy, so that it sinks like a stone in water or liquids of similar density. A creature you see in range must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be affected by this spell for the duration. While affected by this spell, the target must succeed on a Strength (Athletics) check each round (the DC is your spell save DC) or else begin to sink. The target sinks at a rate of 60 feet each round.
If the target has a swim speed, its swim speed is reduced by half (to a minimum of 5 feet). A creature can choose to willingly fail its save.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you may target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.
**Replaces:** __Life Transference__

You gesture at two creatures within range, redirecting the life force from one to heal another within range. One creature of your choice within 30 feet of you that you can see must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target loses **4d8** hit points, which can't be reduced in any way, and another creature of your choice that you can see within 30 feet of your target regains an equivalent number of hit points. A creature can willingly fail this save.
The spell has no effect on constructs or the undead.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by **1d8** for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Sirine's Grace
components: V, S, M (a shard of mirror)

description.value: You infuse yourself with an unearthly grace and confidence. For the duration, you have advantage on Charisma and Dexterity checks and your base AC becomes 10 + your Charisma modifier + your Dexterity modifier while you are not wearing armor. In addition, you gain a swim speed of 60 feet and the ability to breathe water.

name: Skeletal Guard
components: V, S, M (a bag of fingerbones, which the spell consumes)

description.value: You scatter your bag of fingerbones on the ground, causing animate skeletons to spring up where they land. You create up to four skeletal guards, each in an unoccupied space you can see in range. These creatures use the Skeletal Guard stat block. A skeletal guard crumbles to dust when it drops to 0 hit points or the spell ends.

The skeletal guards are friendly to you and your companions and act immediately after you in initiative. They obey any verbal commands that you issue to them (no action required by you). If you don't issue any commands to them, they defend themselves from hostile creatures, but otherwise take no actions.

Your magic deepens a creature's understanding of its own talent. You touch one willing creature and choose a skill; until the spell ends, add 4 to ability checks it makes using that skill. Do not add it if a positive bonus has already been applied to the roll by a spell.
You must choose a skill in which the target is proficient, but does not have expertise in.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell at higher levels, increase the bonus to ability checks using that skill by 1 for every 2 additional levels.
**Replaces:** __Skywrite__

You create a gigantic stationary symbol in a part of the sky you can see. You control the appearance of this omen, which displays animations up to 10 minutes in length. The image is visible for a radius of 1 mile. It is obviously unnatural and cannot be mistaken for a real object.

The first time a creature sees the omen, it must make a Wisdom saving throw. A creature can choose to fail its saving throw if it interprets the omen positively. On a failure, it suffers one of the following effects (or another appropriate effect upon its confidence or morale, as determined by the GM). At the end of every day, a creature can repeat its saving throw against this spell.

• **Terror.** A creature failing the save is frightened of the omen.
• **Awe.** A creature failing the save is charmed and will not willingly move anywhere it cannot see the omen.
• **Courage.** A creature has advantage on saving throws against fear and charm effects while it can see the omen.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: If you cast this spell using a 7th-level spell slot, the radius is 6 miles and the duration is *concentration*, up to 8 hours. If you use an 8th-level spell slot, the radius is 12 miles and the duration is *concentration*, up to 24 hours. If you use a 9th-level spell slot, the radius is 18 miles, the spell no longer requires *concentration*, and it lasts until dispelled.

You create four ribbons of pure darkness and hurl them at creatures within range. You can hurl them at one target or several. Make a ranged spell attack for each ribbon aimed at a non-Undead creature. On a hit, the target takes **2d6** necrotic damage. For each ribbon aimed at an Undead creature, the target regains 1d6 hit points.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you create one additional ribbon for each slot level above 3rd.
Choose a willing creature you can see in range. You can move the target up to five feet in any direction into an unoccupied space.
The maximum distance you can move a target increases by 5 feet when you reach 5th level (10 feet), 11th level (15 feet), and 17th level (20 feet).

name: Slime Wave
components: V, S, M (a few drops of stagnant pond water)

description.value: You summon a wave of green slime that violently splatters forward from you in a line 60 feet long and 15 feet wide in a direction you choose. Each creature and object in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw. A target takes **12d6** acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Each creature or object damaged by the initial wave takes an additional **1d6** acid damage at the end of each of its turns for the duration. A creature can use an action to scrape the slime off a target, ending the effect for that target.

The wave spreads around walls and corners, coating walls and ceilings and lasting until the spell ends, at which point the slime evaporates. Any creature that comes into contact with the slime (typically by moving into the affected area) is subject to the ongoing damage as though they had been damaged by the initial wave.
The slime deals no damage to creatures or objects made entirely out of stone.

You brush a hand against a creature, bestowing upon it an aura which attracts predatory animals. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be affected for the duration. While affected, any Beast with Intelligence of 3 or lower is hostile towards the target. Hostile Beasts prefer to attack the subject over other creatures and have advantage on all attack rolls made against the target.

name: Snake's Swiftness
components: V, S, M (a few scales from a snake)

description.value: You indicate a target to a friendly creature, both of which must be in range. The friendly creature may immediately use its reaction to make a single melee or ranged attack against the target.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you may choose one additional friendly creature to make an attack for each slot level above 1st.

One of your arms transforms into a venomous snake with a fanged maw for the duration. You can't hold items in your transformed hand. This snake can be used to make unarmed strikes at targets up to 10 feet away, using either Strength or Dexterity for the attack and damage rolls. The snake deals **1d6** + your Strength or Dexterity modifier piercing damage plus **4d4** poison damage on a hit.

As a bonus action before the end of your next turn you can teleport back to the location where you casted this spell. You can use this once and regain all uses after a short rest. You fail to teleport if the location is occupied or in another plane of existence.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The number of times you can use this spell before resting increases by 1 when you reach Rogue levels 5 (2 uses), 11 (3 uses), and 17 (4 uses).

You manipulate the senses of one creature you can see in range so that it perceives itself to be the only real creature in all of existence and everything around it to be merely an illusion. The target must succeed on an Intelligence saving throw or be affected for the duration.

While affected, the target is incapacitated, has disadvantage on saving throws and any attack rolls against it have advantage. Whenever the target takes damage, it may make an Intelligence saving throw, ending the effect on a success.

You lace your next performance with trace amounts of magic, subtly improving your results. The next time you make a Charisma (Performance) check, you gain advantage on that check and the spell ends. In addition, while the  spell lasts, you can perfectly imitate the sound of any Beast you have heard before.

The words of your spell twist upon each other and grow stronger. Then, they streak toward a creature or object you can see in range and detonate in a screaming bellow. The target must make a Constitution saving throw, taking **2d10** thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. In addition, if the target fails its save by 5 or more, it is also deafened for one minute. A creature deafened in this way may make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 1st.

You compress a thunderous boom into an invisible ball and project it at a creature you can see within range. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes **1d8** Thunder damage and has the Deafened condition until the start of your next turn.
If the spell's target is within 10 feet of you, the spell is amplified and its damage becomes 1d10, instead of 1d8.

description.name: Cantrip Upgrade
description.value: The damage increases by 1d8 (or 1d10, if amplified) when you reach levels 5 (2d8 or 2d10), 11 (3d8 or 3d10), and 17 (4d8 or 4d10).
**Replaces:** __Thunder Step__

You create and step through a brief dimensional rift, teleporting to an unoccupied space you can see within range. You can bring your possessions and any objects you can carry. You may also bring one willing creature your size or smaller, who must be standing 5 feet from where you cast the spell and appears within 5 feet of your destination. If there is not enough space at the destination, it is left behind.

After you teleport, the rift closes and emits a sonic shockwave. Choose either your starting or ending space. All creatures within 10 feet of that space except you and any creature you brought with you must make a Constitution saving throw, taking **4d8** thunder damage on a failure or half as much damage on a success. The shockwave is audible out to 300 feet.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by **1d8** for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Sonic Rumble
components: V, S, M (a hollow cone of brass and gold worth 50 gp)

description.value: You create a deep, rumbling hum as loud as the din of a battlefield, which blasts out from you in a 30-foot cone and lingers in the area for the duration. Each creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes **5d10** thunder damage and is deafened until the start of its next turn on a failed save, or half as much damage and is not deafened on a successful one.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 5th.

You create a brief but powerful burst of sound centered on a creature you can see in range. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take **1d8** thunder damage and be deafened until the start of your next turn.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

You forcefully clasp your hands and a shockwave of booming force shoots forth from you and emits a boom audible out to 500 feet. All creatures in a 30-foot cone must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take **4d8** thunder damage, fall prone, and be deafened for 1 minute. On a success, creatures take half damage and are not knocked prone or deafened.
A creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th-level or higher, the damage increases by **1d8**, and the cone increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Sonic Whip
components: V, S, M (a miniature silk whip)

description.value: A whip of hissing blue energy appears in your hand. This magic whip lasts until the spell ends. It counts as a simple melee weapon with which you are proficient. It deals **3d6** thunder damage on a hit and has the finesse and reach properties. In addition, as a bonus action on your turn you can crack the whip. When you do, each Beast with an Intelligence score of 3 or lower within 30 feet of you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of you until the end of your next turn.
If you drop the weapon, it dissipates at the end of the turn. Thereafter, while the spell lasts, you can use a bonus action to cause the whip to reappear in your hand.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2nd.
When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Soul Cage
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when a humanoid you can see within 60ft of you dies
components: V, S, M (a tiny silver cage worth 100 gp)

description.value: This spell snatches the soul of a humanoid as it dies and traps it inside the tiny cage you use for the material component. A stolen soul remains inside the cage until the spell ends or until you destroy the cage, which ends the spell. While you have a soul inside the cage, you can exploit it in any of the ways described below. You can use a trapped soul up to six times. Once you exploit a soul for the sixth time, it is released, and the spell ends. While a soul is trapped, the dead humanoid it came from can't be revived.
Steal Life. You can use a bonus action to drain vigor from the soul and regain 2d8 hit points.

Query Soul. You ask the soul a question (no action required) and receive a brief telepathic answer, which you can understand regardless of the language used. The soul knows only what it knew in life, but it must answer you truthfully and to the best of its ability. The answer is no more than a sentence or two and might be cryptic.

Borrow Experience. You can use a bonus action to bolster yourself with the soul's life experience, making your next attack roll, ability check, or saving throw with advantage. If you don't use this benefit before the start of your next turn, it is lost.

Eyes of the Dead. You can use an action to name a place the humanoid saw in life, which creates an invisible sensor somewhere in that place if it is on the plane of existence you're currently on. The sensor remains for as long as you concentrate, up to 10 minutes (as if you were *concentrating* on a spell). You receive visual and auditory information from the sensor as if you were in its space using your senses.
A creature that can see the sensor (such as one using see invisibility or truesight) sees a translucent image of the tormented humanoid whose soul you caged.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell at a higher level you can exploit the soul an additional 2 times for each additional spell level.

A Humanoid you touch makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a fragment of its soul is bound to the doll used in this spell's casting, which becomes an effigy of that creature. The spell ends if the effigy is destroyed or if the target is on another plane of existence. For the duration, you can use a Magic action to do one of the following.

description.name: Control
description.value: You directly control the target's actions and movement on its next turn by manipulating the effigy's limbs. That target can only take the Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Utilize action. While controlled, the target's movements are jerky and unnatural.

description.name: Harm
description.value: You prod the effigy and deal **2d8** damage to the target. This damage is Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing or another damage type, appropriate to the means by which you harm the effigy. This damage ignores Resistance and Immunity.

description.name: Restrain
description.value: You submerge the effigy in water, causing the target to believe it is suffocating. The target has the Restrained condition until the end of your next turn.

name: Soul Shatter
components: V, S, M (A specially crafted black wand worth at least 1000gp.)

description.value: You point the wand at one target within range and utter some strange words, after which a purple streak of energy. The target must succeed a Constitution saving throw or take **20d8** Necrotic damage, half as much on a success. If the spell reduces the target's Hit Points to 0, then its soul shatters into two shards and the person dies instantly. Each soul shard enters the closest creature to it; each shard into a different creature. A possessed creature gains Proficiency in one skill, tool, or saving throw, of their choice from the ones the soul had. If they are already proficient in all skills, tools, and saving throws the soul was as well, then they gain Expertise in one.

When two shards enter one creature they merge into a new soul, which will attempt to possess the creature they inhabit. The creature it attempts to possess must succeed a Charisma saving throw or be possessed by a Ghost (see Ghost stat block for details) and lose their gained Proficiency. On a success the creature is not possessed and the second shard shatters.

name: Soul Transfer
components: V, S, M (a tiny ornate container worth at least 500 gp)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Magic Jar__

Your body falls unconscious as your soul enters the spell's material component. You perceive from the component using your senses, but can't move or use reactions. You can only use your action to project your soul up to 100 feet, either to return to your living body (ending the spell) or to try to possess a humanoid's body that you can see. Creatures warded by a __protection from evil and good__ or __circle of protection__ spell can't be possessed.

The target must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, its soul is trapped in the component, and you take control of its body. You use its physical statistics and features, but retain your alignment and mental ability scores, and your GM determines which mental features you may use. You can use your action to return to the component if it is within 100 feet, returning the target creature's soul to its body. If the target succeeds at its Charisma saving throw, you can't attempt to possess it again for 24 hours.

The possessed creature can perceive from the component using its senses and can repeat its saving throw as an action after every hour. It can take no other actions. On a success, the target returns to its body and you return to the component if it is within 100 feet; otherwise, you die.

If the target's body dies while you possess it, the creature dies, and you must make a Charisma saving throw against your spellcasting DC. On a success, you return to the component if it is within 100 feet; otherwise, you die.

If the spell ends or the container is destroyed, each affected soul attempts to return to its body if it is alive and within 100 feet; otherwise, it dies. Only a __wish__ spell can prevent this death.
When the spell ends, the container is destroyed.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th level or higher, the possessed creature can repeat its saving throw once per day. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 9th level, the possessed creature can repeat its saving throw once per year.
You unleash a projectile of intense sonic energy at a creature or object you can see in range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes **8d8** thunder damage.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 3rd.
You take the help action to attempt to stabilize a creature in range.

description.name: Cantrip Upgrade
description.value: The range doubles when you reach levels 5 (30 feet), 11 (60 feet), and 17 (120 feet).

With a quick jolt of necromantic energy, a corpse momentarily rises to obey you. Choose the corpse of a Huge or smaller creature that has died within the last hour. When you cast this spell, the corpse stands up and can move up to 15 feet and make a single melee attack using your spell attack modifier against a target of your choice within its reach. On a hit, this attack deals Bludgeoning damage based on the corpse's size: Tiny (1d4), Small (1d6), Medium (1d8), Large (1d10), and Huge (1d12). Once the corpse attacks, it once again crumples into a heap. A corpse targeted by this spell doesn't become an Undead creature.

description.name: Cantrip Upgrade
description.value: The damage increases by one damage die when you reach levels 5 (2 dice), 11 (3 dice), and 17 (4 dice).

You outline an Undead creature you touch with a faint glow. The target must make a Constitution saving throw, which it can choose to fail. On a failed save, the target's creature type changes to the creature type it possessed before it became Undead. If it was never alive, the DM chooses an appropriate creature type.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you may target up to two additional Undead creatures for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Sparking Shot
components: V, S, M (a piece of ammunition or weapon worth at least 1 cp)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Lightning Arrow__

You imbue a piece of ammunition or weapon with crackling electricity. When you make an attack with the piece of ammunition or weapon, it creates arcs of lightning from the attack's target. The target and two creatures of your choice within 15 feet must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking **3d12** lightning damage on a failure or half as much on a success. If the attack hit, the target automatically fails this saving throw.
The piece of ammunition or weapon then reverts to normal.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by **1d12** for each slot level above 3rd.

Sparks of lightning erupt from a point of your choice within range. Each creature within a 10-foot-radius Sphere centred there, must succeed a Dexterity saving throw or take **3d8** Lightning damage or half as much on a successful one. Creatures made of metal or wearing metal armour have disadvantage on the save.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The Lightning damage increases by **1d8** for each level above 2nd.
**Replaces:** __Speak with Animals__ and __Speak with Plants__

You can verbally communicate with beasts for the duration. This allows beasts to answer questions you pose; at minimum, a beast can inform you about whatever it can perceive or has perceived within the past day, including nearby locations and monsters.

The knowledge, awareness, and personality of a beast is limited by its intelligence, but you may deceive, intimidate, persuade, or otherwise influence a beast at the GM's discretion. A creature is under no compulsion to answer (or answer truthfully) if you are hostile to it, or it recognizes you as an enemy.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you imbue plants with limited sentience, allowing you to communicate with them like beasts. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you imbue plants with limited animation, allowing them to freely move branches, tendrils, and stalks. You can command plants to release a restrained creature, to turn ordinary terrain into difficult terrain (or the opposite), or to perform other tasks at the GM's discretion.
**Replaces:** __Spirit Shroud__

You summon a large, ghostly entity which envelops you, aiding your attacks and making its own, striking down your foes. The entity is incorporeal and invulnerable. Choose a damage type when you cast this spell: cold, necrotic, or radiant. All damage dealt by this spell is of that type.

For the duration of the spell, your weapons are wreathed in ethereal light, dealing **1d4** extra damage on every hit. Any creature that takes this damage can't regain hit points until the start of your next turn. In addition, when you cast this spell and as a bonus action on subsequent turns, you can command the entity to make a melee spell attack against one target within 10 feet. On a hit, the target takes **2d8** damage and must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have its speed reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage dealt by the entity's attacks increases by **1d8** for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Spectral Passage
components: V, S, M (an object a spirit has passed through)

description.value: You touch a willing creature. Until the spell ends, it becomes semi-incorporeal and can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. If the creature ends its movement inside another object or creature, it is immediately shunted to the nearest unoccupied space, taking **1d10** force damage for every 5 feet it was forced to travel.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th-level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 3rd.

You forge a telepathic bond with a willing creature. While this bond lasts, you and the target can telepathically communicate over any distance, provided you are both on the same plane of existence. You do not need to both share a common language. Creatures with Intelligence scores of 2 or less aren't affected by this spell.

name: Spell Engine
components: V, S, M (a disk of polished bone, one of your tears, and a silver wheel worth 100 gp)

description.value: When you cast this spell, or as an action while the spell lasts, you and any number of creatures of your choice in a 30-foot radius sphere centered on you can swap out any or all of their prepared spells for other spells that they can prepare.

name: Spell Glyph
components: V, S, M (silver powder worth at least 100 gp, which the spell consumes)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Glyph of Warding__

When you cast this spell, you mark a fixed surface with an arcane inscription, occupying a 5-foot diameter circle. When a creature enters the glyph's space or otherwise disturbs it, the glyph triggers.
You can refine the trigger by specifying or exempting creatures or creature types, or by specifying a password a creature can speak as a reaction to prevent the glyph from triggering.

The glyph is nearly invisible and requires a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to be found. A creature has advantage on this check if it is able to perceive magical effects, such as by casting detect magic. If a creature uses its action to destroy the glyph, or the surface is destroyed, the spell ends without triggering.

As part of the casting, you must cast another prepared spell of 3rd level or lower, storing it in the glyph. The spell must have a casting time of 1 action and must be able to target a creature other than the caster. When the glyph triggers, it releases the stored spell, targeting the triggering creature. If the spell targets an area or summons creatures, the effect is centered on the triggering creature. A spell requiring *concentration* lasts for its full duration. A triggered glyph glows brightly for the stored spell's full duration. If a creature uses its action to destroy the triggered glyph, or the surface is destroyed, the spell ends.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the stored spell's maximum level increases by 1 and the material component cost increases by 50 gp for each slot level above 3rd.

At your touch, silvery motes of light begin to snow down on a willing creature of your choice in range. While the spell lasts, the next time that creature is targeted by, or included in the area of effect of, a spell of 2nd level or lower, that spell has no effect on the target. Once the target has been protected from another spell, this spell ends.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the triggering spell has no effect if its level is less than or equal to the level of the spell slot you used.

A violet spray springs from your fingertips and wraps around a creature you can see in range. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or gain vulnerability to one of the following damage type of your choice: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. If the target has resistance to that damage type, it loses that resistance instead for the duration. If the target is immune to that damage type, this spell has no effect on it.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you may target one additional creature for each slot level above 3rd.

You place a curse on a creature within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become cursed for the duration of the spell. While cursed in this way, the creature takes 1d8 + its spellcasting ability modifier (minimum of 1) Psychic damage each time it casts a spell or uses a magical feature that deals damage or forces a creature to make a saving throw. __Remove Curse__ spells that the target casts on itself can't remove this curse.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: When you cast this spell using a level 6+ spell slot and the target of this spell has ever targeted you with a harmful spell or magical effect against your will, they have Disadvantage on the saving throw and the effect is permanent unless removed by __Remove Curse__, __Greater Restoration__, or similar magic. You can also choose to end the spell by using an action to dismiss it.

name: Sphere of Ultimate Destruction
components: V, S, M (a pinch of dust from a disintegrated creature)

description.value: You conjure a featureless black sphere of nothingness that utterly destroys anything it touches. The sphere appears in a space you can see in range. Any creature that enters the same space as the sphere for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes **10d6 + 40** force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

The target is disintegrated if this damage leaves it with 0 hit points. A disintegrated creature and everything it is wearing and carrying, except magic items, are reduced to a pile of fine gray dust. The creature can be restored to life only by means of a true resurrection or a wish spell. On each of your turns after you cast this spell, you can use an action to move the sphere up to 60 feet in any direction.

If the sphere enters the same space as a large or smaller nonmagical object or a creation of magical force (such as the wall created by wall of force) the target is automatically disintegrated. If the target is a huge or larger object or creation of force, a 5-foot-cube portion of it is disintegrated instead. A magic item is unaffected by this spell.

You transform a creature you can see in range into a spider-like monstrosity that obeys your mental commands. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be transformed for the duration. The spell ends early if the target drops to 0 hit points or dies. While transformed, the target's game statistics, including mental ability scores, are replaced by the statistics of a drider (the GM has the creatures' statistics). The target assumes the hit points of its new form. When it reverts to its normal form, the creature returns to the number of hit points it had before it transformed. If it reverts as a result of dropping to 0 hit points, any excess damage carries over to its normal form. As long as the excess damage doesn't reduce the creature's normal form to 0 hit points, it isn't knocked unconscious.
The creature is limited in the actions it can perform by the nature of its new form, and it can't speak, cast spells, or take any other action that requires hands or speech.

The target's gear melds into the new form. The creature can't activate, use, wield, or otherwise benefit from any of its equipment. The target can only use actions from its new stat block if it is provided the proper equipment to do so (such as longbow or longsword attacks)

While the creature is transformed, it is charmed by you and has a telepathic link to you. You can use this telepathic link to issue commands to the creature while you are conscious (no action required), which it does its best to obey. You can specify a simple and general course of action, such as "Attack that creature," "Run over there," or "Fetch that object." If the creature completes the order and doesn't receive further direction from you, it defends and preserves itself to the best of its ability. Each time the target takes damage, it makes a new Wisdom saving throw against the spell. If the saving throw succeeds, the spell ends.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a 7th-level spell slot, the duration is *Concentration*, up to 10 minutes. When you use a 8th-level spell slot, the duration is *Concentration*, up to 1 hour. When you use a spell slot of 9th level or higher, the duration is *Concentration*, up to 8 hours.

name: Spiderskin
components: V, S, M (a piece of a spider)

description.value: You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor, causing their skin to become tougher and more like carapace. The target's base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier. In addition, the target ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing and can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down and on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check. The spell ends if the target dons armor or if you dismiss the spell as an action.

The ground in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range sprouts hard spikes and thorns. The area becomes Difficult Terrain for the duration. When a creature moves into or within the area, it takes **2d4** Piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels.

The transformation of the ground is camouflaged to look natural. Any creature that can't see the area when the spell is cast must take a Search action and succeed on a Wisdom (*Perception* or *Survival*) check against your spell save DC to recognize the terrain as hazardous before entering it.

name: Spiny Shield
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when an attack deals damage to a creature you can touch

description.value: An barrier of spikes interposes itself between the target and the attacker. Reduce the damage by 1d6. If it was a melee attack, deal piercing damage to the attacker equal to the amount reduced.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell at higher levels, increase the amount reduced by 1d6 for each additional level.

Protective spirits flit around you in a 15-foot Emanation for the duration. Choose necrotic or radiant damage when you prepare this spell. You can prepare this spell multiple times as long as you pick a different damage type each time.

Enemies treat the affected area as difficult terrain and must make a wisdom saving throw when they are within it. On a failed save, they take 2d6 of the chosen damage type. On a success, they take half as much. Once they make the saving throw they do not need to do so again until the start of their next turn.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The damage increases by **1d8** for each spell slot level above 3.

name: Spirit Remnant
components: V, S, M (a small heart-shaped piece of wood)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Speak With Dead__

You perform a rite over a corpse you can see within range, summoning a vestige of its spirit and compelling it to answer questions. It must have a mouth or other means of speaking, can't be undead, and can't have been the target of this spell within the past 10 days.

Until the spell ends, the corpse will answer up to five questions using the knowledge it possessed before its death. Its responses are typically brief, cryptic, or puzzling, but it will not lie or refuse to answer.

name: Spirit Worm
components: V, S, M (a piece of fire-blackened ivory or bone carved in the shape of a segmented worm)

description.value: You create a lingering decay in the spirit and body of a creature you can see in range. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or become infected for the duration. While infected, the target cannot regain hit points and takes **1d4** necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. The target can make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

name: Spiritjaws
components: V, S, M (a piece of bone from a dinosaur's jaw)

description.value: A massive set of ghostly dinosaur jaws appears and attacks a creature you can see in range. Make a melee spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes **8d6** force damage and is grappled by the jaws if it is Large-sized or smaller. A creature can use an action to attempt to break free from the jaws (escape DC is your spell save DC). At the end of each of its turns while grappled, the target takes an additional **2d6** force damage.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4tf level or higher, the initial damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd and the ongoing damage increases by 1d6 for every two slot levels above 3rd.

You summon a large and ornate chariot made of transparent, faintly glowing azure energy in an unoccupied space you can see in range. When you cast this spell, you must choose one willing creature to be properly harnessed to it. The chariot is made of force and weighs nothing. The chariot has enough room to hold one Medium creature or two Small creatures in addition to the driver. The creature harnessed to the chariot can end the spell early as an action. If the target has a flying speed, the chariot stays upright behind them.

Creatures in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point of your choice within range have their soul rent, and must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, they take **8d6** necrotic damage, and for the next minute, they have a muddied sense of self and subtract 1d6 from any Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw they make. On a success, they take half damage and suffer no saving throw penalty.
Targets can make a Charisma saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a successful save.

name: Spiritwall
components: V, S, M (a clear cut gemstone)

description.value: You create a an immobile, swirling mass of greenish-white forms resembling tortured spirits. You can make the wall up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or a ringed wall up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick. The wall is opaque and lasts for the duration.

When the wall appears, each creature within its area must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes **6d8** necrotic damage, or half as much damage on a successful save. A creature that passes through the wall or ends its turn inside the wall takes **6d8** necrotic damage.

One side of the wall, selected by you when you cast this spell, emits a low groaning, which can be heard up to 30 feet away by creatures on that side of the wall. Whenever a creature enters the area for the first time in a turn or starts its turn there it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of the wall for the duration. A creature frightened of the wall can repeat this saving throw at the start of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Undead and Constructs are unaffected by this spell and can pass through the wall unhindered.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 5th.

name: Splinterbolt
components: V, S, M (a splinter of wood)

description.value: You launch two javelin-sized shards of wood at targets you can see in range. You can launch them at one target or several. Make a ranged spell attack for each shard. On a hit, a target takes **2d10** piercing damage. You may choose a Large-sized or larger tree as the origin point instead of yourself. If you do so, both the tree and the target must both be within range.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you create one additional shard for every two slot levels above 2nd.

name: Spreadshot
components: V, S, M (a nonmagical thrown weapon or nonmagical piece of ammunition)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Conjure Barrage__

You touch the component used in the spell's casting, multiplying the projectiles in a 60-foot cone. Make a single ranged attack roll with the weapon. Each target in the cone takes **4d8** damage on a hit, or half as much damage on a miss. The damage type is the same as that of the weapon or ammunition used as a component.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by **1d8** for each slot level above 3rd.

You flood magic into your legs, allowing you to bound high into the air. Until the start of your next turn, the distance of your Long and High Jumps increases by 10 feet (this extra distance costs movement as normal), and you suffer no penalty from making a standing jump.

name: Staggering Smite (Alternate)
components: V, M (a melee weapon worth at least 1 sp)

description.value: When you hit with a melee weapon attack you can cause the weapon to pierce both body and mind. This attack deals **4d6** additional psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or until the start of its next turn, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks and it cannot take reactions.
If your target is an aberration or it can speak telepathically this bonus psychic damage increases by **1d6**.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th-level or higher, the psychic damage increases by **1d6** for each spell slot level above 4th.

At your touch, you cause a tiny mark to appear on a creature you can see. The tiny mark appears in a location of your choice and is visible only to you or by someone with the ability to detect magic. You choose what the mark looks like when you cast this spell, which can be no larger than 1 inch in diameter. You can see the brand even if the subject uses magical means to change or hide its appearance.

name: Stalwart Pact
components: V, S, M (powdered silver worth 1000 gp, which the spell consumes)

description.value: You create a bond between a willing creature and a greater power, which provides a measure of protection when the need is dire. Once before the spell ends, if the target is reduced to fewer than half of their maximum hit points, the pact activates. When the pact activates, the target immediately gains 25 temporary hit points and has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons for one minute. The pact can only be activated once before the spell ends. The spell ends immediately if you cast it again.

You command the waters to lift a willing creature or object you can see in range and propel it forward. An object so lifted may contain creatures or other objects. The target is lifted up to 20 feet above the water surface and is propelled at a speed of 60 feet in a straight line at the end of each of your turns. When you cast this spell, or as a bonus action on your turn, you may choose the direction the target will be propelled in. When the target reaches land, the waters harmlessly lower the target and the spell ends. The target may be up to Medium size.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a higher level spell slot, the maximum size increases: Large with a 5th-level slot, Huge with a 7th-level slot, Gargantuan with a 9th-level slot.

name: Starvation
components: V, S, M (a piece of spoiled food)

description.value: When you cast this spell, and at the beginning of each of your turns for the duration, the target must make a Constitution saving throw. The target takes **6d10** necrotic damage and suffers one level of exhaustion on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Once the target has made three successful saving throws against this spell, the spell ends. When this spell ends, all levels of exhaustion caused by this spell go away.

You release motes of static that float around a creature in range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes **1d10** lightning damage, and until the end of your next turn they emit 5ft of bright light and an additional 5ft of dim light. Creatures in the bright light perceive dim light as darkness.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: This spell's damage increases by 1d10 when you reach levels 5 (2d10), 11 (3d10), and 17 (4d10).

Sparks of lightning shoot out of you in a 10-foot-radius emanation. All creatures within that radius must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take **4d8** Lightning damage and become Paralyzed for the duration of the spell. On a success they only take half as much damage. A Paralyzed creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of their turns.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The Lightning damage increases by **1d8** for each level above 5th.

You draw upon the power of steaming volcanic vents, creating a 15-foot-radius sphere of boiling steam at a point you can see within range, which begins to roil away from you. The sphere spreads around corners and its area is heavily obscured. When a creature enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, that creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. The creature takes **4d6** fire damage and is blinded until the start of its next turn on a failed save, or half as much damage and is not blinded on a successful one. A creature that fails its save by 5 or more is blinded until it receives magical healing.
At the start of each of your turns while the spell lasts, the sphere moves 10 feet away from the location you were standing when you cast the spell.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 4th.

name: Steel Wind Strike (Alternate)
components: V, M (a melee weapon worth at least 1 sp)

description.value: You flourish the weapon used in the casting and then vanish to strike like the wind. Choose up to five creatures you can see within range. Make a melee weapon attack against each target using the weapon used in the casting. On a hit, targets take the normal damage of an attack with that weapon plus an additional **5d10** force damage.
You can then teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 5 feet of one of the targets you hit or missed.

name: Steeldance
components: V, S, M (a pair of daggers, which the spell consumes)

description.value: You cause a pair of daggers to grow to the size and shape of longswords, appearing in unoccupied spaces that you can see within range. The swords use the statistics of flying swords (the GM has the creature's statistics) with the following change: each of the swords uses your spellcasting ability modifier for their to hit and damage rolls. A sword crumbles to dust when it drops to zero hit points or when the spell ends.

The swords are friendly to you and your companions and take their turns immediately after you in initiative. They obey verbal commands that you issue to them (no action required by you). If you don't issue any commands to them, they defend themselves from hostile creatures, but otherwise take no actions.
As a bonus action while the spell lasts, you can touch up to two daggers to transmute them into additional swords. You can have a maximum of two swords at a time.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the maximum number of swords you can control at one time increases by 1 for every two slot levels above 3rd.

name: Stick
components: V, S, M (a bit of dried glue)

description.value: You affix one object weighing up to 5 pounds to another object. At the end of the duration the object falls loose. The bond is not particularly strong and the two items can be separated by even a small amount of force.

A colorless glow surrounds you and your mount for an instant. When the glow fades, you feel more attentive to the movements of your mount, even while an unseen force holds you fast to it. For the duration, you cannot be dismounted as a result of being knocked prone or as a result of involuntary movement from you or your mount. You may end this spell at any time, no action required.

name: Sting Ray
components: V, S, M (four dried stinging insects)

description.value: From your outstretched hand leaps forth a ray of glittering energy at a creature you can see in range, which appears to be composed of countless miniscule writhing insects. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes **3d10** poison damage and must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is left with the lingering sensation of many tiny insects biting and crawling across their body. For the next minute, the target can't take reactions and has disadvantage on Constitution saves made to maintain *Concentration*. The target can make a Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 2nd.
**Replaces:** __Infestation__

You cause a cloud of biting, stinging insects to appear near one creature you can see within range. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On failure, it takes **1d4** piercing damage and **1d4** poison damage and moves 5 feet in a direction of your choice. The creature doesn't move into obviously dangerous ground, such as a fire or a pit.
The spell's damage increases by 1d4 when you reach 5th level (2d4+2d4), 11th level (3d4+3d4), and 17th level (4d4+4d4).

name: Stolen Breath
components: V, S, M (a stoppered glass vial)

description.value: You attempt to steal the air from the lungs of a creature you can see in range. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be affected for the duration. While affected, the target cannot speak or cast spells that require verbal components. In addition, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks. The target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
This spell has no effect on creatures that don't need to breathe.

name: Stone Body
components: V, S, M (a piece of stone from an earth elemental or stone golem)

description.value: Your flesh begins to stiffen and turn gray, as you transform your body into living stone. Until the spell ends, this transformation grants you several benefits:

• While you are not wearing armor, your armor class becomes 17. You can use a shield and still gain this benefit.
• You gain 50 temporary hit points. If any of these remain when the spell ends, they are lost. 
• You are immune to any other spell or affect that would alter your form.
• You have advantage on Constitution saving throws.
• You have resistance to poison damage and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine.
Choose a creature you can see within range. The target has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage until the spell ends at the end of your next turn.
**Replaces:** __Meld Into Stone__
You lay your hand on an outcropping of rock or a stone wall and speak to the stone, coaxing it to grant a mighty boon. Choose one of the following options:

• **Stone Meld.** You and up to 7 other Large or smaller creatures you choose are able to meld with the stone. Until the end of your next round, each willing creature can touch a 5 foot area of the stone and be absorbed into it. While absorbed, a creature cannot see or hear anything, but has tremorsense within 30 feet. A creature may exit the stone voluntarily as an action, or be ejected if the stone is destroyed or the spell ends.
• **Stone Armor.** The stone joins with you, covering your body in a rocky exterior. You gain 10 temporary hit points and have resistance to nonmagical damage as long as you have these temporary hit points.
• **Stone Step.** Your feet blend into the stone. You gain tremorsense within 30 feet, and as long as you are standing on the ground, you are immune to the prone condition or to being moved against your will.

name: Stone Sphere
components: V, S, M (a smooth sphere of marble1 inch in diameter)

description.value: You create a 5-foot-diameter sphere of stone, which appears in an unoccupied space of your choice within range and lasts for the duration. The sphere has an AC of 17 and 500 hit points and weighs approximately 5 tons. As a bonus action, you can move the stone up to 30 feet. When you move the sphere, any creatures or objects in its path must make a Dexterity saving throw. A target takes **7d6** bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. The sphere stops moving if it enters the space of a Large-sized or larger object, unless it deals enough damage to destroy the target.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 4th.

Choose up to 6 10-foot squares you can see in range. Each 10-foot square must include a surface of stone, dirt, sand or mud. Whenever a creature enters one of the areas for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be grappled as several arms made of solid rock burst forth to seize the target. While grappled by the arms, the target is also immobilized. A creature grappled by the arms can use an action to attempt to break free (escape DC is your spell save DC).
Each 10-foot square can only hold one creature at a time. When you initially cast this spell, you may designate any number of creatures to be unaffected.

A roiling black storm cloud appears in the shape of a cylinder that is 10 feet tall with a 40-foot radius, centered on a point you can see within range. The spell fails if you can't see a point in the air where the storm cloud could appear (for example, if you are in a room that can't accommodate the cloud). As a bonus action, you may move the cloud up to 40 feet in any direction.

The area beneath the cloud is constantly buffeted by a swirling windstorm. Ranged attacks that pass into or out of the area have disadvantage and each creature that enters the area for the first time in a turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. In addition, when you initially cast this spell, or at the start of your turn on subsequent rounds, you may choose one of the following effects:

• **Fire.** Flames pelt the area beneath the storm cloud. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes **12d8** fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
• **Earth.** Chunks of rock fall from the sky. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes **10d8** bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. In addition, the rubble left behind is difficult terrain
• **Water.** A deluge of rain extinguishes unprotected flames. Everything in the area is heavily obscured. In addition, a creature moving through the area must spend 4 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves.

You conjure a terrifying mass of storm clouds centered on a point you can see, spreading outward to a radius of 360 feet. You are completely immune to the effects of this dark storm. Violent winds, thunder, and lighting fill the storm, forcing all creatures within and below the storm to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, they take **2d6** thunder damage and are Deafened while they remain in the area.
