Each subsequent round the storm lasts, you can use your action to add (or end) one of the weather effects below, which lasts for the duration. They affect all creatures and objects in and below the storm, and each can only be added once:

description.name: Acid Rain
description.value: Acidic rain falls from the clouds, dealing **1d6** acid damage to all creatures at the end of each of your turns.

description.name: Freezing Rain
description.value: Frigid rain falls from the clouds. The area becomes difficult terrain and heavily obscured. Targets in the area take **1d6** cold damage at the end of each of your turns.

description.name: Hail Stones
description.value: You infuse the storm with bitter cold. At the end of each of your turns, creatures and objects in the area take **2d6** bludgeoning damage and crops are destroyed.

description.name: High Winds
description.value: Strong winds up to 50 miles per hour rage, instantly dispersing all fog, mist, or similar effects, mundane or magical. Ranged attacks in the area become impossible.

description.name: Lightning Strikes
description.value: You charge the storm with lightning. As a bonus action on each turn, you can call six bolts of lighting from the cloud, each striking targets of your choice within the area. They must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking **10d6** lighting damage on a failure, and half on a success.

You form an enormous tower of dark, swirling storm clouds and howling wind. The tower appears as a 20-foot radius, 100-foot high cylinder centered on a point you can see in range. Each creature in the area is immune to lightning damage and ranged attacks that pass into or through the area automatically miss. The edge of the area provides heavy obscurement and the roaring winds prevent sounds from entering or leaving the area. In order to pass the edge of the area, a creature must use an action to attempt to push through the stormwall. When a Huge-sized or smaller creature does so, it must first succeed on a Strength saving throw or be stopped at the edge of the area. If it fails its saving throw by 5 or more, it is knocked prone.

A creature that ends its turn within 10 feet of the outside of the wall must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes **4d10** lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
**Replaces:** __Storm Sphere__

You create a 20-foot radius cylinder of crackling storms, up to 100 feet high, centered on a point you choose within range. At the start of each of your turns, you can choose to move the cylinder up to 10 feet in a direction of your choice. The cylinder spreads around corners, and its area is difficult terrain. The area is lightly obscured, and creatures inside are deafened.

As a bonus action on each of your turns, you can direct a lightning strike from the cylinder at one creature of your choice within 60 feet of the center. Make a ranged spell attack, with advantage on the attack roll if the target is within the cylinder. On a hit, the target takes **2d12** lightning damage.
After this lightning strike, each creature in the area must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes **4d8** thunder damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the thunder damage increases by **1d8** and the lightning damage increases by **1d12** for every two slot levels above 4th.

You harness the powers of wind and storm to move, protect yourself, and attack. For the duration, you have a flying speed of 40 feet, gain three-quarters cover against ranged attacks and are completely unaffected by natural or magical wind.

As an action once per round while the spell lasts, you can discharge a bolt of electricity from your eyes at a creature you can see within 120 feet. When you do so, make a ranged spell attack against the target, dealing **10d6** lightning damage on a hit.

name: Stream of Flame
components: V, S, M (a drop of oil)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Aganazzar's Scorcher__

A gout of flame projects from your hand in a direction you choose. Each creature in a 30-foot long, 5-foot wide line must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes **4d8** fire damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success.The flames ignite any flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by **1d8** and the length of the line increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Stun Ray
components: V, S, M (a coiled copper wire)

description.value: A quick jolt darts from your raised hand at a target you can see in range, leaving a lingering smell of ozone. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target is stunned for the duration. A stunned target can make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a successful save, the spell ends.

You exhale with a concussive force. Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes **6d8** thunder damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn on a failed save, or takes half as much damage and isn't stunned on a successful one.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 5th.

name: Submerge Ship
components: V, S, M (a miniature wooden rudder inlaid with silver, worth 2,500 gp)

description.value: You connect yourself to a Large-sized or larger water vehicle you can see in range until the spell ends. While you are riding the connected vessel, you extend your senses to see and hear anything that happens around the vehicle. In addition, you can command the ship to submerge as an action.

While the ship is submerged, it gains a swim speed equal to its normal sailing speed. You control the movement of the ship on your turn while submerged. All interior spaces of the ship remain dry, even if the doorway or porthole is open while the ship is underwater.

When the spell ends, the magic lingers for an additional 1 minute. During that time, the vehicle ascends towards the water's surface if it is still submerged, at a rate of 60 feet per round. When this additional time runs out, it immediately sinks if it is still submerged.

name: Subvert Planar Essence
components: V, S, M (a tuning fork made from cold iron)

description.value: Taking command of the forces that connect the material plane to all others, you disrupt the natural defenses of outsiders. Each Celestial, Elemental, Fey and Fiend in a 20-foot radius sphere centered on a point you can see in range must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or lose all resistances and immunities to damage for the duration.

You gesture towards a creature you can see in range, and a razor-sharp stalagmite immediately bursts from the ground at their feet to impale them. The target and any creatures up to 10 feet straight above their space must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes **10d6** piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. In addition, a creature that fails its saving throw by five or more is impaled by the stalagmite and restrained. A restrained creature can use its action to break free with a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 4th.

You create a 5-foot Cube of acidic smoke at a point you can see within range. Each creature in the Cube must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take **1d8** Acid damage. The area of the Cube is Lightly Obscured with noxious fumes and lasts until the start of your next turn. A creature entirely within the Cube has Disadvantage on attack rolls.

description.name: Cantrip Upgrade
description.value: The damage increases by 1d8 when you reach levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

name: Summon Animal Spirit
components: V, S, M (a set of fine animal statuettes, collectively worth at least 200 gp)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Summon Beast__

You gather energy from the nature around you and sculpt it into a powerful spirit animal, appearing in an unoccupied space you can see within range. It uses the __Animal Spirit__ stat block, and you select either the Earth, Sea, or Sky option when you cast the spell. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends.

The creature is an ally to you and your companions. In combat, it shares your initiative count, and takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands. If you don't issue any command, it takes the Dodge action and moves only to avoid hazards.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, certain values increase in its stat block.

name: Summon Golem
components: V, S, M (a stone or iron statuette worth at least 400 gp)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Summon Construct__

You conjure raw materials and sculpt them into a construct, appearing in an unoccupied space you can see within range. It uses the __Golem Spirit__ stat block, and you select either the Flesh, Stone, or Iron option when you cast the spell. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends.

The creature is an ally to you and your companions. In combat, it shares your initiative count, and takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands. If you don't issue any command, it takes the Dodge action and moves only to avoid hazards.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, certain values increase in its stat block.

name: Summon Grave Spirit
components: V, S, M (a jeweled skull statuette worth at least 300 gp)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Summon Undead__

You summon an undead creature which manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. It uses the __Grave Spirit__ stat block, and you select the Ethereal, Ghoulish, or Bone option when you cast the spell. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends.

The creature is an ally to you and your companions. In combat, the creature shares your initiative count, and it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands. If you don't issue a command, it takes the Dodge action and moves only to avoid hazards.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, certain values increase in its stat block.

You make up to three willing creatures as surefooted as any mountain goat, which makes walking in even the most treacherous terrain child's play. For the duration, moving through nonmagical difficult terrain costs a target no extra movements.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you may target up to two additional creatures for each slot level above 1st.

name: Suspended Silence
components: V, S, M (a feather and a handful of gem dust worth 50 gp, which the spell consumes)

description.value: You sprinkle a handful of gem dust on an object in range, readying a spell to be unleashed at a later time. When you initially cast this spell, choose a command word. Until the spell ends, if you speak the command word while within 60 feet of the target the stored magic is released.

When released, no sound can be created or pass through a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on the target, which moves with the target. Any creature or object entirely inside the sphere is immune to thunder damage, and creatures are deafened while entirely inside it. Casting a spell that includes a verbal component is impossible there. Once released, the area of silence lasts for one minute before the spell ends.

A sea-green halo forms around the head of a creature you can see in range. Moments later, the target's lungs begin to fill with fetid water. For the next minute, the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw at the start of each of its turns or be incapacitated until the start of its next turn. In addition, on a failed save the target contracts __Sewer Plague__ (see "Diseases", DMG ch. 8). If the target succeeds on three of these saves, the spell ends.
A creature that doesn't need to breathe or can breathe water is unaffected by this spell.

You gain the ability to enter a pool of water and move from inside it to inside another pool of water within 500 feet. Both pools of water must be at least large enough for you to fully submerge yourself. You must use 5 feet of movement to enter a pool. You instantly know the location of all other pools of water within 500 feet and, as part of the move used to enter the pool, can either pass into one of those pools or step out of the pool that you're in. You appear in a spot of your choice within 5 feet of the destination pool, using another 5 feet of movement. If you have no movement left, you appear within 5 feet of the pool you entered.
If you enter a single large body of water, you can instead use your movement to transport yourself 500 feet in any direction within the same body of water.
You can use this transportation ability once per round for the duration.

name: Swift Flight
components: V, S, M (a bird's wing feather)

description.value: Streaks of energy flow from the back of a creature you touch, tracing the shapes of wings. The target has a Fly Speed of 60 feet and can hover until the end of its next turn. When the spell ends, the target falls if it is in the air and nothing is holding it aloft.

name: Swift Quiver (Alternate)
components: V, S, M (a quiver with a piece of ammunition)

description.value: You transmute your quiver so it produces an endless supply of nonmagical ammunition, which seems to leap into your hand when you reach for it.

On each of your turns until the spell ends, you can use a bonus action (including the bonus action used to cast this spell) to make two attacks with a ranged weapon that uses ammunition from this quiver. When you make such a ranged attack, your quiver magically replaces the ammunition you used with a nonmagical copy of that ammunition. Pieces of ammunition created by this spell disintegrate when the spell ends. If the quiver leaves your possession, the spell ends.

Choose a Humanoid within range that you can see or hear. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become cursed. While cursed, the target is shape-shifted into a Beast form for the duration. That form can be any Beast you choose that has a Challenge Rating of 1 or lower. The target's game statistics are replaced by the stat block of the chosen Beast, but the target retains its alignment, personality, Hit Points, and Hit Point Dice. The target is limited in the actions it can perform by the anatomy of its new form, and it can't speak or cast spells.
The target's gear melds into the new form. The creature can't use or otherwise benefit from any of that equipment.

The spell ends if the target is reduced to 0 Hit Points. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. When you cast this  spell using a level 6+ spell slot, if the target has eaten your food or slept in your home within the past 24 hours, or if it has shown unkindness to another creature of the chosen form in the past 24 hours, it has Disadvantage on its saving throw and the effect is permanent unless removed by __Remove Curse__, __Greater Restoration__, or similar magic. You can also choose to end the spell by using an action to dismiss it.
A creature cursed permanently by this spell regains the ability to speak after it finishes a Long Rest.
You conjure a defensive ring of spectral blades which sweep around you. Creatures within 5 feet of you must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 slashing damage.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The damage die of this spell increases at 5th level (1d8), 11th level (1d10), and 17th level (1d12).

A spectral blade of pale green force to appears at a point you can see in range, which lasts for the duration or until you cast this spell again. When you cast the spell, you can make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of the weapon. On a hit, the target takes necrotic damage equal to 2d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. In addition, the next time the target makes a saving throw in the next hour, it does so at disadvantage and the effect ends. As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the sword up to 20 feet and repeat the attack against a creature within 5 feet of it.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for every two slot levels above 5th. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the target's maximum hit points are reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.
**Replaces:** __Beacon of Hope__

You create a tiny symbol above you, which radiates hope in a 30-foot radius until the spell ends. The symbol can take whatever form you choose, such as that of your deity. As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the symbol up to 30 feet.

Each non-hostile, living creature in the symbol's radius (including you) has advantage on Wisdom saving throws, adds your spellcasting ability modifier to its death saving throws (treating rolls equal to or above 20 as a natural 20), and regains the maximum number of hit points possible from any healing.

The first time a non-hostile, living creature starts its turn in the symbol's radius, it can use a bonus action to spend one Hit Die to regain hit points as if it had taken a short rest. If the creature had fewer hit points than half its hit point maximum, it also gains an equivalent number of temporary hit points until the spell ends.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, a creature can spend one additional Hit Die as a bonus action for each slot level above 3rd.

You trace a symbol that attacks the minds of spellcasters, either upon a surface (such as a table or a section of floor or wall) or within an object that can be closed (such as a book, a scroll, or a Treasure chest) to conceal the symbol. If you choose a surface, the symbol can cover an area of the surface no larger than 10 feet in diameter. If you choose an object, that object must remain in its place, if the object is moved more than 10 feet from where you cast this spell, the symbol is broken and the spell ends without being triggered. The symbol is nearly invisible and requires a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to be found.

You decide what triggers the symbol when you cast the spell. For symbols inscribed on a surface, the most typical triggers include touching or standing on the symbol, removing another object covering the symbol, approaching within a certain distance of the symbol, or manipulating the object on which the symbol is inscribed. For symbols inscribed within an object, the most common triggers include opening that object, approaching within a certain distance of the object, or seeing or reading the symbol. Once a symbol is triggered, this spell ends. You can further refine the trigger so the spell activates only under certain circumstances or according to physical characteristics (such as height or weight), creature kind (for example, the symbol could be set to affect Aberrations or drow), or alignment. You can also set conditions for creatures that don't trigger the symbol, such as those who say a certain password.

Once triggered, the symbol remains active for 10 minutes, attacking the minds of spellcasters in a 30-foot radius sphere centered on the symbol. Any character that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there is affected. An affected creature with the Spellcasting or Innate Spellcasting trait must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or else it loses the highest level spell slot they have available of 5th level or lower.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the highest level spell slot a target can lose increases by 1 for each slot level above 5th.

name: Symphonic Nightmare
components: V, S, M (a small statue of an opened skull, within which is a miniature orchestra, worth at least 1,000 gp)

description.value: You place a curse on a creature, haunting its sleep with nightmares of a discordant orchestra. Whenever the target attempts to take a long test it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or gain none of the benefits of a long rest. In addition, on a failed save, the target gains one level of exhaustion. After succeeding on three of these saving throws, the creature breaks the curse and the spell ends.
The caster can end the curse early as an action. A creature that does not need to sleep is immune to this spell.
**Replaces:** __Psychic Scream__

You send a roiling wave of psionic energy outward in a 60-foot cone of psionic power, creating psychic storms in the brains of affected creatures. All creatures in the area must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes **10d8** psychic damage and is stunned. On a success, it suffers half as much damage and no other effects.

At the end of each of a stunned creature's turn, it rolls 1d6. Its Intelligence score is reduced by an amount equal to the roll. The creature then repeats the saving throw using its original intelligence score, gaining a bonus to the roll equal to the total amount its Intelligence score has been reduced. On a success, it is no longer stunned. If a creature's Intelligence is reduced to 0, it dies.

A creature regains 1 point of lost Intelligence after finishing a long rest. The __heal__, __mass heal__, __regenerate__, and __wish__ spells can instantly restore all lost Intelligence. __Greater restoration__ can restore 1d6 points of lost Intelligence.
**Replaces:** __Raulothim's Psychic Lance__

You send a spear of psychic energy at a creature within range. The target must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, it takes **6d8** psychic damage and is blinded and deafened until the end of your next turn. On a success, it takes half as much damage and suffers no other effects.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by **1d8** for each slot level above 4th.

You bond up to four willing creatures you can see in range together, granting them a greater understanding of one another's actions. For the duration, each bonded creature has a +2 bonus on melee attack rolls and deals an additional **1d8** damage with melee attacks against a creature if at least one of the other bonded allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the bonded ally isn't incapacitated.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you may target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

You psychically lash out at one creature you can see within range. The target must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes **3d6** psychic damage, and it can't take a reaction until the end of its next turn. Moreover, on its next turn, it must choose whether it gets a move, an action, or a bonus action; it gets only one of the three. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and suffers none of the spell's other effects.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd. The creatures must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.

With a complex input gesture, you can manipulate a technological device you can see within range. You can use this ability to perform any basic operation on the device, including, but not limited to: pressing an external button, entering a dozen keystrokes of data, performing an authorized operation (such as opening an unlocked door), dimming or brightening a screen, or muting a device that makes noise. You can't disconnect or reconnect wires, or perform an unauthorized operation without making a Hacking attempt.

You create an invisible psychic aura around yourself. For the duration, you can mentally communicate with any creature with an Intelligence score of 3 or higher within 120 feet of you. This communication is one way (you can send messages to creatures but they can't respond) and works whether or not you share a common language.
**Replaces:** __Storm of Vengeance__

You create a swirling storm cloud, centered on a point you can see and covering a cylinder with a 60-foot radius and a height up to 2,000 feet. Each creature starting its turn below the cloud must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take **4d8** thunder damage and be deafened until the start of its next turn.

As long as you maintain *concentration* on the spell, you can use your action to intensify the storm. You can add one of the following effects to the storm, which lasts for the duration. Adding an effect does not remove prior effects, though most effects can be added only once.

• **Lightning.** Lightning strikes rain down. As a bonus action, you can designate two points below the cloud to be struck by lightning. All creatures within a 10-foot radius of either point must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking **4d12** lightning damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
• **Downpour.** Torrential rain falls. The storm's entire area becomes difficult terrain, and heavily obscured to every creature except you.
• **Hurricane.** Gusting winds whip with brutal ferocity. Ranged weapon attacks in the area automatically miss. Every Huge or smaller creature starting its turn below the cloud must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be thrown 30 feet in a random direction and knocked prone.
• **Hailstorm.** Icy stones rain down. Each creature starting its turn below the cloud takes **2d10** bludgeoning damage. Any creature below the cloud has disadvantage on saving throws it makes to maintain *concentration*.
• **Expansion.** You can move the storm 120 feet or increase its radius by 60 feet. You can add this effect any number of times.

name: Tempestuous Blade
components: V, M (a simple or martial melee weapon)

description.value: As a bonus action, you infuse the melee weapon used in the casting of this spell with electrified magic. Until the start of your next turn, your attacks with that weapon deal lightning damage in place of the weapon's normal damage type.

Once per casting when you deal lightning damage with this spell, you can infuse your target with an electrical charge until the start of your next turn. If the target uses a reaction of any kind before then, this tempestuous charge is unleashed and it takes **1d6** lightning damage.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The lightning damage dealt by this spell when the creature moves at least 5 feet increases at 5th level (**1d8**), 11th level (**1d10**), and 17th level (**1d12**).

name: Temporal Shunt
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when a creature you see within 30ft is about to make an attack roll or cast a spell

description.value: You target yourself and the triggering creature. Each target must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or be thrown to the same random point in time. If the triggering creature failed, the attack or spell they were about to make is canceled before it's used. At the start of the triggering creature's next turn, each target returns to the present in the nearest unoccupied space.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, you can target an additional creature of your choice that you can see within 30ft for each slot level above 5th.

name: Tenser's Transformation
components: V, S, M (a few hairs from a bull)

description.value: You endow yourself with endurance and martial prowess fueled by magic. Until the spell ends, you can't cast spells, and you gain the following benefits:

• You gain 50 temporary hit points. If any of these remain when the spell ends, they are lost.
• You have advantage on attack rolls that you make with simple and martial weapons.
• When you hit a target with a weapon attack, that target takes an extra **2d12** force damage.
• You have proficiency with all armor, shields, simple weapons, and martial weapons.
• You have proficiency in Strength and Constitution saving throws.
• You can attack twice, instead of once, when you take the Attack action on your turn. You ignore this benefit if you already have a feature, like Extra Attack, that gives you extra attacks.
• You can drop or stow anything your holding
• You can draw up to two weapons
• You can instantly don armor that you have on your person

Immediately after the spell ends, you can drop, stow or doff anything you used this spell to draw or don. Additionally, you must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or your exhaustion increases by 1.

name: Thorn Whip
components: V, S, M (the stem of a plant with thorns)

description.value: You create a vine-like whip covered in thorns that lashes out at your command toward a creature in range. Make a melee spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes **1d6** Piercing damage, and if it is Large or smaller, you can pull it up to 10 feet closer to you.

description.name: Cantrip Upgrade
description.value: The damage increases by 1d6 when you reach levels 5 (**2d6**), 11 (**3d6**), and 17 (**4d6**).
**Replaces:** __Encode Thoughts__

You touch your head, transferring a thought into a cloud-like wisp, which appears in your hand as a Tiny, weightless, semisolid object. The color of the thought-wisp depends on the thought: ideas are yellow, memories are silver, and messages are blue.

When you cast the spell, you can limit who can receive the contents to specific creatures or creature types. A specified creature can use its action to receive whatever the thought-wisp contains, ending the spell. If no limit is specified, any creature can do so.

Any creature who can cast this spell or is *concentrating* on a spell that allows thought reading (such as __detect thoughts__ or __modify memory__) can use its action to receive what a thought-wisp contains, ending the spell. A creature *concentrating* in this manner can also cast this spell to transform thoughts it reads into a thought-wisp. Additionally, modify memory can affect thought-wisps.
A creature can touch a thought-wisp and use its action to disperse it, ending the spell.
**Replaces:** __Thunderclap__

You create a concussive pulse, producing a boom audible out to 300 feet. All other creatures within 5 feet of you must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take **1d8** thunder damage and be deafened until the end of its next turn.
The spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

name: Thunderhead
components: V, S, M (a small piece of copper wire)

description.value: Black mist forms near the ground and sweeps upward to join a small cloud forming above a creature you can see in range. Miniature peals of thunder erupt from the cloud, which moves with the target and follows it unerringly even if it becomes invisible or leaves the area. At the start of each of the target's turns while the spell lasts, the target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take **1d4** lightning damage as a miniature bolt of lightning leaps from the thundercloud to strike the target.
The spell ends if you cast it again or dismiss it as an action.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you may target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

name: Thunderlance
components: V, S, M (a small metal spear)

description.value: A gray, shimmering spear appears in your hand. This magic spear lasts until the spell ends. It counts as a simple melee weapon with which you are proficient. It deals **3d8** thunder damage on a hit and has the reach and thrown properties (range 20/60). In addition, when you use the spear to attack a target that is protected by a magical spell that increases its AC (such as shield or mage armor) of 3rd level or less, that spell ends (before resolving the attack roll).
If you drop the spear or throw it, it dissipates at the end of the turn. Thereafter, while the spell persists, you can cause the spear to reappear in your hand, no action required.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for every two slot levels above 4th.
You produce a wave of noise in a 10-foot Cone, which can be heard up to 100 feet away. Each creature in that area must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take **1d6** Thunder damage.
An echo of this noise persists for the spell's duration. If you cast this spell again before the end of your next turn, the spell is amplified and its damage becomes 1d8, instead of 1d6.

description.name: Cantrip Upgrade
description.value: The damage increases by 1d6 (or 1d8, if amplified) when you reach levels 5 (2d6 or 2d8), 11 (3d6 or 3d8), and 17 (4d6 or 4d8).

Calling upon the lost voices of dead creatures, you fill a 20-foot radius sphere centered on a point you can see with the enraged roaring of a thousand dinosaurs. Each creature and object not being worn or carried in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw. A target takes **5d8** thunder damage and is knocked prone on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature made of inorganic material such as stone, crystal, or metal has disadvantage on this saving throw. The roar can be heard for miles.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Thunderous Smite (Alternate)
components: V, M (a melee weapon worth at least 1 sp)

description.value: When you hit with a melee weapon attack, you can cause the weapon to explode with a thunderous shockwave audible out to 300 feet. This attack deals **1d8** additional thunder damage, and the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away from you in a line and fall prone. Huge and larger targets have advantage on this saving throw.
If your target is a construct or an earth elemental the bonus thunder damage increases by **1d8** and it has disadvantage on the Strength saving throw.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd-level or higher, the thunder damage increases by **1d8**, and the target is pushed an additional 10 feet away from you in a straight line for each spell slot level above 1st.

name: Tiny Hut (Alternate)
components: V, S, M (a pearl cut perfectly in half)

description.value: A 10-foot-radius immobile dome of arcane force springs into existence around and above you and remains stationary for the duration. The spell ends if you leave its area.

Nine creatures of Medium size or smaller can fit inside the dome with you. The spell fails if its area includes any Large creatures or more than nine creatures. Creatures and objects within the dome when you cast this spell can move through it freely. All other creatures and objects cannot pass through it. Spells and other magical effects cannot extend through the dome or be cast through it. The atmosphere inside the dome is comfortable and dry, regardless of the weather outside.
Until the spell ends, you can command the interior to be dimly lit or dark. The dome is opaque and dull in color as to blend in with surroundings. It is transparent from the inside.

description.name: Statistics
description.value: The dome has 100 hit points and Armor Class equal to your Spell save DC. It is immune to poison, psychic, and non-magical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, it is vulnerable to force and all magical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, and it is resistant to all other damage types. A disintegrate spell destroys it instantly.

Choose one creature within range that you can see or hear. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become cursed for the duration of the spell. When you cast the spell, choose a topic of conversation. While the target remains cursed, whenever it attempts to speak about the chosen topic, you, or this spell, a phenomenon of your choice spills forth from its lips instead of words:

• Tiny toads, snakes, moths, or other vermin
• Short-lived wildflowers in full bloom
• Black filth or bile
• Fairy tales and nursery rhymes
• Unflattering, unrelated truths about the target or those they are addressing

Attempts to circumvent the curse by writing about the subject result in crude drawings of the chosen phenomenon. If the target can communicate telepathically or another creature reads its mind, it can communicate about the curse that way.

If you have caught the target in a lie, or if it was rude or ungrateful after you granted a request from it, the target has Disadvantage on its saving throw, the spell doesn't require *Concentration*, and the effect is permanent unless removed by __Remove Curse__, __Greater Restoration__, or similar magic. You can also choose to end the spell by using an action to dismiss it.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: When you cast this spell using a level 3+ spell slot, you can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.

A burst of elemental water erupts from you in a line 30 feet long and 5 feet wide in a direction you choose, forcing any creature in that area to make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, it takes **1d12** cold damage and is knocked back 10 feet in a straight line and falls prone. On a success, it takes half as much damage and is not moved or knocked prone. A Huge or larger creature has advantage on its saving throw.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd-level or higher, the damage increases by **1d12** and it knocks back 10 additional feet for each slot level above 1st.

At your touch, a willing creature grows the armor plating of a tortoise across its torso and a tough, leathery skin elsewhere. For the duration, the target's base AC is 16 and its speed is reduced by 10 feet (to a minimum of 5 feet). The spell ends if the target dons armor or if you dismiss the spell as an action.
As long as the target is a Beast, it gains an additional +2 bonus to AC while the spell lasts.

name: Totemic Cowl
components: V, S, M (a leaf from the first day of fall)

description.value: You touch a willing creature. Until the spell ends, it is cloaked in a ghostly cowl, and any damage it takes is reduced by 2.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd-level or higher, the damage reduction from the cowl increases by 1 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Touch of Filth
components: V, S, M (a piece of rotting food)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Ray of Sickness__ (with __Minor Drain__)

You envelop your hand in a vile miasma. Make a melee spell attack against a creature within your reach. On a hit, the target takes **1d6** poison damage and is poisoned. At the end of each of its turns, it can make a Constitution saving throw, ending the poison on a success. Until the spell ends, you can make this attack again on each of your turns as an action.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by **1d6** for each slot level above 2nd.

You touch a living creature, clouding their mind. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. The target takes **3d8** psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. In addition, if the target fails its save by 5 or more, it is incapacitated until the start of your next turn.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Transfix
components: V, S, M (a drop of pine resin)

description.value: You create an area of enchantment in a 20-foot radius sphere centered on a point you can see in range, which can transfix any creature that enters it. Each Medium-sized or smaller creature that enters the area for the first time in a turn or starts its turn there must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed saving throw a target is charmed for the duration. While charmed by this spell, that creature is paralyzed.

At the end of each hour, or whenever it takes any damage, an affected creature can make a Wisdom saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. If an affected creature is removed from the area, it is freed from the spell's effects.
Once a creature has successfully saved against this spell, it is unaffected by this casting of Transfix.

name: Transient Bulwark
components: V, S, M (a pearl worth 10+ GP, which the spell consumes)

description.value: A fragile, invisible shield protects you for the duration. The next attack roll against you has a -10 penalty to hit, and the spell ends.

You transform a 10 foot cube of nonmagical material of any sort that you can see in range into an equal volume of red-hot molten lava. If the cube of lava is on a wall or ceiling, the lava flows down to the floor, spreading out in a 15-foot radius pool at the start of your next turn.

When you first cast this spell, any creature standing in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a success, that creature can move up to 5 feet into an unoccupied space adjacent to the area. Each creature or object that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes **20d6** fire damage.
The lava cools naturally as time passes, slowly reverting to stone. Each hour after being transformed, the area deals **1d6** less damage.

Two creatures instantly teleport to the others current position. A solid object such as the ground, a bridge, or a rope must connect both targets. Both targets must be within range. Objects worn or carried by the target are teleported with them, but other creatures are not. An unwilling target may make a Wisdom save to resist this effect. If either target successfully saves, the spell fails and nothing happens.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the range of this spell increases by 30 feet for each slot level above 2nd. If you cast this spell at 5th level or higher, an unwilling creature has disadvantage on its Wisdom saving throw.

For the duration, you can sense the presence and location of copper, silver, gold, electrum, platinum and precious gems within 60 feet of you. You can also identify the different kinds of materials in each case.
The spell can penetrate barriers, but it is blocked by a thin sheet of lead.

name: Tremorsense
components: V, S, M (a bit of skin from a bulette)

description.value: You touch a willing creature to grant it the ability to detect even the most subtle of vibrations. For the duration, that creature has Tremorsense out to a range of 60 feet.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you may target one additional creature for each slot level above 3rd.

Choose one spell you have prepared that is 3rd-level or lower with a casting time of an action or bonus action. As part of initially casting this spell, or as an action on your turn while the spell lasts, you may cast the chosen spell without expending a spell slot. Once you have cast the chosen spell three times, this spell ends.

name: Tricksy Switch
components: S, M (Any non-magical object you are holding)

description.value: You can instantly switch an object for someone else's. Choose a target you can see within range, that is holding a non-magical object. Using an action, its object and yours switch. Upon switching choose one of the following effects:

• **Normal Switch**: Both items switch normally.
• **Damaging Switch**: You damage the object that the creature will end up holding. For example glass will shatter, wood will crack, and metal will be bent.
• **Illusory Switch**: You make the object that the creature will end up holding appear as if it is the original object it was holding. When the creature tries to use it or stops holding it, the illusion fades.

name: Troubling Sleep
components: V, S, M (A piece of wool or a pinch of fine sand)

description.value: With a sweet, but chilling voice and some soft gestures you make creatures' sleep troubled. Choose a creature you can see within range, it must succeed a Wisdom saving throw or fall unconscious into a nightmare filled sleep. While in this nightmare, it takes **1d8** Psychic damage at the start of each of their turns.

The nightmare ends when the spell ends, or when the sleeper takes damage, other than this spell's damage, or someone uses an action to wake the sleeper. If the sleeper wakes up before the spell has ended, they are considered Frightened for the remaining duration.
Undead creatures, constructs, and creatures immune to being Charmed aren't affected by this spell.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: You may target another creature for each spell slot level above 2nd.

name: True Creation
components: V, S, M (a tiny piece of the kind of matter you intend to create, which the spell consumes)

description.value: You create a nonmagical, unattended object of any sort of matter. The object created must be no larger than a 25-foot cube, and the object must be of a form and material that you have seen before. Objects created are permanent and can be used as spell components.

name: True Polymorph
components: V, S, M (a drop of mercury, a dollop of gum arabic, and a wisp of smoke)

description.value: Choose one creature or nonmagical object that you can see within range. The creature shape-shifts into a different creature or a nonmagical object, or the object shape-shifts into a creature (the object must be neither worn nor carried). The transformation lasts for the duration or until the target dies or is destroyed, but if you maintain *Concentration* on this spell for the full duration, the spell lasts until dispelled.

When you prepare this spell, choose 5 stat blocks with a challenge rating of 18 + your spellcasting modifier or lower. You can prepare this spell multiple times, but you must pick different stat blocks each time.

An unwilling creature that is being targeted or is holding the item being targeted can make a Wisdom saving throw. If it succeeds, the spell has no effect. This spell has no effect on items worth 100,000gp or more.

description.name: Creature into Creature
description.value: If you turn a creature into another kind of creature, choose one of the prepared stat blocks to turn it into. The target's game statistics are replaced by the stat block of the new form, but it retains its saving throw modifiers, Hit Points, Hit Point Dice, alignment, and personality.

The target gains a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to the Hit Points of the new form. The spell ends early on the target if it has no Temporary Hit Points left. It looses these temporary hit points if the spell ends.
The target is limited in the actions it can perform by the anatomy of its new form, and it can't speak or cast spells.
The target's gear melds into the new form. The creature can't use or otherwise benefit from any of that equipment.

description.name: Object into Creature
description.value: If you turn an object into a creature, choose one of the prepared stat blocks to turn it into. The stat block's creature size must be no larger than the object's size. The creature is Friendly to you and your allies. In combat, it takes its turns immediately after yours, and it obeys your commands.
If the spell lasts more than an hour, you no longer control the creature. It might remain Friendly to you, depending on how you have treated it.

description.name: Creature into Object
description.value: If you turn a creature into an object, it transforms along with whatever it is wearing and carrying into that form, as long as the object's size is no larger than the creature's size. The creature's statistics become those of the object, and the creature has no memory of time spent in this form after the spell ends and it returns to normal. The object must not be worth more than 500gp and it cannot be expended while the change is not permanent.

name: True Resurrection
components: V, S, M (diamonds worth 25,000+ GP, which the spell consumes)

description.value: You touch a creature that has been dead for no longer than 2 centuries and that died for any reason except old age. It must make a DC 10 death saving throw.

On a success, the creature is revived with all of its Hit Point. If its also a natural 20, the spell does not consume its material component. On a failure, this spell cannot be used to revive this creature. This restriction ends if the creature is revived through other means. If its also a natural 1, the creature can never be revived.

This spell closes all wounds, neutralizes any poison, cures all magical contagions, and lifts any curses affecting the revived creature when it died. The spell replaces the revived creature's damaged or missing organs and limbs. If the revived creature was Undead, it is restored to its non-Undead form.

The spell can provide a new body for the revived creature if the original no longer exists, in which case you must speak the creature's name. It appears in an unoccupied space you choose within 10 feet of you.

name: True Strike
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when a willing creature within 10 feet would fail an attack roll

description.value: Add a d4, potentially turning it into a success. Do not add it if a positive bonus has already been applied to the roll by a spell. You can cast this once and regain all uses after a short rest.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: The number of uses increases by 1 at 5th level (2 uses), 11th level (3 uses), and 17th level (4 uses).

name: True Strike (Alternate)
components: S, M (a melee weapon worth at least 1 sp)

description.value: You infuse your weapon with divination magic and point it at one creature you can see. The next time you make a melee attack with this weapon against that target before the start of your next turn, you add (1d4) to your attack roll.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: This spell's attack roll bonus increases when you reach 5th (1d6), 11th (1d8), and 17th level (1d10).

name: Tunnel Swallow
components: V, S, M (a lump of chewed food)

description.value: You cause a section of tunnel, up to 20 feet wide and 50 feet long to flex with peristaltic convulsions, crushing contents and moving them along its length in the direction you designate. Each creature in the area must make a Strength saving throw. A creature takes **12d8** bludgeoning damage and is pushed up to 30 feet towards the end you designate on a failed save, or it takes half as much damage and is not pushed on a successful one.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the damage increases by 2d8 for each slot level above 6th.
**Replaces:** __Whirlwind__

You call down a huge tornado at a point you can see on the ground within range. The twister occupies a 30-foot radius, 100-foot high cylinder centered on that point. As an action, you can move the twister up to 30 feet along the ground.

When a creature enters the twister on its turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, it takes **10d6** bludgeoning damage, and a Large or smaller creature is sucked up into the twister and restrained. Restrained creatures move with the twister when it moves and are carried vertically 25 feet each round toward the twister's center. At the end of each of its turns, a restrained creature can repeat the saving throw. On a success, it is hurled 60 feet horizontally out of the twister in a random direction.
The twister's area is lightly obscured, and ranged attacks that pass through the twister automatically miss.

name: Unbinding
components: V, S, M (a lodestone and a pinch of saltpeter)

description.value: You release a burst of energy, which coalesces around a creature you can see in range. When you cast unbinding, all spells or magical effects that charm, paralyze, frighten, petrify, stun or restrain the target end and the target is immune to such spells for the duration. In addition, any magical barriers (such as wards or walls) do not impede the target and magical difficult terrain costs no additional movement. This does not prevent damage dealt by spells, even those that also impede movement.
**Replaces:** __Crown of Madness__

You plant an unquenchable rage in the mind of one humanoid you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become charmed by you, its eyes glowing with a fiery light. When you cast the spell and as an action on subsequent turns, you can activate this rage.

If you activate a target's rage, it must move up to its speed at the start of its turn towards the nearest creature and use its action to make one melee attack against that creature. If you don't activate its rage or it can't reach another creature with its movement, the target takes its turn as normal. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on a success.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the target makes two melee attacks if it has an ability that would normally allow it to make more than one attack on its turn.
You touch a nonmagical weapon. Until the spell ends, the weapon becomes a magic weapon, which deals an extra **2d6** damage to Undead.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for every two slot levels above 2nd.

You designate one willing creature in range as your lieutenant, granting it a measure of command over the Undead in your control. For the duration, the target can give orders to any Undead under your direct control (such as those created by the animate dead spell). Any orders given by you supersede orders given by your lieutenant.
You may choose to end the spell early as an action.

name: Undead Torch
components: V, S, M (a firefly or glowworm)

description.value: With a dark incantation, a willing Undead creature you can see in range bursts into blue flames, which shed dim light in a 20-foot radius. The flames do not harm the target, and any melee attacks it makes count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage and deal an additional **2d6** necrotic damage. Undead, Constructs and Elementals are unaffected by this additional damage.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for every two slot levels above 3rd.

A familiar and soothing song wells up in your mind, helping you to focus on the task at hand. For the duration, whenever you are forced to make a Constitution saving throw to maintain your *Concentration*, you can instead make a Charisma (Performance) check instead.

name: Unearth Legend
components: V, S, M (rare gems worth at least 250 gp, which the spell consumes, and a jeweled notebook worth at least 200 gp)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Legend Lore__

You contact an otherworldly entity, offering it the gems used in the spell's casting in exchange for the history of a person, place, or object. The entity tells you everything it knows about the subject (typically well-known lore or widely-told stories).

After it is contacted, the entity researches the subject for up to seven days. Its discoveries appear as writing in the jeweled notebook. It might learn obscure myths, forgotten legends, or even lost secrets. The more information you possess when you cast the spell, the faster and more detailed the results will be. The entity may not understand the information it finds, and so might impart unsolved riddles, confusing poems, or other puzzling communications. Once the entity has conveyed everything it can discover, the spell ends.
**Replaces:** __Mordenkainen's Faithful Hound__

You conjure an arcane sentry in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. It can take any form you wish, but is obviously magical in nature, and is always Small or Medium. It lasts for the duration, until you dismiss it, until you move 100 feet from it, or until you cast the spell again.

When you cast the spell, designate any number of creatures you can see as the sentry's allies. The sentry is invisible to everyone except its allies, and if any other creature of challenge rating 1/4 or higher comes within 60 feet of it, it calls out an alarm. It can see invisible creatures, see into the Ethereal Plane, and cannot be deceived by illusions.

As an action on your turn, you may direct the sentry to attack a target you can see within 100 feet of its original location. It can move up to 30 feet, and attack a creature within 5 feet of it. Make a melee spell attack. On a hit, it deals **4d8** force damage. If you are incapacitated, unconscious, or otherwise unable to direct the sentry, then at the end of your turn it attacks the nearest creature of challenge rating 1/4 or higher that is not its ally.

You touch a willing creature, causing thick tree roots to anchor it to the ground and provide it with life sustaining healing. For the duration, the creature has a speed of zero and can't benefit from any bonus to its speed. The target has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws and any attempts to move the creature against its will automatically fail. In addition, the target regains 30 hit points at the start of each of its turns and ends any poison or disease currently affecting it.
The creature must be touching the ground when the spell is cast to have an effect on it. This spell has no effect on Constructs or Undead.

name: Updraft
components: V, S, M (a miniature propellor or windmill)

description.value: Detritus and loose debris on the ground beneath you begins to spin about, caught in a small vortex, which quickly coalesces into a column of dirty gray-brown air thick enough to hold you aloft. When you cast the spell, you are propelled up to 30 feet into the air, then gently float back down to the ground. While you descend, you can use any movement you have remaining to move horizontally. You take no falling damage on the turn you cast this spell.

name: Uptick
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when a creature you can see within 90 ft would fail an attack roll, ability check or saving throw

description.value: You tick back time a single second, allowing the target to roll another d20. Compare the number on the die of both rolls to 18. If the new number's distance from 18 is greater than the old number's distance from 18, it replaces it.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell at a higher level, subtract 1 from the number your comparing to for each additional spell level.
You imbue a willing creature with a fighting spirit. For the duration, whenever the target takes the attack action on its turn, it can make one additional attack as part of that action.
Swirling wisps of darkness obscure your form, surrounding you and obscuring you from foes. For the duration, you are lightly obscured.

name: Verdant Slumber
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when a creature within range is reduced to 0 HP or fails a Death Saving Throw

description.value: With a burst of power, you preserve a creature in mortal peril in magical slumber. The creature instantly falls asleep and has Immunity to all damage for the duration of the spell. It has the Unconscious condition for 24 hours, then awakens as if it had finished a Long Rest. You can also end the spell prematurely as an action, awakening the creature with 1 Hit Point.

If you move the creature to an area of fertile soil and natural growth, the duration of its slumber extends to a year and a day, as moss and vines grow over it. When you sleep within 60 feet of the creature, you can communicate with it in dreams. Many creatures preserved in this way are willing to share knowledge in exchange for eventual release, and you have Advantage on Charisma checks that you make to interact with it.

You can extend the duration of the creature's slumber by another year and a day by casting this spell again on the day that the duration would end. Otherwise, it wakes as if it had finished a Long Rest.

You unleash a string of insults laced with subtle enchantments at one creature you can see or hear within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take **1d6** Psychic damage and have Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes that does not already have disadvantage before the end of its next turn.

description.name: Cantrip Upgrade
description.value: The damage increases by 1d6 when you reach levels 5 (**2d6**), 11 (**3d6**), and 17 (**4d6**).

You unleash a string of provoking words at a creature that can hear and understand you within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw, or it takes 1d6 psychic damage and have disadvantage on every attack roll against targets other than you until the start of your next turn.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: This spell's damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th (**2d6**), 11th (**3d6**), and 17th level (**4d6**).

You bathe a 10-foot radius sphere, centered on a point you can see in range, with sacred light. Each creature that ends its turn in the area regains one hit point. You can end this spell early as an action.

name: Vile Death
components: V, S, M (a bit of brimstone and a bloodstone worth 5000 gp, which the spell consumes)

description.value: You summon the spirit of a Fiend and bind it to the body of an Undead creature with a Challenge Rating of 3 or higher. The target permanently gains several benefits:

• If the target has an Intelligence of less than 12, its Intelligence becomes 12.
• The target gains resistance to cold damage as well as resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
• The target has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magic effects.
• The target gains immunity to fire and poison damage.
• The target is immune to the poisoned condition.
• The target has telepathy out to 120 feet.
• The target gains darkvision out to 120 feet.
• •The target gains the Fiend creature type in addition to its Undead creature type. It can be affected by any game effects that work on either of its creature types.

name: Vine Mine
components: V, S, M (a crown of ivy leaves)

description.value: You create an explosion of plant growth in a 10-foot radius sphere centered on a point you can see in range. When you cast this spell, choose one of the following effects:

• **Climbing.** The vines form into convenient handholds and footholds throughout the entire area. Any creature can climb them as easily as a regular ladder.
• **Binding.** The vines wrap themselves around anything in the area. Each creature that ends its turn in the area must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be restrained by the vines until the spell ends or you change the effect. A creature restrained by the plants can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC. On a success it frees itself.
• **Hindering.** The vines are thick and gnarled, turning the entire area into difficult terrain.
• **Camouflage.** The vines sprout a thick cover of foliage. Any creature in the area is heavily obscured.
You invoke the blessings of a divine being. For the duration, you grant a willing creature the following benefits:

• The target gains resistance to acid, cold and lightning damage if they are Evil, or resistance to cold, fire and radiant damage if they are Good or Neutral.
• The target can use Charisma instead of Strength or Dexterity for attack and damage rolls with weapon attacks.
• The target gains darkvision out to a range of 60 feet.

name: Viscid Glob
components: V, S, M (a tiny ball of spider silk)

description.value: You fling a small glob of viscous material at a Huge-sized or smaller creature you can see in range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target is restrained for the duration as the glob expands and dries on the target. A creature restrained by this spell can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC. Once it has succeeded on this check three times, the spell ends.
Applying a pint or more of alcohol can dissolve the glob instantly, as does Oil of Etherealness or Universal Solvent.

For the duration, you can speak and understand Draconic. In addition, any creature that can understand you and speaks with you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration, or until you or any of your companions do anything harmful to it. A charmed creature regards you as a friendly acquaintance. This spell has no effect on creatures you or your companions are fighting.

name: Vorpal Blade
components: V, S, M (the finger bone of a necromancer)

description.value: You conjure a blade of pure negative energy in your empty hand and make one melee weapon attack against a creature within your reach, attempting to behead it. On hit, it takes force damage equal to **6d8** + your spellcasting modifier.
If this damage reduces the creature to 50 hit points or fewer, you instantly cut off one of its heads of your choice
The creature instantly dies if it cannot survive without the lost head. The creature's head is not removed if it is immune to slashing damage, or if it doesn't have or need a head.

A huge school of transparent piranhas swirls rapidly through the air around a point you can see in range. The vortex creates a 40-foot radius, 20-foot high hollow cylinder with a 5-foot radius safe zone in the center. A creature takes **8d4** piercing damage when it enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 2d4 for each slot level above 4th.

You magically twist space around another creature you can see within range that is large or smaller. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (they can choose to fail), or the target is teleported to an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range. The chosen space must be on a surface or in a liquid that can support the target without the target having to squeeze.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the range of the spell increases by 30 feet for each slot level above 2nd.

You unleash a terrible cry of malice and anger. Each creature in a 30-foot cone must make a Wisdom saving throw. A creature takes **8d6** psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. In addition, each creature that fails its save is frightened of you for 1 minute. A creature frightened by this spell can make a Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect for itself on a success.
Whenever a hostile creature dies due to damage from this spell, each creature in a 5-foot radius sphere centered on that creature takes **2d6** psychic damage.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by 2d6 for each slot level above 5th.
**Replaces:** __Wall of Sand__

You construct a wall of blowing dirt and grit at a point you can see within range. The wall can be up to 30 feet long, 10 feet high, and 10 feet thick. The wall blocks line of sight, and a creature is blinded and deafened while within the wall.

When a creature enters the wall or starts its turn there, it must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, each foot that the creature moves through the wall costs 6 feet of movement. On a success, each foot that the creature moves through the wall only costs 3 feet of movement.
The wall disappears when the spell ends.

name: Wall of Force
components: V, S, M (a shard of glass)

description.value: An Invisible wall of force springs into existence at a point you choose within range. The wall appears in any orientation you choose, as a horizontal or vertical barrier or at an angle. It can be free floating or resting on a solid surface. You can form it into a hemispherical dome or a globe with a radius of up to 10 feet, or you can shape a flat surface made up of ten 10-foot-by-10-foot panels. Each panel must be contiguous with another panel. In any form, the wall is 1/4 inch thick and lasts for the duration. If the wall cuts through a creature's space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (you choose which side).

Nothing can physically pass through the wall. It has an AC of 5 and 120 hit points. It can't be dispelled by __Dispel Magic__. A __Disintegrate__ spell destroys the wall instantly, however. The wall also extends into the Ethereal Plane and blocks ethereal travel through the wall.

name: Wall of Force (Alternate)
components: V, S, M (powder from crushed clear gemstone)

description.value: A shimmering opaque wall of force springs into existence at a point you choose within range and lasts for the duration.

description.name: Orientation & Shape
description.value: The wall appears in any orientation you choose, as a horizontal or vertical barrier or an angle. It can be free floating or rest on a solid surface. You can form it into a hemispherical dome, a sphere with a radius of up to 10 feet, or you can shape a flat surface made up of ten 10-by-10-foot panels. Each panel must be contiguous with another. In any form, the wall is 1/4 inch thick. Nothing can pass through the wall physically, and anything viewed through it is lightly obscured. The wall extends into the Ethereal Plane, blocking ethereal travel through the wall. If it cuts through a creature's space when it appears, the creatures must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a success, it chooses which side of the wall it moves to. On a failure, you choose the side it moves to.

description.name: Statistics
description.value: The wall has 150 hit points and its Armor Class equals your Spell save DC. It is immune to poison, psychic, and non-magical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, vulnerable to force and magical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, and resistant to all other damage types. It cannot be dispelled by a __dispel magic__ spell, but a __disintegrate__ spell destroys the wall it instantly.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th-level or higher, the hit points of the wall created by this spell increase by 25 for each spell slot level above 5th.

A massive wall made of machinery springs into existence, occupying ten contiguous five-foot squares that you can see in range. Each section is five feet wide, ten feet tall, and 6-inches thick, consisting of a mass of moving iron cogs, wheels, gears, pistons and assorted mechanical parts.

When you cast the spell, choose one of the following damage types: bludgeoning, piercing or slashing. When the wall appears, each creature within its area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes **6d6** damage of the chosen type, or half as much on a successful save. If a creature would be surrounded on all sides by the wall (or the wall and another solid surface), that creature can use its reaction to move up to its speed so that it is no longer enclosed by the wall on a successful save. Each creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of the wall takes **6d6** damage of the chosen type. As a bonus action, you can change the type of damage the wall deals.

Each five-foot square has an AC of 19 and 20 hit points. If a section of the wall is reduced to 0 hit points, it is destroyed and no longer impedes movement in that space. At the end of each of your turns, destroyed sections of the wall regenerate.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by 2d6 for each slot level above 5th.

name: Wall of Gloom
components: V, S, M (a bit of fleece from a black sheep)

description.value: You create a wall of dark shadows to appear. You can make the wall up to 40 feet long, 10 feet high and 1 foot thick, or a ringed wall up to 15 feet in diameter, 10 feet high and 1 foot thick. The wall is opaque, blocking all light from passing through it, and lasts for the duration. Dark whispers constantly issue forth from the wall, making any speech heard from the opposite side of the wall to be completely unintelligible.

The wall is insubstantial, so creatures can move through it freely. The first time a creature moves through the wall in a turn or starts its turn in the same space as the wall, it takes **4d4** psychic damage.

You conjure forth a writhing mass, which rises up and forms a wall comprised of thousands of wriggling arms. You can make the wall up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick, or a ringed wall up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick. The wall provides total cover, though creatures can move through the wall, treating it as difficult terrain.

Each creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the wall or attempts to pass through the wall for the first time on a turn must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes **5d8** bludgeoning damage, or half as much damage on a successful one. In addition, if a creature attempting to pass through the wall fails its saving throw, it is caught by the grasping arms and is restrained until the spell ends. A creature that starts its turn in the area and is already restrained by the arms takes **5d8** bludgeoning damage.
A creature restrained by the arms can use its action to make a Strength or Dexterity check (its choice) against your spell save DC. On a success, it frees itself.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 5th.

With a wave of your hands, black smoke swirls into existence as a dark wall. You can make the wall up to 30 feet long, 10 feet high and 1 foot thick, or a ringed wall up to 10 feet in diameter, 10 feet high and 1 foot thick. It lasts for the duration or until a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses it.

The area is heavily obscured and any creature that enters the area for the first time in a turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 minute. A creature poisoned by the wall may make a Constitution save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

name: Wall of Thorns (Alternate)
components: V, S, M (a handful of thorns)

description.value: You conjure a wall of thick plant growth bristling with thorns hard as iron. It appears in range on a solid surface. The wall can be up to 60 feet long, 10 feet high, and 5 feet thick. Or, it forms a 20-foot diameter circle, 20 feet high and 5 feet thick.

When it appears, creatures within it must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take 5d8 piercing damage and remain within the wall. On a successful save, they take half as much damage and move to an adjacent space of its choice not within the area of the wall.

description.name: Moving Through
description.value: Any creature can painfully move through the wall, but it must spend 4 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves within it. The first time a creature enters the wall or begins its turn in it, it must make a Dexterity saving throw. It takes 5d8 piercing damage on a failure, half on a success.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th-level or higher, the whirlwind is 10 feet taller and it deals an additional 2d6 thunder damage every time it deals damage for each slot level above 7th.

You let loose a victorious cry, inspiring panic in your enemies. The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before this spell ends, the attack deals an extra **2d6** damage to the target. Additionally, the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of you for 1 minute. While this spell lasts, you deal an additional **1d6** psychic damage to any creature you hit with a weapon attack that is frightened of you.
A creature frightened by this spell makes a Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a successful save, it is no longer frightened.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the initial damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2nd.
**Replaces:** __Blade Ward__

You make a magical sign, creating a protective ward around yourself. The ward has 4 hit points and is resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. For the duration, whenever you take damage, the ward takes the damage instead. If this damage reduces the ward to 0 hit points, you take any remaining damage and the spell ends.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the ward's hit points increase by **2d4** for each slot level above 1st.

name: Water Wall
components: V, S, M (a vial of pure water)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Wall of Water__

You summon a wall of swirling water at a point you can see on the ground within range. The wall can be up to 30 feet long, 10 feet high, and 5 feet thick, or shaped as a ring up to 15 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick. Each foot moved through the wall costs 3 feet of movement. The wall's water disappears when the spell ends.

A creature that starts its turn in the wall or enters it on its turn must make a Strength saving throw, suffering **2d6** bludgeoning damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
