Ranged attacks passing through the wall have disadvantage and deal half damage. Fire effects passing through are instantly extinguished. Cold effects passing through apply to any creature within 5 feet of the point they touch the wall. Lightning effects apply half their damage to any creature in contact with the wall when they pass through.

You cause water to rise up into a whirling, 5-foot radius, 80-foot tall cylinder centered on a point you can see in range, which must contain a body of water at least 10 feet wide and 20 feet deep. Any object that isn't being worn or carried or any creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn in the area of the waterspout must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes **10d6** bludgeoning damage and, if it is Large or smaller, is carried to the top of the waterspout before being thrown out the top to land prone 10 feet away in a random direction. To determine the direction, roll a d8 and assign a direction to each die face. On a successful save, a creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet to any side of the waterspout. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw.

As a bonus action, you may move the waterspout up to 30 feet horizontally. When the waterspout moves into the space of a creature or object, that creature or object must make a saving throw as if it had ended its turn in the waterspout's area. A creature can only be affected by the waterspout once each time you move it.

Emitting a mournful wail, you send out a pulse of magic imbued with sorrow and sadness in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the cone must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or have disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks for the duration. Undead and creatures immune to being charmed aren't affected by this spell.

name: Wayfinding
components: V, S, M (two divinatory tools to indicate direction or display an image, such as a pendulum and a mirror, worth 100 gp)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Find the Path__

You name a specific location on the same plane of existence, receiving supernatural knowledge regarding the way between you and the destination. If the destination moves to another plane, the spell fails.

When you cast the spell, choose one of the following options, the effects of which last for the duration of the spell. While the spell lasts, you can end one option as an action to gain the benefits of a different one:

• **Dowsing.** The pendulum tugs in a direction with increasing urgency as you near your destination, informing you of its distance and direction.
• **Ascertainment.** Whenever you are presented with a choice of paths along the way to the destination, the pendulum points towards the shortest and most direct route (ignoring safety).
• **Forecast.** The mirror displays images of the next 30 miles on the path to the destination, granting a general awareness of natural hazards or obstacles, such as decaying bridges or cliffs.
As a bonus action you give a creature, you can see within 30 feet, disadvantage on D20 Tests, until the start of your next turn.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The duration of the spell increases by 1 round for each spell slot level above 1st.

name: Weapon Shift
components: V, S, M (one nonmagic melee weapon worth at least 1 cp)

description.value: You touch the weapon used in casting this spell, transforming it into a different nonmagic simple or martial melee weapon of your choice. The new weapon must be composed of the same materials as the original weapon. You may end the spell early during your turn, no action required. The weapon transforms back when the spell ends. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three transformed weapons active at a time.

name: Weather Eye
components: V, S, M (a bowl, mirror, crystal ball, or other scrying device)

description.value: You accurately predict the natural weather that will occur over the next week in a 1-mile radius sphere centered on you. If the current weather is unnatural (such as the result of a spell or other magical effect), you become aware of this, though gain no other information on the cause.

name: Web
components: V, S, M (a bit of spiderweb)

description.value: You conjure a mass of sticky webbing at a point within range. The webs fill a 20-foot Cube there for the duration. The webs are Difficult Terrain, and the area within them is Lightly Obscured.

If the webs aren't anchored between two solid masses (such as walls or trees) or layered across a floor, wall, or ceiling, the web collapses on itself, and the spell ends at the start of your next turn.

Whenever a creature is in the affected area it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be restrained by the webs until the start of it's next turn. After a creature makes this saving throw it doesn't need to do so again until the start of its next turn. If the creature leaves the area, they are no longer restrained.

At the start of each of its turns the restrained creature can repeat the saving throw. On a success it is no longer restrained. As an action the target or a creature the target is within reach of can make a Strength (Athletics) check against the save DC. On a success, it is no longer restrained.

If the webs are exposed to fire they all burn. Any creature that is restrained by the webs while they are burning takes **2d4** fire damage. Once they take this damage they cannot take it again until the start of their next turn. After 1 round of burning, all the webs are burned away and the spell ends.
Drawing on the deepest fears, regrets, and primal instincts of a creature, you create the illusion of the most horrifying thing imaginable to them, which is visible only to that creature.

Choose a point within range, and creatures of your choice within a 30-foot radius of the point become frightened for the duration. If a target is immune to the frightened condition, it must make a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened anyway.
At the end of each of a frightened creature's turns, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or it takes **4d10** psychic damage. On a success, the spell ends for that target.

name: Wellspring
components: V, S, M (a tiny silver watering can)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Healing Spirit__

You pour out a stream of pure water and create a 10-foot radius magical healing pool at a point on the ground you can see within range. At any time (no action required by you) you can choose to restore 2d4 hit points to any creature in the pool, depleting the pool's magic. The pool's magic is restored at the start of each of your turns.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell with a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the healing increases by **1d4** and the radius of the pool increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Whirling Blade
components: V, S, M (a melee weapon worth at least 1 sp)

description.value: You hurl the weapon used to cast this spell, which continues whirling forward in a 5-foot wide, 60-foot long line. Make a single melee spell attack against each creature in the line. On a hit, the creature takes the weapon's normal damage dice + your spellcasting ability modifier damage. The weapon automatically returns to your hand after reaching the end of the line.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can roll one of the weapon's damage dice one additional time for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Whirling Blades
components: V, S, M (a shard of metal)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Cloud of Daggers__

You produce a storm of metal shards that occupy a 5-foot diameter sphere in a space you can see within range. A creature takes **4d4** slashing damage when it enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there.

As an action, you can cause the blades to point and shoot at a creature within 30 feet of the sphere. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, targets take **4d4** piercing damage, or half as much damage on a miss. Hit or miss, the spell then ends.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by **2d4** for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Whirling Water
components: V, S, M (a droplet of water)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Watery Sphere__

You create a swirling ball of water in a 10-foot radius at a point on the ground or in water you can see within range. Any creature that enters the sphere on its turn or starts its turn in it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be restrained and trapped within the water. At the start of each of its turns, a restrained target can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success. A Huge or smaller creature partially within the sphere makes its saving throw with advantage, while a Gargantuan creature automatically succeeds.

As an action, you can cause the sphere to roll up to 30 feet, carrying all restrained creatures with it and dousing all nonmagical flame it passes through. If this causes a creature in the sphere to collide with a creature outside it, both creatures take **4d6** bludgeoning damage. Restrained creatures are not affected by any terrain the sphere passes over.

As a bonus action, you can hurl a restrained creature out of the sphere. It is thrown 20 feet in a direction of your choice and takes **4d6** bludgeoning damage. If it collides with another creature, that creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take **4d6** bludgeoning damage.
When the spell ends, creatures restrained by it fall prone, and all fires within 20 feet are extinguished. The water disappears afterward.
**Replaces:** __Maelstrom__

You conjure a 30-foot radius circle of churning water centered on a point on the ground or in a body of water which you can see within range. The whirlpool's area is difficult terrain, but it is not deep enough to require swimming. Any creature that starts its turn there or enters on its turn must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, it takes **5d8** bludgeoning damage and is pulled 10 feet towards the center. If the spell targets an existing body of water, the damage increases by 1d8.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by **1d8** for each slot level above 5th.

name: Whirlwind (Alternate)
components: V, M (a single leaf or piece of straw)

description.value: You magically transmute the winds in the area to conjure a powerful tornado under your control. This whirlwind appears as a 10-foot radius, 50-foot high cylinder centered on a point you can see in range. The whirlwind sucks up any Medium or smaller objects that aren't being worn or carried or otherwise secured when they enter its space for the first time.

Any creature that enters the whirlwind's space must make a Strength saving throw. They take 10d6 thunder damage on a failure, and half as much on a successful save. Any Large or smaller creature that fails its saving throw is also sucked into the Whirlwind and Restrained in it. Each creature can only be forced to make this saving throw once per turn.

Restrained creatures move with the Whirlwind, and at the start of each of its turns it is Restrained within it, it takes 2d6 thunder damage and moves 10 feet up within the whirlwind. When a creature moves beyond the top of the whirlwind, it is thrown 60 feet in a random direction and lands Prone.
As an action, any Restrained creature can make a Strength check against your Spell save DC. On a successful check, it is thrown from whirlwind 60 feet in a direction of its choice.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th-level or higher, the whirlwind is 10 feet taller and it deals an additional 2d6 thunder damage every time it deals damage for each slot level above 7th.

You intone words that will give you and up to six other willing creatures speed and stamina for the long journey ahead. This spell doubles the overland travel speed of all targets, so long as they are all traveling together in the same direction. This spell has no effect in combat.

You evoke the powers of the sky, and the wind picks up around you. It blows from your back, wrapping itself around your allies' missiles, sending them to their targets more surely. When you cast this spell, choose up to five willing creatures. For the duration, their ranged weapon attacks have advantage, and their normal and long ranges are each doubled.

With the sound of whirling wind, you will a frigid air to overcome your foe. A creature you can see in range must make a Constitution saving throw. The target takes **2d8** cold damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. If the target fails its save by 5 or more, it also gains one level of exhaustion. Levels of exhaustion caused by this spell go away after one hour. A creature that has resistance or immunity to cold damage cannot gain levels of exhaustion from this spell.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st.

You clutch the air as though grabbing a nearby creature, then blow on your fist. As you do so, ice and snow appear around a creature you can see in range. When you cast this spell, or as a bonus action on subsequent turns you can force the target to make a Constitution saving throw. The target takes **4d8** cold damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. If the target fails its save by 5 or more, it also gains one level of exhaustion. Levels of exhaustion caused by this spell go away when the spell ends. A creature that has resistance or immunity to cold damage cannot gain levels of exhaustion from this spell.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 3rd.
Wish is the mightiest spell a mortal can cast. By simply speaking aloud, you can alter reality itself.

Cast another spell of 8th level or lower without expending a spell slot or its casting time. You do not need to know the spell or have it prepared. This spell's casting time is the casting time of the spell you pick. You don't need to meet any requirements to cast the spell, including costly components.

Instead of casting another spell you can make a boundless wish. State your wish to the DM as precisely as possible. The DM chooses a casting time and effect based on the wish. They can utilize any room for interpretation in the wish to make it do something other than what you intended. If the effect would be more powerful than the spells you could have casted with this spell, the DM prevents this by reducing the power of the effect, adding unintended consequences, or a combination of both.

The stress of casting Wish to produce any effect other than duplicating another spell weakens you. After enduring that stress, each time you cast a spell until you finish a Long Rest, you take **1d10** Necrotic damage per level of that spell. This damage can't be reduced or prevented in any way. In addition, your Strength score becomes 3 for 2d4 days. For each of those days that you spend resting and doing nothing more than light activity, your remaining recovery time decreases by 2 days. Finally, there is a 33 percent chance that you are unable to cast Wish ever again if you suffer this stress.

You make a wish upon the source of your magic. Roll a d2 - 1 and cast a spell of your choice. Its level must be equal to or less than your roll's total and it must be on the spell list that you prepared this spell from. You can prepare this spell multiple times as long as it is prepared from a different spell list each time. You do not expend the casting time or components (except for costly components) to cast it. The casting time of this spell becomes the casting time of the spell you chose. Once you cast Wish Upon in this way, you can't cast it again until you finish a short rest.

Instead of casting a spell of your choice, you can speak aloud a wish. It can be no more than 10 words and it must start with "I wish". The DM chooses a casting time and effect based on the wish. They can utilize any room for interpretation to make the wish do something other than what you intended. If the effect would be more powerful than the spells you could have chosen, the DM prevents this by reducing the power of the effect, adding unintended consequences, or a combination of both. Once you cast Wish Upon in this way, you can't cast it again until you finish a long rest.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell at a higher level, add a d2 - 1 to the roll for each additional spell level.

name: Witch Bolt (Alternate)
components: V, S, M (a piece of wood struck by lightning)

description.value: A beam of crackling energy lances out toward a creature within range, forming a sustained arc of lightning between you and the target. Make a ranged spell attack against that creature. On a hit, the target takes **1d12** lightning damage, and neither you nor the target can move more than 30 feet away from each other while this spell lasts.

You can use an action on each subsequent turn to deal an additional 1d12 lighting damage to the creature. A creature can attempt to move beyond the range of the spell by using its action to make a Strength check against your Spell save DC. If another creature attempts to move the target of this spell beyond the range of this spell it can use its action to make a Strength check against your Spell save DC. Any attempts by the target or another creature (magical or mundane) to move the target beyond this range automatically fail.
The spell immediately ends if you are forced to move more than 30 feet away from the target of this spell.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, both the initial and subsequent damage increases by **1d12** for each slot level above 1st.

You clench your hand in a grasping motion toward a creature within range, wrapping the target with twisting ribbons of shadow. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have the Grappled condition and be held in place for the duration. A creature Grappled by this spell can take an action to make a Strength or Dexterity check (its choice) against your spell save DC. If it succeeds, it is no longer Grappled.

If the target of this spell has attacked you or forced you to make a saving throw within the last minute and has never been damaged by you, it has Disadvantage on its saving throw. On a failure, you can choose for the target to take **1d8** Necrotic damage as part of the casting of this spell, and an additional **1d8** Necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns while Grappled by this spell.
The spell ends if the target is ever outside the spell's range.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: When you cast this spell using a level 2+ spell slot, the initial damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 1.

You attempt to wither the limbs of a creature you can see in range. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be affected for the duration. When you cast this spell, choose one of the following options:

• **Arms.** The affected creature cannot use objects (including using weapons) or cast spells with somatic components. The target drops anything it was holding when the spell was cast.
• **Legs.** The affected creature falls prone and is unable to stand up while the spell lasts. The target's speed is reduced by 10 feet.
• **Wings.** The affected creature loses the use of its wings. If it has a fly speed requiring the use of its wings, its fly speed is reduced to 0.

The target suffers no negative effects from this spell if it does not possess the chosen limbs. When the spell ends, the withered limbs return to normal. An affected creature can make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on a success.

name: Withering Field
components: V, S, M (a fistful of fine sand and a drop of blood)

description.value: **Replaces:** __Abi-Dalzim's Horrid Wilting__

You shrivel and decay every living thing within a 30-foot cube you can see within range, sucking the life away until the targets crumble to dust. Each creature in the area must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target takes **12d8** necrotic damage, has its speed halved and has disadvantage on all of its attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half as much damage and suffers no other effects.
Constructs and undead automatically succeed on this saving throw, while plants have disadvantage. Anything reduced to 0 hit points while under the spell's effect crumbles to dust.

Make a melee weapon attack against a creature in range. If the attack hits, the target takes **10d10** necrotic damage and must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target's Strength and Dexterity scores are reduced by 1d10. The target dies if this reduces either of those scores to 0. Otherwise, this reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest. If the target fails its save by 5 or more, the reduction lasts indefinitely.

You speak a word of power, as a set of shining steel manacles appear around the wrists and ankles of a creature you can see in range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be bound until the spell ends. While bound, the target is restrained. In addition, if it attempts to cast a spell requiring somatic components, it must first make a Dexterity or Strength check against your spell save DC. On a success, it can cast the spell normally. On a failure, the spell fails and has no effect.
As an action, the bound creature can make a Dexterity check against your spell save DC. On a success, it frees itself.

You recite a word of authority to a creature you can see within range, which must make a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition until the end of your next turn. A creature targeted by this spell within the last 24 hours automatically succeeds on its saving throw against it.

While Charmed, the target doesn't move or act unless verbally commanded by you to do so. You can issue commands to the target (no action required), such as "Attack that creature," "Move over there," or "Fetch that object." The target does its best to obey on its turn.

You recite a word of magical force to a creature you can see within range, which makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes **1d6** Force damage, is pushed 10 feet away from you, and has the Prone condition. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

You and up to five willing creatures within 5 feet of you instantly teleport to a previously designated sanctuary. You and any creatures that teleport with you appear in the nearest unoccupied space to the spot you designated when you prepared your sanctuary (see below). If you cast this spell without first preparing a sanctuary, the spell has no effect.
You must designate a location, such as a temple, as a sanctuary by casting this spell there.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a 7th level spell slot or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 6th.

You recite a word of fear to a creature you can see within range, which makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes **2d6** Psychic damage and has the Frightened condition until the end of your next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 2.

You recite a word of banishment to a creature you can see within range, which must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature vanishes from its current plane of existence and appears on the Ethereal Plane (the spell ends instantly if it is already on that plane).

You can give the target the Incapacitated condition while it is on the Ethereal Plane. While on the Ethereal Plane, the target can perceive the plane it left, which is cast in shades of gray. It can affect and be affected only by other creatures on the Ethereal Plane, and creatures on the other plane can't perceive it unless they have a special ability that lets them perceive things on the Ethereal Plane.
The target returns to the plane it left at the start of your next turn, appearing in the nearest unoccupied space to the location it left.
**Replaces:** __Harm__

You send a surge of negative energy into a creature that you can see within range. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it takes **14d6** necrotic damage, or half as much damage on a success. The target's hit point maximum is reduced for 1 hour by an amount equal to the necrotic damage it took.

The words of this spell produce hissing, sibilant echoes that spin around you, invoking doom upon those who dare to harm you. You can end this spell early by using an action to dismiss it. While the spell lasts, you have resistance to psychic damage. In addition, whenever a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, the whispers lash out at their mind. The attacker takes **2d6** psychic damage.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage dice increases to d8.

You attempt to curse a creature you can see in range with crippling pain. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes **8d10** psychic damage and is paralyzed until the spell ends. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and is not paralyzed. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make another Constitution saving throw. On a success, the spell ends on the target.

In addition, on a failed save, the target is frightened of you for another 10 minutes after you stop *Concentrating* on this spell. A creature frightened by this spell can make a Wisdom saving throw at the end of each or its turns. On a successful save the target is no longer frightened.

The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack during this spell's duration, it drains the life of the target hit, dealing an additional **2d10** necrotic damage to the target. Additionally, the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have its hit point maximum reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd-level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 2nd.

You brandish a whip, and a creature you can see in range must make a Wisdom saving throw. The target takes **12d10** psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. In addition, on a failed save the target is stunned and falls prone. At the end of its next turn, a stunned creature must make another Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature dies. On a successful save, the creature is no longer stunned.

name: Wrathful Smite
casting_time: Bonus action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike

description.value: The target takes an extra **1d6** Necrotic damage from the attack, and it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Angered condition until the spell ends. At the end of each of its turns, the Angered target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: The damage increases by **1d6** for each spell slot level above 1.

name: Wrathful Smite (Alternate)
components: V, M (a melee weapon worth at least 1 sp)

description.value: When you hit with a melee weapon attack you can cause the weapon to strike at both body and mind. This attack deals an additional **1d8** psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw, or it is frightened of you until the spell ends. As an action, the creature can repeat this Wisdom saving throw, ending the effects of the spell on a success.
If your target is an aberration or it can speak telepathically this bonus psychic damage increases by **1d8**.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd-level or higher, the psychic damage increases by **1d8** for each spell slot level above 1st.

name: Wreathe
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take before a willing creature you can see within 60 ft hits or misses with an attack roll.

description.value: If the attack deals damage, change up to 5 of the damage to a damage type of your choice. On a hit, deal 1 extra damage of the damage type you chose.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell at a higher level, increase the extra damage by 1 and increase the amount of damage that is converted to a different damage type by 5 for each additional spell level.

In a fit of shakes and spasms, you take on a monstrous semi-humanoid shape unique to you and your magic. When you cast this spell, you gain 20 Temporary Hit Points. Describe your new form and choose one of the following benefits:

• Huge, molting feathers and a flying speed of 30 feet
• Squamous skin, the ability to breathe water, and a swimming speed of 60 feet
• Shaggy fur hide and an AC of 13 + your Wisdom modifier.

For the duration of the spell, you gain the chosen qualities and you have Advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws and ability checks. As a Bonus Action, you can make a melee spell attack against a creature within reach. On a hit, you deal **2d10** acid damage.

You can end the Wyrding early as an action. If the spell doesn't end early, you become cursed until the curse is lifted by __Remove Curse__, __Greater Restoration__, or similar magic. While cursed in this way, you remain trapped in your Wyrding form, and you lose the ability to speak, read, write, understand language, or cast spells with Verbal components.

description.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
description.value: When you cast this spell using a level 5+ spell slot, the Temporary Hit Points it grants increase by 5 and the damage you deal with your melee spell attack increases by 1d10 for each spell level above 4.

name: Xorn Movement
components: V, S, M (a scale from a xorn's hide)

description.value: You grant a willing creature the ability to move through earth and stone with the ease of a xorn. For the duration, the target can move across difficult terrain made of earth or stone without spending extra movement. The target can move through solid earth or stone as if it was air without destabilizing it. The target can breathe normally, even while surrounded in earth and rock. If the target is still surrounded in earth or rock when the spell ends, it is ejected to the nearest unoccupied space and stunned until the end of its next turn.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you may target one additional creature for each slot level above 4th.

You invoke a divine shield to protect you as you close with a chosen opponent. When you cast this spell, choose one hostile creature within 120 feet. Attack rolls made against you by creatures other than the target have disadvantage. In addition, your movement doesn't provoke attacks of opportunity as long as you are moving closer to the target.

You can cast this spell as a bonus action before making an attack roll with a weapon. Give the attack roll advantage. Immediately after the attack hits you can move up to 10 ft in a straight line without provoking opportunity attacks.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell at higher levels, increase the distance you move by 10 ft for each additional level (up to a maximum of 60 ft).

name: Zero Gravity
components: V, S, M (a lodestone and iron filings)

description.value: This spell creates a zero gravity environment within a 30-foot radius Sphere, centered on a point you can see within range.

In a zero gravity environment, creatures and objects hang in the air until they are moved. A creature in zero gravity can move only by pushing or pulling against a fixed object or surface within reach (such as a wall or a ceiling), which allows it to move as if it were climbing. Its Speed is otherwise 0. Once a creature or object is set into motion, it can't stop moving until it collides with an obstacle. A creature automatically continues its movement at the same speed at the start of each of its turns, and an object set in motion moves with the same speed each round after it was moved.
Creatures and objects in an area of zero gravity have no weight, but still may require significant force to move. When the spell ends, affected objects and creatures fall downward.

name: Zone of Respite
components: V, S, M (a small amount of blood from a gorgon)

description.value: You create a 20-foot radius sphere centered on yourself that is temporarily warded against interplanar intrusion. Conjuration spells cast within the area automatically fail and have no effect. In addition, any spell or effect that would teleport a creature or object into the area fails and has no effect.
The spell ends if you dismiss it as an action or cast this spell again.

description.name: At Higher Levels
description.value: When you cast this spell using certain higher level spell slots, the duration increases: 24 hours with a 5th-level slot, 1 week with a 7th-level slot and until dispelled with a 9th-level slot.

name: Zone of Revelation
components: V, S, M (a handful of ash from an undead creature)

description.value: You ward a 30-foot radius sphere centered on a point you can see against that which is hidden. Anything in the area can be perceived by any creature looking at it as if they had truesight.
